people.bio: Holds a B.Sc. (Agriculture) from Junagadh Agricultural University and an MBA in agribusiness from Allahabad Agricultural Institute. Before Dharmaj he worked at Cheminova India, Crop Life Science, Sumitomo Chemical India and Excel Crop Care. He joined in 2016 to run brand management, sales and marketing, and became CEO on 6 January 2023. He also promoted a group company, Khetipoint Private Limited.

people.name: Vikas Mohanlal Agarwal
people.bio: A chartered accountant and company secretary with more than 20 years in manufacturing companies, mainly chemicals. His work covers corporate and business finance, controllership, tax, risk management and planning, and he has handled the merger of a listed company and the set-up of chemical and textile projects. He earlier worked at Indokem (formerly Refnol Resins & Chemicals) and Soma Textiles & Industries. He became CFO on 26 November 2024.

companies.changes: Head of Operations for the Saykha plant, Bhupendra Varasada (senior management), resigned on 8 July 2026. Independent director Amisha Shah resigned on 7 August 2026 and Megha Joshi joined the board.

companies.styleNote: Part of the Bhilwara-based Ostwal group, founded by M.K. Ostwal, who is non-executive Chairman. His son Praveen Ostwal is MD; his other son Pankaj Ostwal is a non-executive director here and MD of the sister company Madhya Bharat Agro Products. A long-serving CFO sits on the board as whole-time director. The group buys and sells heavily with its other companies (Ostwal Phoschem, Madhya Bharat), so related-party approvals are large. Promoters own about 72.9%, mostly through the holding company Ostwal Phoschem (India) Ltd (67.4%).

people.name: Praveen Ostwal
people.relation: Son of Chairman M.K. Ostwal; brother of director Pankaj Ostwal
people.stake: 2.46% (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); promoter group about 72.9%, mostly via Ostwal Phoschem (India) Ltd (67.4%)
people.bio: A chartered accountant, aged 45, with over two decades in fertilisers, mineral beneficiation and chemicals. He runs the company day to day, with a focus on production, technical supervision and new technology, and gives strategic direction across group companies. He is also MD of group company Shri Ganpati Fertilizers and a non-executive director of Madhya Bharat Agro Products, where he has been on the board since 2004.

people.name: Sunil Kothari
people.bio: A chartered accountant with over two decades in the industry. He joined the company in 2008 and runs finance, accounts and commercial functions, with particular depth in audit and tax matters. He is on the board as a whole-time director as well as CFO.

companies.changes: No executive changes since the FY26 annual report. Independent director Priyanka Surana completed her term on 24 June 2026 and Archana Dangi joined.

companies.styleNote: Part of the Bhilwara-based Ostwal group. Founder M.K. Ostwal is non-executive Chairman; his son Pankaj Ostwal is MD, and his other son Praveen Ostwal (MD of sister company Krishana Phoschem) is a non-executive director. A long-serving CFO sits on the board as whole-time director. The group trades heavily between its companies, so related-party approvals are large. Promoters own about 71.4%, mostly through the holding company Ostwal Phoschem (India) Ltd (65.2% at March 2026); a preferential issue approved in July 2026 dilutes this by about 5%.

people.name: Pankaj Ostwal
people.relation: Son of Chairman M.K. Ostwal; brother of director Praveen Ostwal
people.stake: 0.94% (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); his HUF 0.30%; promoter group about 71.4%, mostly via Ostwal Phoschem (India) Ltd
people.bio: A chartered accountant, aged 48, with over two decades in fertilisers, mineral beneficiation and chemicals. As MD he leads financial and strategic planning and international business; he runs the company as it builds the Dhule fertiliser complex, which takes capacity from 9 to 15.6 lakh tonnes. He also gives strategic direction across the group and is a non-executive director of Krishana Phoschem.

people.name: Sourabh Gupta
people.bio: A chartered accountant who has been with the company since 2010. He manages finance, accounts, tax and the overall commercial side of the business, and sits on the board as a whole-time director as well as CFO.

companies.changes: No executive changes since the FY26 annual report. Paras Mal Surana was re-appointed as an independent director.

companies.styleNote: Controlled by Zuari Maroc Phosphates, a joint venture of the Adventz (Saroj Kumar Poddar) group's Zuari Agro Chemicals and Morocco's state phosphate company OCP. Saroj Kumar Poddar is non-executive Chairman and his son Akshay Poddar non-executive Vice Chairman; two OCP executives sit as non-executive directors. Long-serving Adventz group professionals run the company: MD & CEO N. Suresh Krishnan and, from April 2026, Joint MD & COO Rajeev Nambiar. Promoters own about 57.9% after the Mangalore Chemicals merger.

people.name: N. Suresh Krishnan
people.since: Board since February 2020; re-appointed to February 2029
people.stake: 1,40,477 shares, a tiny fraction of 1% (FY26 annual report)
people.bio: An alumnus of BITS Pilani (B.E. Hons. and M.Sc.), aged 62, with over 35 years across fertilisers, energy, sugar and cement. Within the Poddar group he has been MD & CEO of Zuari Agro Chemicals, Mangalore Chemicals & Fertilizers and Zuari Industries. He is the immediate past Chairman of the Fertiliser Association of India and a former board member of the International Fertilizer Association. He also sits on the board of the promoter, Zuari Maroc Phosphates. His strengths are projects, manufacturing, restructuring and mergers; he was MD through the merger of Mangalore Chemicals into Paradeep, which took effect in October 2025.

people.name: K.K. Rajeev Nambiar
people.role: Joint Managing Director & Chief Operating Officer
people.since: Joined January 2024 as President & COO; Joint MD since April 2026
people.bio: A mechanical engineer from NIT Surathkal, aged 54, with over 31 years in industry. He spent 21 years at ACC, in operations, large project execution and trade sales, where he commissioned the largest kiln at ACC Wadi and turned round loss-making units. From 2015 he was at Shree Digvijay Cement, rising to MD & CEO and turning round its 75-year-old 1.2 million-tonne plant. He joined Paradeep in January 2024 and runs the plants and day-to-day operations, supporting the MD.

people.name: Harshdeep Singh
people.bio: An engineer from NIT Rourkela with a master's in international business from IIFT, who also did the Tata Strategic Leadership Programme at Harvard Business School (2012). He began his career at Hindustan Unilever in 1995, in roles including Regional Business Manager. He has long experience in agribusiness and FMCG across brand management, supply chain, procurement and sales, and runs sales and marketing at Paradeep.

people.name: Bijoy Kumar Biswal
people.bio: A chartered accountant with over 23 years in finance, including about eight years in Adventz group companies. He was Finance Controller of Zuari Agro Chemicals in Gurgaon and CFO of Forte Furniture Products India in Chennai before becoming Paradeep's CFO. He is responsible for finance, accounts and tax.

companies.changes: No executive changes since the FY26 annual report (August 2026). Rajeev Nambiar became Joint MD on 1 April 2026, and Suresh Krishnan was re-appointed MD from 16 February 2026.

companies.styleNote: Run by the Dhanuka family. Founder Dr. R.G. Agarwal is Chairman Emeritus (not on the board). His brother M.K. Dhanuka is executive Chairman, his son Rahul Dhanuka is MD, and M.K. Dhanuka's son Harsh Dhanuka is an executive director; a cousin, Manish Dhanuka, is a non-executive director. Family members hold few shares directly; the family owns 69.5% mainly through two trusts (Triveni Trust 57.1%, Pushpa Dhanuka Trust 10.2%). A long-serving CFO runs finance.

people.name: Mahendra Kumar (M.K.) Dhanuka
people.relation: Brother of Chairman Emeritus R.G. Agarwal; father of Harsh Dhanuka; uncle of MD Rahul Dhanuka
people.stake: 0.06% directly (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); his HUF 0.43%; promoter group together 69.5%, mostly via family trusts
people.bio: A B.Com (Hons.) graduate of Shri Ram College of Commerce, Delhi University, with 52 years in the agrochemical industry. As Chairman he oversees corporate affairs and finance: he chairs the banking, finance and operations committee and the CSR committee and sits on the audit committee. The company credits him with keeping it debt-free with no long-term borrowing.

people.name: Rahul Dhanuka
people.since: Promoter; over 28 years with the company
people.relation: Son of Chairman Emeritus R.G. Agarwal; nephew of Chairman M.K. Dhanuka; cousin of Harsh Dhanuka
people.bio: Holds an MBA from S.P. Jain Institute of Management & Research and has a corporate career of more than 28 years. As MD he runs all operations and is credited with pushing sales deep into rural India, bringing in ERP and new systems, and managing the relationships with its multinational technology partners. He chairs the board's risk management committee.

people.name: Harsh Dhanuka
people.relation: Son of Chairman M.K. Dhanuka; cousin of MD Rahul Dhanuka
people.bio: Holds a BBA (marketing and HR) and a master's in international business from Monash University, Melbourne. He trained across accounts, finance, HR and R&D, then spent over seven years in sales as Sales, Regional and Zonal Manager, and was earlier Vice President-Marketing. He started the Sales Excellence function, handled international partnerships and new patented products, and now runs day-to-day operations reporting to the MD, with added charge of exports and the Dahej technicals plant. He is 43.

people.name: Ashish Saraf
people.bio: A commerce graduate of Shaheed Bhagat Singh College, Delhi University, with over three decades in business. He was promoter and CEO of Narayan International, a trade and consultancy firm in New Delhi, from 1988 to 2013, and then COO and consultant at Mauria Udyog (terry towels) from 2013 to 2017. He joined Dhanuka's board as a whole-time director in March 2017 and oversees CSR, administration, HR and safety. He is 56.

people.name: Vinod Kumar (V.K.) Bansal
people.bio: A chartered accountant (ICAI membership no. 86263) who has been Dhanuka's CFO for several years; he was already CFO on the company's July 2020 earnings call. He is a member of the board's risk management committee and signs the financial statements with the MD. The company does not publish a fuller profile.

companies.changes: Senior managers K.B. Kejariwal (May 2026) and Abu Khalid, head of quality (30 June 2026), retired. Shalinder Singh joined as General Manager-Sales on 3 August 2026.

companies.styleNote: Founded and controlled by the Agarwal family of Lucknow; promoters own about 63.7%, led by Anand Swarup Agarwal (31.2%). In June 2026 he and his sons Vishal and Vishwas Swarup Agarwal left the board, which the company called a move to a professionally managed board. The only promoter still on the board is non-executive director Rahul Arun Bagaria (0.24%). The chair is an independent director, Dr. Madhu Dikshit. Long-serving professionals run the business: CEO Dheeraj Kumar Jain, CFO Satya Prakash Gupta and two chemist whole-time directors.

people.name: Dheeraj Kumar Jain
people.since: With the company over 25 years; CEO since January 2021 (re-appointed to January 2031)
people.bio: Holds bachelor's and master's degrees in chemical engineering from Osmania University, Hyderabad. Before joining the company he worked at the Indian Institute of Chemical Technology, Hyderabad. Over more than 25 years at India Pesticides he has run product development, international business development and project engineering. He became CEO in January 2021 and was re-appointed for five years from January 2026. In June 2026 the PMFAI Agribusiness Foundation gave him a lifetime achievement award.

people.name: Satya Prakash Gupta
people.since: With the company over 25 years; CFO since 2020 (re-appointed to September 2030)
people.bio: A commerce graduate of the University of Allahabad and an associate member of both the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India and the Institute of Cost Accountants of India. He has over 27 years in finance, more than 25 of them at India Pesticides. Earlier he worked at Delite Commercial and Trimurtee Fertilisers. He has been CFO since 2020 and was re-appointed for five years from September 2025.

people.name: Dr. Udaya Bhaskar Mantripragada
people.bio: A chemist, aged 64, with over 35 years in synthetic organic chemistry, dyestuffs, agrochemicals and formulations. He holds an M.Sc. in organic chemistry from Roorkee University, an M.Phil. from Nagarjuna University and a Ph.D. in natural products and synthetic chemistry. He has published 33 international research papers and holds 11 patents, and held senior posts at leading agrochemical companies, developing commercial processes for fungicides, herbicides and insecticides. The company's website earlier listed him as Vice President for project management, production and business development; he joined the board in July 2025.

people.name: Dr. Kuruba Adeppa
people.since: Joined June 1997; whole-time director since July 2024
people.bio: Holds a Ph.D. in organic chemistry from Gautam Buddh Technical University, Lucknow, and has over 33 years in agrochemical and pharmaceutical manufacturing. Before joining in 1997 he worked at Vantech Industry and Dr. Reddy's Laboratories, Hyderabad (1993-97). He has developed many of the company's commercial processes for fungicides, herbicides and insecticides and was earlier its Vice President-R&D. He is 55.

companies.changes: On 6 June 2026 the promoter family's three non-executive directors, Anand Swarup Agarwal and his sons Vishal and Vishwas Swarup Agarwal, resigned from the board. No change in the executive team.

companies.styleNote: A family company that traces its start to 1972, when the founder and his brother decided to make helmets; it was incorporated in 1983. Founder Madhu Bhushan Khurana is Chairman and MD, his son Sidhartha is MD and his daughter Shilpa Arora runs international sales. The three are the named promoters. The promoter group owns 61.75% after selling shares in the November 2025 IPO. A hired CFO took over in July 2026.

people.name: Madhu Bhushan Khurana
people.relation: Founder; father of MD Sidhartha Bhushan Khurana and Whole-time Director Shilpa Arora
people.stake: 28.30% (30 Jun 2026 shareholding pattern; same at 31 Mar 2026); promoter group together 61.75%
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in aeronautical engineering from Punjab Engineering College, Chandigarh. Before incorporating the company he was already an entrepreneur making two-wheeler helmets. He has been on the board since 1983 and oversees administration, finance strategy and management. He sold part of his stake in the November 2025 IPO, which was entirely an offer for sale, and his holding fell from 37.95% to 28.30%. He is 78; shareholders approved his continuing past 70 at the 2025 AGM. His FY26 pay was about ₹2.8cr.

people.name: Sidhartha Bhushan Khurana
people.relation: Son of Chairman Madhu Bhushan Khurana; brother of Whole-time Director Shilpa Arora
people.stake: 29.75% (30 Jun 2026 shareholding pattern; same at 31 Mar 2026), the largest single holder
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in aeronautical engineering from Punjab Engineering College, Chandigarh. He has spent his whole career, more than 25 years, in the company and oversees administration, finance and management. He also sold shares in the 2025 IPO (his stake fell from 31.79% to 29.75%). His stated goal is more than ₹1,000cr of revenue in three to four years, driven by the premium SMK brand, exports, the new Facility V plant and new products such as riding gear and Bluetooth devices. His FY26 pay was about ₹2.7cr.

people.name: Shilpa Arora
people.role: Whole-time Director & Global Sales Head (outside India, Nepal and Bangladesh); CEO of US subsidiary Bikerz US
people.relation: Daughter of Chairman Madhu Bhushan Khurana; sister of MD Sidhartha Bhushan Khurana
people.stake: 0.46% (FY26 annual report and 30 Jun 2026 shareholding pattern)
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in dental surgery from Manipal Academy of Higher Education and an MBA from the University of Toronto. She worked for nearly 15 years at Rogers Communications in Canada, leaving as senior director of demand and planning. She then spent about three years in marketing and management at Bikerz, the group's US distribution business. Since August 2024 she has led international sales and marketing, now about 20% of revenue, and is CEO of Bikerz US, which made its first profit in FY26. She is 52.

people.name: Bharat Goyal
people.bio: A chartered accountant with more than 17 years in financial control, statutory reporting, treasury and budgeting. He has worked at Tata 1mg Technologies (AGM, financial control and statutory reporting), Daikin Airconditioning India (head of accounts and finance) and Honda Cars India (revenue accounting, budgets, banking and treasury). He had also worked at Studds before, as finance controller and DGM-finance. He has led SAP S/4 HANA roll-outs and finance automation projects.

companies.changes: Manish Mehta, CFO since 2018, moved to Vice President-Taxation & Compliance on 1 Jul 2026 and then resigned from the company on 27 Aug 2026. Bharat Goyal became CFO on 1 Jul 2026.

companies.styleNote: Founded in 1985 by Dr Ramachandra N Galla, whose son Jayadev Galla is now Chairman, MD and CEO. Jayadev's nephews, the brothers Harshavardhana and Vikramadithya Gourineni, are executive directors running the lead-acid and new-energy businesses; both were reappointed for five years from June 2026. No director holds shares personally; the family owns 32.86% through Amara Raja Enterprises Pvt Ltd (formerly RNGalla Family Pvt Ltd). Hired professionals head finance, operations and the business units.

people.name: Jayadev Galla
people.since: With the company since 1985 (co-founder); board since 1994; current term to Aug 2030
people.relation: Son of founder Dr Ramachandra N Galla; uncle of Executive Directors Harshavardhana and Vikramadithya Gourineni
people.stake: nil personally (FY26 annual report); family holds 32.86% through Amara Raja Enterprises Pvt Ltd
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in political science and economics from the University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign. Before joining the family business he was an international sales executive at GNB Battery Technologies in the US. He joined the board in 1994 and rose to MD; under him revenue crossed ₹10,000cr and exports to the Indian Ocean region grew. He was a Telugu Desam Party MP for Guntur from 2014 to 2024 and said in January 2024 that he was leaving politics to focus on the business and its ₹9,500cr lithium-cell programme. He was reappointed CMD for five years from 1 Sep 2025. He sits on World Economic Forum and CII bodies.

people.name: Harshavardhana Gourineni
people.since: Board since 12 Jun 2021; reappointed to Jun 2031
people.relation: Nephew of CMD Jayadev Galla; brother of Executive Director Vikramadithya Gourineni
people.stake: nil personally (FY26 annual report); a director of promoter company Amara Raja Enterprises (32.86%)
people.bio: Holds a degree in industrial and organisational psychology from Purdue University. He began his career at Johnson Controls (now Clarios) in the US, working on manufacturing and demand planning. He then held roles in group companies and was MD and CEO of Mangal Industries, the group plastics firm, where he added customers such as Samsung and IKEA. Since 2021 he has run the automotive and industrial battery businesses, more than US$1.5bn of revenue, and led the launch of AGM and EFB batteries and the battery-recycling plant at Cheyyar, Tamil Nadu. He is 38.

people.name: Vikramadithya Gourineni
people.since: Joined 2013; board since 12 Jun 2021; reappointed to Jun 2031
people.relation: Nephew of CMD Jayadev Galla; brother of Executive Director Harshavardhana Gourineni
people.stake: nil personally (FY26 annual report); a director of promoter company Amara Raja Enterprises (32.86%)
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in biochemistry from the University of Wisconsin-Madison. He joined the company in 2013 as a management executive and worked across supply chain, procurement, marketing and sales. Since 2021 he has led the new-energy business: he set up the lithium subsidiary Amara Raja Advanced Cell Technologies in 2022 and is building the Giga Corridor in Telangana, including the planned 16 GWh cell and pack plant and the e+ Energy Labs. He also oversees the chargers and power-systems subsidiary and sits on the board of battery maker Inobat. He is 37.

people.name: Y Delli Babu
people.bio: A chartered accountant. He has held senior finance roles in Amara Raja group companies since 2010 and joined Amara Raja Batteries' finance and accounts team in November 2013. He was Deputy CFO for about two years before becoming CFO in February 2019.

people.name: Chandrasekar Radhakrishnan
people.role: Chief Business Officer - Automotive & Home Energy (India and SAARC)
people.bio: Holds a B.Tech from Manipal University and a master's in marketing studies from NMIMS, Mumbai. He brings experience from other large brands and took over the domestic automotive battery business (Amaron) from Rajesh Jindal when Jindal's tenure ended during FY26.

people.name: M M Venkata Krishna
people.bio: A mechanical engineering graduate who attended a general management programme at IIM Bangalore. He joined Amara Raja as an engineer trainee in 1991 and spent most of his career in industrial-battery marketing and sales around India. He has headed marketing, sales and operations of the industrial business and was a business head before his current role.

people.name: Narayan Choudhary
people.bio: A mechanical engineer with a master's in management. He brings long experience of running plants and P&Ls in the automotive and industrial sectors, including greenfield projects, supply chains and Lean, TPM and Six Sigma programmes. He replaced C Narasimhulu Naidu, whose tenure ended on 31 Mar 2026.

companies.changes: Several senior managers handed over on 31 Mar 2026: Dwarakanadha Reddy B succeeded S Vijayanand as head of the lithium subsidiary ARACT, Divakar S succeeded Indeevar Govardhanagiri as head of international business, and COO C Narasimhulu Naidu's tenure ended. The two Gourineni brothers were reappointed as executive directors for 2026–2031.

companies.styleNote: There is no promoter family. The promoter is Chloride Eastern Ltd, a UK holding company that owns 45.99% but has no executive role. The chairman, Sridhar Gorthi, is independent; Rajan B Raheja is non-executive vice-chairman (a Raheja-group company, Hathway Investments, owns 4.32%). Hired professionals run the company: MD and CEO Avik Roy with three whole-time directors, all hired in the last few years.

people.name: Avik Roy
people.since: Joined 2 Jan 2019; board since 1 May 2021; MD & CEO since 1 May 2024
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in electrical engineering from Jadavpur University, Kolkata and an executive MBA from the Asian Institute of Management, Manila. He has about 30 years in industrial businesses. Before Exide he was Vice President and business unit head at Siemens Ltd India, and had worked abroad as Director-Strategy at Siemens AG, Germany and as a director of Siemens Energy in Bangladesh; he also worked at Crompton Greaves. He joined Exide in 2019 as President-Industrial, ran the industrial and submarine battery businesses as an executive director, and became MD and CEO in May 2024 for a three-year term. He is also on the board of the lithium-cell subsidiary Exide Energy Solutions.

people.name: Manoj Kumar Agarwal
people.since: Joined 2 Feb 2023 as Deputy CFO; whole-time director and CFO since 1 May 2025 (term to Apr 2028)
people.bio: A commerce graduate from Goenka College of Commerce, Kolkata, and a chartered accountant and company secretary. He has more than 30 years in finance, accounts, audit, treasury, tax, procurement, IT, M&A and IPOs, and in managing overseas subsidiaries. Before Exide he held senior positions at Vedanta and Tega Industries. He joined as Deputy CFO in 2023 and succeeded long-time CFO Asish Kumar Mukherjee in May 2025. The board gave him a 30% rise in basic salary from May 2026, subject to shareholder approval. He is 55.

people.name: Rajeev Khandelwal
people.role: Executive Director (heads trade: replacement and retail batteries)
people.since: Joined 20 Nov 2024; whole-time director since 1 Sep 2025 (term to Aug 2028)
people.bio: An engineer from Visvesvaraya Regional College of Engineering, Nagpur, with an MBA in marketing from SP Jain Institute of Management, Mumbai. He has more than 30 years in consumer goods, at P&G, Gillette and Reckitt, and most recently as President-Strategy and Business Expansion for the RPSG Group's FMCG business. He has worked in India, Sri Lanka, Singapore and Africa. At Exide he runs marketing, sales and service for the trade business across mobility, inverter and other replacement batteries.

people.name: Pravin Saraf
people.role: Executive Director; MD & CEO of lithium subsidiary Exide Energy Solutions (EESL)
people.since: Joined 23 Oct 2024; whole-time director since 1 Sep 2025 (term to Aug 2028)
people.bio: A mechanical engineer from the Government College of Engineering, Pune with an MBA in materials management. He has more than 35 years in manufacturing and operations at Bajaj, Bosch, Endurance Technologies and Crompton Greaves Consumer Electricals, and has run both greenfield and brownfield expansions. He joined Exide as Senior President and Head-Operations and now heads Exide Energy Solutions, which commissioned its first lithium-cell plant in Bengaluru in September 2026.

people.name: Prabal Bose
people.bio: A chemistry graduate with an MBA in marketing. He is a business-to-business leader with experience in energy, mobility, electrification and infrastructure customers. At Exide he heads the institutional (business-to-business) sales business.

people.name: Indranil Chatterjee
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in production engineering and an advanced management diploma from the Wharton School, University of Pennsylvania. He has long experience in manufacturing, capacity expansion, process improvement and recycling operations. He heads Exide's manufacturing operations.

companies.changes: No KMP changes since the annual report. In 2025 the top team was rebuilt: Manoj Agarwal replaced Asish Kumar Mukherjee as Director-Finance and CFO in May 2025, and Rajeev Khandelwal and Pravin Saraf joined the board as executive directors in September 2025.

companies.styleNote: Founded in 1989 by J.K. Jain and his wife Seema Jain, and still run by the family. In a succession step from 1 June 2026, J.K. Jain moved from Chairman & MD to Executive Chairman, his son Rahul Jain became MD and his daughter Aanchal Jain became Joint MD. Two long-serving non-family executives, Joint MD Rajesh Sharma and Whole-time Director K.R. Yadav, also sit on the board. The family owns 54.5%.

people.name: J.K. (Jagjeevan Kumar) Jain
people.relation: Founder; husband of Seema Jain; father of Rahul Jain and Aanchal Jain
people.stake: 20.56% (FY26 annual report and June 2026 shareholding); family and promoter group together 54.52%
people.bio: A graduate of the University of Delhi, he co-founded the company with his wife in February 1989 and has more than five decades in automotive lighting. He grew it from a single small-scale unit into nine plants supplying Indian and global vehicle makers, mainly two-wheeler makers, and pushed it to build its own R&D, design centres in Italy and Japan, and test labs. The company credits his financial caution for its zero-debt balance sheet. He was Chairman & MD until May 2026; as Executive Chairman (term to August 2030) he now focuses on strategy, diversification and mentoring the next line of leaders. He is 74.

people.name: Rahul Jain
people.since: Board since 2004; Joint MD until May 2026; MD since June 2026
people.relation: Son of J.K. Jain and Seema Jain; brother of Aanchal Jain
people.bio: Holds a Bachelor of Science degree and studied management at the University of Bradford, UK. He joined the board in November 2004 and has led manufacturing operations across all plants, business development, corporate planning and operational-excellence work. He was re-appointed Joint MD in October 2025 and re-designated Managing Director from 1 June 2026 to run day-to-day operations and carry out the long-term plan. He is 39.

people.name: Aanchal Jain
people.since: Board since 1999; Joint MD since June 2026
people.relation: Daughter of J.K. Jain and Seema Jain; sister of Rahul Jain
people.bio: Holds an MBA from Indiana Institute of Technology, USA. She began her career at the company and has been on the board since December 1999. She leads human resources, employee engagement and organisational development, and also works on operations and business development. She was a Whole-time Director until May 2026, when she was re-designated Joint MD; shareholders re-appointed her for a further five years from April 2027. She is 44.

people.name: Rajesh Sharma
people.since: Joined 2003; Whole-time Director 2020; Joint MD since November 2023
people.bio: A science graduate with more than 40 years in auto components, he joined Fiem in September 2003. His career has been in marketing, business development, sales, relationships with vehicle makers and new product development, across car and two-wheeler customers. He joined the board as Whole-time Director in January 2020 and became Joint MD in November 2023, re-appointed for five years from January 2025. He is 63 and is not related to the promoters.

people.name: Seema Jain
people.relation: Co-founder; wife of J.K. Jain; mother of Rahul Jain and Aanchal Jain
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in science from the University of Delhi and comes from a business family. She co-founded the company with her husband in 1989 and has worked in it for more than 40 years. As Whole-time Director she oversees finance and administration and the company's CSR work. Shareholders re-appointed her for five more years from April 2027. She is 71.

people.name: Kashi Ram (K.R.) Yadav
people.since: With the company since inception; board since October 2008
people.bio: Educated to matriculation, he has about 49 years of experience in production and manufacturing and has been with Fiem since it started. He runs production at the North India plants, covering capacity, workforce, quality systems and delivery. He joined the board in October 2008 and was re-appointed for three more years from October 2026. He is 70 and not related to the promoters.

people.name: O.P. Gupta
people.bio: A member of the Institute of Chartered Accountants, the Institute of Company Secretaries and the Institute of Cost Accountants of India, and a graduate of Himachal Pradesh University (MarketScreener profile). He has been CFO since about 2006 and is a permanent invitee to the risk committee. His FY26 pay was ₹80.4 lakh.

companies.changes: CEO & Whole-time Director Vineet Sahni, re-appointed only from May 2026, resigned for personal reasons and left on 31 May 2026. From 1 June 2026 J.K. Jain became Executive Chairman, Rahul Jain MD and Aanchal Jain Joint MD (approved at the 31 July 2026 AGM). Independent director Rakesh Chand Jain died on 7 July 2026.

companies.styleNote: Controlled jointly by the Jain family of the Lumax D.K. Jain group and Japan's Stanley Electric, each with about 37.5%; promoters together own 75%. Brothers Deepak Jain (Chairman) and Anmol Jain (MD from 28 May 2026) run the company, with a hired CEO, Raju Ketkale, for day-to-day operations. Stanley places two executive directors on the board. D.K. Jain is Chairman Emeritus. Anmol Jain is also MD of the listed group company Lumax Auto Technologies.

people.name: Deepak Jain
people.since: Chairman & MD until May 2026; Chairman (whole-time) since 28 May 2026
people.relation: Promoter; brother of Anmol Jain
people.stake: 13.30% (FY26 AGM notice and June 2026 shareholding); Jain family and group companies about 37.5%, promoter group with Stanley 75%
people.bio: Holds a business degree from Illinois Institute of Technology, USA, specialising in operations management and international business, and trained early on at Stanley in the USA and Japan. He has more than 25 years in auto components. He was Chairman & MD, re-appointed for five years from February 2026, and in May 2026 handed the MD role to his brother to focus on strategy and board oversight. He was President of ACMA (2019–21), chaired CII Northern Region (2024–25), and sits on the National Automotive Board's governing council and on supplier councils of Toyota Kirloskar, Maruti Suzuki and Tata Motors. He is also a non-executive director of Lumax Auto Technologies. He is 51.

people.name: Anmol Jain
people.since: Joined the Lumax group in 2000; Joint MD until May 2026; MD since 28 May 2026
people.relation: Promoter; brother of Deepak Jain
people.stake: 13.30% (FY26 AGM notice and June 2026 shareholding); Jain family and group companies about 37.5%
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in business administration (finance and supply-chain management) from Michigan State University, USA. He began as a management trainee at GHSP in the USA and joined the Lumax group in 2000. As Joint MD he ran day-to-day operations and mentored senior management; from May 2026 he is MD with primary responsibility for operations. He is also Managing Director of Lumax Auto Technologies, where he holds about 19%. He chairs ACMA's Northern Region and is President of the Bajaj Auto Vendor Association. He is 47.

people.name: Raju Bhauso Ketkale
people.bio: Holds a BE in mechanical engineering and a master's in machine design from Bangalore University, and has more than 30 years in manufacturing. Before Lumax he was Executive Vice President – Manufacturing at Toyota Kirloskar Motor and sat on its board, where he led reforms in manufacturing, engineering, HR and sustainability. He joined the Lumax D.K. Jain group in October 2023 and became CEO of Lumax Industries in July 2024, replacing Vishnu Johri. He runs daily operations, the budget and the search for expansion and acquisitions.

people.name: Tadayoshi Aoki
people.role: Senior Executive Director (Whole-time Director; Stanley nominee)
people.since: With the company since 2017–18; re-appointed for three years from February 2027
people.relation: Nominee of co-promoter Stanley Electric Co., Japan
people.bio: Holds a mechanical engineering degree from Tokyo Denki University, Japan. He has more than 30 years at Stanley in car electronics, engineering, sales of automotive electronic parts and sales planning. He represents Stanley, the Japanese co-promoter and technology partner, as a whole-time director. He is 60.

people.name: Kenjiro Nakazono
people.relation: Nominee of co-promoter Stanley Electric Co., Japan
people.bio: A graduate of Hamamatsu Commercial High School, Japan, with more than 30 years at Stanley in procurement, planning, auditing and new product development. He joined the board as a Stanley nominee executive director for three years from May 2025. He is 56.

people.name: Raajesh Kumar Gupta
people.since: June 2020; re-appointed whole-time director for three years from May 2026
people.bio: A qualified company secretary and cost accountant and a law graduate, with more than 30 years in secretarial, legal and compliance roles, over 15 of them in autos. Since joining in June 2020 he has handled governance, regulatory compliance and relations with joint-venture partners, and sits on the risk committee. He is 57.

people.name: Ravi Teltia
people.bio: He is the company's CFO and a Key Managerial Personnel, signs the financial statements with the CEO and sits on the risk management committee. He is also the contact for investor queries. The annual report and filings give no further details of his background.

companies.changes: From 28 May 2026 Deepak Jain moved from Chairman & MD to Chairman and Anmol Jain from Joint MD to MD (approved at the 26 August 2026 AGM). In July 2026 Norihisa Sato (EVP, Global Relations) ceased to be senior management and four new senior managers were named, including CTOs for four-wheelers (C.S. Singh) and electronics (Suva Ranjan Das).

companies.styleNote: The flagship of the Spark Minda group, run by founder-promoter Ashok Minda as Chairman & Group CEO, with his son Aakash Minda as Executive Director. A long-serving group professional, N.K. Modi, is the third executive director, and hired executives run finance and the business divisions. Promoters own 64.8%, almost all held by Ashok Minda, Sarika Minda and the family's Minda Capital.

people.name: Ashok Minda
people.since: Promoter; re-appointed for three years from August 2025
people.relation: Promoter; father of Aakash Minda
people.stake: 34.19% (8.17 crore shares, FY26 annual report and June 2026 shareholding); promoter group together 64.84%
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in commerce and has more than 40 years in the auto-parts industry. He built Spark Minda into a multi-product group with plants in India, Indonesia and Vietnam, and has set up partnerships with parts makers from the US, Germany, Japan and France. He sits on the boards of several group companies, including Minda Instruments, Minda VAST Access Systems, Minda Capital and Flash Electronics. His current term as Chairman & Group CEO runs to July 2028.

people.name: Aakash Minda
people.since: Board since 2020; re-appointed for five years from November 2025
people.relation: Son of Chairman Ashok Minda
people.bio: Graduated with honours from the Cox School of Business and holds an MBA from the Indian School of Business; the annual report also calls him an alumnus of Harvard Business School. He has about 13 years in the auto industry across Europe, North America and Asia. At Spark Minda he started as CEO of the plastics and interiors and electronics manufacturing divisions, then ran the newly acquired Minda Autoelektrik and the interior plastics business. He joined the board in 2020 and now oversees group finance, HR, strategy, marketing, technology and investor relations. He is on the boards of Minda Capital, Flash Electronics and other group companies, and is a member of YPO and EO.

people.name: Naresh Kumar (N.K.) Modi
people.since: With the group for about 27 years; re-appointed for five years from December 2025
people.bio: A chartered accountant and company secretary with a B.Com (Hons) from St. Xavier's College, Kolkata. He worked at E&Y and the Birla Group before joining Spark Minda, where over about 27 years he has held roles in strategy, finance, HR and operations, including business head at Minda Instruments, group CHRO, CEO of the information and connected systems businesses, and head of group sourcing. He is also CEO & Whole-time Director of the subsidiary Minda Instruments and heads group marketing. He is not related to the promoters.

people.name: Ajay Agarwal
people.role: Group CFO, President – Finance & Strategy and Group Chief Risk Officer
people.bio: A chartered accountant and lawyer with more than 24 years of experience. He was previously President – Finance and Strategy at Vedanta Limited, and earlier held roles at KPMG and PwC. He joined Minda Corp in May 2025 to lead strategy, corporate planning, M&A, joint ventures and investor relations, and took over as Group CFO and Group Chief Risk Officer on 5 February 2026 after Vinod Raheja left.

people.name: Supratik Roy
people.bio: Holds an MBA from IIT Bombay and Washington University (WashU), studied strategic management at IIM Lucknow, and has a postgraduate degree in international relations and an economics degree from JNV University, Jodhpur. He has worked with the main car and two-wheeler makers, including Maruti, Tata Motors, Mahindra, Honda, Hero, TVS and Bajaj, knows the EV-parts supply chain including localising Japanese and Southeast Asian businesses in India, and has run large greenfield projects. He joined in December 2025 to lead the newer businesses.

people.name: Hitendra Mishra
people.bio: Holds a B.Tech in mechanical engineering from NIT Kurukshetra and an MBA from XLRI Jamshedpur. He has 32 years of experience, with a record of growing revenue and profit and turning around acquired companies. He joined in May 2025 to run the die-casting division.

companies.changes: Group COO Ashim Vohra left in August 2025 and Group CFO Vinod Raheja in November 2025; Ajay Agarwal became Group CFO in February 2026. Company Secretary Pardeep Mann resigned on 21 August 2026 and Meenal Bansal was appointed on 24 September 2026, when Geetika Mishra was also named Chief Procurement Officer. Joy Panda became Group Chief Marketing Officer in October 2025.

companies.styleNote: Run by promoter Tarang Jain as Chairman & MD since 2001, with his two sons each running one of the two business groups as whole-time directors. A former Bosch executive, Avinash Chintawar, is whole-time director and COO, and a hired Group CFO runs finance. Promoters own 75%: Tarang Jain 39.7% directly and 22.2% as trustee of the TJ Holding Trust, plus two other family trusts with 6.55% each.

people.name: Tarang Jain
people.since: With the company since incorporation (1988); MD since 2001; current term June 2025 to May 2028
people.relation: Promoter; father of Arjun Jain and Dhruv Jain
people.stake: 39.74% directly plus 22.16% as trustee of TJ Holding Trust (FY26 annual report and June 2026 shareholding); promoter group together 75%
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in commerce from Sydenham College, University of Bombay, and a diploma in business administration from the University of Lausanne, Switzerland. He has about 36 years in the auto industry and has been with Varroc since it was set up, becoming Managing Director in 2001. He built it into a global tier-1 supplier of lighting, electronics, EV and body parts; the global four-wheeler lighting business was later sold to Plastic Omnium (now OPmobility), whose US$66M arbitration claim against Varroc is pending. He was re-appointed Chairman & MD for three years from June 2025.

people.name: Arjun Jain
people.role: Whole-time Director and CEO – Business I
people.relation: Son of Tarang Jain; brother of Dhruv Jain
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in economics and political science from Vassar College, New York, and worked at Bain & Company India before joining Varroc in October 2013 as General Manager – Business Excellence. He became head of the electrical division in May 2015 and CEO of the India business in 2022, and has been a whole-time director since August 2018. He now runs Business I; he was paid ₹30.2M in FY26. He is 36.

people.name: Dhruv Jain
people.role: Whole-time Director and CEO – Business II
people.since: Board since September 2022 (non-executive); whole-time director since June 2025
people.relation: Son of Tarang Jain; brother of Arjun Jain
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in economics from the University of Chicago. He joined the board as a non-executive director in September 2022 while heading Business II, and became a whole-time director in June 2025. He runs Business II and leads the company's ADAS and lighting-electronics strategy. He is 31.

people.name: Avinash Chintawar
people.role: Whole-time Director and Chief Operating Officer
people.since: COO since October 2025; whole-time director since November 2025
people.bio: Holds a BE from Visvesvaraya National Institute of Technology, a postgraduate diploma in management from IGNOU, and ICWA (Inter). He spent his career in the Bosch group, where he was MD of Bosch Chassis Systems India and of Bosch Electrical Drives India, Director of Operations at Robert Bosch Bamberg in Germany, and technical plant manager at Bosch Nashik, and chaired the Bosch India Foundation. He joined Varroc as COO in October 2025 to run operations and joined the board as whole-time director for three years from November 2025, replacing Vidyadhar Limaye.

people.name: K. Mahendra Kumar
people.bio: A chartered accountant and cost accountant from the Indian institutes and a CIMA (UK) management accountant, with more than 20 years at large European and American multinationals and Indian conglomerates. He was Executive Vice President and CFO of Tube Investments of India for over five years before joining Varroc as Group CFO in September 2022. On his appointment the chairman cited debt reduction, risk management and M&A among his strengths.

companies.changes: Whole-time director Vidyadhar Limaye took early retirement in June 2025; Group General Counsel & Company Secretary Ajay Sharma left in July 2025 (Anil Ghatiya replaced him). CTO Fritz Abraham resigned in March 2026 and Eric Hamon became CTO on 3 August 2026; Avijit Roy became Group CHRO in April 2026.

companies.styleNote: A joint venture of the Motherson group (Samvardhana Motherson International, 33.4%) and Japan's Sumitomo Wiring Systems (25.1%); promoters own 61.7% in all. The Motherson founder Vivek Chaand Sehgal is non-executive Chairman (2.3% personally) and his son Laksh Vaaman Sehgal and two Sumitomo nominees are non-executive directors. Day-to-day management is by professionals: Whole-time Director & COO Anurag Gahlot and CFO Gulshan. There is no MD or CEO.

people.name: Anurag Gahlot
people.stake: 50,820 shares, negligible (FY26 annual report and AGM notice)
people.bio: Holds a diploma in electrical engineering from the Board of Technical Education, Uttar Pradesh, and has more than 31 years in the auto sector. He has been a whole-time director and COO since the company was demerged from Motherson and listed in 2022, and is its senior-most executive, signing the code-of-conduct declaration and heading its ESG work. He was paid about ₹2.42 crore in FY26 and came up for re-appointment by rotation at the July 2026 AGM. He is 52.

people.name: Gulshan
people.bio: A chartered accountant with a B.Com from Kurukshetra University and more than 14 years in finance and audit, much of it in the auto sector. Before joining he was a Director in Assurance Services at a Big 4 firm, working on IPO readiness, M&A, restructuring, due diligence and finance transformation. He became CFO in July 2025, replacing Mahender Chhabra.

companies.changes: CFO Mahender Chhabra resigned in June 2025; Gulshan took over in July 2025. Sumitomo nominee director Yuichi Shimizu resigned on 28 April 2026 and Ryuji Sakai replaced him.

companies.styleNote: Run by professionals: MD & Group CEO Vivek Vikram Singh, a hired executive since 2016, with business CEOs and a Group CFO under him. The promoter, Aureus Investment (the Kapur family vehicle), owns 28.0% and is not in management; Priya Sachdev Kapur, a director of Aureus, is a non-executive director, and the Chairman, Jeffrey Overly, is independent. The family is in a dispute over the trusts that control Aureus. Executive directors are not related to each other or to the promoter.

people.name: Vivek Vikram Singh
people.since: Joined July 2016; MD & Group CEO since July 2019
people.stake: 0.054% (3,38,465 shares, FY26 annual report; from ESOPs and the 2025 performance share plan)
people.bio: Holds a B.Tech in computer science and engineering from HBTI Kanpur and a postgraduate diploma in management from IIM Ahmedabad. He joined Sona in July 2016 and became MD & Group CEO in July 2019. His company profile cites over 18 years of experience, including eight in the auto industry. He is responsible for the EV and hybrid product platform, capital allocation and shareholder relations. EY India named him Entrepreneurial CEO of the Year 2021 and the Economic Times listed him among India's 40 under 40 in 2018. He also sits on the boards of the Novelic subsidiary in Serbia and is an independent director of Varmora Granito.

people.name: Vikram Verma Vadapalli
people.role: Whole-time Director and CEO – Driveline Business
people.since: With the Sona group for over 36 years; CEO of the company from 2011; whole-time director since January 2025
people.bio: Holds a B.Tech in mechanical engineering (1981) from Karnataka Regional Engineering College, Surathkal (now NIT Surathkal), and has more than 41 years in the auto industry. He led plant operations at Sona Koyo Steering Systems before joining Sona BLW in 2007 as Chief Engineer (Projects), became Executive Director and CEO in 2011, and has run the driveline (gears and differentials) business since the Comstar merger in 2019. He joined the board as whole-time director for three years from January 2025 and came up for re-appointment by rotation at the 2026 AGM. He is 66.

people.name: Rohit Nanda
people.role: President, Group CFO and Chief Risk Officer
people.bio: A chartered accountant with more than 20 years in the auto, steel, engineering, pharma, chemicals and industrial-goods industries. Before joining Sona in 2019 he worked at Usha Martin, MTAR Technologies, Jindal Stainless, SRF and Ranbaxy Laboratories. He is responsible for capital allocation, financial reporting, investment decisions, risk management and IT, and is the designated Chief Risk Officer.

people.name: Sat Mohan Gupta
people.since: With Comstar for about 25 years; CEO of Comstar Automotive since 2012
people.bio: Holds a master's degree in commerce from the University of Delhi and is a qualified cost and management accountant, with more than 35 years in the auto industry. He spent about 25 years at Comstar and became CEO of Comstar Automotive in 2012; after the 2019 merger it became Sona's motor business, which makes EV traction motors, controllers and starter motors. He is responsible for winning customers, new products and operations in that business.

people.name: Praveen Chakrapani Rao
people.since: Over 24 years with Comstar and Sona Comstar
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering from BMS College of Engineering, Bangalore, and a master's in management systems from BITS Pilani, and completed a one-year professional programme from MIT. He worked at Bosch, Ford and Visteon in product engineering and business development, then spent more than 24 years in the business that began as Visteon's starter-motor unit, became Comstar and merged into Sona. He led R&D for the motor business, building the EV team for traction motors, controllers and motor modules, before becoming Group CTO.

companies.changes: Company Secretary and General Counsel Ajay Pratap Singh resigned from 15 April 2026; interim appointees Suman Poddar (CS) and Arjun Singh (compliance officer) left on 16 June 2026, and Pankaj Gupta became SVP (Legal), Company Secretary and Compliance Officer from 17 June 2026.

companies.styleNote: Run by the Divgi family, whose group was founded in the early 1960s by Ramrao and Bhaskar Divgi. Brothers Jitendra Divgi (MD) and Hirendra Divgi (Executive Director) are the two executive directors; their first cousins Bharat and Sanjay Divgi sit on the board as non-executive directors. The chairman, Praveen Kadle, is independent. Hired professionals serve as CFO and COO. Promoters own 60.6%, mostly through Divgi Holding (51.7%).

people.name: Jitendra Divgi
people.since: Joined the family business (Divgi Metalwares) in 1994
people.relation: Promoter; elder brother of Hirendra Divgi; first cousin of directors Bharat and Sanjay Divgi
people.stake: 2.39% (FY26 annual report and June 2026 shareholding); promoter group together 60.56%, mostly via Divgi Holding (51.68%)
people.bio: Holds a B.E. (Hons) in mechanical engineering from BITS Pilani (1985) and an MS in manufacturing from the University of Massachusetts, USA (1986). He began his career at Digital Equipment Corporation in Massachusetts and joined Divgi Metalwares in 1994. He served on the board of BorgWarner's China business, a legacy of the BorgWarner joint venture that the family bought out in 2016 to form Divgi TorqTransfer. As MD he also chairs the ESG steering committee. He was paid ₹1.78 crore in FY26 and the 2026 AGM was asked to approve a special incentive of ₹1.23 crore. He is 65.

people.name: Hirendra Divgi
people.relation: Promoter; younger brother of MD Jitendra Divgi; first cousin of Bharat and Sanjay Divgi
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering from the University of Bangalore. He joined the company in 1988 and has more than 30 years there, including roles as new product development manager and controller of operations. He is one of the two executives responsible for the company's business-responsibility policies, and the 2026 AGM was asked to approve a special incentive of ₹59.5 lakh for him.

people.name: Sudhir Shridhar Mirjankar
people.bio: Holds a B.Com from the University of Pune and a postgraduate diploma in business administration from Symbiosis Centre for Distance Learning, is a Certified Management Accountant (Institute of Management Accountants, USA), and completed IIM Kolkata's CFO programme. He joined the company in December 2016 and was named CFO in June 2022, before the March 2023 IPO, whose prospectus he signed.

people.name: Dipak Annasaheb Vani
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in production engineering from Shivaji University, Kolhapur. He joined in July 2006 and worked across production, quality, quality systems, supply chain, purchasing and global sourcing; at the 2023 IPO he was Head of Purchase and Global Supply Management. He is now COO and a Key Managerial Personnel.

companies.changes: Company Secretary Aniket Kokane, appointed in June 2025, resigned with effect from 19 September 2026; Ishita Kokare became compliance officer from 20 September 2026. Chief Information Officer Pulak Das left in March 2026 and Kishor Hole replaced him in June 2026.

companies.styleNote: Founded in 2007–08 out of an IIT Bombay lab by Prof. Shashikanth Suryanarayanan with his students Amit Dixit and Manish Sharma, who still run it as MD, Joint MD and COO; CTO Anay Joshi, who joined as an intern in 2015, was made the fourth promoter. Promoters own only 26.2% (Shashikanth's wife Mallika Iyer holds 2.8% of that); venture funds such as A91 (10.9%) and Xponentia hold large stakes. The chairperson, Poyni Bhatt, is independent.

people.name: Shashikanth Suryanarayanan
people.relation: Founder-promoter; husband of promoter-group shareholder Mallika R Iyer
people.stake: 16.19% (June 2026 shareholding); with his wife Mallika Iyer about 19%; promoter group together 26.23%
people.bio: Holds a B.Tech in mechanical engineering from IIT Madras and a PhD from the University of California, Berkeley. He is an associate professor of mechanical engineering at IIT Bombay, currently on leave, and founded the company from his lab there with three of his students. He has run it since incorporation and was re-designated MD for three years from March 2025. Sedemac listed in March 2026 through a share sale by existing holders; in FY26 revenue rose over 60% to above ₹1,000 crore.

people.name: Amit Arun Dixit
people.since: Founding shareholder; joined full-time August 2008; Joint MD since March 2025
people.relation: Co-founder and promoter
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in production engineering from K.J. Somaiya College of Engineering and an M.Tech and a PhD from IIT Bombay, where his thesis was on parameter estimation for servo systems with friction. A founding shareholder, he joined the company full-time in August 2008 and has more than 17 years in control systems. He became Joint MD for three years from March 2025.

people.name: Manish Sharma
people.since: Founding shareholder; joined full-time August 2008; board since 2007; whole-time director since May 2025
people.relation: Co-founder and promoter
people.bio: Holds a BE in mechanical engineering from Bharati Vidyapeeth's College of Engineering (University of Mumbai) and an M.Tech in control engineering from IIT Bombay. He worked as an engineer at Eaton India Engineering Center before joining Sedemac full-time in August 2008. As COO he runs the plants and production; he became a whole-time director for three years from May 2025 and came up for re-appointment by rotation at the September 2026 AGM. He is 47.

people.name: Anaykumar (Anay) Avinash Joshi
people.since: June 2015 (joined as an intern); promoter since before the 2026 IPO
people.relation: Promoter (not a founder)
people.bio: Holds a B.Tech in electrical engineering from IIT Bombay and worked as a senior embedded engineer at Gram Power before joining Sedemac as an intern in June 2015. He rose to CTO, leading R&D and engineering across controllers, control software and the newer electric motors for starter-generators, and the founders made him one of the four promoters. He was paid ₹11.6M in FY25.

people.name: Rajesh Madhukar Sheth
people.since: With the company since May 2015; CFO since May 2025
people.bio: A chartered accountant with about 27 years in finance. He was previously finance controller at Vanderlande Industries Software and manager-finance at Chemetall-Rai India, among others. He joined Sedemac in May 2015 and was appointed CFO in May 2025, ahead of the IPO; he handles financial strategy, planning and risk.

people.name: Nikhil Rai
people.role: Senior Vice President, Global Sales and Business Development
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in electrical power systems engineering from Amravati University and has about 28 years in sales and marketing. He was head of India marketing at Eicher Engineering Solutions and general manager at Froude Hofmann Test Technology before joining Sedemac in October 2014. He leads global sales, new markets and customer relationships and is part of the management team named in the annual report.

companies.changes: No changes to the executive team since the March 2026 listing. In FY26 Manish Sharma joined the board as whole-time director and Rajesh Sheth became CFO (both May 2025); Prasad Chavan is Company Secretary.

companies.styleNote: Founded by the Soni brothers. Gurdeep Soni is Chairman and MD and runs the aftermarket business; his brother Paramjit Singh Soni is Vice Chairman, lives in the US and runs the OEM business. Neither draws pay from the listed company; both are paid by subsidiaries. Since January 2026 a hired Group CEO, Tanushree Bagrodia, runs the company day to day, with a new CFO from March 2026. The Soni family owns 65.88%, partly through US family trusts.

people.name: Gurdeep Soni
people.role: Chairman & Managing Director (heads the aftermarket business)
people.relation: Co-founder; brother of Vice Chairman Paramjit Singh Soni
people.stake: 19.93% (FY26 annual report and 30 Jun 2026 shareholding pattern); Soni family together 65.88%
people.bio: Holds a master's degree in management studies from BITS Pilani. He has about 45 years of work experience, much of it in different roles within the Uniparts group, and has been a director since the company was set up in 1994. He is involved in day-to-day operations and is responsible for the group's aftermarket (replacement) business. He takes no pay from the listed company; he is MD of the wholly owned subsidiary Gripwel Fasteners (April 2025–March 2028), which paid him ₹2.95cr in FY26.

people.name: Paramjit Singh Soni
people.role: Vice Chairman & Executive Director (heads the OEM business; based in the US)
people.relation: Co-founder; brother of Chairman & MD Gurdeep Soni
people.stake: 0.02% in his own name (FY26 annual report); three US Soni family trusts in the promoter group hold 32.75% (The Paramjit Soni 2018 trust 14.59%, the Meher Soni and Karan Soni trusts 9.08% each, 30 Jun 2026)
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in commerce from the University of Delhi. In about 43 years he has held various roles in the Uniparts group. He lives in the USA and runs the OEM business (sales to tractor, construction and forestry equipment makers), and helps set strategy and planning. He takes no pay from the listed company; the US subsidiary Uniparts USA paid him ₹4.99cr in FY26.

people.name: Tanushree Bagrodia
people.role: Whole-time Director & Group Chief Executive Officer
people.since: Whole-time director since 25 Nov 2024 (term to Nov 2027); Group CEO since 1 Jan 2026
people.stake: nil (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); entitled to performance-linked stock options
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in computer engineering from VES Institute of Technology, Mumbai and an MBA from INSEAD. She began as an investment banker in London and Mumbai, working with Merrill Lynch, KBC Financial Products, HVB and IDFC Capital. In 2013 she moved into industry and became one of the youngest women CFOs of a listed Indian company, at NRB Bearings; she later worked at Udaan Capital and Laxmi Organic Industries. She joined the Uniparts board in November 2024 and was made Group CEO from January 2026. Her FY26 pay was ₹2.3cr.

people.name: Sandeep Taneja
people.bio: A chartered accountant and a licensed CPA (Colorado), with bachelor's and master's degrees in commerce and an MBA from the US. He has over 25 years of finance experience, about 15 in India and 10 in the US. For the eight years before joining he was Finance Director of Gates India, covering industrial and automotive businesses with several plants. Before that he spent five years at Ingersoll Rand India and five years at Corning in India and the US, and earlier worked at Ernst & Young (Atlanta), Whirlpool India and Fena. He replaced Rohit Maheshwari, who resigned in March 2026.

people.name: Paleswara Rao S V Duvvuri
people.bio: An engineering graduate from JNTU College of Engineering, Hyderabad with a postgraduate finance qualification from IGNOU. He has more than 30 years in engineering and FMCG companies and previously ran operations at Regal Rexnord (Marathon Electric Motors India). He was trained as a Lean Six Sigma Black Belt and Master Black Belt at General Electric.

people.name: Biru Gupta
people.since: Joined 10 Nov 2008; current role since 1 Jan 2026
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in engineering from Delhi University and a postgraduate management certificate from XLRI. He has over 30 years of experience running P&Ls and projects in IT and manufacturing, including at Wipro, Blue Star and Hewlett Packard. He has been with Uniparts since 2008.

people.name: Jyotbir Singh Sethi
people.since: Joined 1 May 2008; current role since 1 Jan 2026
people.bio: A commerce graduate from Shri Ram College of Commerce, Delhi, a chartered accountant, and holder of a postgraduate programme in management (finance and strategy) from the Indian School of Business. He has over 21 years in P&L management, business development, financial planning, operations and ERP roll-outs, and worked at PwC before joining Uniparts in 2008.

companies.changes: Group CFO Rohit Maheshwari resigned on 12 Mar 2026; Sandeep Taneja joined on 16 Mar 2026. Manish Singh, previously 14 years at Blue Star, was appointed Group Chief HR Officer on 17 Aug 2026.

companies.styleNote: A joint venture: Kalyani-group company BF Investment and Cummins's Meritor each own 35.52%. Neither runs it day to day. Chairman Baba Kalyani is non-executive and Cummins has a nominee director. The only executive director is President Nagaraja Gargeshwari, a long-time Meritor engineer. The CFO post has been held on an interim basis since the previous CFO retired in November 2025.

people.name: Nagaraja Gargeshwari
people.bio: Holds a diploma in mechanical engineering from CPC Polytechnic, Mysore (1990), a B.Sc. in engineering technology from BITS Pilani (2003) and an MBA in international management from ICFAI University (2010). He began as an engineer at Wipro Infotech in 1990 and then worked at Maxtor Peripherals in Singapore. In 1999 he joined Reva Electric Car and in 2000 moved to Meritor India, rising to Director of Meritor's technical centre in Bengaluru. In 2017 he moved to Meritor Inc. in the US as Senior Director of global product validation and materials engineering, leading about 220 engineers. His FY26 pay was ₹1.6cr.

people.name: Raman K
people.bio: A commerce graduate from Madras University and an associate member of the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India. He has about 15 years in global automotive and electronics companies, in corporate finance, business partnering and investor relations. He holds the CFO role until the board appoints a permanent CFO.

companies.changes: CFO Ranganathan S retired on 22 Nov 2025; Raman K has been interim CFO since 4 Feb 2026 while the board looks for a permanent CFO. No changes since the annual report.

companies.styleNote: A subsidiary of Italy's Carraro group: Carraro International S.E. owns 68.77%. Promoter-family member Tomaso Carraro is non-executive Vice Chairman and the chairman is independent. The company is run by long-serving Indian managers, MD Balaji Gopalan (with Carraro India since 1998) and COO Sudhendra Mannikar (since 1999), with Italian CFO Davide Grossi from the parent.

people.name: Balaji Gopalan
people.since: Joined 1 Sep 1998; current MD term 4 Feb 2026 to 8 Aug 2029
people.bio: Holds a PhD in human resource management from the University of Pune. He joined Carraro India as an employee in 1998, when the company was a year old, and rose to lead it; he has more than 26 years in manufacturing. As MD he is responsible for revenue, EBITDA, working capital and CSR targets. Shareholders reappointed him at the September 2025 AGM for a term running to August 2029.

people.name: Sudhendra Mannikar
people.since: Joined 2 Aug 1999; current term 15 Mar 2026 to 8 Aug 2029
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in production engineering from the University of Pune and an MBA from Savitribai Phule Pune University. He worked at Essar Projects before joining Carraro India in 1999, and has over 26 years in supply chain, purchasing and operations. He shares responsibility for revenue, EBITDA, working capital and CSR targets and was reappointed at the September 2025 AGM.

people.name: Davide Grossi
people.stake: one share, held jointly with Carraro International S.E. (FY26 annual report)
people.bio: Holds an undergraduate degree in business administration and a master's in accounting, corporate finance and control, both from Bocconi University, Milan. He has about 14 years in finance, including at Deloitte & Touche in Italy, as CFO Nordics of Alten Sverige in Sweden, and at Isagro (Asia) Agrochemicals. He is paid mainly in euros (a €143,000 salary, a €70,000 management allowance and a €20,000 deferred retention payment a year) and received a one-off ₹87.5 lakh reward for operational initiatives in FY26. He is 39.

people.name: Ashok Kumar
people.bio: Holds a postgraduate degree in international business from the Symbiosis Institute of International Business, Pune. He leads sales and new business development.

people.name: Mamta Bakshi
people.bio: Holds a postgraduate diploma in management (executive) from IMT Ghaziabad. She heads human resources, leadership development and culture.

people.name: Dheeraj Kumar Rai
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering from Government Engineering College, Jabalpur and an M.Tech from Maulana Azad National Institute of Technology, Bhopal. He has worked at Tata Cummins, Meritor India, Suzlon Energy and Asia Motor Works. He will run manufacturing operations, equipment effectiveness and operational excellence.

companies.changes: Director of Purchase & Supply Chain Vijay Raman resigned on 19 Jun 2026. Director of Manufacturing Sanjay Kumar retires on 30 Sep 2026 and Dheeraj Kumar Rai takes over on 1 Oct 2026. Company Secretary Nakul Patil left in November 2025; Mohith Kumar Khandelwal replaced him in February 2026.

companies.styleNote: A subsidiary of Germany's ZF group (formerly WABCO India): Wabco Asia owns 60%. ZF Group India President Akash Passey is non-executive chairman and the other group directors are non-executive. The only executive director is MD Paramjit Singh Chadha, hired in July 2025. A new CFO joined in September 2026. None of the directors other than one independent director own shares.

people.name: Paramjit Singh Chadha
people.bio: An automobile engineer with nearly 40 years in the car and component industry. He started his career at Maruti Suzuki and then worked at brake and chassis makers including Kalyani Brakes, Bosch Chassis Systems, Continental Brakes and Knorr-Bremse, with a particular focus on safety-critical brake systems. He has been a regional head, business-unit head, plant head, managing director and President (Operations), and has led three greenfield plants. He also led ESG, manufacturing-excellence and digitalisation projects in the ADM Group, and has been involved with the ACMA Centre for Excellence and the Indian Value Engineering Society. He succeeded P Kaniappan, who retired in June 2025.

people.name: Rakesh Mishra
people.bio: A chartered accountant with a commerce degree from Utkal University and more than 30 years in finance at global technology and engineering companies, both listed and unlisted. He has led greenfield projects, restructurings and ERP roll-outs, and was a NASSCOM regional council member in 2023–24. He has attended executive programmes at Cornell University and the Indian School of Business.

companies.changes: CFO Sweta Agarwal resigned on 30 Jun 2026; Rakesh Mishra joined as CFO on 1 Sep 2026. Company Secretary Muthulakshmi M resigned in March 2026 and C V Kavviya now holds the role. Senior sourcing manager Ponraj Pandian resigned on 15 Sep 2026. On the board, Lars Orlik resigned in April 2026 and Claudia Jehle joined as a ZF nominee in May 2026.

companies.styleNote: Part of the Chandigarh-based Steel Strips group of the Garg family. Managing Director Dheeraj Garg runs the company; his father, R K Garg, is non-executive Chairman. The promoter group owns 61.14%, partly through group companies such as SAB Industries and SAB Udyog. Tata Steel (6.92%) and Sumitomo Metal (5.41%) are long-standing investors. The Deputy MD resigned in June 2026, leaving Dheeraj Garg and veteran executive director M L Jain as the executive directors.

people.name: Dheeraj Garg
people.since: Board since 29 Apr 1993 (executive director, later MD)
people.relation: Son of Chairman R K Garg (non-executive)
people.stake: 29.52% (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report; same at 30 Jun 2026); his father R K Garg holds 1.94%; promoter group together 61.14%
people.bio: Holds a B.S. in finance. He has been with the company for about 33 years: he joined the board as an executive director in 1993 and was later made MD. The company credits him with building its management team and with its growth into a large steel and alloy wheel maker; his strengths are finance, corporate strategy and business development. He is also a director of group company Indian Acrylics. His FY26 pay was ₹13.3cr, about 268 times the median employee's. He is 54.

people.name: M L Jain
people.since: With the group for more than three decades
people.bio: A fellow chartered accountant (FCA) and fellow company secretary (FCS). He has been with the Steel Strips group for more than three decades and has wide experience in finance, legal and tax matters. He was reappointed as an executive director for five years from July 2020. He was born in 1955.

people.name: Rahul Kumar
people.since: With the company since 2022; CFO since 12 Nov 2025
people.bio: A chartered accountant and commerce graduate who has also taken the CFA (Chartered Financial Analyst) programme. He has over eight years in finance, accounts and commercial control, earlier in healthcare, technology and ed-tech companies, and joined Steel Strips Wheels in 2022. His areas are financial reporting, internal audit, MIS, cost control and ERP. He replaced Naveen Sorot, who resigned in September 2025.

companies.changes: Deputy MD Mohan Joshi resigned on 3 Jun 2026 for health and family reasons. CFO Naveen Sorot resigned in September 2025 and Rahul Kumar became CFO in November 2025. Tata Steel's nominee director left the board in March 2026.

companies.styleNote: Part of the TSF/TVS group. The promoters are group companies: TSF Investments (26.57%), Trichur Sundaram Santhanam & Family Pvt Ltd (26.20%) and India Motor Parts & Accessories (4.09%); together they own 56.86% after the September 2026 preferential issue and QIP. Chairman and MD Srivats Ram runs the company and sits on the boards of the family holding companies, including both promoters and T V Sundram Iyengar & Sons, but is not himself classified as a promoter. Long-time chairman S Ram left the board in March 2026. The other directors from the group, S Viji and his son Harsha Viji, are non-executive.

people.name: Srivats Ram
people.since: Board since 1 Oct 2000; Chairman since 31 Mar 2026
people.relation: From the group's controlling family circle: a director of promoter companies TSF Investments and Trichur Sundaram Santhanam & Family, though not himself classified as a promoter
people.stake: 1.17% (25 Sep 2026 shareholding pattern, after he bought ₹15cr of shares in the September 2026 preferential issue); promoter companies together 56.86%
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in economics from the University of Madras and an MBA from Case Western Reserve University, USA. He has been on the Wheels India board since 2000 and has more than 21 years of industry experience. He became Chairman in March 2026 when S Ram stepped down. He is also a director of Sundaram Finance, India Motor Parts & Accessories, Axles India and several TVS-group family companies, including T V Sundram Iyengar & Sons. In 2026 he oversaw a fund-raise through a preferential issue to the promoters and a QIP, and a commercial-vehicle air-systems joint venture with Bosch. His FY26 pay was about ₹6.6cr, including ₹3cr of commission.

people.name: P Ramesh
people.bio: He is the CFO and a key managerial person, and signs the financial statements with the Chairman and MD. The company has not published a detailed profile of his education or earlier career.

people.name: S Suresh
people.bio: He heads the non-automotive business and sits on the board's risk management committee. The company has not published a detailed profile.

people.name: Murali Vaidyanathan
people.bio: He heads the automotive business and sits on the board's risk management committee. The company has not published a detailed profile.

companies.changes: S Ram, chairman and on the board for more than five decades, left the board on 30 Mar 2026; Srivats Ram became Chairman. Harsha Viji joined as a non-executive director in June 2026. No executive changes since the annual report.

companies.styleNote: Founded in 1991 by Sudhir Rai, who is Chairman and MD. His wife Anita and their sons Sumeet and Kunal are whole-time directors, running procurement, plants and finance; Kunal is also the CFO. The family owns 68.57%. In August 2026 the board proposed issuing warrants worth about ₹32cr to Sumeet and Kunal, alongside a ₹32cr share issue to outside investors.

people.name: Sudhir Rai
people.relation: Founder; husband of Anita Rai; father of Sumeet and Kunal Rai
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in science from the University of Delhi and a diploma in business administration from the Xavier Institute of Management. He started Kross in Jamshedpur in 1991 and has led it since; it makes trailer axles, suspension parts and other components for trucks and tractors. He oversees all parts of the business, from operations to governance, and took the company public in September 2024.

people.name: Anita Rai
people.relation: Wife of founder Sudhir Rai; mother of Sumeet and Kunal Rai
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in education from the University of Delhi and a postgraduate certificate in logistics and supply-chain management from XLRI Jamshedpur. She has been with the company since it was set up and mainly handles stores, purchasing and procurement.

people.name: Sumeet Rai
people.relation: Son of Sudhir and Anita Rai; brother of Kunal Rai
people.stake: 5.89% (30 Jun 2026 shareholding pattern); proposed allottee of up to 7.5 lakh warrants at ₹212 (August 2026)
people.bio: Holds a bachelor of science in mechanical engineering from the University of Michigan. He joined the company in 2008 and mainly runs plant operations.

people.name: Kunal Rai
people.since: Joined 8 Apr 2014; whole-time director term 26 Oct 2023 to 26 Oct 2028
people.relation: Son of Sudhir and Anita Rai; brother of Sumeet Rai
people.stake: 5.41% (30 Jun 2026 shareholding pattern); proposed allottee of up to 7.5 lakh warrants at ₹212 (August 2026)
people.bio: Holds a bachelor of science degree from Aston University, UK. He joined in 2014 and handles finance and commercial matters; he is also the company's CFO.

companies.changes: Head of Accounts & Finance Dhirendra Jana resigned with effect from 31 Jul 2026. Independent director Mukesh Agarwal resigned on 24 Jul 2026.

companies.styleNote: A Kanpur family company run by the Bhatia family. Chairman and MD Kundan Lal Bhatia, on the board since 1981, is the senior figure; his nephews Kapil Bhatia (MD) and Neeraj Bhatia (whole-time director and CFO) run the business, and their wives Mamta and Manju Bhatia are whole-time directors. All five are executives. The promoter group owns 51.76%.

people.name: Kundan Lal Bhatia
people.relation: Paternal uncle of MD Kapil Bhatia and CFO Neeraj Bhatia
people.stake: 3.39% (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); promoter group together 51.76%
people.bio: Holds a diploma in engineering. He has been on the board since 1981 and is responsible for overall decision-making. In his FY26 chairman's letter he reaffirmed the company's guidance of ₹500cr of gross revenue. He was reappointed Chairman and MD at the 2024 AGM. He was born in 1943, making him 83.

people.name: Kapil Bhatia
people.relation: Nephew of Chairman Kundan Lal Bhatia; brother of Neeraj Bhatia; husband of Mamta Bhatia
people.bio: Holds an MBA. He has been on the board since 1994 and handles overall administration and finance. He was reappointed MD at the 2024 AGM. His FY26 pay was about ₹2.0cr. He is 60.

people.name: Neeraj Bhatia
people.relation: Nephew of Chairman Kundan Lal Bhatia; brother of MD Kapil Bhatia; husband of Manju Bhatia
people.bio: A commerce graduate from Chhatrapati Shahuji Maharaj University, Kanpur. He became a whole-time director in 1991 and has led production, operations and marketing; the company credits him with transforming production and marketing. He is also the CFO. He retires by rotation and is up for reappointment at the 2026 AGM. His FY26 pay was about ₹2.0cr. He is 59.

people.name: Mamta Bhatia
people.relation: Wife of MD Kapil Bhatia
people.bio: A graduate of the University of Allahabad with an MBA from IGNOU. As a whole-time director she has worked on administration, financial controls and marketing strategy. Her FY26 pay was ₹1.44cr.

people.name: Manju Bhatia
people.relation: Wife of CFO Neeraj Bhatia
people.bio: A graduate of Hemwati Nandan Bahuguna Garhwal University. As a whole-time director she has worked on administration, financial controls and marketing strategy. Her FY26 pay was ₹1.44cr. She is 56.

companies.changes: No executive changes. Independent director Nimesh Mukerji died in April 2026 and was replaced by S K Luthra in May 2026.

companies.styleNote: Controlled by Spain's CIE Automotive S.A., which owns 65.70% through Participaciones Internacionales Autometal Dos. There is no founding family here: the company is run by hired professionals, and the group CEO is an employee of the Spanish parent.
