The chairman, Shriprakash Shukla (a former Mahindra group executive), is a non-executive director. The annual report says no director is related to another and no executive director is a promoter.

people.name: Ander Arenaza Álvarez
people.relation: Not related to any director; employee of the parent CIE Automotive S.A.
people.stake: nil (corporate governance report, CY2025 annual report)
people.bio: Holds a degree in industrial engineering from the Industrial Engineering School of Bilbao and an MBA from Deusto University, Bilbao. He has more than 30 years in the automotive sector and joined the CIE Automotive group in 2007 after roles at other auto companies. Within CIE he led the group's machining and aluminium high-pressure die-casting divisions worldwide. He is in the whole-time employment of CIE Automotive S.A., the Spanish parent, and was re-appointed as a whole-time director in 2025.

people.name: Manoj Mullassery Menon
people.role: Executive Director & CEO (Gears, Composites, Foundry, Stampings and Magnetic Products)
people.relation: Not related to any director
people.bio: Holds a B.Tech in production engineering from NIT Calicut and a master's in management studies from Symbiosis Institute of Business Management. He has more than 35 years of experience, from setting up greenfield plants to running operations and strategy. Before this role he was Executive Director and CEO of Mahindra Gears and Transmissions, a former subsidiary. He runs the gears, composites, foundry, stampings and magnetic products businesses in India and, since 2023, is also Executive Director and CEO of the subsidiary CIE Aluminium Casting India. He also sits on the board of Metalcastello, the Italian subsidiary.

people.name: K. Jayaprakash (Kiyath Jayaprakash Nair)
people.relation: Not related to any director
people.bio: An associate member of both the Institute of Company Secretaries of India and the Institute of Cost and Works Accountants of India, with a master's in commerce from Pune University. He has more than 35 years in finance, and has also looked after HR, purchase and IT. His experience spans engineering, retail, steel and automotive. Before joining in 2007 he was with Pantaloon Retail (CFO of the Big Bazaar business of the Future Group), and earlier worked for a steel company in Nairobi for two years.

people.name: Sunil Narke
people.relation: Not related to any director
people.bio: A mechanical engineering graduate from the College of Engineering and Technology, Pune University. He attended the Visionary Leaders for Manufacturing programme in Japan and the Oxford Advanced Management and Leadership Programme. He has about 27 years in the automotive sector in India and Europe, including roles at the Anand Group, Raymond, TI Murugappa and Mahindra & Mahindra. He joined in 2018 as Vice President, Operations and Special Projects, at the Chakan forging plant, became Chief Operating Officer in 2019 and now heads the forging division.

people.name: Vikas Sinha
people.role: Senior Vice President – Strategy and Chief Investor Relations Officer
people.relation: Not related to any director
people.bio: A mechanical engineer from IIT Delhi with an MBA from IIM Ahmedabad. He started his career as a quality engineer at Maruti Suzuki and later worked with Tata Strategic Management Group and the Group Strategy Office of Mahindra & Mahindra. He was a key member of the team when CIE Automotive entered India in 2013 by combining with Mahindra's auto component businesses. He has nearly 30 years of corporate experience and handles strategy and investor relations.

companies.changes: Rajendra Vadlapudi, CEO of the Iron Casting Division (a KMP for over 16 years), resigned with effect from 22 Jul 2026 for a new opportunity; no successor was named at the time. Rahul Desai, CEO of Stampings, Magnetic Products and Composites, left in Feb 2025 and his businesses now sit under Manoj Menon.

companies.styleNote: Run by the Talwar family, who founded the group; promoters own 58.43%. On 1 Apr 2026 the family reshuffled roles: Naresh Talwar stepped down as chairman after 26 years and stays a non-executive director; his brother Umesh Talwar became Executive Chairman; Umesh's son Anuj Talwar became MD; and Naresh's son Varun Talwar became Vice Chairman and MD. Naresh's other son Vidur Talwar is a non-executive director, as is Group CFO Navin Juneja. A hired CEO, Ashish Gupta, joined on the same date to run operations.

people.name: Umesh Talwar
people.since: Executive Chairman since Apr 2026; earlier Vice Chairman & MD
people.relation: Promoter; brother of Naresh Talwar (former chairman); father of MD Anuj Talwar
people.stake: 3.04% (18,75,090 shares, 31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); promoter group together 58.43%
people.bio: A graduate of Hindu College, Delhi University, with an MBA from XLRI Jamshedpur. He has about 48 years in the automotive components industry, all with the Talbros group. He was Vice Chairman and Managing Director until March 2026 and was then appointed Executive Chairman for three years from 1 April 2026, approved by shareholders through a postal ballot. As chairman he has guided the company to target 15–20% yearly growth and its first ₹1,000 crore of revenue.

people.name: Varun Talwar
people.relation: Promoter; son of Naresh Talwar; brother of director Vidur Talwar; cousin of MD Anuj Talwar
people.bio: Holds a B.S. in business administration from Drexel University, Philadelphia. He joined Talbros in early 2006 and was a Joint Managing Director until March 2026. From 1 April 2026 he was appointed Vice Chairman and Managing Director for three years, and he oversees the company's operations, including the forging division.

people.name: Anuj Talwar
people.relation: Promoter; son of Executive Chairman Umesh Talwar; cousin of Varun Talwar
people.bio: A business administration graduate from the College of William and Mary, Virginia, with an MBA from Boston University's Graduate School of Management. He joined Talbros in 2008 and served as Joint Managing Director until March 2026. He was appointed Managing Director for three years from 1 April 2026 and oversees operations across the businesses.

people.name: Ashish Gupta
people.relation: Not related to the promoters
people.bio: A production engineering graduate from Nagpur University with over 35 years of experience across several industries, including flexible packaging. He has held senior roles in India and abroad, including in Germany and the CIS region (Uzbekistan), and has set up and scaled automotive manufacturing operations. He was appointed CEO from 1 April 2026; the company says he will focus on operational excellence, profitability and innovation.

people.name: Manish Khanna
people.relation: Not related to the promoters
people.bio: A B.Com (Hons) graduate and chartered accountant who also holds an MBS. He has over 23 years of experience in accounting, finance, taxation and ERP implementation. He is the CFO and a key managerial person of the company.

people.name: Suresh Sharma
people.relation: Not related to the promoters
people.bio: Holds an engineering degree in mechanics and an MBA. He has over 30 years in auto components and joined Talbros in 2016. He heads the gasket division, the company's largest business.

people.name: Vivek Singh
people.relation: Not related to the promoters
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering and studied management at INSEAD, Fontainebleau. He has over 26 years of experience across manufacturing, railways, IT and engine and gearbox businesses. He heads the forging division.

companies.changes: Leadership reshuffle on 1 Apr 2026: Naresh Talwar stepped down as chairman (continues as non-executive director), Umesh Talwar became Executive Chairman, Anuj Talwar MD, Varun Talwar Vice Chairman & MD, and Ashish Gupta joined as CEO. Independent director Rajat Verma resigned on 13 Mar 2026; Pratham Mittal joined as an independent director on 20 May 2026.

companies.styleNote: Founded in Rajkot by Manesh Madeka and run by the Madeka family: Manesh is Chairman & MD, his brother Bhautik and nephew Mihir are whole-time directors. The three other board members are independent. The promoter group owned 52.24% at 31 Mar 2026; it did not tender in the ₹180cr buyback completed in July 2026, so its stake rose to 54.23%.

people.name: Manesh Dayashankar Madeka
people.relation: Founder; brother of Bhautik Madeka; uncle of Mihir Madeka
people.stake: 9.54% (2,59,89,150 shares, 31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report), about 9.9% after the July 2026 buyback; promoter group 54.23% after the buyback
people.bio: He founded the business in Rajkot, starting with traditional bearing-ring manufacturing, and has more than 39 years of experience across marketing, production and finance. He built Rolex Rings into one of India's larger hot-forged bearing-ring makers, and then into automotive components and exports. He led the company through financial restructuring in the last decade, its 2021 listing and a debt-free balance sheet, and completed the Right to Recompense payment to lenders before announcing a ₹180 crore buyback in April 2026.

people.name: Bhautik Dayashankar Madeka
people.relation: Promoter; brother of the CMD Manesh Madeka; uncle of Mihir Madeka
people.stake: 8.70% (2,36,96,060 shares, FY26 AGM notice), about 9.0% after the July 2026 buyback
people.bio: A commerce graduate from Ranchi University. He has more than 24 years of experience in production, planning and control and has been with the company since 2002; the AGM notice also cites experience in marketing and finance. He is a whole-time director and retires by rotation at the 2026 AGM, seeking re-appointment.

people.name: Mihir Rupeshkumar Madeka
people.relation: Promoter family; nephew of Manesh and Bhautik Madeka
people.bio: An engineering graduate from Nagpur University. He has more than 20 years in marketing with the company since 2002, and specialises in customer and product development, which includes bringing in the new export customers.

people.name: Hiren Dilipbhai Doshi
people.relation: Not related to the promoters
people.bio: A chartered accountant and the company's CFO and key managerial person. He presents the financials on the company's results calls, as he has done since at least 2022. The annual report does not give his earlier career.

companies.changes: No change in key managerial personnel during FY26. The ₹180cr buyback (1 crore shares at ₹180) closed in July 2026 and the shares were extinguished on 28 Jul 2026; promoters did not tender. Shares were split from ₹10 to ₹1 face value in October 2025.

companies.styleNote: The company was renamed SPR Auto Technologies in FY26. It is controlled by the Deepak Shriram family, who with the promoter group own 43.75%, mostly through the Deepak Shriram Family Benefit Trust. The family's Luv Deepak Shriram is a whole-time director, and his sister Meenakshi Dass is a non-executive director. Day-to-day the company is run by a hired MD & CEO, Krishnakumar Srinivasan. The chairman, Pradeep Dinodia, is a non-executive, non-independent director. Japan's NPR-RIKEN and Germany's Kolbenschmidt each nominate a non-executive director.

people.name: Krishnakumar Srinivasan
people.relation: Not related to the promoters
people.stake: nil (FY26 corporate governance report lists only Luv Shriram and Meenakshi Dass as director shareholders)
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering (College of Engineering, Pune), an MBA and a postgraduate diploma in export management. He has more than four decades of experience, mostly in the automotive industry, in India and abroad. Before joining he was President of Bharat Forge's European operations and business strategy, and earlier headed Eaton in Asia-Pacific. Since 2020 he has led the company's move beyond pistons, including buying the Grupo Antolin India interiors businesses, EMF Innovations (EV motors) and TGPEL Precision.

people.name: Luv Deepak Shriram
people.since: Board since Apr 2009; whole-time director since May 2014
people.relation: Promoter; brother of Meenakshi Dass (non-executive director)
people.stake: 0.02% in his own name; with his sister he holds 27.28% as trustee of the Deepak Shriram Family Benefit Trust (FY26 annual report); promoter group 43.75%
people.bio: A commerce graduate from the University of Delhi. He is from the promoter family and has over 30 years of experience in management and finance. He joined the board in April 2009 and has been a whole-time director since May 2014. He sits on the risk management and CSR committees.

people.name: Prem Prakash Rathi
people.relation: Not related to the promoters
people.bio: A chartered accountant. According to his public profile, he was CFO of Raymond's garmenting business before this and earlier held senior finance roles at AMW Motors and GHCL. He is the company's CFO and a key managerial person, and signs its financial statements with the MD & CEO.

companies.changes: Pankaj Gupta, Deputy Executive Director, Head Legal & Company Secretary, resigned on 15 Jun 2026. The company changed its name from Shriram Pistons & Rings to SPR Auto Technologies. Independent director Shinichi Unno left in May 2025 and Akihiro Ozaki joined in June 2025.

companies.styleNote: Founded and run by the Rathee family. Kuldip Singh Rathee is Chairman & MD, and his sons Prashant and Aman Rathee are Joint MDs (re-designated in May 2025). His wife Vijay Rathee is a non-executive director and the largest single shareholder. Promoters owned 65.15% at 31 Mar 2026, down from 69.15% after Kuldip sold 4% in the open market to meet the minimum public shareholding rule. Half the 10-member board is independent.

people.name: Kuldip Singh Rathee
people.relation: Founder; husband of director Vijay Rathee; father of Joint MDs Prashant and Aman Rathee
people.stake: 30.18% (5,95,03,608 shares, 31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); with his wife Vijay Rathee (34.97%) the promoters hold 65.15%
people.bio: Holds a BA (Economics Honours) from St. Stephen's College, University of Delhi. He began his career in the Central Reserve Police Force, where he was directly recruited as a Deputy Superintendent of Police in 1974 and served until 1978. He was later empanelled as a Class I contractor with the CPWD's Directorate General of Works. He founded ASK and has over 36 years in manufacturing, building it into a large maker of brake shoes, aluminium castings and control cables. With his wife he set up AHSAAS Trust, the company's CSR arm. In FY26 he sold 78.9 lakh shares (4%) to bring public holding up to the required level.

people.name: Prashant Rathee
people.relation: Son of Kuldip Singh Rathee and Vijay Rathee; brother of Aman Rathee
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in commerce from the University of Delhi. He was a director of A.A. Autotech Private Limited from 2008 until it merged into the company, gaining manufacturing experience there. He has over 25 years of experience in the industry. He was re-designated from executive director to Joint Managing Director from 13 May 2025.

people.name: Aman Rathee
people.relation: Son of Kuldip Singh Rathee and Vijay Rathee; brother of Prashant Rathee
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in science (engineering) and an MBA from Purdue University, Hammond, Indiana, USA, and has a certificate in mergers and acquisitions from Harvard Business School. He was a director of A.A. Autotech Private Limited from 2012 until it merged into the company. He has over 23 years of experience in manufacturing. He was re-designated as Joint Managing Director from 13 May 2025.

people.name: Rajesh Kataria
people.relation: Not related to the promoters
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in business administration from Chaudhary Charan Singh University, Meerut, and a master's in business administration (human resources) from the Eastern Institute for Integrated Learning in Management University, Sikkim. He has more than 21 years of experience in human resource management. He now oversees the company's operations and is also a director of the wholly owned subsidiary ASK Automobiles.

people.name: Naresh Kumar
people.relation: Not related to the promoters
people.bio: A chartered accountant and member of the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India. He is the company's CFO and a key managerial person, and signs its financial statements with the Chairman & MD.

companies.changes: Rajender Dharna, President – Operations (ALPS), retired on 30 Jun 2026. In FY26 two senior hires left within the year: Ibha Lal, CEO (Operations) of the ALPS and cable division, and Prashant Kumar Gupta, President & Chief Marketing Officer. Independent director Arun Duggal resigned in Aug 2025.

companies.styleNote: Founded and run by the Chordia family of Indore. Sunil Chordia is Chairman & MD and his son Yashovardhan Chordia is CEO & Deputy MD; Yashovardhan's wife Mohini Chordia works as a General Manager. Promoters own 65.21%, largely through family trusts and holding companies. Abhishek Dalmia is a non-executive director, and the other board members are independent.

people.name: Sunil Chordia
people.relation: Founder; father of CEO & Deputy MD Yashovardhan Chordia
people.stake: 1.04% in his own name (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); promoter group together 65.21%
people.bio: Holds a B.Sc, a DCMA and an MBA in finance from Devi Ahilya Vishwavidyalaya, Indore. He began in his family's iron and steel trading business, moved into manufacturing in 1990 and started the bead-wire business in 1995. He built Rajratan into a global bead-wire supplier, including Thailand's first bead-wire plant and a second Indian plant in Chennai. He chairs the CII National MSME Council and the Industrial Research and Technology Development Council of IIT Indore. He has been President of the Indore Management Association, Chairman of CII Western Region and Chairman of the Steel Wire Manufacturers Association of India.

people.name: Yashovardhan Chordia
people.since: Board since Jul 2019; CEO & Deputy MD since Jan 2025
people.relation: Son of Sunil Chordia; husband of Mohini Chordia (General Manager)
people.bio: Holds a degree in finance and psychology from FLAME University, Pune. He joined the board in July 2019, became a whole-time (executive) director in April 2023 and CEO & Deputy MD in January 2025. He was re-appointed until April 2029, approved at the July 2026 AGM. The company credits him with turning around and expanding the Thailand business, now a key growth engine. He leads the push into Japan, Europe and the US and oversees operations in India and Thailand. He is active in the Young Entrepreneurs Club in Thailand, EO Indore and CII.

people.name: Hitesh Jain
people.relation: Not related to the promoters
people.bio: The company's CFO and a key managerial person. He signs the financial statements and the CEO/CFO compliance certificate. The annual report does not give his education or earlier career.

companies.changes: Independent director Bhavani Balasubramanian resigned on 23 Feb 2026. Yashovardhan Chordia was re-appointed as CEO & Deputy MD from 21 Apr 2026 to 20 Apr 2029.

companies.styleNote: Promoter Nitin Menon is Executive Chairman. Day-to-day running is with MD Arun Aradhye, a long-serving professional who replaced 83-year-old R. D. Dixit in March 2026. The Menon family owns 68.44%: Nitin 27.56%, the family company Menon United 24.30%, his wife Sucheta 5.00%, and Aditya and Anshul Nitin Menon 5.79% each. Anshul, a relative of the chairman, works in the company as Executive Assistant to the Chairman.

people.name: Nitin Menon
people.since: With the company since 1992; board since Apr 1995
people.relation: Promoter; Anshul Nitin Menon (Executive Assistant to Chairman) is his relative per the annual report
people.stake: 27.56% (1,54,43,454 shares, 31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); 32.56% with his wife; family and group together 68.44%
people.bio: A commerce graduate (B.Com). He has been with Menon Bearings since it started in 1992 and has more than 31 years in the automobile sector. He also runs the family's other businesses in hospitality, agriculture and allied services. He is a director of Menon Alkop, Menon Brakes, Menon Bearing New Ventures, Menon United and the Flyga hotel and resort companies.

people.name: Arun Aradhye
people.relation: Not related to any director
people.bio: Holds an M.Com, a GDC&A, an LL.B. (Special) and CA Intermediate. He has more than 50 years of experience across banking, finance, insurance, transport, tourism, telecom and manufacturing, and before joining worked at Ghatge Patil Transport, Kolhapur. He joined in 2011, was Whole-time Director and CFO from January 2019, and became MD for five years from 4 March 2026, approved by shareholders in May 2026. He oversees finance, corporate administration, operations, production and stakeholder relations.

people.name: Chandrakant Ramchandra Ghatge
people.relation: Not related to any director
people.bio: A commerce graduate (B.Com) with about 30 years of experience. Before joining in October 2020 he worked at Mani Auto Components, Kolhapur. He was appointed CFO from 4 March 2026, when Arun Aradhye moved up to MD.

companies.changes: MD R. D. Dixit resigned on 3 Mar 2026 because of his age; Arun Aradhye became MD and Chandrakant Ghatge CFO from 4 Mar 2026. Independent director M. L. Shinde resigned on 1 Oct 2025. Prof. Rajendra Sonkawade joined as a non-executive director on 14 May 2026.

companies.styleNote: Run by promoter Gursharan Singh as Chairman & MD; his wife Narinder Paul Kaur is a non-executive director and his son Prabh Mehar Singh is Chief Operating Officer. Promoters held 42.75% at 31 Mar 2026: Gursharan 33.47%, the family company Aadhar Infosystems, and UP's state investment corporation PICUP (8.57%, which sold shares during the year). A ₹80cr preferential issue to institutions in May 2025 diluted the promoters.

people.name: Gursharan Singh
people.relation: Promoter; husband of director Narinder Paul Kaur; father of COO Prabh Mehar Singh
people.stake: 33.47% (39,45,134 shares, 31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); promoter group 42.75%
people.bio: Holds a diploma in mechanical engineering and a postgraduate diploma in export management. Before joining in 1987 he worked at Escorts Tractors (Ford). He has more than 45 years in auto component manufacturing, administration and business development. He built RACL into a precision gear maker for global motorcycle and tractor brands such as KTM, BMW and Kubota. He holds no other directorship, and the board has proposed his re-appointment as CMD from August 2027 to August 2032.

people.name: Prabh Mehar Singh
people.relation: Son of Chairman & MD Gursharan Singh
people.bio: Holds a master's in management (finance). He worked at KPMG India before joining the company in February 2016, and has about 14 years of experience. He was re-designated as Chief Operating Officer from 1 August 2025 and sits on the board's risk management committee.

people.name: Jitender Jain
people.relation: Not related to the promoters
people.bio: A chartered accountant with about 24 years of experience. He joined as CFO in September 2023 from banking; his earlier employers include Citibank and RBL Bank. He is a key managerial person and sits on the board's risk management committee.

people.name: Rajiv Kumar Goel
people.relation: Not related to the promoters
people.bio: A mechanical engineering graduate (B.Tech) with about 35 years of experience, all of it with the company since 1990. He was re-designated as Chief Technical Officer from 1 August 2025.

companies.changes: Prabh Mehar Singh (COO) and Rajiv Goel (CTO) were re-designated on 1 Aug 2025. No change in KMP in FY26. Gursharan Singh's re-appointment as CMD for 2027–32 was put to the Sep 2026 AGM.

companies.styleNote: Part of the TVS group; the promoter company TVS Sundram Fasteners holds 46.79% (promoter group 46.95%). Suresh Krishna's family runs it: Chairman Suresh Krishna is now a non-executive director (re-appointed to 2031), his daughter Arathi Krishna is MD and his daughter Arundathi Krishna is Joint MD. A third daughter, Preethi Krishna, is a non-executive director.

people.name: Arathi Krishna
people.relation: Daughter of Chairman Suresh Krishna; sister of Joint MD Arundathi Krishna and director Preethi Krishna
people.stake: 0.02% (47,040 shares, 31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); promoter group 46.95%, mostly via TVS Sundram Fasteners Pvt Ltd
people.bio: Holds an MA in economics from Stella Maris College and an MBA from the University of Michigan Business School. She joined Sundram Fasteners as a management trainee in 1990, became manager for business strategy and systems in 1993 and general manager in 1998. She was Executive Director from 2006 to 2011 and Joint MD from 2011 to 2018, and became MD on 20 April 2018. She was re-appointed for five years from 3 May 2026 to 2 May 2031.

people.name: Arundathi Krishna
people.relation: Daughter of Chairman Suresh Krishna; sister of MD Arathi Krishna and director Preethi Krishna
people.stake: 0.02% (51,840 shares) plus a 9.35% beneficial interest (FY26 AGM notice)
people.bio: Holds an MA in econometrics from the University of Madras, where she ranked second in her class, and an MBA from the University of Michigan. She worked at America-On-Line Netscape in San Francisco, as a freelance journalist with The Hindu and Business Line (1994) and as a brand manager at Pond's India (1996). She joined the company in 1997 as manager for business strategy and systems and set up the gear-shifter assembly project. She became a whole-time director in 2008, Deputy MD in 2013 and Joint MD in April 2018. She oversees TVS Upasana (where she is MD) and the overseas subsidiaries.

people.name: R Dilip Kumar
people.relation: Not related to the promoters
people.bio: A chartered accountant and company secretary with more than 31 years of experience (as of 2022) in accounts, finance, secretarial work, taxation, and compensation and benefits. He was the company secretary before becoming CFO on 1 July 2022, when he handed that role to G Anand Babu.

companies.changes: No change in directors or KMP in FY26. Arathi Krishna was re-appointed MD from 3 May 2026 and Suresh Krishna as non-executive director from 1 Jul 2026.

companies.styleNote: Founder Srinivasan Ravi is Chairman and MD; his son Ravi Gauthamram is a whole-time director. Both were re-appointed for five more years from 1 Oct 2026. Finance and operations are run by long-serving hired managers. Promoters own 42.4% after the June 2026 raise and the founder's 2% sale.

people.name: Srinivasan Ravi
people.relation: Founder and promoter; father of Whole-time Director Ravi Gauthamram
people.stake: 44.0% (1,05,00,000 shares at 31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); he sold about 2% of the company on 23 Jun 2026; promoter group now 42.4%
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering from PSG College of Technology, Coimbatore. He started the business in 1984, at 21, as a partnership with college seniors while still a final-year student, and it began as a small machining unit in Coimbatore in 1986. He is a first-generation entrepreneur with almost 40 years in engineering; he dabbled in plastics, die-casting and textiles in the 1990s before focusing only on Craftsman. He led the buys of DR Axion India, Sunbeam Lightweighting and Craftsman Germany. He is 63. FY26 pay was ₹11.94cr; from FY27 the board approved ₹50 lakh a month, and 9% of votes opposed his re-appointment.

people.name: Ravi Gauthamram
people.since: On the board since Feb 2014; whole-time director
people.relation: Son of Chairman & MD Srinivasan Ravi
people.bio: A mechanical engineering graduate of PSG College of Technology, with a master's in production systems engineering from RWTH Aachen University, Germany. Before joining the company he worked at Caterpillar India. He oversees the powertrain segment, including large engine blocks, and the industrial and engineering products (including storage), greenfield projects and the German foundry, Craftsman Fronberg Guss. He is vice-president of the Coimbatore Industrial Infrastructure Association. He is 38; FY26 pay was ₹3.99cr.

people.name: C.B. Chandrasekar
people.bio: Holds a commerce degree from the University of Madras and is an associate of both the Institute of Cost Accountants of India and the Institute of Company Secretaries of India. He has more than three decades in finance, accounts and secretarial work. Before Craftsman he worked at Lakshmi Machine Works and Elgi Equipments. He took the company through its 2021 IPO and later equity raises.

people.name: Thiyagaraj Damodharaswamy
people.since: COO since Aug 2017; with the company since Jan 2002
people.bio: Holds a diploma in mechanical engineering from PSG Polytechnic, where he won the best outgoing student award, and a bachelor's in mechanical engineering from Bharathiar University. He worked at Rieter-LMW Machinery before joining Craftsman in 2002 as a quality systems engineer. He rose to COO – Automotive in 2017 and is now named COO – Powertrain among the company's key managerial personnel.

companies.changes: No change in key managerial personnel found since the FY26 annual report. The CMD and whole-time director were re-appointed at the 23 Jul 2026 AGM for 2026–2031.

companies.styleNote: The Rai family controls it; Shailendrajit (S.) Rai is Managing Director and the only executive director. The group traces back to Atlas Automotive Components, founded by Charanjit Rai in 1967. Day-to-day operations are run by a hired CEO, Sumit Bhatnagar, who took over from Rajeev Sikand on 1 Apr 2026. The chairman, Ajay Nanavati, is non-executive and not family. In May 2026 the MD's wife Pamela Rai left the board and their son Ishaan Rai, a lawyer, joined as a non-executive director. Promoters own about 54%.

people.name: Shailendrajit Rai
people.since: On the board since Oct 2002; Managing Director since Nov 2014
people.relation: Promoter; husband of former director Pamela Rai; father of non-executive director Ishaan Rai
people.stake: 6.87% (11,22,350 shares at 31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); promoter group about 54%, mostly through Nastic Trading LLP (41.4%)
people.bio: He holds an undergraduate degree from the University of Kent, UK (per Bloomberg). He has been on the board through the Enkei years, the 2010 rename to Alicon, the addition of the Austrian firm Illichmann and the 2017 merger of Atlas Castalloy. He was Chairman and MD from 2019 to 2022 and has sat on the board of group firm Atlas Castalloy for over three decades; the company bought ₹36cr of plant from Atlas Castalloy in FY26. He is also a director of Enkei Wheels (India) and several Rai family holding companies. His FY26 pay was about ₹1cr, small next to total key management pay of ₹22cr.

people.name: Sumit Bhatnagar
people.since: Joined Sep 2025 as CEO-designate; CEO since 1 Apr 2026
people.bio: Holds a BE in production engineering from Jawaharlal Nehru Engineering College, Aurangabad, and a PGDBM in finance and strategy (2011) from IIM Kozhikode. He has over 26 years in auto components. He was Business Head at Anand CY Myutec (2008–2011), then Senior Vice President and COO of Gabriel India (2011–2017). From 2017 he was Group President at the ANAND Group, and from 2022 MD of its arm ANEVOLVE and head of group manufacturing excellence. He was hired to succeed the long-serving CEO Rajeev Sikand.

people.name: Vimal Gupta
people.bio: He has been with the company since December 2006 and is its long-serving Group CFO, leading the earnings calls. His LinkedIn profile lists earlier roles at Motherson Sumi Systems, Subros and Industrial Technology (ME). His pay fell 10.7% in FY26.

people.name: Manish Kapoor
people.bio: He joined as COO in mid-2025 with more than 30 years in industry, per the CFO on the Q1 FY26 call. His LinkedIn profile lists a stint as Joint Vice President at AIA Engineering and earlier roles at Amtek Auto, Osram and Birla Yamaha, plus an earlier spell at Alicon. It also lists an MBA from Madhya Pradesh Bhoj University and a graduate diploma in materials management from the Indian Institute of Materials Management, Mumbai.

companies.changes: CEO Rajeev Sikand retired on 31 Mar 2026; Sumit Bhatnagar took over on 1 Apr 2026. Company Secretary Sneha Shukla joined on 10 Nov 2025. Pamela Rai left the board on 12 May 2026 and her son Ishaan Rai joined as a non-executive director the same day. Ashish Srivastava joined as Chief HR Officer in Sep 2025.

companies.styleNote: A family business run by the Aggarwals. Founder Anil Aggarwal is Chairman and Whole-time Director. Atul Aggarwal, who is family, is MD. Anil's sons Akhill (sales) and Anish (finance and the EV parts arm) are whole-time directors, a planned hand-over to the next generation. The EV motor-controller subsidiary is run by non-executive director Jaideep Wadhwa. Promoters own 64.9%.

people.name: Anil Aggarwal
people.since: Founder (company incorporated 1979); CMD until May 2024; re-appointed Chairman & WTD for five years from 1 Apr 2026
people.relation: Founder and promoter; father of Whole-time Directors Akhill Aggarwal and Anish Agarwal; related to MD Atul Aggarwal
people.stake: 16.81% (61,10,583 shares at 31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); promoter group 64.9%
people.bio: A commerce graduate (B.Com) with 49 years in auto components: manufacturing, project management, product development and quality. The annual report calls him the founder of the Sterling Group, which grew from one Faridabad fastener plant into a diversified parts maker that now also makes EV motor controllers. He was Chairman and MD until May 2024, when he handed the MD role to Atul Aggarwal and moved to a mentoring role as Chairman and Whole-time Director. He is 68; FY26 pay was ₹3.79cr.

people.name: Atul Aggarwal
people.since: Employed since 1994; MD since May 2024; re-appointed for five years from 1 Apr 2026
people.relation: Promoter; related to Chairman Anil Aggarwal (he has said the first plant was set up by his late father and elder brother)
people.stake: 25.99% (94,45,574 shares at 31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report), the largest single holder
people.bio: Holds a B.Com from Shri Ram College of Commerce, Delhi University, and an MBA from the Kenan-Flagler Business School, University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill. He has 36 years of experience across strategy, marketing and sales, finance, corporate affairs and IT. As MD he leads group strategy, customer relationships and the push into electric-vehicle and green-technology parts. He is 62; FY26 pay was ₹3.72cr.

people.name: Akhill Aggarwal
people.since: On the board since Aug 2019; employed since Jul 2024; Whole-time Director since May 2024
people.relation: Son of Chairman Anil Aggarwal; brother of Whole-time Director & CFO Anish Agarwal
people.stake: 7.35% (26,71,838 shares at 31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); the Aug 2026 AGM notice shows 31,71,838 shares
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in economics from the University of Richmond, USA. He has 16 years in the auto business and related services. He runs OEM and after-market sales and sits on the risk management committee. He is also a director of group firms including Sterling Tech-Mobility, Sterling E-Mobility and Jaycee Automobiles. He is 41; FY26 pay was ₹1.04cr.

people.name: Anish Agarwal
people.role: Whole-time Director & Chief Financial Officer; heads Sterling Tech-Mobility
people.since: Director before FY26 (non-executive); CFO and Whole-time Director since 15 May 2026
people.relation: Son of Chairman Anil Aggarwal; brother of Whole-time Director Akhill Aggarwal
people.stake: 7.53% (27,37,317 shares at 31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report)
people.bio: A third-generation entrepreneur with degrees in manufacturing and mechanical engineering from the University of Warwick and an MBA from Imperial College Business School, London. He has over 14 years in the auto sector, mainly in electric-vehicle businesses and new product development. Besides leading group finance, he heads Sterling Tech-Mobility, which is building the group's high-voltage EV components business. He became CFO after the previous CFO, Pankaj Gupta, left on 31 Dec 2025.

people.name: Roney John
people.bio: An MBA with 32 years of experience, he joined on 11 Nov 2025 from Endurance Technologies. He is 53 and is among the company's highest-paid employees named in the FY26 annual report.

companies.changes: CFO Pankaj Gupta resigned with effect from 31 Dec 2025; Anish Agarwal became CFO and Whole-time Director from 15 May 2026 (approved by shareholders 26 Jun 2026). Company Secretary Komal Malik (joined Aug 2025) left on 28 Feb 2026; Pragya Saxena is CS from 23 Mar 2026. Roney John joined as Chief Manufacturing Officer in Nov 2025.

companies.styleNote: A promoter-run firm that grew out of the Omega Bright Steel ('Anglian Omega') group. MD Saksham Leekha runs it with his paternal uncle, Executive Director Ashwani Leekha. Veteran Sanjeev Verma, who helped set it up, is Executive Director and CFO. The chairperson, Asha Narang, is non-executive; she has 50+ years with the Anglian Omega group and holds 29.6% of Omega Bright Steel, a related-party steel supplier. Promoters owned 69.8% at March 2026 and 66.2% after the Sep 2026 share issue.

people.name: Saksham Leekha
people.since: On the board since the company was formed (17 Mar 2017)
people.relation: Promoter; nephew of Executive Director Ashwani Leekha
people.stake: 13.91% (35,95,447 shares at 31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); promoter group 69.81% then, 66.2% after the Sep 2026 issue
people.bio: Holds a B.Tech in computer science from Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University. He has been MD since the company was set up in 2017. He oversees all plants and leads customer additions, new products, technology upgrades and automation, and also handles investor relations. He took the company public on NSE Emerge in Oct 2024 and raised more equity in Feb and Sep 2026. His FY26 salary was ₹36 lakh, the only pay drawn by an executive director.

people.name: Ashwani Leekha
people.relation: Promoter; paternal uncle of MD Saksham Leekha
people.stake: 17.27% (44,62,500 shares at 31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report), the largest individual holding among directors
people.bio: He has over 35 years in precision engineering, per the May 2026 investor presentation. He oversees plant operations and process improvement. The annual report shows no salary paid to him by the company in FY26. He retires by rotation and seeks re-appointment at the Sep 2026 AGM.

people.name: Sanjeev Verma
people.stake: 0.03% (7,600 shares at 31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); he also owns 25.25% of related-party supplier Omega Bright Steel & Components
people.bio: He has 35+ years in the steel and auto-component industry and, per the company, played a pivotal role in forming OBSC Perfection. He leads expansion and runs finance as CFO. He owns a quarter of Omega Bright Steel & Components, which invests in the company and sells it steel. Shareholders are being asked to approve large transactions with that firm. No salary was paid to him by the company in FY26.

people.name: Kuntal Mukherjee
people.bio: Named in the May 2026 investor presentation as Chief Growth Officer. He holds an MBA in marketing and strategy from Liverpool Business School. He has 13+ years in sales and marketing and has worked at Bosch and ZF.

companies.changes: Company Secretary Mudit Johri resigned in Sep 2026; Heena Arora was appointed CS in Sep 2026. Independent directors Saurabh Priya Singh (Mar 2026) and Mohit Bhardwaj (May 2026) joined. The presentation also names a business head, Aarush Leekha (UK master's in international business), whose family link is not disclosed.

companies.styleNote: The Kapur family controls it. Co-promoter Arvind Kapur, 76, is Chairman, CEO and MD. His nephew Samarth Kapur is a whole-time director who runs the alloy-wheel subsidiary, and his daughter Shikha Kapur (ex-Walmart, Whirlpool, EY) sits as a non-executive director. Two long-serving hired engineers, Rajiv Kumar Miglani and Kaushalendra Verma, are whole-time directors who each run a business division. Promoters own 50.3%.

people.name: Arvind Kapur
people.since: Co-promoter since incorporation (company set up 1983–84; production from 1986)
people.relation: Co-promoter; father of director Shikha Kapur; uncle of Whole-time Director Samarth Kapur
people.stake: 10.44% (1,41,18,043 shares at 31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); promoter group 50.3%
people.bio: A science graduate from St. Stephen's College, University of Delhi, who also did a management programme at Harvard Business School. He co-promoted the company and has over four decades in the auto-parts industry, building it into an aluminium and iron casting and machining group. He was President of the Automotive Component Manufacturers Association (ACMA) in 2011–12 and Vice-President in 2010–11. He is also a director of Subros and of family holding firms including ASN Manufacturing and Services, which owns 15.4% of Rico. He was born in July 1950.

people.name: Rajiv Kumar Miglani
people.role: Whole-time Director (Executive Director), Business Division I
people.since: With Rico since 1999; Executive Director since Aug 2022; re-appointed to Aug 2027
people.bio: Holds a diploma in mechanical engineering from Karnal (1983). He was an industrial engineer at New Allenberry Works (1983–85), then spent ten years at Maruti Udyog in engine-parts machining and four years heading the engine-parts machine shop at Daewoo Motors India, with training at Suzuki in Japan and Daewoo in Korea. At Rico since 1999, he runs Business Division I: the Gurugram aluminium and iron casting and machining plants, Pathredi, Halol and Bawal, the defence arm AAN Engineering, automation and robotics, corporate purchase and after-market sales. He has also been MD of Rico Aluminium and Ferrous Auto Components since 2019.

people.name: Kaushalendra Verma
people.role: Whole-time Director (Executive Director), Business Division II
people.since: With Rico group since about 2010; re-appointed to Aug 2027
people.bio: Holds a BE in industrial engineering from Nagpur University (1991) and did senior executive programmes, including one from the Ross School of Business. He started at DLF Industries in 1991, worked at Northwest Switch Gears and Minda, then spent 1997–2019 as country head or MD at Delphi Automotive Systems, Magna Powertrain and Magna Rico Powertrain. At Rico he runs Business Division II (Chennai, Haridwar, Rico Jinfei Wheels, Rico Fluidtronics, Rico Friction Technologies, dies and moulds) plus sales, HR, IT, engineering and R&D. He is also MD of Rico Fluidtronics.

people.name: Samarth Kapur
people.role: Whole-time Director (Executive Director); runs Rico Jinfei Wheels
people.since: With the group since about 2012; on the board since Aug 2022; re-appointed to Aug 2027
people.relation: Nephew of Chairman Arvind Kapur
people.bio: A commerce graduate from GGDSD College, Chandigarh, with a master's in global business management from the University of Manchester. He has been a whole-time director of subsidiary Rico Jinfei Wheels, which makes two-wheeler alloy wheels, since December 2017 and manages that company's affairs. He is paid by the subsidiary, not by Rico. He was born in 1988.

people.name: Naveen Sorot
people.bio: A chartered accountant (2005) with a B.Com (Hons) from Delhi University (2000). He has over 20 years in auto-component finance, covering corporate finance, planning, investor relations, credit ratings and M&A. He was previously CFO of Steel Strips Wheels and of Sunbeam Auto, and a corporate finance manager at Hi-Tech Gears. He says he has run greenfield and brownfield projects and bought assets under the insolvency code.

companies.changes: CFO Rakesh Kumar Sharma retired on 12 Nov 2025; Naveen Sorot took over on 13 Nov 2025. The three whole-time directors were re-appointed for two years from 26 Aug 2025.

companies.styleNote: Run by three promoter groups that listed it on the BSE SME platform in 2026. The Kulkarnis, founder-chairman Anil Kulkarni and his son, MD Sanket Kulkarni, run the factory side. Rahul Ranka, an investor-promoter since 2011–12, runs the commercial side. The Agrawal family (Vaishali Agrawal as non-executive director and Bhavya Agrawal as CFO) invested through Bhavya Financial Services. Before the IPO, Jayshree Anil Kulkarni held 28.5%, Rahul Ranka 26.5% and Bhavya Financial Services 25.0%; promoters now own 60.6%. Independent directors joined only in Dec 2025, ahead of the listing.

people.name: Anil Shivajirao Kulkarni
people.since: 1993 (MD from Sep 1993; company set up in 1992–93 as Pooja Castings)
people.relation: Founder-promoter; father of MD Sanket Kulkarni
people.stake: 6.84% (10,00,320 shares at 31 Mar 2026, before the IPO; FY26 annual report); promoter group 60.6% after the IPO
people.bio: Holds a BSc in mechanical engineering from Ranchi University and has over 32 years in aluminium die-casting, tooling and engineering manufacturing. He has been with the company since it began in 1993, first as MD, and is now Chairman and Whole-time Director, re-appointed for three years in Dec 2025. He sets strategy and capital spending and mentors senior managers. He is 76. The AGM notice shows FY26 pay of ₹3.84cr, large next to FY26 profit of ₹33cr.

people.name: Sanket Anil Kulkarni
people.relation: Son of Chairman Anil Kulkarni
people.stake: 2.06% (3,01,200 shares at 31 Mar 2026, before the IPO; FY26 annual report)
people.bio: Holds a BE in mechanical engineering from the University of Pune and a post-diploma in tool design. He has over 16 years in casting and engineering. As MD he leads production, operations, quality, finance and business development, focusing on cost, productivity, capacity use and tooling and die design. He has personally guaranteed the company's SBI loans, along with his father and Rahul Ranka.

people.name: Rahul Sohanlal Ranka
people.relation: Promoter (not related to the Kulkarnis); his father is a director of G K Founders, a related-party supplier
people.stake: 26.47% (38,74,480 shares at 31 Mar 2026, before the IPO; FY26 annual report)
people.bio: He has over 25 years in alloy manufacturing, casting and engineering. He invested in the company in 2011–12 and joined the board in 2012. He runs commercial operations: product costing and yield, negotiations with OEMs, Tier-1 and export customers, raw-material buying and vendor contracts. The company seeks approval for material purchases from and sales to G K Founders, where his father is a director.

people.name: Bhavya Dakshendra Agrawal
people.relation: Promoter from the Agrawal family (Vaishali and Dakshendra Agrawal are also promoters)
people.bio: A promoter of the company with over 5 years of experience. The annual report calls him part of the younger generation of leaders. He oversees financial planning, reporting and controls, and was made CFO in December 2025 ahead of the IPO. The annual report does not give his education.

companies.changes: Company Secretary Bhavana Tak resigned on 26 Jun 2026; Shalaka Khandelwal replaced her the same day. Three independent directors joined on 16 Dec 2025 before the IPO.

companies.styleNote: The Shah family runs it. Promoter Yatin Shah is Chairman and MD, and his son Karan Shah is a whole-time director for business development. His wife Dr Suhasini Shah is a non-executive director and heads the group's CSR foundation. Finance is run by long-serving whole-time director and CFO Ravindra Joshi, who is not family. Promoters own 65.4%, with Yatin Shah alone holding about 40%.

people.name: Yatin S. Shah
people.since: Director since Jun 1992, when the company started commercial production
people.relation: Promoter; husband of director Dr Suhasini Shah; father of Whole-time Director Karan Shah
people.stake: 39.78% (3,77,88,717 shares at 31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); promoter group incl. Cams Technology (14.22%) and Suhasini Shah (11.35%) 65.37%
people.bio: The promoter of the Solapur camshaft maker, on its board since June 1992, when the company began production. The FY26 annual report credits him with over 30 years in auto components, covering business management, strategy, marketing, sales and administration. As CMD he runs overall management, strategy and customer relationships. Under him the company bought MFT in Germany and EMOSS in the Netherlands; in FY26 the company wrote off its investment in German unit MFT, which went into liquidation. His FY26 pay was ₹3.14cr; the board seeks approval for up to ₹3.83cr in FY27 even if profits are inadequate. His education is not given in the annual report.

people.name: Ravindra R. Joshi
people.bio: He has over 35 years in finance, accounting, mergers and acquisitions, profitability management and governance. He has worked on the company's expansion, financial management and cost cuts. He has also overseen procurement and production and led the company-wide SAP roll-out. As CFO he runs treasury, planning, risk and compliance. His FY26 pay was ₹2.77cr.

people.name: Karan Y. Shah
people.since: On the board since Aug 2018; re-appointed as whole-time director in Jul 2023
people.relation: Son of Chairman & MD Yatin Shah and director Dr Suhasini Shah
people.stake: 0.02% (14,500 shares at 31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report)
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's in mechanical engineering from Purdue University, USA, and an MBA from Harvard Business School. He handles business development, strategic planning and new business, and works on customer relationships and operational efficiency. His FY26 pay was ₹71 lakh.

companies.changes: No change in key managerial personnel in FY26 or since the annual report was published.

companies.styleNote: Three generations of the Jalan family. Founder Mahabir Prasad Jalan (BITS Pilani mechanical engineer, set up the company in 1981) is non-executive 'Chairman Emeritus'. His son Naresh Jalan is MD and grandson Chaitanya Jalan is a whole-time director. Two long-serving professionals, CFO Lalit Kumar Khetan and marketing head Milesh Gandhi, are also whole-time directors. Promoters own 43.4%, mostly through family companies; Chaitanya also holds 34 lakh warrants issued in 2025–26.

people.name: Naresh Jalan
people.since: Joined 1995; MD; re-appointment for Nov 2026–Nov 2029 proposed at the 2026 AGM
people.relation: Son of founder and Chairman Emeritus Mahabir Prasad Jalan; father of Whole-time Director Chaitanya Jalan
people.stake: 1.52% (27,65,425 shares at 31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); promoter group 43.4%
people.bio: An MBA with 32 years of experience, he joined the family company in January 1995, straight into the business. As MD he took it into hot, warm and cold forgings, castings, advanced machining and heat treatment, and made it India's second-largest forging company by revenue. He drove greenfield plants and acquisitions. He is 51; FY26 pay was ₹4.92cr, including ₹2.5cr commission above the legal limits that needs shareholder approval.

people.name: Chaitanya Jalan
people.since: Joined 2017; employed as whole-time director since Nov 2019
people.relation: Son of MD Naresh Jalan; grandson of founder Mahabir Prasad Jalan
people.stake: 1.68% (30,47,900 shares at 31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report), plus 34,00,000 warrants at ₹588 (about ₹200cr) allotted Jan 2026
people.bio: A B.Com (Hons) graduate of St. Xavier's College, Kolkata, and the third generation of the family in the business. He joined in 2017 and leads acquisitions and forward integration, including the moves into warm and cold forgings, castings and electric-mobility parts. He also oversees daily plant operations and pushed wider use of IT. He is 29; FY26 pay was ₹2.21cr.

people.name: Lalit Kumar Khetan
people.stake: 0.04% (66,000 shares at 31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report), plus ESOPs
people.bio: A chartered accountant and cost accountant with 30 years in finance, accounts, compliance and audit. He was CFO of several companies, including large EPC and manufacturing firms, for about 20 years; his last job was at McNally Bharat Engineering. At Ramkrishna he worked on all the recent acquisitions and won CII (Southern Region)'s CFO excellence award for FY24. He is 56; FY26 pay was ₹2.02cr.

people.name: Milesh Gandhi
people.since: With the company since Sep 2000; whole-time director since Jun 2024
people.stake: 0.01% (25,632 shares at 31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report), plus ESOPs
people.bio: A B.Com (Hons) graduate with executive programmes, and 25 years at the company. He heads marketing and global sales strategy. He opened markets in autos, railways, defence, earthmoving, mining, farm equipment and energy in India and abroad. He is 46; FY26 pay was ₹1.01cr.

people.name: Sakti Prasad Senapati
people.bio: Holds an MBA and a diploma in labour law, with 28 years of experience. He joined from NRB Bearings in April 2016 and is among the company's ten highest-paid employees named in the FY26 annual report. He is 53.

people.name: Rahul Kumar Bagaria
people.bio: A chartered accountant with 21 years of experience, all at the company since September 2005. He heads accounts and finance under the CFO and is listed on the company's leadership page. He is 48.

companies.changes: No change in key managerial personnel in FY26. Independent directors Partha Sarathi Bhattacharyya and Sandipan Chakravortty completed their terms on 20–21 May 2026; Chetan Desai joined as an independent director on 29 Apr 2026.

companies.styleNote: A subsidiary of US-based Tenneco (owned by Apollo funds). Tenneco group companies own 74.79% after the November 2025 IPO, which was entirely a sale of shares by the parent. Hired managers run it; the chairman, Niranjan Kumar Gupta (CFO of Hindustan Unilever), is independent, and two Tenneco LLC executives sit as non-executive directors. No director or manager is from a promoter family, and no director owns shares.

people.name: Arvind Chandrasekharan (Arvind Chandra)
people.bio: He has a bachelor's degree in chemical engineering from Bombay University, a master's in industrial engineering (robotics) from Oklahoma State University and an MBA from the University of Michigan. He has more than two decades in the auto industry, with leadership roles at Delphi (now Phinia) across its powertrain, energy and exhaust divisions, Faurecia's exhaust business, WABCO and Minda Corporation. Just before Tenneco he was India CEO of the Aliaxis Group. He runs all of Tenneco's Indian businesses: clean air, Monroe ride products, Champion ignition, and bearings and seals.

people.name: Rishi Verma
people.role: President (runs Clean Air & Powertrain and Advanced Ride Technologies)
people.since: With the company since April 2019; Tenneco group since August 2007
people.bio: He leads the company's operations across both its clean air and powertrain business and its ride (suspension) business. He has been with the Tenneco group since August 2007, working across R&D, operations, sales, programme management and general management. Before that he worked at National Engineering Industries, Dana India Technical Centre and Walker Exhaust India.

people.name: Mahender Chhabra
people.bio: He has nearly three decades in finance and business leadership, and is responsible for financial strategy, operations, compliance and overall financial performance. Before joining in June 2025 he held senior finance roles at Motherson Sumi Wiring India and HMD Mobile India.

people.name: R. C. Subramaniam
people.role: Managing Director, Advanced Ride Technologies (in subsidiary Tenneco Automotive India)
people.bio: He runs the Advanced Ride Technologies (shock absorbers and struts) division, which sits in the material subsidiary Tenneco Automotive India. He has been with the Tenneco group since January 2009. Earlier he worked at General Motors India and Saint-Gobain Glass India, with a background in manufacturing and operations.

people.name: Aditya Kohli
people.bio: He has a postgraduate diploma in human resources from Symbiosis Institute of Management Studies and more than 20 years in HR. Before joining on 1 April 2026 he worked at Orient Electric, Clix Capital, Bharti Airtel, Standard Chartered Bank and Hewitt Associates.

companies.changes: Aditya Kohli joined as CHRO on 1 April 2026. Non-executive director Utsav Baijal (Apollo nominee) resigned on 30 May 2026 and Noah Jesse Falk joined as a non-executive director. No change in the CEO or CFO since the annual report.

companies.styleNote: Run by the Relan family. Promoter Ajay Relan has been MD since the company was set up in 1986 and his son Aashim Relan is CEO. From 1 September 2026 Ajay Relan was re-appointed as a whole-time director with the title Executive Chairperson (board approved in August; put to the 24 September 2026 AGM). The current chairperson, Kishan N Parikh, is a non-executive, non-independent director and not family. Promoters own about 64.3%, of which 46% sits in the SMIL Trust with Ajay Relan as trustee. A hired Deputy MD (ex-Varroc CEO) joined in July 2025.

people.name: Ajay Relan
people.role: Managing Director; Whole-time Director & Executive Chairperson from 1 September 2026
people.relation: Promoter; father of CEO Aashim Relan
people.stake: 12.25% (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); as trustee of the SMIL Trust he also controls another 46.00%; promoter group together about 64.3%
people.bio: He has a B.Com (Hons.) and attended Harvard Business School's Owner/President Management Programme. He has been with Sharda Motor since it was incorporated in 1986 and has led it as MD, building its exhaust and suspension parts business, new plants and joint ventures with global component makers; the board credits him with the company's turnaround. He is also a director of Relan Industrial Finance, an associate company. He is 64. His proposed pay as Executive Chairperson is above the SEBI threshold for promoter directors, so it needs a special resolution.

people.name: Aashim Relan
people.since: Not stated in the annual report
people.relation: Son of MD Ajay Relan
people.bio: He graduated in finance and economics from Emory University, Atlanta, and holds other business certifications. As CEO he is responsible for supply chain, operations, strategy and innovation. He is a key managerial person but not on the board.

people.name: Ashwani Maheshwari
people.role: Deputy Managing Director (senior management, not on the board)
people.bio: He has a mechanical engineering degree from IIT Roorkee, is a Sloan Fellow of London Business School, and attended executive programmes at Wharton and Stanford. He has more than 31 years of experience in turnarounds and transformations. He was CEO and executive director of Varroc Engineering from 2018 to 2020 and an operating partner at private-equity firm Kedaara Capital in 2024–25; earlier he was President of Birla Tyres at Kesoram Industries and a senior vice president at ITC Infotech.

people.name: Nitin Vishnoi
people.since: On the board as whole-time director (DIN 08538925)
people.bio: He has a B.Com (Hons.) and is a fellow member of the Institute of Company Secretaries of India, with more than 34 years in corporate restructuring, compliance and governance. He sits on the board as the only executive director other than Ajay Relan, and also serves as company secretary. He led the company's ERP implementation.

people.name: Ghan Shyam Dass
people.bio: He is a qualified chartered accountant and cost accountant (CMA) with more than 25 years across industries including automotive. He has handled large organic and acquisition-led growth projects and business transformations. He became CFO on 1 April 2025.

people.name: Deepak Manchanda
people.bio: He has a PG diploma in business management (marketing and systems) from IMT Ghaziabad and a master's-level certification in mechanical engineering from CIIMS Nagpur. He has more than 29 years in automotive, aerospace and defence businesses, including Spark Minda, Samvardhana Motherson, Escorts and Delphi Automotive. He leads the company's overseas business.

companies.changes: Two senior managers (Head–People Practices and Head–Strategic Initiatives) stopped being counted as senior management on 31 January 2026 after a reorganisation; both stay employed. Ajay Relan's term as MD ended on 31 August 2026; he was re-appointed as Whole-time Director and Executive Chairperson from 1 September 2026, subject to shareholder approval at the 24 September 2026 AGM.

companies.styleNote: Run by the Relan family. Promoter Rohit Relan is non-executive Co-Chairman and his son Rishabh Relan is a non-executive director; his twin sons Pranav and Ayush Relan are whole-time directors who run day-to-day operations. The chairman, Sanjiv Kapur, is a non-executive director and not family. In September 2025 the family moved all its shares, 73.13% of the company, into the Rohit Relan Family Trust, so no family member now holds shares directly. Pranav, Ayush and Rajat Bhandari all came from Bharat Seats, a related party.

people.name: Pranav Relan
people.relation: Son of Co-Chairman Rohit Relan; brother of directors Rishabh and Ayush Relan
people.stake: nil directly (FY26 annual report); a beneficiary of the Rohit Relan Family Trust, which holds 73.13%
people.bio: He has an economics degree from Emory College of Arts and Sciences, Emory University (USA), and has passed the NISM equity derivatives certification. From July 2015 to July 2018 he worked at a stockbroking firm that is a member of the NSE, then served as Assistant Chief Operating Officer at group company Bharat Seats, handling financial, operating and compliance controls. He joined the NDR board in October 2020 and runs day-to-day management with a focus on operations and growth. He is 34. Shareholders re-appointed him for three more years from 27 October 2026 at the July 2026 AGM.

people.name: Ayush Relan
people.since: January 2021 (on the board from October 2020; re-appointed to January 2030)
people.relation: Son of Co-Chairman Rohit Relan; brother of directors Rishabh and Pranav Relan
people.stake: nil directly (FY26 annual report); a beneficiary of the Rohit Relan Family Trust, which holds 73.13%
people.bio: He has a BS in business administration (entrepreneurship and marketing) from Northeastern University, Boston. Before NDR he was Assistant Chief Operating Officer at group company Bharat Seats. He has been a whole-time director since 2 January 2021 and shares day-to-day management with his brother, with a focus on operations and growth. He is also a director of the joint ventures Toyota Boshoku Relan India and Toyo Sharda India and the new subsidiaries. He is 34. Shareholders re-appointed him for three more years from 2 January 2027.

people.name: Rajat Bhandari
people.since: November 2020 on the board; whole-time director since January 2021 (re-appointed to January 2030)
people.bio: He is a chartered accountant and company secretary with more than 40 years in the Indian auto-component industry. He has worked in finance, secretarial, purchasing and supply chain at Escorts group companies, Federal-Mogul Goetze India and Bharat Seats. He is the company's only executive director from outside the family. He is 62.

people.name: Vikram Krishan Rathi
people.stake: 2,450 shares (FY26 annual report), a negligible stake
people.bio: He is a chartered accountant with about 25 years of experience. He joined NDR in August 2024 from Uno Minda and became CFO on 1 April 2025. He is 52.

companies.changes: No change in executives since the annual report. The July 2026 AGM approved three-year re-appointments of Pranav Relan, Ayush Relan and Rajat Bhandari. The board granted employee stock options in August 2026.

companies.styleNote: Co-founder K. A. Joseph is Managing Director and his son Kevin Joseph is an executive director, but a hired Group CEO, Sanjay Thapar, has led strategy, acquisitions and finance since 2015. The promoter owns only 20.90%; private-equity firm Everstone (Evergraph) sold out and was reclassified as public in 2025. The chairman, Ramesh C. Jain (ex-Eicher Group Vice Chairman), is independent.

people.name: K. A. Joseph
people.relation: Promoter and co-founder; father of Executive Director Kevin K. Joseph
people.stake: 20.90% (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); he is the only named promoter
people.bio: He has a B.Sc. from Bangalore University and a postgraduate diploma in business administration from St. Joseph's College of Business Administration, Bengaluru. He has more than 39 years in the decorative printing (aesthetics) business and co-founded SJS. He leads plant and manufacturing operations and technology and product innovation, and designed the Bengaluru plant the company moved into in 2018. He received the SPAI FESPA Lifetime Achievement Award in 2023. He is also a director of subsidiaries SJS Decoplast and Walter Pack India.

people.name: Sanjay Thapar
people.stake: 3,87,505 shares, about 1.2% (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report)
people.bio: He has a first-class mechanical engineering degree (with distinction) from Delhi College of Engineering and more than 40 years in the auto industry. He began at TELCO (now Tata Motors), and was later President of Minda HUF, Managing Director of Minda Valeo Security Systems and Group Chief Strategy Officer of the Ashok Minda Group. At SJS he leads strategy, M&A, business development and finance, and led the purchases of Exotech (now SJS Decoplast) and Walter Pack India and the push into exports. He is 67; the board re-appointed him in May 2026, subject to the July 2026 AGM.

people.name: Kevin K. Joseph
people.relation: Son of MD K. A. Joseph
people.stake: 100 shares, negligible (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report)
people.bio: He has a mechanical engineering degree from Visvesvaraya Technological University, Belgaum, and completed IIM Bangalore's Executive General Management Programme in May 2025. He started as a design engineer at Tata Elxsi in the passenger-vehicle segment. At SJS he drives manufacturing excellence and product innovation and oversees day-to-day operations. He is 34; the board re-appointed him in May 2026, subject to the July 2026 AGM.

people.name: Mahendra Kumar Naredi
people.bio: He has a B.Com (Hons.) and a law degree from Rajasthan University, and is a chartered accountant and company secretary with more than 25 years of experience. He worked at GE India and Wipro and spent 17 years in the Spark Minda Group, where he was CFO of its European companies, CFO and company secretary of Minda Vast Access Systems, and AVP of corporate finance at Minda Corporation. He joined SJS in August 2022. CII named him leading CFO of the year 2024-25 in the auto and auto-components sector.

people.name: Ranjit Raghunath Nambiar
people.bio: He has a postgraduate diploma in plastics technology from CIPET Mysore and a B.Sc. from Calicut University, and did IIM Ahmedabad's Transformational Leadership Program. He has more than 30 years across chemicals, plastics, appliances, auto systems and EV components. He held senior roles at Spark Minda, Tata AutoComp and International Automotive Components (IAC Group), where he built IAC India from scratch. He replaced Mahender Singh, who resigned in September 2025.

people.name: R. Raju
people.bio: He has a diploma in mechanical engineering from Thiagarajar Polytechnic, Salem, a diploma in production management from Annamalai University, and a PG diploma and MBA in marketing from IGNOU. He has more than 26 years in marketing, business development and sales in automotive, appliances and engineering. He previously worked at ITW India, Sundaram Auto Components (TVS group) and the Minda group, including Minda Asean in Indonesia and Minda SAI.

companies.changes: Chief Operating Officer Sadashiva Baligar retired on 20 April 2026. Randhir Singh Kalsi, a former Maruti Suzuki executive, joined as an independent director on 5 May 2026. Group COO Mahender Singh left in September 2025 and was replaced by Ranjit Nambiar.

companies.styleNote: Part of the D.K. Jain family's Lumax group. Founder-chairman D.K. Jain is Executive Chairman and his younger son Anmol Jain is Managing Director. His elder son Deepak Jain, who runs sister company Lumax Industries as its Chairman and MD, became non-executive Vice Chairman here in May 2026. A hired CEO, Vikas Marwah, handles day-to-day management under the MD. Promoters own 55.98%: Deepak and Anmol about 19% each and promoter company Lumax Finance 17.77%. Group CFO Sanjay Mehta sits on the board as a non-executive director.

people.name: D. K. (Dhanesh Kumar) Jain
people.since: Founder of the Lumax group; re-appointed Executive Chairman for three years from 28 May 2026
people.relation: Founder; father of Vice Chairman Deepak Jain and MD Anmol Jain
people.stake: Not a named holder in the FY26 annual report; the Dhanesh Kumar Jain Family Trust holds 0.30%; promoter group together 55.98%
people.bio: He has an MBA from Delhi University and completed Harvard Business School's President Management Program. He has more than six decades in the auto-component industry and founded the Lumax group. He is a past President of the Automotive Component Manufacturers Association (ACMA) and of the Toyota Kirloskar Motor suppliers' association, and has chaired CII Northern Region committees. He is 83. As chairman he provides strategic direction and guides the senior management team.

people.name: Anmol Jain
people.since: Joined the Lumax group in 2000; re-appointed MD for five years from 28 May 2026
people.relation: Younger son of Executive Chairman D.K. Jain; brother of Vice Chairman Deepak Jain
people.stake: 18.95% (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); he also holds 13.30% of sister company Lumax Industries; promoter group together 55.98%
people.bio: He has a BBA in finance and supply-chain management (double major) from Michigan State University. He started as a management trainee at GHSP in the USA and joined the Lumax group in 2000, and has more than 25 years in the industry. As MD he has overall responsibility for day-to-day running of the company and mentors the senior team. He chairs ACMA's Northern Region, is on ACMA's executive committee, and is President of the Bajaj Auto Vendor Association. He is 47.

people.name: Vikas Marwah
people.since: May 2020 (term extended five years from 1 November 2025)
people.bio: He joined the Lumax group in May 2018 as Executive Vice President and Chief Strategy Officer of Lumax Management Services, and became CEO of Lumax Auto Technologies in May 2020. Earlier he was CEO of Lumax Automotive Systems and Group Chief Sales & Marketing Officer at Varroc Engineering, and worked with Sona Koyo Steering (JTEKT), ORIX Auto, Easy Cabs, Sixt and JK Tyre. He runs day-to-day management. He reached retirement age in October 2025, and the board extended his term by five years.

people.name: Ankit Thakral
people.since: July 2025 (with the Lumax group since August 2011)
people.bio: He is a commerce graduate with an MBA in finance and more than 18 years in corporate finance and banking. He joined the Lumax group in August 2011 and was its Financial Controller and Treasury Head before becoming CFO on 1 July 2025. He replaced Ashish Dubey, who retired as CFO and moved to a larger group role. He is about 40.

companies.changes: Deepak Jain became non-executive Vice Chairman on 29 May 2026. Sunil Koparkar, CEO of the Intelligent Ambient Comfort (IAC) division, was named senior management on 22 July 2026. Chief Technology Officer Satish Sundaresan resigned on 25 September 2026, and Sanjay Bhagat, Senior EVP for the aftermarket division, retires on 30 September 2026. Pooja Minocha joined as CHRO in March 2026.

companies.styleNote: Founder K. Ajith Kumar Rai is Executive Chairman and his son Akhilesh Rai is a whole-time director and Chief Strategy Officer; his wife Dr. Supriya Rai is a non-executive director. A hired professional, N.S. Mohan, has been MD and Group CEO since 2019. Two other family members, Ashutosh Rai (CTO) and Aashish Rai (head of data science), are senior managers; the annual report lists both as relatives of key managers and shareholders approved their pay as relatives. Promoters own 45.27%, mostly through the Supriyajith Family Trust (38.60%).

people.name: K. Ajith Kumar Rai
people.since: 1985 (founder; on the board since May 1985; re-appointed to March 2029)
people.relation: Founder; husband of director Dr. Supriya A. Rai; father of Akhilesh Rai
people.stake: 2.79% (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); the Supriyajith Family Trust holds 38.60%; promoter group together 45.27%
people.bio: He is a mechanical engineer with a master's in industrial engineering from Dalhousie University, Canada. A first-generation entrepreneur, he founded Suprajit in 1985 and built it into India's largest maker of automotive control cables and halogen bulbs, with plants and tech centres on four continents. He chairs the Suprajit Foundation, the family and group's CSR arm, and is an independent director of VST Tillers Tractors. He is a member of CII and ACMA and sits on the board of NIT Karnataka and Dalhousie's advisory committee. He is 68.

people.name: N. S. Mohan (Mohan Srinivasan Nagamangala)
people.bio: He has a mechanical engineering degree, is a member of the Institute of Cost and Works Accountants of India, and has a diploma in management. He has more than 39 years in the auto industry and has run operations in India, the USA, China, Thailand and Europe, in roles including chief operations officer, country manager, executive director and managing director. He joined the Suprajit board in April 2019 as MD and Group CEO and has led the integration of the global cables business, including the Stahlschmidt Cable Systems turnaround. He is 64.

people.name: Akhilesh Rai
people.since: About 2013 at Suprajit; re-appointed whole-time director from June 2025 to March 2030
people.relation: Son of Executive Chairman K. Ajith Kumar Rai and Dr. Supriya A. Rai
people.bio: He has a bachelor's in electrical engineering (minor in economics) from Purdue University and an MBA from London Business School. As group Chief Strategy Officer he led the purchases of Osram's lamp plant and Kongsberg Automotive's light-duty cable business, and completed the Wescon turnaround in 2019. He also set up the internal controls team and runs the group's IT, digitisation and analytics roadmap.

people.name: Medappa Gowda J.
people.bio: He is a fellow company secretary (FCS) and has spent about 31 years with Suprajit, serving as group CFO and company secretary. In FY26 he led a stronger treasury and currency-hedging framework and the start of a group-wide SAP rollout.

people.name: Venkat Subramaniam
people.bio: He has more than three decades in the auto and engineering industries. He held leadership roles at Bosch India, Delphi, General Motors and Avtec, was a board member of SKF Technologies, and was most recently CEO of SEForge. He joined in January 2025 to run all Indian operations: cables, electronics and Phoenix Lighting.

people.name: James Gerard Ryan
people.bio: He has about 32 years in the global cable business, including Teleflex, Kongsberg and Leggett & Platt. He runs the overseas cables division, which completed the second tranche of the Stahlschmidt Cable Systems purchase in FY26 and closed or moved plants in Poland, Canada, Germany and Mexico.

people.name: Ashutosh Rai
people.relation: Promoter-group member; the annual report lists him as a relative of key managers (exact relation not stated)
people.bio: He heads the Suprajit Technology Centre and has 27 patents granted. He is building braking systems and actuators as the next business lines, and is moving the group to a single global engineering team run from India, housed in a new technology centre on the plot where the company was founded.

companies.changes: No change in directors or key managers since the annual report.

companies.styleNote: Founder Jayant Davar runs the company as Executive Chairman and CEO (he was Chairman, MD and CEO until December 2025). His wife Monica Davar and son Neel Jay Davar sit on the board as non-executive directors. The only other executive director is long-serving manager Gurvinder Jeet Singh. Promoters own 70.38%; Jayant Davar alone holds 50.56%, and two family trusts he heads as trustee hold 4.36% each. Senior management turnover has been high in 2026.

people.name: Jayant Davar
people.role: Executive Chairman (Executive Director) & Chief Executive Officer (Founder)
people.since: Founder; Executive Chairman & CEO from 1 January 2026 for five years
people.relation: Founder; husband of director Monica Davar; father of director Neel Jay Davar
people.stake: 50.56% (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); he is also trustee and first holder of the Cream and Cookies and Hazelnut family trusts (4.36% each); promoter group together 70.38%
people.bio: He has a mechanical engineering degree from Thapar Institute of Engineering & Technology, Patiala, which gave him its distinguished alumnus award, and is an alumnus of Harvard Business School. He has more than four decades in the auto-component industry and founded Sandhar, building it into a maker of locks, mirrors, castings, sheet-metal parts and cabins, mainly for two-wheelers. He is an adviser to ACMA, on the executive committee of CII's National Council, on the advisory committee of Germany's Fraunhofer-Gesellschaft, and Co-Chairman of the Hero MotoCorp Suppliers Council.

people.name: Gurvinder Jeet Singh
people.since: About 21 years at Sandhar; whole-time director since May 2025 (three-year term)
people.bio: He is a qualified tool engineer with 37 years in the industry, more than 21 of them at Sandhar. He has led strategic projects, greenfield plants, mergers and acquisitions and the running of several business verticals. Before Sandhar he was Head of Design and Development at Schefenacker Motherson. He joined the board as a whole-time director in May 2025.

people.name: Yashpal Jain
people.bio: He is an associate member of the Institute of Company Secretaries of India and holds both the CFO and company secretary roles. The annual report gives no further background.

people.name: Ankush Passi
people.role: Chief Operating Officer – Sheet Metal & Allied Business
people.since: Named key managerial personnel in August 2025
people.bio: He runs the sheet-metal and allied parts business and was named a key managerial person in August 2025. The annual report gives no further background.

people.name: Ajay Kumar Raghav
people.role: Chief Operating Officer – Casting, Machining & Tooling Business
people.bio: He heads the aluminium die-casting, machining and tooling business. The annual report gives no further background.

people.name: Shirin Sachdeva
people.since: Named key managerial personnel in August 2025
people.bio: She acts as confidant and adviser to the Chairman's office and handles strategic initiatives. The annual report gives no further background.

companies.changes: Vikas Puri stepped down as COO – Automotive Business on 13 June 2026 and left as a key manager on 17 June 2026. Senior managers Rashmi Mohan Shrivastva (VP, cabins fabrication) resigned in June 2026, Atul Sharma (VP, castings) leaves on 11 September 2026 and Vijay Dahiya resigned on 3 September 2026. COO – Cabins & Fabrication Venkataraman Srinivasan left in October 2025. Independent director Arjun Sharma's term ended in May 2026 and Gazal Kalra joined as an independent director in August 2026.

companies.styleNote: Part of the Chennai-based Rane group, controlled by the Lakshman and Ganesh families through Rane Holdings. Harish Lakshman (son of L Lakshman) has been Chairman since April 2024 and also Managing Director since April 2025; he is the only executive director.
