He worked in the company as a business head for more than 12 years before joining the board in 1995, and has over 40 years in industrial gases. He oversees the eastern region, sets strategy and governance, and is also a director of family companies including Ellenbarrie Cryogenics, Ellenbarrie Agro Products and several tea businesses. He and Varun have personally guaranteed some of the company's loans.

people.name: Varun Agarwal
people.relation: Son of Chairman & MD Padam Kumar Agarwala
people.bio: Varun Agarwal holds a B.Sc. in economics from the London School of Economics and an M.Phil. from the University of Cambridge. He began his career at Lehman Brothers before joining the family company in 2008, and has over 15 years of experience. He runs the southern region and focuses on financial performance and growth strategy. He delivered the AGM statement alongside his father in September 2026.

people.name: K. Srinivas Prasad
people.since: Joined Dec 2013 as Controller – Finance; CFO since 1 Nov 2014
people.bio: K. Srinivas Prasad has a commerce degree from BJB College, Bhubaneswar (Utkal University). He is a chartered accountant and company secretary (ICAI and ICSI associate) and has qualified as a cost accountant. Before Ellenbarrie he worked at Air Liquide North India. He joined in December 2013 and became CFO in November 2014.

people.name: Sanjay Basak
people.bio: Sanjay Basak holds an M.Tech in cryogenic engineering from IIT Kharagpur and did an executive programme in operations management at IIM Calcutta. He earlier worked at BOC India and Bhushan Steel. He joined in 2016 and heads projects and engineering.

people.name: Aditya Keshri
people.bio: Aditya Keshri is an associate member of the Institute of Company Secretaries of India. He earlier worked at Alcove Developers, Grameen Shakti Microfinance and Jiwanram Sheoduttrai Industries, and joined in March 2024.

companies.changes: No KMP changes in FY26. Sujoy Sen was appointed Chief Information Officer (senior management) from 1 Aug 2026. Subir Sen is GM – HR (senior management).

companies.styleNote: The Vaze family runs Keva: third-generation Kedar Vaze is Whole-time Director & Group CEO. His father Ramesh Vaze, the non-executive Chairman and a master perfumer, died on 15 Sep 2026; his mother Prabha Vaze is a non-executive director. Promoters own 54.87%, with about 50 lakh promoter shares pledged. No new chairman had been named as of 29 Sep 2026.

people.name: Kedar Vaze
people.role: Whole-time Director & Group Chief Executive Officer
people.since: With Keva since Oct 1996; Group CEO since 2014; re-appointed 1 Sep 2025 – 31 Aug 2028
people.relation: Promoter; son of the late Chairman Ramesh Vaze and of director Prabha Vaze
people.stake: 9.44% (1,30,60,131 shares, FY26 annual report); promoter group together 54.87%
people.bio: Kedar Vaze holds an M.Sc. in chemistry from IIT Bombay and completed Stanford's Global Managers Program. He joined the family business in October 1996 and worked as Chief Technology Officer and then Group COO before becoming Group CEO in 2014. He is a trained perfumer with several fragrance and flavour patents. His FY26 pay was ₹4.4cr; shareholders were asked to waive recovery of excess pay he received for FY25.

people.name: Jagdish Agarwal
people.bio: Jagdish Agarwal has over 28 years in finance across manufacturing, telecom and banking. He was Executive Director and CFO of Huhtamaki India for about four years, and before that spent over 15 years at Owens Corning India in finance roles including CFO. Earlier he worked at Reliance Communications and ICICI Bank. He joined Keva as Group CFO in December 2025 after a four-month gap filled by an interim CFO.

people.name: B. Ramkrishnan
people.bio: B. Ramkrishnan heads the fragrance business in Asia and the USA and is listed first among senior management. The annual report does not give his background.

people.name: Amit Gulati
people.role: Chief Operating Officer – Asia (Fragrance & Flavours) (senior management)
people.bio: Amit Gulati is COO for fragrance and flavours in Asia and is part of the senior management team. The annual report does not give his background.

people.name: Deepti Chandratre
people.since: Joined 11 April 2025; Company Secretary since 1 May 2025
people.bio: Deepti Chandratre joined as Global Legal Counsel in April 2025 and became Company Secretary and Compliance Officer from May 2025. She also served as interim CFO from 7 Oct to 1 Dec 2025, between the exit of Rohit Saraogi and the arrival of Jagdish Agarwal.

companies.changes: Chairman Ramesh Vaze died on 15 Sep 2026; no successor announced yet. CFO Rohit Saraogi left on 30 Jul 2025 and Group CHRO Nishant Kolgaonkar in Apr 2025. Ranjeet Agrawal joined as EVP – Sales (India subcontinent) on 20 Aug 2026.

companies.styleNote: A Tibrewala family company: founder Surendrakumar Tibrewala is Chairman & MD, his son Sanjay is Executive Director & CFO and his daughter Aarti Jhunjhunwala is an Executive Director. The three family members are the only executives listed as senior management. Promoters own about 62%.

people.name: Surendrakumar Tibrewala
people.relation: Founder-promoter; father of Sanjay Tibrewala and Aarti Jhunjhunwala
people.stake: 52.28% (FY26 annual report); promoter group together about 62%
people.bio: Surendrakumar Tibrewala, son of the late Deviprasad Tibrewala, holds a commerce degree from R. A. Poddar College (University of Mumbai) and a law degree from Government Law College. He started in specialty chemicals at 20 and has over four decades of experience making chemicals and enzymes for textiles, construction, water treatment, leather, paper and paints. As Chairman & MD he sets the long-term strategy. He chairs the board's Administrative Committee, which handles day-to-day business matters and is made up only of the three family executives.

people.name: Sanjay Tibrewala
people.since: Promoter since inception; re-appointed for 1 Oct 2025 – 30 Sep 2030
people.relation: Son of the Chairman & MD; brother of Aarti Jhunjhunwala
people.bio: Sanjay Tibrewala graduated from Narsee Monjee College of Commerce and Economics (University of Mumbai) in 2001 and then studied textile processing and chemistry at SASMIRA, Mumbai. He has been with the company since inception and has over two decades in textile chemicals. As Executive Director and CFO he leads new markets and the product range. The company moved into oilfield chemicals by buying US-based CrudeChem in December 2025. His pay matches his father's (both 23.9 times the median employee).

people.name: Aarti Jhunjhunwala
people.relation: Daughter of the Chairman & MD; sister of Sanjay Tibrewala
people.bio: Aarti Jhunjhunwala, 42, holds a master's in accounts and taxation from Narsee Monjee College. She has over 16 years in the business, covering business development, sales, branding and global alliances, and led the push into international textile markets. She won the 'Women at Work Leadership Award' at the Asia Pacific HRM Congress. Her FY26 pay was ₹1.07cr, up 24%.

people.name: Sunny Parmar
people.bio: Sunny Parmar is Company Secretary and Compliance Officer and the only non-family member of senior management. The annual report gives no further background.

companies.changes: No changes in KMP or senior management in FY26 or since the annual report. Independent director Navin Mittal completed his term in Sep 2025.

companies.styleNote: A subsidiary of Germany's BASF SE, which owns 73.33%. It is run by BASF group executives on rotation: a German MD, a long-serving BASF finance head as CFO and a manufacturing head, all whole-time directors. The chairman, Pradip P. Shah, is non-executive. No directors are related to each other.

people.name: Alexander Gerding
people.bio: Alexander Gerding, born in Bremen in 1979, joined BASF in 2000 through a dual-study programme and earned an MBA from the University of North Carolina at Greensboro in 2005. He has held roles in Argentina, the US and Germany, mostly in crop protection; before India he was Vice President, Business Management for Agricultural Solutions, EMEA East (from 2019). He chairs the Risk Management Committee. His background is in the agri business that is now being demerged into BASF Agricultural Solutions India. His FY26 pay was ₹9.97cr, including BASF SE share-based incentives.

people.name: Narendranath J. Baliga
people.since: CFO since 1 Jan 2015; whole-time director 1 Jan 2025 – 30 Jun 2027
people.bio: Narendranath Baliga is a chartered accountant and a business management graduate from Mysore University. He joined BASF in 1994 and has worked in India, Singapore, China and Germany in finance, controlling, supply chain and process and enterprise architecture. He has been CFO of BASF India since 2015 and also heads Global Business Services. He joined the board as a whole-time director in January 2025. His FY26 pay was ₹3.46cr.

people.name: Anil Kumar Choudhary
people.bio: Anil Kumar Choudhary has a bachelor's in mechanical engineering and a postgraduate qualification in marketing management. He joined BASF in 2004 and was Managing Director of BASF Catalysts India and then Business Director for Performance Materials. He now oversees all manufacturing sites (as Occupier under the Factories Act) and the materials, industrial solutions and surface technologies segments. His FY26 pay was ₹3.04cr.

people.name: Manohar Kamath
people.role: Director – Legal, General Counsel (India) & Company Secretary
people.bio: Manohar Kamath is BASF India's general counsel and Company Secretary and sits on the management committee. He is secretary to the board committees. The annual report gives no further background.

companies.changes: No executive changes in FY26 or since. Non-executive BASF nominee Marcelo R. Lu resigned on 30 Nov 2025 and was replaced by Andrew Postlethwaite. Sunita Sule is the fifth member of the management committee.

companies.styleNote: Founder Dr. A. N. Gupta (80) is non-executive Chairman; his wife Dr. Kailash Gupta and daughter Shonika Prasad are non-executive directors. Day-to-day the company is run by professional executives, led by MD T. V. Chowdary. The Gupta family holds 41.33% (now largely through the AKS Family Trust), which Apollo Micro Systems has agreed to buy, with an open offer due in Q3 FY27, so control and possibly the management team will change.

people.name: T. V. Chowdary
people.since: Board since 31 Aug 2005; MD since 14 Feb 2022 (term to 13 Feb 2027)
people.bio: T. V. Chowdary, 69, holds a B.Sc. (Tech) in petroleum and is a chemical engineer with over 40 years in making explosives, detonators and solid propellants. He joined the board in 2005 and was Deputy MD until the board made him MD in February 2022 as part of the succession plan. He leads operations and strategy, with focus on execution, safety and customers. His current term ends in February 2027, around when Apollo Micro Systems is due to take control.

people.name: Y. Durga Prasad Rao
people.since: With the company since 1 July 1989; board since 10 Aug 2019 (term to 9 Aug 2027)
people.bio: Durga Prasad Rao, 63, has a B.Tech in mechanical engineering from Sri Venkateswara University, Tirupati. He joined Premier in July 1989 and has 36 years in explosives, propellants, refractories and factory management. He heads manufacturing at the Peddakandukuru and Katepally plants and is central to plant discipline and delivery.

people.name: B. M. Vijay Kumar
people.bio: Buddhavarapu Mahadeva Vijay Kumar is a Fellow of the Institute of Chartered Accountants, the Institute of Cost Accountants and the Institute of Company Secretaries of India, and a law graduate. He has more than 30 years of experience in accounts, finance, management, secretarial and legal work. He became CFO in November 2024.

people.name: K. Jhansi Laxmi
people.bio: K. Jhansi Laxmi is Company Secretary and Compliance Officer and secretary to the audit and nomination committees. The annual report gives no further background.

companies.changes: Apollo Micro Systems is buying the promoters' 41.33% (announced 9 Jul 2026; open offer pending), so board and management changes are likely. Independent director Dr. Kumuda Raghavan resigned on 31 Jul 2026. No executive changes since the annual report.

companies.styleNote: Founded in 1955 by Keshavlal V. Bodani and now run by the third generation: brothers Dharmil Bodani (Chairman & MD) and Shyamal Bodani (Executive Director), who own 37.08% each. A hired Group CEO, Parag Satoskar, runs day-to-day operations under them. Promoters own 74.17% with no pledge; the two brothers were paid ₹8.5cr in FY26.

people.name: Dharmil A. Bodani
people.relation: Promoter, third generation; brother of Shyamal Bodani
people.bio: Dharmil Bodani has over three decades in flavours, fragrances and aroma chemicals and trained in perfumery in Grasse, France. He leads the company's strategy and has built it into one of the few integrated flavour, fragrance and aroma chemical makers in India, with a focus on research. His FY26 pay was ₹4.74cr, even though profit fell to about ₹3cr.

people.name: Shyamal A. Bodani
people.since: Career began 2003; current term to 15 Aug 2027
people.relation: Promoter; brother of Dharmil Bodani
people.bio: Shyamal Bodani began his career in 2003 and has over two decades in the industry. He oversees domestic and international marketing, sales and exports, contributes to financial management, and leads project planning and execution across the group. He also chairs the CSR committee. His FY26 pay was ₹3.79cr.

people.name: Parag K. Satoskar
people.bio: Parag Satoskar holds a bachelor's in pharmaceutical science from the Institute of Chemical Technology, Mumbai. He was earlier a partner at Arofine Chemical Industries. He has been CEO since May 2019, signs the code-of-conduct and CFO-CEO certifications, and sits on the risk committee.

people.name: Satish Kumar Ray
people.bio: Satish Kumar Ray holds an MBA and has 25–30 years of experience across manufacturing operations, procurement, sales, supply chain, HR, insurance and claims. He is the legal Occupier of the plants at Ambernath, Bareilly and Vadodara, the Mahad subsidiary plant, and the Chandivali R&D centre. His FY26 pay was ₹41.6 lakh.

people.name: Girish Khandelwal
people.bio: Girish Khandelwal is a chartered accountant and a long-serving finance executive of the company; he earlier worked in finance and accounts when it was called Camphor & Allied Products. He is the CFO and a key managerial personnel.

people.name: Anita P. Satoskar
people.bio: Anita Satoskar is Chief Technology Officer and a key managerial personnel. The annual report gives no further background.

people.name: Kiranpreet Gill
people.bio: Kiranpreet Gill is Company Secretary and Compliance Officer. The annual report gives no further background.

companies.changes: No KMP changes in FY26. Senior managers Pravin Varade (Projects, Oct 2025) and Savita Dalvi (VP Sales, F&F, Nov 2025) resigned; Nitin Bhuduvalekar joined as VP – Sales Fragrance on 1 Aug 2026. Independent director Deepak Ramachandra resigned in May 2026, replaced by John Gloster.

companies.styleNote: Founder Anil Jain is Chairman & MD and the only promoter on the board; no directors or KMP are related to him. Promoters own about 56.6%, almost all through Refex Holding, and a large share of it (over 40%) is pledged. The CFO and Company Secretary are paid by the promoter's holding company, not by Refex Industries.

people.name: Anil Jain
people.relation: Founder-promoter
people.stake: 25.41% as ultimate beneficial owner (FY26 annual report); promoter group about 56.6%
people.bio: Anil Jain, 50, is a commerce graduate who built the Refex group from a refrigerant-gas refiller into a group spanning renewables, ash and coal handling, mobility, pharma, medical technology, airport transport and venture capital. He set up Refex Capital, a Category-I AIF that has backed over 30 start-ups, and was Secretary General of the Jain International Trade Organization. He also sits on the boards of Refex Renewables & Infrastructure, Venwind Refex Power, Refex Green Power, Lee Pharma and Emco. In December 2025 SEBI fined him ₹10 lakh for an alleged 2023 insider-trading breach (stayed on appeal by SAT), and the Income Tax department searched the company that month. His FY26 pay was ₹1.5cr.

people.name: Dinesh Kumar Agarwal
people.since: With the group since 2014; WTD & CFO since 1 June 2024 (earlier non-executive director)
people.bio: Dinesh Agarwal is a chartered accountant with over 22 years in corporate finance, audit, accounting, tax planning and fund-raising; he says he has helped raise over ₹3,000cr of debt and equity. He earlier worked with Aircel and Brisk and advised start-ups, SMEs and NGOs. He joined Refex in 2014 and is also CEO and CFO of Refex Holding, the promoter company, which pays his salary. He moved from non-executive director to WTD & CFO in June 2024.

people.name: Tarun Arora
people.role: Chief Business Officer – Ash & Coal Handling (senior management)
people.bio: Tarun Arora has a B.E. in chemical engineering from Thapar Institute, Patiala (2004) and an executive MBA from SPJIMR, Mumbai (2015). He spent 2011–2022 at Hindustan Zinc and Vedanta as SBU head, silver business head and Chief Commercial Officer, then was VP and Head of Operations at Karam Chand Thapar & Bros. He joined in April 2025 to run the ash and coal business, now the main earner.

people.name: Ankit Poddar
people.bio: Ankit Poddar is Company Secretary and Compliance Officer; like the CFO, his salary is paid by the promoter company Refex Holding. The annual report gives no further background.

companies.changes: Lalitha Uthayakumar moved from President – Refrigerant Gas to GM – Accounts from 1 Aug 2026 after the gas business was shut, and left senior management. Anil S. Kulkarni was named Chief Business Officer (RMC division) and Prasad Jakkaraju VP – ESG in Aug 2026. Jagdish Jain is Business Head – Ash & Coal and Sahil Singla President – Corporate Finance (both senior management since Aug 2025).

companies.styleNote: No promoter: the company is widely held, and its largest holders are mutual funds (HDFC Mutual Fund about 9.8% at March 2026). A hired MD & CEO, Promeet Ghosh, is the only executive director. The chairman, D. Sundaram (ex-HUL CFO and vice chairman), is non-executive. The annual report says no directors are related to each other.

people.name: Promeet Ghosh
people.since: Board since Aug 2016 (non-executive); MD & CEO since May 2023, term to Apr 2028
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in electrical and electronics engineering from NIT Trichy and an MBA from IIM Calcutta. He was an investment banker for about two decades, 18 years of them at DSP Merrill Lynch, where he helped build its M&A business. He then spent nearly a decade as Deputy Head of Temasek India and advised Temasek until March 2023. He sat on Crompton's board as a non-executive director from 2016 and took over as MD & CEO in May 2023, running the 'Crompton 2.0' plan. He is also on the board of Butterfly Gandhimathi Appliances, Crompton's listed kitchen-appliance subsidiary.

people.name: Kaleeswaran Arunachalam
people.role: Group Chief Financial Officer & Head of Strategy
people.bio: A chartered accountant (ICAI member) with more than two decades in corporate finance, planning, investor relations and risk. Before Crompton he was Global CFO of Eicher Motors, where he worked on Royal Enfield's financial model, pricing, cost and retail finance, and set up an internal-controls centre of excellence and a shared accounting and reporting platform. At Crompton he also heads strategy and has signed the company's exchange filings after the company secretary left in April 2026.

people.name: Rajat Chopra
people.since: At Crompton about 28 years; senior management since Jan 2026; current role from Jul 2026
people.bio: A Crompton veteran with over 28 years at the company in many roles. He was made Business Unit Head for Pumps and Home Electricals in January 2026, where the company credits him with strengthening the fans, pumps and large-appliance businesses. From 2 July 2026 he moved to run sales and service for the whole group, with a brief to transform how the company sells and services its products.

people.name: Anand Kumar N
people.role: Business Unit Head – Kitchen Appliances (also oversees Pumps)
people.since: At Crompton over 35 years; current role from Jul 2026
people.bio: A long-serving Crompton executive with more than 35 years in the company. As Group Sales & Service Head he drove sales, distribution reach and channel partnerships. In July 2026 he was moved to head kitchen appliances, covering small and large kitchen appliances, and also oversees the pumps business. He works with the team at Butterfly Gandhimathi, the listed kitchen-appliance subsidiary, to capture savings between the two companies.

people.name: Shaleen Nayak
people.role: Business Unit Head – Lighting & New Businesses
people.since: Senior management (listed in FY26 annual report)
people.bio: Runs the lighting business, including indoor, commercial and solar lighting, plus new businesses such as the entry into residential wires, according to the FY26 annual report. The company does not publish a detailed career history for him in the annual report.

people.name: Sachin Phartiyal
people.bio: Has nearly three decades in consumer durables and electricals. He holds a B.Sc. from C.C.S. University, Meerut, a postgraduate degree in management and strategy certificates from Apeejay School of Management and Copenhagen Business School. He started at Godrej Appliances and MIRC Electronics, spent over a decade at Whirlpool of India in senior roles, and earlier led several business lines at Crompton itself. Just before rejoining he was CEO and Executive Director of Torrent Electricals (2024–2026). He now runs fans and other home electricals, Crompton's biggest business.

people.name: Anuj Lall
people.bio: Has more than 35 years in supply chain and business roles at Procter & Gamble and Whirlpool. Before joining Crompton he was Executive Director and Vice President – Integrated Supply Chain at Whirlpool India, running manufacturing, quality, logistics and distribution. He has led supply-chain changes, plant turnarounds and acquisitions in India, Singapore, Indonesia and the wider Asia-Pacific region.

companies.changes: Jul 2026 reshuffle: Sachin Phartiyal (ex-CEO of Torrent Electricals) hired to run Home Electricals; Rajat Chopra moved to group sales and service; Anand Kumar N moved to kitchen appliances; Anuj Lall (ex-Whirlpool India) hired for supply chain. Aarushi Agarwal, head of large kitchen appliances and new business, resigned (left 27 Jul 2026). Company secretary Rashmi Khandelwal left in Apr 2026; Yesha Gandani is now compliance officer.

companies.styleNote: Founded by Kochouseph Chittilappilly, who handed the MD role to his son Mithun in 2012 and has since left the board. Mithun also became Chairperson on 27 Sep 2026. Mithun's wife, Dr Reena (Reenaa) Philip, joined the board as a non-executive director in Jan 2026. Professional executives serve as COO and CFO. The Chittilappilly family and its trusts own 53.2%.

people.name: Mithun K Chittilappilly
people.since: Director since 2003 (rejoined 2006); MD since Apr 2012; Chairperson since 27 Sep 2026
people.relation: Promoter; son of founder Kochouseph Chittilappilly; husband of director Dr Reena Philip
people.stake: 19.78% (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report), plus 4.88% as trustee of the Anekha Chittilappilly Trust; promoter group together 53.22%
people.bio: A commerce graduate with a postgraduate degree in management from the University of Melbourne. He worked at Deloitte and Hewlett Packard before joining V-Guard as a director in 2003, took a break to study in Australia, and came back in 2006. He became MD in April 2012, taking over from his father. Sales have grown from about ₹229cr when he joined to ₹5,966cr in FY26, driven by growth outside South India, new products, a new brand identity and the Sunflame acquisition. He is also MD of subsidiary V-Guard Consumer Products and a director of Sunflame.

people.name: Ramachandran V
people.since: Whole-time Director since Jun 2013; COO since Jun 2016
people.bio: A professional manager with over 30 years of experience, including at Hindustan Unilever and LG Electronics. He joined V-Guard's board in June 2013 as Director, Marketing & Strategy, and was made Director & COO in June 2016. He leads strategy and new growth platforms, and has driven changes in marketing, customer service, supply chain, manufacturing and R&D. He is on the boards of the subsidiaries V-Guard Consumer Products, GUTS Electro-Mech and Sunflame. Much of his pay comes from stock options, and shareholders are being asked to raise pay limits so he can exercise them.

people.name: Antony Sebastian K
people.bio: Has spent over 40 years at V-Guard, having joined in 1985. He holds an executive MBA in materials management, a diploma in electronics engineering and a diploma in production management, and attended a quality management programme in Osaka and an executive programme at IIM Bangalore. He built the company's supply-chain function and still heads it, after earlier roles in after-sales service, production and quality control. He joined the board as an executive director in May 2023.

people.name: Sudarshan Kasturi
people.bio: An engineering graduate of BITS Pilani with an MBA from IIM Bangalore. He spent many years at Hindustan Unilever in India and the US, then was CFO and Finance Director of Unilever Nigeria and CFO of Tiger Brands' Nigerian business, a $350m food company. He joined V-Guard as CFO in June 2017, taking over from the retiring Jacob Kuruvilla.

companies.changes: Mithun Chittilappilly became Chairperson on 27 Sep 2026 after independent chair Radha Unni retired at the end of her term. VP–HR Venkateshwaran Sundaram resigned in Jul 2026.

companies.styleNote: Controlled by private-equity firm Advent International through Lunolux Limited (Cyprus), which owns 62.56%. Advent bought the business from Shapoorji Pallonji in 2022. Advent's Sahil Dalal and Advent industry adviser Arvind Uppal (the chairman) sit on the board as non-executive directors. A hired team, led by MD & CEO Pratik Pota, runs the company. No family members are in management.

people.name: Pratik Pota
people.bio: An engineering graduate of BITS Pilani with an MBA from IIM Calcutta, with more than 30 years of experience. Earlier in his career he held senior roles at Hindustan Unilever, where he helped design and launch Project Shakti, its rural women-distributor programme, and at Bharti Airtel. At PepsiCo India he was COO of beverages and foods and CEO of NourishCo, then a PepsiCo–Tata joint venture. He was then CEO of Jubilant FoodWorks (Domino's India) for about five years, during which margins doubled and the market value rose almost ten-fold. He joined Eureka Forbes as MD & CEO in August 2022, soon after Advent took control.

people.name: Gaurav Khandelwal
people.bio: A chartered accountant (rank holder) with about 20 years of experience in India, the US and the UK. He worked at Hindustan Unilever, Airtel and OYO Hotels & Homes before joining Eureka Forbes as CFO in August 2022. Besides finance, he oversees the commercial, legal and secretarial functions.

people.name: Anurag Kumar
people.role: Chief Growth Officer (also heads e-commerce and direct-to-consumer)
people.bio: Has about 28 years of industry experience, including at Tata Play, Unilever and ICI India. He joined Eureka Forbes in 2023 as Chief Growth Officer. In January 2025 he was given charge of overall revenue management, and from May 2026 he also runs the e-commerce and direct-to-consumer business.

people.name: Nithyanand Shankar
people.since: Joined about 2023; Chief Business Officer since May 2025
people.bio: Spent about 16 years at Procter & Gamble and Amazon before joining Eureka Forbes. He joined as Chief Digital & Product Officer, later became Chief Digital & Technology Officer, and was made Chief Business Officer in May 2025 when he took on more of the business.

people.name: Rakesh Moza
people.bio: Has over 25 years in consumer durables at LG, Samsung and Havells. He spent most of his career at Samsung, where he managed a business of more than ₹10,000cr and led modern retail for India and general trade in the South and West. His last role was Executive Vice President – Retail Sales at Havells India, covering Havells and Lloyd across 20 product categories. He joined Eureka Forbes in May 2025.

people.name: Suresh Redhu
people.role: Chief Technical Officer – R&D and Manufacturing
people.since: At Eureka Forbes about 15 years; also heads innovation and R&D since Sep 2025
people.bio: Has spent about 15 years at Eureka Forbes after some 23 years at Blue Star, Mahle India Filter Systems and other companies. As Chief Technical Officer he runs manufacturing and technical work, and since September 2025 he has also led innovation and R&D, after the previous R&D head resigned.

people.name: Aviral Chopra
people.bio: Has about 15 years of experience. Before joining Eureka Forbes in December 2024 he was Head of Supply Chain at Blinkit, the quick-commerce business, and before that worked at Hindustan Unilever in manufacturing and other supply-chain roles.

companies.changes: Chief Growth Officer Anurag Kumar took charge of e-commerce and direct-to-consumer in May 2026. No executive exits since the FY26 annual report.

companies.styleNote: Founded by the late Bijon Nag (died 2024). Bikramjit (Bikram) Nag, a relative of the founder and part of the promoter group, is the executive Chairman. In April 2026 the company hired an outside MD & CEO, Sandeep Joseph Abraham, for the home-appliances division. The other executive directors are long-serving employees. The promoter group owns 74.96%, mostly through IFB Automotive (46.5%), Nurpur Gases (14.8%) and Asansol Bottling & Packaging (8.3%).

people.name: Bikramjit Nag
people.since: Joined Nov 2008; board since Oct 2008; earlier Joint Executive Chairman & MD; now Chairman
people.relation: Promoter group; relative of the late founder Bijon Nag; Mrs Preombada Nag, listed as a relative of a KMP, also holds shares
people.stake: 0.01% (3,000 shares, 31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); Preombada Nag 0.72%; promoter group together 74.96%, mostly through group companies
people.bio: Holds a BBA from Richmond College, London, and has about 30 years of experience. He joined IFB in November 2008 and was Joint Executive Chairman & Managing Director while his relative, founder Bijon Nag, was Executive Chairman. He now chairs the company and signs its reports. His listed strengths are strategy, controls, planning, marketing and legal matters. He is also Chairman and a whole-time director of the group company IFB Agro Industries.

people.name: Sandeep Joseph Abraham
people.role: Managing Director & CEO – Home Appliances Division
people.bio: A mechanical engineering graduate of REC Tiruchirappalli with a PGDM from IIM Ahmedabad, and over 30 years in both consumer and industrial businesses. He worked at TAFE, GSK Consumer Healthcare, Sify, Trident Hotels and Vodafone. For more than 11 years before joining IFB he was Vice President – Business Development at MRF, and the company says he has run a business of close to ₹20,000cr. He is the first outside professional to run IFB's main appliance business, and he is not related to any director.

people.name: Arup Das
people.since: At IFB since 1992; Executive Director from Apr 2026 (one-year term)
people.bio: Holds a B.Sc. from Calcutta University, an engineering degree through AMIE and a PGDBM from IBMR. He has more than 38 years of experience and has been with IFB since 1992. In the Engineering Division (fine-blanked parts for car and two-wheeler makers) he has headed heat treatment, new product development, supply chain, and marketing and sales. Before joining the board he was President – M&A and New Projects. He took over the engineering business after MD P. H. Narayanan resigned on 1 April 2026.

people.name: Amar Singh Negi
people.bio: Holds a four-year post-diploma in electrical engineering (electrical machines and power apparatus) from YMCA Institute of Engineering, Faridabad, finished in 1982, and has more than 40 years of experience. He joined IFB in November 2000 from Gravs Appliances. He runs the after-sales service business, which sells service contracts and spares to IFB's installed base of appliances.

people.name: C. S. Govindaraj
people.bio: Holds a BE in mechanical engineering from Bangalore University. He worked at BPL Sanyo Utilities, Matsushita Washing Machine India and LG Electronics, where he spent 10 years and ran the Pune factory from 2003 to 2013. He first joined IFB as VP Projects in 2013, left to consult from 2015 to 2018, and rejoined in June 2018 as CEO – Industrial Business and Projects. He now runs manufacturing for the appliance business.

people.name: Soumitra Goswami
people.bio: A science graduate and cost accountant with about 39 years of experience. He joined IFB in January 1995 from Elkom Enterprises and has since risen to CFO.

companies.changes: Sandeep Joseph Abraham joined as MD & CEO of the appliance division on 9 Apr 2026. P. H. Narayanan resigned as MD – Engineering on 1 Apr 2026; Arup Das replaced him as Executive Director.

companies.styleNote: Part of the CK Birla group. Promoter C.K. Birla is the non-executive Chairman; the promoter group owns 38.31%, mostly through Central India Industries (25.1%). A hired MD & CEO, Ravindra Singh Negi, runs the business with a professional team. One family member works in management: Avani Birla, a relative of the Chairman, is President – Strategy. The annual report says no directors are related to each other.

people.name: Ravindra Singh Negi
people.bio: A B.Com graduate of DAV College, Dehradun (1993) with a PGDBM from FORE School of Management, Delhi (1996), plus executive courses at ISB, CCL Singapore and MIT. He spent two decades at Bharti Airtel, ending as CEO of its Delhi and NCR circle. He then led the electrical consumer durables business at Havells and was COO – Consumer Products at Bajaj Electricals before joining Orient in May 2024. He is a former chairman of the Indian Fans Manufacturers Association and leads the small-appliances group at the industry body CEAMA.

people.name: Arvind Kumar Vats
people.role: Chief Financial Officer (also Chief Risk Officer)
people.bio: A chartered accountant and cost accountant with an MBA, and about 30 years of experience after qualifying. He has worked in FMCG, modern retail, quick-service restaurants, telecom and textiles, covering planning, strategy, IPOs and listing, investor relations, treasury, tax and risk. He joined Orient in December 2024 and became CFO on 1 January 2025.

people.name: Avani Birla
people.since: Senior management (listed in FY26 annual report)
people.relation: Promoter family; the annual report calls her a relative of Chairman C.K. Birla
people.stake: 0.06% (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); promoter group together 38.31%
people.bio: A member of the promoter family who works full-time in the company as President – Strategy. In 2025 shareholders approved a long-term cash incentive of ₹383 lakh for her, paid over three years if set targets are met, as a related-party payment. The annual report does not give her education or earlier career.

people.name: Gaurav Dhawan
people.role: Business Unit Head – Electric Consumer Durables (fans and appliances)
people.since: Senior management (listed in FY26 annual report)
people.bio: Runs the electric consumer durables unit, Orient's largest business, which sells fans, coolers, water heaters and home appliances. The company's filings do not give his earlier career.

people.name: Anika Agarwal
people.role: Executive Vice President & Business Unit Head – Lighting
people.since: At Orient about 4 years; lighting head since Aug 2026
people.bio: Has over 20 years in consumer electricals, insurance and telecom. She was President – Consumer Business at MMTC-PAMP India, Chief Marketing Officer and Director – Digital at Max Bupa Health Insurance (now Niva Bupa), and held leadership roles at Nokia in India and the Middle East and Africa. At Orient she was Chief Marketing & Customer Experience Officer until August 2026, when she moved to run the lighting business.

people.name: Ajay Saraf
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering, a general management programme from IIM Calcutta and a senior leadership programme from IIM Bangalore. He has nearly three decades in sales, marketing, profit-and-loss roles and turnarounds, with leadership roles at Legero India (lighting), Kingspan (India and South Asia), Panasonic Life Solutions, Havells India and Philips India. He joined Orient in November 2025 to run switchgear and wires.

people.name: Sandhya Biswas
people.bio: Has close to 20 years in consumer durables, lifestyle, telecom, energy and home-improvement businesses in India and the US. She is an alumna of the Indian School of Business, Hyderabad, with a background in electronics and informatics. She has worked at Airtel, Kohler, Morphy Richards, Livguard and, most recently, Fenesta. She joined Orient in September 2026.

companies.changes: Aug 2026: CMO Anika Agarwal moved to head lighting; Sep 2026: Sandhya Biswas hired as CMO and Deepankar Bhattacharjee as head of internal audit. CHRO Aditya Kohli left in Mar 2026.

companies.styleNote: Controlled by the Burman family of Dabur. Dr Anand Chand Burman is the non-executive Chairman, and Mohit Burman and Aditya Chand Burman are non-executive directors. No family member holds an executive job. Burman companies (M B Finmart, Puran Associates and VIC Enterprises) own about 35%; the whole promoter group, which still includes some old Khaitan-family holdings, owns 43.20%. Hired professionals run the company: CEO Anirban Banerjee and Executive Director & CFO Bibek Agarwala. Long-time MD Suvamoy Saha left at the end of his term in Sep 2025.

people.name: Anirban Banerjee
people.since: CEO since May 2025; earlier SVP & head of batteries, flashlights and lighting
people.bio: An alumnus of St. Stephen's College, Delhi, with an MBA from Symbiosis Centre for Management & HRD, Pune, and over 25 years in FMCG, consumer durables and retail. At the Godrej group he was Head of Marketing & E-commerce at Godrej Indonesia and Global Head of Innovation at Godrej Consumer Products. He also worked at Nature's Basket, Reliance Infocomm and AB Electrolux. He joined Eveready as Senior Vice President and head of the batteries, flashlights and lighting unit, and was made CEO in May 2025. He is not on the board.

people.name: Bibek Agarwala
people.since: CFO since Dec 2022; board since Aug 2024
people.bio: A commerce graduate of St. Xavier's College, Kolkata, and a fellow chartered accountant and company secretary. He has over 24 years of experience in finance and business change, covering treasury, M&A, tax, commercial work, supply chain, innovation and digitisation. He became Eveready's CFO in December 2022 and joined the board as a whole-time director in August 2024.

people.name: Rakesh Ramachandran
people.bio: Holds a B.Tech from Government Engineering College, Thrissur, and did an executive business programme at IIM Kozhikode. He has over 27 years of sales experience in lighting and consumer appliances, at Bajaj Electricals, Signify Innovations India, Crompton Greaves and Khaitan India. He runs sales to institutions and businesses.

people.name: Anand Singh
people.bio: Holds a BE from BIT Mesra, an M.Tech from MIT Jaipur and an MBA from Sikkim Manipal University, and did an executive leadership programme at IIM Calcutta. He works on R&D, new products, simulation-based design and product lifecycle management, and earlier worked at Panasonic Life Solutions, the El-Araby group and LG Electronics.

companies.changes: MD Suvamoy Saha completed his term on 30 Sep 2025 and left; Anirban Banerjee has been CEO since May 2025. Aditya Chand Burman joined the board as a non-executive director in Nov 2025. No executive changes filed since the FY26 annual report.

companies.styleNote: Founder Achal Bakeri is Chairman & Managing Director and owns 41.93% himself; the promoter group, including Rupa Bakeri (10.16%) and Sanskrut Tradecom (17.89%), owns 73.43%. His daughter Jonaki Bakeri sits on the board as a non-executive director. Long-serving Nrupesh Shah, not family, is MD – Corporate Affairs. The company has had no Group CEO since Amit Kumar resigned in Mar 2026.

people.name: Achal Bakeri
people.relation: Founder and promoter; father of non-executive director Jonaki Bakeri
people.stake: 41.93% (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); promoter group together 73.43%
people.bio: An architect with an MBA from the University of Southern California. He founded Symphony in 1988 to make affordable air coolers and built it into the world's largest air-cooler company, designing and branding coolers while outside vendors make them. He took the company abroad through subsidiaries in Mexico, the US, China and Australia.

people.name: Nrupesh Shah
people.since: Joined 1993; MD – Corporate Affairs since Oct 2023; reappointed May 2026
people.stake: 1.66% (11,41,728 shares incl. spouse, family trust and related entities, 31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report)
people.bio: A commerce graduate, chartered accountant (FCA) and company secretary. He joined Symphony in 1993 and has spent over three decades there. He oversees corporate affairs: growth strategy, performance review, mergers and acquisitions, finance, legal, treasury and management reporting. He was promoted to Managing Director – Corporate Affairs in October 2023 and was reappointed in May 2026.

people.name: Girish Thakkar
people.since: CFO (listed as KMP in FY26 annual report)
people.bio: Symphony's CFO and a member of the board's risk management committee. The company's filings do not give his education or earlier career.

people.name: Rajesh Mishra
people.bio: A mechanical engineering graduate (B.Tech) who began his career in sales at the Indian Express and Nissan Marketing Agency while studying at Pune University. He joined Symphony as a management trainee in 1995 and has spent about 30 years there in sales and marketing. He headed sales for India and international markets from 2018 and in 2023 was made President – International Subsidiaries, to align the Australian, US, Mexican and Chinese businesses with India, while also leading exports. He is now Chief Growth Officer.

people.name: Shambhu Kumar
people.since: Senior management (listed in FY26 annual report)
people.bio: Heads sales as President – Sales. The company's filings do not give his education or earlier career.

people.name: Gaurav Sarda
people.bio: Holds a PGDM from IIM Ahmedabad and has over 20 years in consumer goods marketing, brand management, sales and market research. He worked at Asian Paints, Lodha Developers and, most recently, the Welspun group before joining Symphony as CMO in February 2025.

companies.changes: Executive Director and Group CEO Amit Kumar resigned (effective 27 Mar 2026); no successor named yet. CHRO Nitendra Patel resigned in Dec 2025. Nrupesh Shah was reappointed MD – Corporate Affairs in May 2026.

companies.styleNote: A Tata group company: Tata group companies own 30.30%, led by Tata Sons (26.64%). Noel Tata is the non-executive Chairman. Hired professionals run the business; the MD, Mukundan Menon C.P., came from rival Blue Star in 2023 and took over from Pradeep Bakshi in Sep 2025. No family members are in management.

people.name: Mukundan Menon C.P.
people.since: Joined Jul 2023 as Executive Director & Head – RAC; MD since Sep 2025 (term to May 2027)
people.bio: Holds a B.Tech in mechanical engineering and a graduate diploma in management, with executive programmes at IIM and INSEAD. He has about 38 years of experience across room ACs, commercial air-conditioning and commercial refrigeration. Before Voltas he was President & COO of Blue Star and a director of Blue Star Climatech. He joined Voltas in 2023 as Executive Director to run the room-AC business, and became MD on 1 September 2025. He is also MD of the projects subsidiary Universal MEP Projects & Engineering Services, and President of the industry body RAMA.

people.name: K. V. Sridhar
people.bio: A chartered accountant and cost & works accountant. He joined Voltas from Abbott, where he was Group Finance Director, and earlier held leadership roles at Danone in India and abroad and at Britannia. His experience covers finance, IT, supply chain, demand planning and procurement.

people.name: Jayant Balan
people.since: Tata group since 1999; Voltas since 2001; RAC head since Jan 2026
people.bio: Joined the Tata group in 1999 through the Tata Administrative Service and moved to Voltas in 2001. He has held leadership roles in manufacturing, supply chain, strategy, international operations and consumer durables. From 2019 to 2025 he was CEO of Voltbek Home Appliances, the appliance joint venture with Arçelik. In January 2026 he took over the room-AC business, Voltas's largest, from Mukundan Menon.

people.name: Kishore Chandrasekharan
people.bio: Holds a B.Tech in mechanical engineering from Shivaji University and is a certified project management professional (PMI, USA). He has over 26 years in commercial air-conditioning, building services, after-sales service, project management and sales. Before Voltas he was GM Sales and Service at AJM Kooheji Group in Bahrain, and earlier worked at the Al Futtaim group, General Electric Trading in Oman, and Blue Star.

people.name: Rakesh Govindan
people.since: Joined Aug 2023; business head since May 2025
people.bio: A mechanical engineer with over 30 years of experience, 26 of them in refrigeration, at Carrier Refrigeration, Danfoss and Frigoglass in India and South-East Asia. He joined Voltas in August 2023 as Head – Institutional Sales for commercial refrigeration and was made head of the business in May 2025.

people.name: Karan Sehgal
people.bio: A management graduate of the Faculty of Management Studies (FMS), Delhi. He joined Voltas in August 2026 from ITC, where he held several leadership roles and was most recently General Manager, Marketing Development in the tobacco division, running large sales teams. He takes over sales of room ACs and other unitary products from Jogesh Jaitly, who retires in March 2027.

companies.changes: Head of Sales Jogesh Jaitly retires on 31 Mar 2027; Karan Sehgal (ex-ITC) joined in Aug 2026 to take over from 1 Oct 2026. Vishal Gupta was appointed Head – IT & Digital in Jun 2026. Pradeep Bakshi's term as MD & CEO ended on 31 Aug 2025.

companies.styleNote: The Advani family founded and controls Blue Star; the promoter group owns 36.49%, spread across many family members. Vir S Advani, son of Chairman Emeritus Suneel M Advani, is Chairman & Managing Director. Suneel and Ashok M Advani, both former chairmen, are Chairmen Emeriti who advise the board but are not directors. A long-serving professional, B Thiagarajan, is the second MD, and hired executives run the business units.

people.name: Vir S Advani
people.since: Joined Blue Star 2007; ED 2010; MD 2016; Vice Chairman & MD 2019; Chairman & MD since Apr 2024
people.relation: Promoter; son of Chairman Emeritus Suneel M Advani
people.stake: 1.08% (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); father Suneel 1.19%; promoter group together 36.49%
people.bio: Holds bachelor's degrees in systems engineering and economics from the University of Pennsylvania and did an executive programme at Harvard Business School. After two years in private equity in New York, he joined Blue Star Infotech in 2000 and founded Blue Star Design and Engineering in 2003 as its CEO. He moved to Blue Star in 2007 as VP Corporate Affairs, became an executive director in 2010, MD in 2016 and Chairman & MD in April 2024. He links the board and management and directly oversees professional electronics, international operations, corporate finance, HR, IT and planning. He chairs the CII Western Region Council.

people.name: B Thiagarajan
people.since: Joined 1998; board since 2013; Joint MD 2016; MD since Apr 2019
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in electrical and electronics engineering from Madurai University and did the Senior Executive Programme at London Business School. He has over four decades of experience and worked at Larsen & Toubro, BPL Systems and Voltas before joining Blue Star in 1998. He ran product and service businesses and several corporate functions, joined the board in 2013, became Joint MD in 2016 and MD in April 2019. He is on the board of the National Skill Development Corporation and has been President of the industry body RAMA and chairman of the Indian Green Building Council. He receives stock options under the 2024 ESOP scheme.

people.name: Mohit Sud
people.role: Executive Director – Unitary Cooling Products Group
people.since: Joined Mar 2025 as Group President; board since Apr 2026
people.bio: A mechanical engineer with an MBA from XLRI, Jamshedpur. He spent over two decades at Hindustan Unilever in sales and marketing across home care and beauty & wellbeing, ending as Vice President running premium retail distribution for beauty & wellbeing. He joined Blue Star in March 2025 with end-to-end charge of room ACs and commercial refrigeration, from sales and service to R&D, manufacturing and supply chain, and joined the board in April 2026.

people.name: Nikhil Sohoni
people.bio: A chartered accountant and certified treasury and forex professional (ICFAI), and a CII-Fulbright-Nehru fellow who did a global leadership programme at Carnegie Mellon's Tepper School. He began his career in 1992 at A F Ferguson and Geoffrey Manners, then spent 27 years at the Mahindra & Mahindra group in finance roles, ending as Senior Vice President & Group Treasurer. He joined Blue Star as Group CFO in July 2022.

people.name: Sanjeev Agrawal
people.bio: An electrical engineering graduate with a postgraduate diploma in operations management from IGNOU, and over 34 years in R&D and product innovation. Just before Blue Star he was Vice President – Innovation & CTO at Crompton Greaves Consumer Electricals. Earlier he worked at Havells, Anchor Panasonic, Philips India, Dell, Schneider Electric, Electrolux and Khaitan Electricals.

people.name: Manish Jha
people.bio: A mechanical engineering graduate of NIT Patna with a PGDBM from IIM Indore and a production and inventory management certificate from APICS. He spent over 26 years at Tata Motors and its joint venture Tata Cummins, including 16 years at Tata Cummins running manufacturing and supply chain for six plants. Before Blue Star he was Head of Supply Chain for Tata Motors' commercial vehicles.

companies.changes: No executive changes since the FY26 annual report (independent director Arvind Singhal resigned in May 2026). During FY26: Sanjeev Agrawal joined as CTO (Aug 2025), Manish Jha as manufacturing head (Nov 2025), and Mohit Sud joined the board (Apr 2026).

companies.styleNote: Founded in Bhavnagar by the late Ashwinbhai Parekh; his son Chirag Parekh has been MD since 2008 and Chairman since 2013 and owns about 30% himself. Chirag's daughter Rhea Parekh runs international marketing and is being promoted to Senior Vice President from 1 October 2026. The only other executive director is a hired Group CFO. Promoters own 41.3%.

people.name: Chirag Parekh
people.since: Joined 1993; director since 2002; MD since November 2008; Chairman since November 2013
people.relation: Promoter; son of the late founder Ashwinbhai Parekh; father of Rhea Parekh
people.bio: Holds a BBA from European University, Switzerland. He joined the company in 1993, became a director in 2002 and MD in 2008, and has more than three decades in quartz and stainless-steel kitchen sinks. He turned a niche Bhavnagar sink maker into a global kitchen and bath brand that supplies large retailers such as IKEA and owns subsidiaries in the UK and Germany. Under him the company was named in Forbes Asia's 'Best Under a Billion' list in 2020. He drew about ₹8.7 crore in FY26 including commission, and he is now driving the 'Carysil 2.0' growth plan. He is 56.

people.name: Anand Sharma
people.role: Executive Director & Group Chief Financial Officer
people.since: Joined November 2015; on the board since February 2024
people.relation: Not related to any director
people.bio: A fellow chartered accountant who is also a qualified company secretary and cost accountant, with over 30 years in finance, tax, audit, risk, cross-border acquisitions and investor relations. He came from Batliboi Limited and joined Carysil in November 2015. He heads finance, accounts and operations for the company and its group companies, and joined the board as Executive Director in 2024. He is a director of the subsidiaries Carysilnox, Carysil Online and Sternhagen Bath. He is 53.

people.name: Rhea Parekh
people.role: Vice President – International Marketing (Senior Vice President from 1 October 2026)
people.relation: Daughter of Chairman & MD Chirag Parekh
people.bio: Holds a Bachelor of Fine Arts from Parsons School of Design, New York. She leads international marketing and led the FY26 brand push: actor Mira Kapoor as brand ambassador, the Carissa direct-to-consumer brand, four new experience centres and a large Valentine's Day campaign. The board has approved her promotion to Senior Vice President from 1 October 2026; because she is the MD's daughter, her pay is a related-party item put to the 2026 AGM.

people.name: Sumit Kumar
people.relation: Not related
people.bio: A technology and business-transformation leader with over 12 years across consumer goods, retail and pharmaceuticals. He joined from Rubicon Research, where he was Head of Business Transformation, and earlier held leadership roles at Haldiram's and Marico, working on SAP consolidation, CRM, direct-to-consumer strategy and data platforms. He is senior management personnel from 3 September 2026.

companies.changes: Sumit Kumar joined as CTO on 3 September 2026. Rhea Parekh's promotion to Senior Vice President takes effect on 1 October 2026. Independent director Sonal Ambani's term ended on 31 March 2026.

companies.styleNote: The TTK family controls it (promoters own 70.5%, mostly through the TT Krishnamachari & Co. partnership), but since January 2024 a hired MD & CEO runs it. The family sits on the board as non-executive: Chairman T.T. Raghunathan (also a whole-time director of group company TTK Healthcare) and Vice Chairman Dr Mukund T.T. Chairman Emeritus T.T. Jagannathan retired from the board in August 2025 and died in October 2025.

people.name: Venkatesh Vijayaraghavan
people.relation: Not related to any director
people.bio: A chemical engineer from Anna University (1994) with a marketing diploma from the Times School of Marketing, Delhi. He began at Indian Organic Chemicals and Reliance Industries' Patalganga and Hazira plants, then spent more than 19 years in telecom at Escorts and Bharti Airtel, where he rose to CMO operations for India and South Asia, COO Maharashtra and CEO for Andhra Pradesh and Telangana. In 2018 he joined CavinKare, the Chennai consumer-goods company, as CEO and board member. He joined TTK Prestige as CEO in January 2024 and was paid about ₹5.7 crore in FY26. He is 53.

people.name: R. Saranyan
people.since: Joined TTK Group 2008; with the company since April 2019
people.relation: Not related to any director
people.bio: A mathematics graduate and chartered accountant with over 30 years in manufacturing: about 10 years in autos, 7 in engineering and 11 in pharma and medical devices. He worked with the Sanmar Group and Ford India before joining the TTK Group in 2008, and was President of the protective devices division at TTK Healthcare before moving to TTK Prestige in 2019. He runs finance, tax, legal and secretarial work, and is a director of Packwell Packaging Products. He is 60.

people.name: Anil Gurnani
people.relation: Not related
people.bio: A sales and marketing leader with over 21 years of P&L experience across consumer goods, appliances, paints and autos. He holds an MBA in marketing and finance from MDI Gurgaon, an M.Sc. in finance from EDHEC Business School, France, and a gold-medal B.E. in production engineering from VJTI, Mumbai.

people.name: Srikanth B P
people.relation: Not related
people.bio: A mechanical engineer from BMS College of Engineering, Bengaluru, with over 28 years in industry, 20 of them in the automotive sector and 8 outside it. He runs the plants and supply chain.

people.name: Bibhas Sarkar
people.relation: Not related
people.bio: Holds a PGDM from IIM Lucknow and a B.Tech from Motilal Nehru NIT, Allahabad. He joined from Godrej Consumer Products, where he was General Manager for strategy and planning from April 2022, and earlier worked at D'Decor Home Fabrics, on McKinsey's programme office at Emami, and at BMGI consulting. He runs strategy and the project office and reports to the MD.

people.name: Chanchal Saxena
people.relation: Not related
people.bio: A computer science engineer with management qualifications from IMT Ghaziabad and a digital transformation course at IIM Indore, with over 20 years in technology. He held leadership roles at Kohler and Panasonic India before joining on 2 June 2026 to lead digital and technology work.

companies.changes: Chanchal Saxena joined as Chief Information & Digital Officer on 2 June 2026. Non-executive director R. Srinivasan retired from the board on 4 August 2026 and he was re-appointed as a non-executive director on 10 September 2026. Chairman Emeritus T.T. Jagannathan retired from the board in August 2025 and died on 9 October 2025.

companies.styleNote: Run by the Rathod family, whose Cello business goes back to the late Ghisulal Rathod in the 1960s. His sons Pradeep (Chairman & MD) and Pankaj (Joint MD) and Pradeep's son Gaurav (Joint MD) are the three executive directors. A CFO who has been with the group since 1991 runs finance. Promoters own 73.5%; an ICICI Venture private-equity director sits on the board as a non-executive.

people.name: Pradeep Rathod
people.since: Director since incorporation (July 2018); re-appointed CMD in 2025
people.relation: Promoter; son of the late Ghisulal Rathod; brother of Joint MD Pankaj Rathod; father of Joint MD Gaurav Rathod
people.stake: 10.26% (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); Sangeeta P. Rathod (promoter family) 5.66%; promoter group together 73.5%
people.bio: Studied to higher secondary level and has more than 40 years in the business, across manufacturing, exports, finance, administration and sales. He is credited with taking Cello from plastic houseware into many categories, building its plants and the Cello brand. He was also MD of the listed group company Wim Plast until it was merged into Cello World under a scheme that took effect in May 2026. He sits on the boards of many private Cello group companies.

people.name: Pankaj Rathod
people.role: Joint Managing Director (writing instruments, marketing, product development and production)
people.since: Director since incorporation (July 2018); re-appointed Joint MD in 2025
people.relation: Promoter; brother of CMD Pradeep Rathod; uncle of Joint MD Gaurav Rathod
people.stake: 10.75% (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); the Pankaj Rathod Family Trust holds another 8.83%
people.bio: Studied to higher secondary level and has over 35 years across manufacturing, trading, exports, finance and administration. He started the pens business from scratch and grew it, by the company's account, into India's largest writing-instruments brand with over 40% share. He leads marketing, product development and production. He was also Joint MD of Wim Plast before its merger into Cello World, and is a director of many group companies. He retires by rotation at the 2026 AGM and is seeking re-appointment.

people.name: Gaurav Rathod
people.role: Joint Managing Director (glass and opalware, modern trade and online)
people.since: Director since incorporation (July 2018); re-appointed Joint MD in 2025
people.relation: Third-generation promoter; son of CMD Pradeep Rathod; nephew of Joint MD Pankaj Rathod
people.stake: 21.48% (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report), the largest individual holder
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in finance and economics from Bentley University, Massachusetts, and a master's in business strategy from the University of Strathclyde, Scotland. He has about 10 years in the business and started the group's opalware and glassware project from scratch, including what the company calls India's largest and most advanced opalware plant. He also drives modern trade, e-commerce and digital sales. He is a director of the All India Glass Manufacturers' Federation and of many group companies. He was 37 in October 2025.

people.name: Atul Parolia
people.relation: Not related
people.bio: Has more than three decades in finance, accounting, tax and corporate strategy, and has been with the Cello Group since 1991. He leads the finance function, including financial planning and capital allocation.

companies.changes: Wim Plast and Cello Consumer Products were merged into Cello World under an NCLT-approved scheme effective 27 May 2026. No change in the executive team since the annual report.

companies.styleNote: Built on the late Punamchand Shah's plastics business; his three sons run it and each owns about 23%. Kailesh Shah is Chairman & MD (manufacturing, finance and purchase), Bhupesh Shah handles administration and logistics, and Nilesh Shah handles sales, IT and strategy. Two of the next generation, Akshay (Nilesh's son) and Dhvanit (Kailesh's son), were named senior management in August 2026. The CFO is hired. Promoters own 70.2%.

people.name: Kailesh Shah
people.relation: Promoter; son of founder the late Punamchand Shah; brother of Bhupesh and Nilesh Shah; father of Dhvanit Shah
people.stake: 23.32% (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); the three brothers together about 70%
people.bio: A commerce graduate of Lala Lajpatrai College, University of Bombay, with over 40 years in consumer houseware. He has been with the company since it was set up and runs manufacturing, finance and purchasing. He is also a partner in the family firms Chhaya Plastics Industries, Bombay Traders, Pyramid Plastics and B.T. Plastics and Allied Industries. He was named among 'India's Greatest Leaders 2018-19' by AsiaOne. The brothers sold part of their holdings in the August 2025 IPO.

people.name: Bhupesh Shah
people.relation: Promoter; brother of CMD Kailesh Shah and of Nilesh Shah
people.bio: Studied commerce at Lala Lajpatrai College, University of Bombay, and holds a public-speaking diploma from the Nazareth Speakers Academy. He has over 40 years in consumer houseware and has been with the company since it was set up, looking after general administration and logistics. He is a partner in the same four family firms as his brothers.

people.name: Nilesh Shah
people.role: Whole-time Director (sales, marketing, IT and strategy)
people.relation: Promoter; brother of CMD Kailesh Shah and of Bhupesh Shah; father of Akshay Shah
people.bio: A commerce graduate of Lala Lajpatrai College, University of Bombay, with over 40 years in sales, marketing and strategy in consumer houseware, and in IT. He has been with the company since it was set up. He is a partner in the family firms and a director of the subsidiaries All Time Bamboo and All Time Plastics PTE, Singapore. He drew about ₹1.95 crore in FY26 and is 60.

people.name: Manish Gattani
people.relation: Not related
people.bio: A chartered accountant with a commerce degree from Maharshi Dayanand Saraswati University, Ajmer, and over 20 years in finance, accounts and operations. Before joining in June 2015 he worked at Georgia Gullini Fashions, Bella Viesta Apparels and Just Textiles. He runs the finance and operations functions.

people.name: Akshay Shah
people.since: With the company since 2014; senior management since August 2026
people.relation: Son of Whole-time Director Nilesh Shah
people.bio: Holds a B.Com from the University of Mumbai and a postgraduate degree in family-managed business from S P Jain School of Global Management, and has about 12 years with the company. He ran costing and pricing and now runs the supply chain across the three plants, including the new Khatalwada plant, and leads the company's AI projects. His pay (up to ₹1 crore a year from October 2026) is a related-party item at the 2026 AGM.

people.name: Dhvanit Shah
people.since: With the company since 2016; senior management since August 2026
people.relation: Son of Chairman & MD Kailesh Shah
people.bio: Holds a BBA from the Foundation for Liberal and Management Education (FLAME), Pune, and has about 10 years with the company. He manages key customer relationships, has driven new product segments and heads tooling and product design. His pay (up to ₹1 crore a year from October 2026) is a related-party item at the 2026 AGM.

companies.changes: Akshay Shah and Dhvanit Shah were named senior management on 5 August 2026. Vice President – Operations Sanjeev Jain resigned with effect from 5 May 2026.

companies.styleNote: Controlled by the Kheruka family (promoters own 64.7%). Non-executive Chairman P.K. Kheruka is the father of Vice Chairman & MD Shreevar Kheruka, a fourth-generation family member. Since 20 May 2026 a long-serving insider, Rituraj Sharma, is CEO and runs day-to-day business and the plants; a hired whole-time director and CFO handle finance. The Kherukas also control Borosil Renewables and Borosil Scientific.

people.name: Shreevar Kheruka
people.since: With the company since 2006; director since January 2016; MD & CEO from February 2020; MD (CEO title passed on) from 20 May 2026
people.relation: Promoter; son of non-executive Chairman P.K. Kheruka
people.stake: 1.70% (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); P.K. Kheruka 10.43%; promoter group together 64.7%
people.bio: Holds a B.S. in economics (finance and entrepreneurship) from the Wharton School and a B.A. in international relations from the University of Pennsylvania. He joined the business in 2006 and, after a business crisis, rebuilt it around the Borosil brand, distribution and consumer focus, turning a single-product, single-brand company into a multi-product, multi-brand, multi-channel consumer business. He was named a World Economic Forum Young Global Leader in 2021 and one of the Economic Times '40 under Forty' in 2019. He is also Vice Chairman of Borosil Renewables and a director of Borosil Scientific. He was paid about ₹13.3 crore in FY26, including a ₹5.5 crore incentive. He is 44.

people.name: Rituraj Sharma
people.since: With the company for over 20 years; President, then CEO from 20 May 2026
people.relation: Not related
people.bio: A management graduate of the University of Bombay who also did the Senior Management Programme at IIM Ahmedabad. He has spent over 20 years at Borosil across operations, sales, distribution, marketing and strategy, and is credited with much of the consumer business's growth, including new categories, sales transformation and wider distribution. He was President before the board made him CEO in May 2026, with charge of overall business and operations, including the plants.

people.name: Rajesh Kumar Chaudhary
people.relation: Not related to any director
people.stake: 0.05% (63,708 shares including HUF, FY26 annual report)
people.bio: A commerce graduate and chartered accountant with about 28 years in finance, commercial and general management. He has been a whole-time director since February 2020 and is also a director of group company Croton Trading. He retires by rotation at the 2026 AGM and is seeking re-appointment. He is 56.

people.name: Anand Sultania
people.relation: Not related
people.bio: Heads finance as a key managerial person. Before becoming CFO he was Assistant General Manager – Accounts at group company Borosil Renewables (Bloomberg profile). The annual report gives no further detail.

people.name: Ritesh Kumar
people.since: With the company for over 19 years; senior management since July 2026
people.relation: Not related
people.bio: Has more than two decades of industry experience, over 19 years of it at Borosil, leading changes in sales, marketing, distribution and operations. He holds an MBA from IIMT, Greater Noida, and did the Senior Management Programme at IIM Ahmedabad. He was named senior management on 13 July 2026.

companies.changes: Rituraj Sharma became CEO on 20 May 2026 and Shreevar Kheruka's title changed from MD & CEO to MD. Vice President – Operations Manoj Kumar Singh resigned on 31 July 2026. Company Secretary Bhaunik Shah stepped down on 14 August 2026 and Pradeep Joshi took over from 15 August 2026. Ritesh Kumar, Manoj Tiwari, Dev Rishi Bhatnagar and Parag Parekh were named senior management in July–August 2026.

companies.styleNote: Founder Rajendra Gandhi is MD and owns about 55%; his daughter Neha Gandhi is Executive Director and his wife Sunita Gandhi is a non-executive director. The board is chaired by an independent director. Former TTK Prestige MD Chandru Kalro joined in July 2026 as non-executive Vice Chairman, and a new CFO took over in May 2026. Promoters own 55.8%, and the promoter has pledged part of his stake.

people.name: Rajendra Gandhi
people.relation: Founder and promoter; husband of director Sunita Gandhi; father of Executive Director Neha Gandhi
people.stake: 55.2% (1,82,69,115 shares, FY26 annual report); wife Sunita 0.6%; promoter group together 55.8%
people.bio: A first-generation entrepreneur who founded the company in Bengaluru in 1999 with a small unit making kerosene-wick and LPG stoves, and built it into the Pigeon and Gilma kitchen-appliance brands. He has over 25 years in the industry and runs day-to-day affairs. He holds no other directorships. He drew about ₹1.6 crore in FY26. The annual report does not give his education.

people.name: Neha Gandhi
people.since: Executive Director; re-appointed for five years from 30 September 2026
people.relation: Promoter; daughter of MD Rajendra Gandhi
people.bio: Holds a BBA from Christ University, Bengaluru, and a postgraduate certificate in sales and marketing management from MICA, Ahmedabad. She started as a graduate trainee at Viacom18. At Stove Kraft she first led brand and communication and now runs people, process and technology, including digital transformation. She drew about ₹70 lakh in FY26.

people.name: Subhadeep Pal
people.since: Joined April 2026 as VP-Finance; CFO from 16 May 2026
people.relation: Not related
people.bio: A chartered accountant with a B.Com (Hons.) from Patna University and over 23 years in corporate finance, controllership, internal audit, treasury and planning across pharma, consumer goods, foods and energy. Before Stove Kraft he worked at Synokem Pharmaceuticals, Sanofi India and Nestlé India. He replaced Ramakrishna Pendyala as CFO in May 2026.

companies.changes: CFO Ramakrishna Pendyala resigned effective 15 May 2026; Subhadeep Pal became CFO on 16 May 2026. Chandru Kalro (ex-MD of TTK Prestige) joined as non-executive Vice Chairman on 2 July 2026. Chief Growth Officer Mayank Gupta left in February 2026 and Chief Revenue Officer Rohit Mago in November 2025.

companies.styleNote: The founder Suresh Kumar Poddar is Chairman, MD and CEO. His son-in-law Arun Bagaria is the only other executive director, and his daughter-in-law Puja Poddar joined senior management as President in March 2026. The other four directors are independent. Promoters own 58.77%.

people.name: Suresh Kumar Poddar
people.since: Founder (company incorporated 1992); re-appointed CMD & CEO to March 2029
people.relation: Founder and promoter; father-in-law of Whole-time Director Arun Bagaria; father of Manav Poddar and father-in-law of President Puja Poddar
people.stake: 40.46% (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); promoter family together 58.77%
people.bio: A science graduate, he founded the company and is credited with building it into India's largest maker of synthetic leather and the only Indian supplier to North American car makers. Under him the company grew from a single coating line making 0.25 million linear metres to six coating lines.Shareholders re-appointed him CMD and CEO for three years from April 2026, to March 2029. He drew ₹2.85cr in FY26. His son Manav Poddar holds a further 15.78% but has no board or management role.

people.name: Arun Bagaria
people.relation: Son-in-law of Chairman & MD Suresh Kumar Poddar; his wife Dolly Bagaria is an Assistant General Manager
people.bio: Aged 53, he is a commerce graduate with an MBA from the University of Strathclyde Graduate Business School, UK, and has 29 years of experience. He has been on the board since June 2007 and handles strategic management alongside the Chairman. He is also a director of the group's subsidiaries in the USA (Mayur Uniquoters Corp. LLC, Futura Textiles Inc.) and South Africa, and of Mayur Tecfab. His current term runs to July 2027, and the 2026 AGM was asked to re-appoint him for five more years from August 2027. He drew ₹1.94cr in FY26.

people.name: Puja Poddar
people.relation: Daughter-in-law of Chairman & MD Suresh Kumar Poddar
people.bio: She holds a B.Com from Sydenham College of Commerce & Economics, Mumbai, and is a certified health coach. The company says she worked for about five years in its colour technology and development work before taking a strategic role reporting to the Chairman, covering R&D, innovation and CSR. She was named President – HR and Administration and designated senior management in March 2026.

people.name: Vinod Kumar Sharma
people.since: CFO (in post through FY25 and FY26)
people.bio: He is the company's CFO and a Key Managerial Personnel, and signs the accounts with the Chairman. He drew ₹94.5 lakh in FY26, up 6.2%. The annual report gives no education or career details for him.

companies.changes: Company Secretary Pawan Kumar Kumawat left in May 2025; Kapil Arora replaced him. Deputy GM-Finance Prahalad Sahai Jangid retired on 2 Sep 2026. Independent director Ratan Kumar Roongta stepped down in Sep 2026 and Vinod Kumar Haritwal joined as an independent director.

companies.styleNote: The founder M. P. Ramachandran is Chairman Emeritus and not on the executive team. His elder daughter M. R. Jyothy is Chairperson and MD. The two other executive directors (operations and IT/HR) and the CFO are long-serving professionals. In 2025 the founder and his wife moved about 41% of the company into two family trusts for succession. Promoters own 62.9%.

people.name: M. R. Jyothy
people.since: With the company since 2004; MD since April 2020; re-appointed CMD from April 2025
people.relation: Elder daughter of founder and Chairman Emeritus M. P. Ramachandran (the company is named after her)
people.stake: 2.82% (1.04 crore shares, FY26 annual report); promoter group together about 62.9%, mostly held through two M. P. Ramachandran family trusts (about 41%)
people.bio: She is a postgraduate in management with a diploma in family managed business administration, and completed the Owner/President Management Programme at Harvard University. She joined in 2004 and worked in marketing and brand communication, rising to chief marketing officer and whole-time director before taking over as MD from her father on 1 April 2020. She now also chairs the board. She has won Zee Business's Woman Entrepreneur of the Year award and was on Forbes Asia's Power Businesswomen list in 2023. Her FY26 pay rose 59% and was 130 times the median employee's.

people.name: Ananth Rao T
people.bio: He holds a Bachelor of Business Management degree and completed the Owner/President Management Programme at Harvard Business School. He has run operations and commercial since 2007, covering procurement, third-party manufacturing, logistics and supply chain, and is credited with cost savings and lower working capital through tighter inventory control. He also oversaw several capacity expansions. His FY26 pay was 72 times the median employee's.

people.name: Ravi Razdan
people.since: Heads IT since 2010 and HR since 2013
people.bio: He holds a B.E. in information technology and a Master of Management Studies in systems. He has led IT since 2010 and HR since 2013, and moved the company from a home-grown ERP to SAP, which SAP used as a global case study. He has appeared on CIO power lists several times and has been cited among top HR leaders by CHRO Asia.

people.name: Pawan Kumar Agarwal
people.bio: He holds a B.Com (Hons) from Calcutta University and is a chartered accountant (fellow), company secretary and cost accountant, with about 30 years in strategy, investor relations, fund raising, M&A, treasury and tax. Before Jyothy he was CFO of Sajjan India, and earlier worked at Kirloskar Oil Engines, VKL Seasoning, Power Exchange India and Thomson Holdings India. He replaced Sanjay Agarwal, who left in August 2024.

companies.changes: No change in directors or key managers announced since the FY26 annual report.

companies.styleNote: Controlled by Kushagra Bajaj's branch of the Bajaj family, but no family member is an executive. Kushagra Bajaj is the non-executive chairman. A hired MD, Naveen Pandey (ex-Marico and Unibic), took over in July 2025, and a long-serving CFO runs finance. Former MD Sumit Malhotra stays on the board as a non-executive director and advisor. Promoters own 43.0%.

people.name: Naveen Pandey
people.stake: nil (not among the director/KMP holdings in the FY26 annual report)
people.bio: Aged 47, he holds a post-graduate programme in management from IIM Indore and a BBA from the University of Lucknow. He has over 24 years in consumer goods and foods. Before joining he was CEO of Unibic Foods India for over four years. Earlier, at Marico, he was EVP & Business Head of the new foods unit, EVP & Sales Head for India, and MD of Marico Bangladesh. He succeeded Jaideep Nandi, whose five-year term ended in June 2025, and runs the company and its subsidiaries. He drew ₹3.93cr in FY26 (nine months).

people.name: Dilip Kumar Maloo
people.bio: A chartered accountant and company secretary, he has over 30 years in finance, treasury and secretarial work. He joined the group in April 1991 and has led finance through the company's growth over the last two decades. He signs the accounts with the MD and attends audit committee meetings.

people.name: Aditya Singh
people.bio: He has over two decades in marketing and business leadership across FMCG and media. Before joining he was Executive Vice President and Head of Marketing at Marico, where he ran large foods and personal care portfolios. He replaced Sanath Pulikkal, who left by 31 March 2026.

people.name: Aakash U Gupta
people.bio: He joined as Head of Finance and was named senior management on 1 July 2025, working under the CFO. The annual report gives no education or career details.

people.name: Anuj Awasthi
people.bio: He has led national sales since joining in June 2021 and is part of the senior management team. The company gives no education or career details.

companies.changes: Rajesh Menon, Head of Supply Chain, Operations & IT, resigned with effect from 21 Aug 2026. Company Secretary Vivek Mishra left on 30 Jun 2026; Jignesh Nagda now signs as company secretary. CMO Sanath Pulikkal left by 31 Mar 2026.

companies.styleNote: Co-founded in 2016 by husband and wife Varun and Ghazal Alagh, who are the only executive directors. Varun is Chairman and CEO; Ghazal is Chief Innovation Officer. A Peak XV nominee sits on the board. The CFO and business heads are hired professionals, several promoted from within in 2026. Promoters own about 35.5%.
