companies.styleNote: Run by two brothers: Vidyashankar Krishnan is Chairman & MD and K. Venkatramanan is Joint MD, both on the board since 1997. Vidyashankar's wife Sumita, a chartered accountant, is a non-executive director. Two long-serving professionals sit on the board as Director – Commercial and Director – Operations, and a new CFO joined in April 2026. Promoters own about 56.3%. The largest holder is Synmax Consultants and Trading (24.01%), a company where Sumita is a director.

people.name: Vidyashankar Krishnan
people.since: Board since April 1997; MD since February 1999; Vice Chairman & MD from October 2012, now Chairman & MD
people.relation: Promoter; brother of Joint MD K. Venkatramanan; husband of director Sumita Vidyashankar
people.stake: 11.27% (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); his wife Sumita holds 65,600 shares; promoter group together about 56.3%
people.bio: A postgraduate in engineering from IIT Madras with about 36 years of experience, over three decades of it in forging. He has been on the board since 1997 and MD since 1999. He led the big expansion at the Viralimalai plant, set up the Padappai plant, and set up wind-farm and solar sites, along with later expansions and acquisitions. He is a director and former president of the Association of Indian Forging Industry and holds directorships in seven other companies.

people.name: K. Venkatramanan
people.since: Board since April 1997; Joint MD since February 1999
people.relation: Promoter; brother of Chairman & MD Vidyashankar Krishnan
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in engineering and has about 33 years of experience. He has been on the board since 1997 and Joint MD since 1999. He has led marketing and export growth, and the company credits him with a 20-fold rise in export sales. He holds directorships in three other companies.

people.name: Ramnath Nagarajan
people.since: With the company about 24 years; on the board since April 2024
people.bio: A chartered accountant and cost accountant who has been with MM Forgings for about 24 years. He runs the overall marketing function and has helped grow export markets. He joined the board as Director – Commercial for five years from April 2024 and is a director of the subsidiaries DVS Industries, Suvarchas Vidyut and Abhinava Rizel. He is 59.

people.name: Krishnakumar Raman
people.since: Joined April 2022; on the board since April 2024
people.bio: Holds an M.S. in engineering from IIT Madras, a postgraduate certificate in business management from XLRI, and training in production and project planning in the UK. He joined in April 2022 and runs operations, reporting to the Chairman & MD. He joined the board as Director – Operations in April 2024. He is about 52.

people.name: R. Raghunathan
people.bio: A chartered accountant and cost accountant with over 30 years in finance across manufacturing, engineering, healthcare and services. He was CFO of Chettinad Cement and Wheels India, and Group CFO of Archean Chemical Industries and Trivitron Healthcare. He has worked on IPOs, mergers, divestments and restructuring, and has managed debt and funds of over ₹1,200cr.

companies.changes: CFO R. Venkatakrishnan (CFO since 2014) resigned for health reasons and R. Raghunathan took over on 1 Apr 2026. Company Secretary Chandrasekar S resigned on 14 Aug 2026.

companies.styleNote: A Ponnavolu-family company, incorporated in 1982. P. Deepak is MD & CEO and the only executive director. P. Divya, a relative, is a non-executive director and holds 18.57%. The chairman, Vinod K. Dasari, is an independent director. Promoters own 74.87%, all held by Deepak, his HUF and Divya.

people.name: P. Deepak
people.relation: Promoter; related to non-executive director P. Divya (the annual report does not state how)
people.stake: 39.63% (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); his HUF holds 16.67% and P. Divya 18.57%; promoters together 74.87%
people.bio: Holds engineering degrees from Northwestern University and an MBA from its Kellogg School of Management, USA. Before joining the family business he worked in strategy and operations at two Fortune 500 companies; Bloomberg lists John Deere and Federal-Mogul. He has been on the board since January 2012 and runs the company as MD & CEO, and chairs its CSR committee. He is also a member of The Chennai Angels investor network.

people.name: S.K. Sivakumar
people.bio: Srikalathi Sivakumar was appointed CFO in February 2020 and also serves as company secretary and compliance officer. He is the key managerial person for finance, compliance and investor contact.

companies.changes: No change in executives since the annual report. Non-executive director D. Sesha Reddy, on the board since 1982, chose not to seek re-appointment and retires at the 2026 AGM.

companies.styleNote: Part of the Kolhapur-based Shirgaokar (SB) group, whose flagship is The Ugar Sugar Works. Co-founded in 2010 by Sachin Shirgaokar, Sohan Shirgaokar and foundry engineer V. S. Reddy. Sachin is Chairman & MD and Reddy, also a promoter, is whole-time director. Sohan gave up the Joint MD role from 1 April 2026 and is now non-executive; several other Shirgaokar family members sit on the board as non-executive directors. Promoters own about 69.5%, mostly through S.B. Reshellers (34.82%).

people.name: Sachin R. Shirgaokar
people.since: Co-founder (2010); board since April 2013; MD since October 2013; re-appointed to March 2029
people.relation: Promoter; member of the Shirgaokar family that controls the SB group
people.stake: 5.02% (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); S.B. Reshellers holds 34.82%; promoter group together about 69.5%
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering from Karnataka University and an MBA from the University of New Hampshire, USA. He began as a junior consultant at Sanderson & Associates, New York, joined group company S.B. Reshellers in 1991 and has been its MD since 2000, bringing innovations to the sugar industry and moving into engineering castings. He co-founded Synergy Green in 2010. He is on the board of The Ugar Sugar Works, vice chairman of Youth Development Co-operative Bank, and has held posts at CII, GOSHIMA and the Indian Institute of Foundrymen. He is 60.

people.name: V. S. Reddy
people.since: Co-founder (2010); board since April 2012; re-appointed to March 2029
people.relation: Promoter and co-founder, but not a Shirgaokar family member
people.bio: Vendavagali Srinivasa Reddy holds a B.E. in mechanical engineering from SKD University, Andhra Pradesh, an M.Tech from NIFFT Ranchi, and an executive general management programme from IIM Bangalore. He started as a technologist in 1995 and worked at Simplex Castings, ISGEC, U.P. Steels and Larsen & Toubro, where he helped turn around L&T's foundry business and set up a greenfield plant. He co-founded Synergy Green in 2010 and runs product development and operations of its large castings foundry. He is 57.

people.name: Pratik P. Dukande
people.bio: He succeeded long-serving CFO Suhas Kulkarni, who retired, and became CFO on 22 May 2024. He co-signs the CFO certificate on the accounts with the Chairman & MD. The company has disclosed little else about his background.

companies.changes: Sohan Shirgaokar stepped down as Joint MD from 1 Apr 2026 and stays as a non-executive director. Sachin Shirgaokar and V. S. Reddy were re-appointed for three years from 1 Apr 2026.

companies.styleNote: A young Lohia-family company set up in January 2020 and listed on the BSE SME platform in July 2025. Two brothers run it: Himanshu Lohia is MD and also CFO, and Subodh Lohia is whole-time director. Himanshu's wife Saundarya, a chartered accountant, is a non-executive director. There is no separate finance head. Promoters own about 70%; they also took part in the August 2026 warrant issue.

people.name: Himanshu Lohia
people.relation: Promoter; brother of Whole-time Director Subodh Lohia; husband of non-executive director Saundarya Lohia
people.stake: 34.11% (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); promoters together about 70%
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in commerce (international business) from the University of Wollongong, Australia. He has been a director and promoter since the company was set up in January 2020 and has taken it from trading railway-grade materials to an RDSO-approved maker of railway safety castings. He leads strategy, finance, marketing, sales and administration, and is driving the new bogie and coupler plant at Haridwar. He is 29.

people.name: Subodh Lohia
people.relation: Promoter; brother of MD Himanshu Lohia
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in commerce (international business) from Middlesex University, UK. He has been a director and promoter since January 2020 and handles finance, production and operations, with about six years of experience in production and finance. He is 26.

companies.changes: No change in directors since the annual report. Anshu Singh was appointed Company Secretary during FY26. Promoters subscribed to warrants allotted on 31 Aug 2026; stakes after conversion are not yet disclosed.

companies.styleNote: Founder Sharad B Pitti is Founder & Chairman (an executive, whole-time director) and his son Akshay S Pitti is Managing Director & CEO. The day-to-day businesses are run by hired COOs and a chartered-accountant CFO. The promoter family and its holding company own about 54%.

people.name: Sharad B Pitti
people.since: Founder (operations began 1987); Chairman & MD until May 2024, then Founder & Chairman
people.relation: Founder; father of Akshay S Pitti
people.stake: 11.79% (FY26 annual report); promoter group together about 54.2%, including 28.45% through Pitti Electrical Equipment Pvt Ltd
people.bio: Sharad Pitti founded the company and built it into one of India's main makers of electrical-steel laminations, with more than four decades in the industry. He was Chairman & Managing Director until May 2024, when he handed the MD role to his son and was re-designated Founder & Chairman while staying a whole-time director. He also chairs the family's holding companies, Pitti Electrical Equipment, Pitti Holdings and Pitti Components. He and his wife Madhuri own the registered office and some factory land, which they lease to the company. The annual report and the company website give no details of his education.

people.name: Akshay S Pitti
people.since: 2004 (joined as whole-time director); MD & CEO since 2024
people.relation: Son of the Founder & Chairman Sharad B Pitti
people.bio: Akshay Pitti joined the company's leadership in October 2004 as a whole-time director and trained across its functions before taking charge. The company credits him with moving it from loose laminations to high-value stator and rotor assemblies and in-house machining, closing old units, building the large Aurangabad plant and making the Bagadia Chaitra and Dakshin Foundry acquisitions. He is Managing Director & CEO and chairs both subsidiaries. The company website and filings do not give his education.

people.name: M Pavan Kumar
people.bio: Pavan Kumar is a Fellow Chartered Accountant with about 19 years of work in banking, finance, accounts and tax. He has worked across power, steel, leather and textile companies. He joined Pitti in 2017 as General Manager – Finance and became Chief Financial Officer in November 2022. He runs finance strategy and treasury.

people.name: Sandip Agarwala
people.bio: Sandip Agarwala holds a post-graduate diploma in business management. He joined Pitti in May 2013 and has worked in marketing, business development and operations. As COO of the motor and generator components business, the company's core laminations and assemblies line, he runs production and delivery for that division.

people.name: Rishab Gupta
people.bio: Rishab Gupta has an MBA and more than ten years in manufacturing. His work covers supply chain, capital buying, factory automation, technology upgrades and ERP. He was Chief Procurement & Technology Officer before being named COO of machined components and enterprise sourcing in April 2025, after the previous COO of that business, Varun Agarwal, resigned.

people.name: Chaitra Sundaresh
people.bio: Chaitra Sundaresh is a commerce graduate with more than 20 years in electrical laminations. He co-owned and ran Bagadia Chaitra Industries, a lamination and die-cast rotor maker in Tumakuru, Karnataka, which Pitti bought in May 2024 (now Pitti Industries). He stays Managing Director of that unit and joined Pitti's senior team as Deputy COO.

companies.changes: No executive changes since the annual report. Independent director N Vinod Kumar resigned on 26 Aug 2026 for health reasons. Varun Agarwal, COO of machined components, left in April 2025.

companies.styleNote: Promoter Kirit Gala is Chairman & Managing Director and his son Smeet Gala, also a named promoter, is Vice President – Marketing & Sales. Two long-serving professionals from the old Gala group are whole-time directors. Aarti Industries' Rajendra Gogri sits on the board as a non-executive director. The Gala family owns about 55%.

people.name: Kirit Vishanji Gala
people.since: 2009 (MD since incorporation); CMD term to Nov 2028
people.relation: Promoter; father of Smeet Kirit Gala
people.stake: 21.84% (FY26 annual report); promoter family together about 55%
people.bio: Kirit Gala holds a bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering (1984) and a master's in management studies (1986), both from the University of Bombay, and did a short course at IMD, Switzerland in 2022. He has been Managing Director since the company was set up in 2009 and took over the business of the older Gala Precision Technology. He runs strategy and marketing. He received the Pride of Welingkar award in 2023 and speaks on professional entrepreneurship and change management.

people.name: Balkishan Jalan
people.bio: Balkishan Jalan is a commerce graduate of the University of Bombay (1989) and a chartered accountant (1994). He joined the older Gala Equipments (later Gala Precision Technology) in 1998, where he was chief operating officer, and has been with this company since it was set up. He oversees operations, finance and general management. He won an SAP ACE Excellence award in 2010.

people.name: Satish Kotwani
people.bio: Satish Kotwani holds a diploma in mechanical engineering (1991) and diplomas in materials management (1992) and marketing management (1996), and has attended executive programmes at IIM Bangalore and ISB. He worked at Born Marketers from 1993 and joined Gala Equipments in 1995 as a business-development manager. He has about 30 years in marketing and runs global business development and sales.

people.name: S Giridhar (Giridhar Srinivasan)
people.since: Nov 2023 (with the company 2014–2021 and again from 2022)
people.bio: Giridhar Srinivasan is a commerce graduate of the University of Bombay (1987) and a chartered accountant (1993), with about 27 years in finance. He was Vice President – Finance and Accounts at Gala from 2014 to 2021, rejoined in that role in April 2022 and was promoted to CFO in November 2023. He runs accounts, finance and tax.

people.name: Smeet Kirit Gala
people.relation: Son of the Chairman & MD Kirit Gala; a named promoter
people.bio: Smeet Gala holds a B.Tech in production engineering from VJTI, University of Mumbai (2016). He joined the company in April 2021 as Associate Vice President – Marketing and Sales and is now listed as Vice President – Marketing & Sales in senior management. He is one of the two named promoters and is also a director of Workamp Spaces and Slate Workspaces.

people.name: Avadhut Panshikar
people.since: COO since April 2023 (joined the Gala group 2006)
people.bio: Avadhut Panshikar holds a diploma (1993) and a bachelor's degree (1996, Shivaji University) in mechanical engineering. He worked at SKF India, Mahindra & Mahindra and Bharat Bijlee before joining Gala Precision Technology in 2006. He rejoined Gala in 2014 after a short break, became Vice President – Operations in 2018 and Chief Operating Officer (disc springs and related products) in April 2023.

companies.changes: No changes in executives since the annual report (May 2026). A second COO, Rajendra Deshpande, is listed in senior management; the company gives no profile for him.

companies.styleNote: Third-generation promoter Pratik Patel is Chairman & Managing Director; his uncle Suresh Patel is an executive director and his cousin Rahul Patel sits on the board as a non-executive director. The German partner Axel Schutte (Schuette group) is a non-executive director with about 3.9%. The Patel–Amin family owns about 43%.

people.name: Pratik Patel
people.since: Director since about 1995; MD, now Chairman & MD
people.relation: Promoter (third generation of the founding family); nephew of Suresh Patel; cousin of director Rahul Patel; father of promoter Harsh Patel
people.stake: 12.05% (FY26 annual report); promoter group together about 43.2% (June 2026)
people.bio: Pratik Patel holds a bachelor's degree in production engineering from Sardar Patel University, Gujarat and an MBA in finance from Devi Ahilya University, Indore. The business was started in 1948 by Jashbhai Patel and run by the second generation before him. He has been a director since the mid-1990s, working mainly in marketing, product development and design, and the 2017 listing document credits him with the company's acquisitions and new products. He and the then chairman L. D. Amin personally guaranteed the company's bank loans at the time of the 2017 listing.

people.name: Suresh Patel
people.since: Feb 2023; re-appointed for two years from 14 Feb 2026
people.relation: Promoter group; uncle of Pratik Patel
people.bio: Suresh Patel is a member of the promoter group and has more than four decades of experience in running businesses, especially overall management, quality production and acquisitions, according to the company's February 2026 filing. He was first appointed executive director in February 2023 and was re-appointed in February 2026 for two more years. The company's filings do not give his education.

people.name: Dharmendra Jain
people.since: CFO; with the company since about 2006
people.bio: Dharmendra Jain is a Fellow Chartered Accountant and holds a B.Sc. from Mohanlal Sukhadia University, Udaipur. He has worked at Jash since about 2006 and, at the 2017 listing, already had more than 25 years in finance and accounts. He signs the company's accounts as CFO.

people.name: Bhuvanesh Pandey
people.since: Listed as senior management in FY25 and FY26
people.bio: Bhuvanesh Pandey is named as Chief Operating Officer in the company's senior management list. The annual report does not give a profile of him, and no filing with his background was found.

companies.changes: Suresh Patel was re-appointed executive director for two years from 14 Feb 2026. Independent director Vishwapati Trivedi left in Aug 2025 and Rakesh Bhawsar joined. No change in CFO or COO.

companies.styleNote: Promoter Tarak Patel is Managing Director, and since May 2026 the group is run by a Group CEO, Gregory Gelhaus, who is his brother-in-law and the son-in-law of promoter Ashok Patel. Ashok Patel, MD from 1988 to 2015, is now a non-executive director. The board is chaired by an independent director, Prakash Apte. The Patel family owns about 25%.

people.name: Tarak Patel
people.since: MD since June 2015; executive director since 2007; joined 2005
people.relation: Promoter; son of Ashok Patel; brother-in-law of Group CEO Gregory Gelhaus
people.stake: 1.16% (June 2026 shareholding pattern); promoter group together about 25.2%
people.bio: Tarak Patel has a BA in economics from the University of Rochester, USA and an MBA jointly awarded by Columbia Business School, London Business School and HKU Business School. Before joining GMM Pfaudler in 2005 as Vice President – Sales and Marketing he worked at Universal Consulting, a Mumbai strategy consulting firm. He became an executive director in 2007 and Managing Director in June 2015, and shareholders re-appointed him for five years from May 2025. He took on the CEO's duties when Aseem Joshi left in September 2025. He is on the boards of Ready-Mix Concrete Ltd and ReefWatch Marine Conservation and chairs Charutar Arogya Mandal.

people.name: Gregory Gelhaus
people.since: Group CEO since 21 May 2026; joined May 2025 as Group Chief Transformation Officer
people.relation: Son-in-law of promoter Ashok Patel; brother-in-law of MD Tarak Patel
people.bio: Gregory Gelhaus holds a BBA in accounting from the University of Michigan's Ross School of Business and an MBA in finance and marketing from Wharton, and is a New York CPA. He was chief operating officer for Asia Pacific and Central Europe at Global Blue, where he sat on the executive committee, and earlier worked at PwC, Alvarez & Marsal and Kirkham Group. He joined GMM Pfaudler in May 2025 to run its Global Transformation Program and was made Group CEO in May 2026 under a new single-CEO structure. Because he is a promoter relative, his pay needs shareholder approval as a related-party office of profit.

people.name: Ankit Nayyar
people.role: Deputy CFO; Group CFO from 4 Nov 2026
people.bio: Ankit Nayyar is a chartered accountant with a B.Com from Shri Ram College of Commerce and a master's in accounting and finance from Manchester Business School. He was CFO of PI Health Sciences, where he ran global finance and M&A, and helped integrate Monsanto into Bayer in India. Earlier he worked at Pfizer, Morgan Stanley Capital and Tata AIG Life. He joined as Deputy CFO in May 2026 and takes over as Group CFO after the Q2 FY27 results on 4 November 2026.

people.name: Massimo Serapioni
people.bio: Massimo Serapioni holds a BBA and a master's in information, media and technology management from the University of St. Gallen, and a master's in international business strategy from the Stockholm School of Economics. Before GMM Pfaudler he was General Manager of the plastics recycling business at Coperion, where he led the purchase and integration of a German company. He has headed the corrosion-resistant technologies (glass-lined equipment) division since September 2025.

companies.changes: Group CFO Alexander Poempner resigned on 15 Sep 2026; he steps down after the Q2 results on 4 Nov 2026 and Ankit Nayyar takes over. Thomas Kehl, CEO of the international business, retired on 31 Aug 2026. Gregory Gelhaus became Group CEO in May 2026, after CEO Aseem Joshi left in Sep 2025. Manish Shah and Ulf Wittmann stopped being senior management in May 2026 in a reorganisation.

companies.styleNote: The Lalbhai family (Arvind group) controls the company, mainly through Aura Securities, and owns about 41%. No family member works in management: Punit Lalbhai has been non-executive Chairman since November 2025 (taking over from his father Sanjay Lalbhai), and his brother Kulin Lalbhai is a non-executive director. The business is run by a hired MD & CEO, Reginaldo Dsouza, who came from Godrej.

people.name: Reginaldo Dsouza
people.since: CEO since Oct 2022; MD since 6 Jul 2024
people.bio: Reginaldo Dsouza is a mechanical engineer (1997) and holds a PGPX from Great Lakes Institute, Chennai. He spent about 25 years at Godrej & Boyce, mostly in its process-equipment division, working across sales and marketing, operations, supply chain, IT and business excellence; in his last role he led sales and marketing, estimation and IT and ran new-business projects with profit-and-loss responsibility. He joined Anup as CEO in October 2022, replacing Rishi Roop Kapoor, and was made Managing Director in July 2024.

people.name: Nilesh Hirapara
people.bio: Nilesh Hirapara is a chartered accountant. Before Anup he was Head – Finance, Controlling & Treasury at AIA Engineering, and earlier worked at Larsen & Toubro. His experience covers finance and accounts, treasury, MIS, internal audit, compliance and SAP roll-outs. He became CFO in April 2023, replacing Bhavesh Shah.

people.name: Vikram Khandelwal
people.since: Listed as senior management in FY26
people.bio: Vikram Khandelwal is named Chief Operating Officer in the company's senior management list. The annual report and exchange filings do not give his background.

people.name: Dineshkumar Patel
people.bio: Dinesh Patel holds a diploma and a B.E. in mechanical engineering, and is an ASME Authorized Inspector and ASNT Level II in radiography, ultrasonic, magnetic-particle and dye-penetrant testing. He has more than 24 years in inspection of pressure vessels and heat exchangers for oil refining, power and energy projects, and is a lead auditor for ISO 9001. He joined senior management as Chief Quality Officer in May 2025.

people.name: Kunal Shah
people.bio: Kunal Shah is a commerce graduate with a master's in labour welfare from Gujarat University and a certificate in strategic management from XLRI. He has more than 24 years in human resources, covering hiring, pay structures, career planning, performance management and staffing greenfield projects. He joined as Chief Human Resource Officer in May 2025.

companies.changes: No changes in executives since the annual report (July 2026). Rudolph Mathias, appointed Chief Marketing Officer in Aug 2025, left in Oct 2025. Punit Lalbhai replaced his father Sanjay Lalbhai as Chairman in Nov 2025.

companies.styleNote: Founder Krishan Lalit Bansal is Chairman & Managing Director. His daughter-in-law Shikha Bansal and his daughter Shruti Aggarwal are whole-time directors; his wife Ashima Bansal stepped down from the board in April 2025. The Bansal family owns about 70%, with Krishan Lalit Bansal alone holding about 51%.

people.name: Krishan Lalit Bansal
people.since: 1988 (founder); CMD term renewed from Apr 2022 for five years
people.relation: Founder; husband of promoter Ashima Bansal; father of Shruti Aggarwal; father-in-law of Shikha Bansal
people.stake: 50.82% (June 2026 shareholding pattern); promoter group together about 70.2%
people.bio: Krishan Lalit Bansal holds a bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering from Punjab Engineering College, Chandigarh. He started a partnership, Development Engineers, in 1986 and has run DEE since it was incorporated in 1988, building it into a maker of prefabricated process piping, with a side business in biomass power. His other ventures include DEE Group Trust and DDE Piping Components, a promoter company. The Faridabad Industrial Association named him Business Leader of the Year in 2011 and gave him a Lifetime Achievement Award in 2016. He sold shares in the company's 2024 IPO.

people.name: Shikha Bansal
people.since: Dec 2020; re-appointed from 1 Nov 2025 to Oct 2030
people.relation: Daughter-in-law of the Chairman & MD; sister-in-law of Shruti Aggarwal
people.bio: Shikha Bansal holds a B.Com from the University of Delhi and an M.Com from Himachal Pradesh University. She joined the company in December 2020 as a whole-time director. She is also Managing Director of the Thailand subsidiary, DEE Piping Systems (Thailand), and oversees group strategy, operations, international business, HR and marketing across India and Southeast Asia, including budgeting and management reporting.

people.name: Shruti Aggarwal
people.since: Board since Apr 2025; with the company since 2011
people.relation: Daughter of the Chairman & MD Krishan Lalit Bansal
people.bio: Shruti Aggarwal holds a B.Com from the University of Delhi, is a Chartered Financial Analyst (ICFAI) and has a PGDM in finance from Shri Ram Institute of Management, plus an executive certificate in business finance from IIM Raipur. She joined DEE in 2011 as a senior manager in operations, became Vice-President (Operations) in 2023 and joined the board in April 2025, when her mother Ashima Bansal stepped down. She runs the Indian operations, with a focus on project execution, planning, budgeting and forecasting.

people.name: Pankaj Agarwal
people.since: COO since Jul 2023; with the company since 1994
people.bio: Pankaj Agarwal joined DEE in July 1994 as marketing manager and has worked there for more than 30 years. He was made Chief Operating Officer, customer relations, in July 2023 and is part of the core management team. The 2024 prospectus lists his qualification as the senior school certificate (science) from Jamia Millia Islamia, New Delhi.

people.name: Brham Prakash Yadav
people.bio: Brham Prakash Yadav is a chartered accountant and cost accountant with more than 30 years in finance, mostly at multi-plant auto-component makers. He was CFO and a board member of the listed Munjal Auto Industries from May 2020, and before that AVP-Finance at Hema Engineering Industries (2014–2020), where he ran finance for six plants. Earlier he held finance roles at Omax Autos, SIAC SKH Cabs, Krishna Maruti and Lifelong. He has worked on IPOs, private equity and bank fund-raising.

companies.changes: CFO Sameer Agarwal resigned on 5 Jan 2026 for personal reasons; Brham Prakash Yadav took over on 7 Jan 2026. Ashima Bansal resigned as a whole-time director on 14 Apr 2025. The subsidiaries' CEOs, Krisanakorn Triwattanathongchai (Thailand) and Balwan Singh Jangra (Malwa Power), are also listed as senior management; the company gives no profiles for them.

companies.styleNote: The Puri family controls Isgec. Aditya Puri is Managing Director; his father Ranjit Puri, who guided the company for decades, is non-executive Chairman. Two long-serving professionals, Kishore Chatnani (also CFO) and Sanjay Gulati, are Joint Managing Directors. The promoters, including The Yamuna Syndicate, own about 62.4% with no pledge.

people.name: Aditya Puri
people.since: Joined as Controller of Finance; MD, re-appointed for five years from 1 May 2026
people.relation: Promoter; son of Chairman Ranjit Puri
people.stake: 6.21% (June 2026 shareholding pattern); promoter group together about 62.4%
people.bio: Aditya Puri holds a BA (Hons) from St. Stephen's College, Delhi and an MA in economics from Cambridge University. He has more than 35 years with the group, joining Isgec as Controller of Finance and rising to Managing Director. He is also Managing Director of the wholly owned sugar subsidiary Saraswati Sugar Mills and sits on the boards of other group companies. Shareholders re-appointed him MD until April 2031.

people.name: Kishore Chatnani
people.role: Joint Managing Director & Chief Financial Officer
people.since: With the company since 1998; whole-time director from June 2021; Joint MD since Oct 2025
people.bio: Kishore Chatnani holds a B.E. in industrial production engineering from Nagpur University and an MBA in finance from IMS, Indore University. He has more than 35 years in finance, treasury, investment management and M&A, and has been with Isgec since 1998. He joined the board as a whole-time director in 2021, was re-designated Joint Managing Director in October 2025 and re-appointed for five years from June 2026, while staying CFO. He also sits on the boards of other group companies.

people.name: Sanjay Gulati
people.role: Joint Managing Director & Head, Manufacturing Units
people.since: Whole-time director from June 2021; Joint MD since Oct 2025
people.bio: Sanjay Gulati holds a B.E. in industrial production engineering from SGSITS, Indore. He has more than 35 years across marketing, exports, manufacturing, projects and planning, HR and greenfield projects. He heads Isgec's manufacturing units and is also Managing Director of Isgec Hitachi Zosen, the joint venture with Hitachi Zosen. He was re-designated Joint Managing Director in October 2025 and re-appointed for five years from June 2026.

companies.changes: Since the annual report: Gaurav Sharma joined as Business Head – Global Industrial Services and Solutions (3 Aug 2026), Rajesh Goyal as Chief Supply Chain Officer – Project Business (15 Sep 2026), and Chief HR Officer Radhika Arora resigned (21 Sep 2026). Chief Strategy Officer Anup Bhargava retired in Feb 2026. Two independent directors finished their terms in 2025.

companies.styleNote: Three generations of the Khemka family run the company: Hari Shanker Khemka is Chairman and whole-time director, his son Aditya Khemka is Managing Director and built the CP PLUS brand, and Aditya's son Ananmay Khemka is a whole-time director. Aditya's brother Rishi Khemka is a promoter but not in management. The family owned about 74.7% in June 2026, before the September 2026 share placement.

people.name: Aditya Khemka
people.since: About 30 years in the business; MD
people.relation: Promoter; son of Chairman Hari Shanker Khemka; father of Ananmay Khemka; brother of promoter Rishi Khemka
people.stake: 31.53% (June 2026 shareholding pattern); promoter group together about 74.7%
people.bio: Aditya Khemka studied commerce at Shri Ram College of Commerce, Delhi University and has a post-graduate diploma in international business from FORE School of Management, New Delhi. He has about 30 years in IT and video surveillance and is credited with building the CP PLUS brand. At the company he runs growth strategy, operations, investments and core product development. Under a 2024 family agreement he votes on behalf of the other family shareholders and nominates the family's directors. He was named Business World's Security Man of the Year in 2023.

people.name: Hari Shanker Khemka
people.relation: Promoter; father of MD Aditya Khemka and of Rishi Khemka; grandfather of Ananmay Khemka
people.stake: About 0.00% held directly (June 2026 shareholding pattern); the family holds through its members and the Hari Khemka Business Family Trust
people.bio: Hari Shanker Khemka took the final exam for a B.Sc. in chemistry at Hindu College, Delhi University. He has about 30 years in IT and electronic video surveillance. As Chairman and a whole-time director he handles legal matters, administration and strategic planning. He has received several Rotary Club Delhi Premier awards.

people.name: Ananmay Khemka
people.since: Joined Jul 2020; whole-time director since 23 Sep 2024
people.relation: Son of MD Aditya Khemka; grandson of Chairman Hari Shanker Khemka
people.bio: Ananmay Khemka holds a bachelor's degree in global management from Regent's University, London. He joined the company in July 2020 as manager – strategy and business development, working in the internet-of-things business, and was made a whole-time director in September 2024 for five years. He is one of the named promoters.

people.name: Yogesh Chand Sharma
people.bio: Yogesh Chand Sharma is a commerce graduate of Delhi University and a Fellow Chartered Accountant with more than 28 years in finance. Before joining in January 2011 he was general manager (finance) at Rohan Motors and Allied Motors, and earlier worked at Allied Nippon, Techno Foto and the CA firm Singhal Associates. He runs financial strategy and planning.

people.name: Sanjay Gogia
people.bio: Sanjay Gogia holds a bachelor's degree in electronics engineering from the University of Lucknow and joined the company straight after, in April 2000. He has spent more than 24 years in sales there and leads sales strategy across all products and regions. He was paid about ₹2.9cr in FY25.

people.name: Anup Nair
people.bio: Anup Nair holds a bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering from the University of Mumbai and an MBA from Deakin University. He has more than 21 years in IT distribution and security, and before joining in June 2016 was a project consultant at IndusInd Entertainment and director (corporate alliances) at Neoteric Infomatique. He handles the sales team, strategy and key initiatives.

people.name: Monika Sharma
people.role: Senior Vice President – R&D & Product Development
people.bio: Monika Sharma holds a B.Com from Delhi University and an MBA from Southern Taiwan University. She first worked for the company as a general manager in 2011, served as legal representative of its Shenzhen and Hong Kong subsidiaries, and rejoined in January 2021. She runs research and product development.

companies.changes: No executive changes since the annual report (July 2026). Non-executive director Atul B. Lall resigned on 25 May 2026. A September 2026 share placement of about ₹1,500cr lowers the family's stake below the June figure.

companies.styleNote: The promoter group, led by the Khaitan family (Williamson Magor group companies) and the promoter company Firstview Trading (29.6%), owned about 46% at March 2026. No promoter works in management: Amritanshu Khaitan has been non-executive Chairman since April 2026, and Aditya Khaitan left the board in March 2026. The company is run by a hired Managing Director, Ranjit Lala, with a whole-time director for operations and long-serving executives.

people.name: Ranjit Pamo Lala
people.since: MD; re-appointed for two years from 15 May 2025 to May 2027
people.bio: Ranjit Lala holds a B.E. in machine tool engineering and a master's in marketing management, and has attended management programmes at leading institutes. He has about 37 years in engineering companies. Before Kilburn he was Managing Director of Aerzen Machines India for about seven years, where he ran the business and set up a new factory. At Kilburn he is responsible for overall management and is not related to any director.

people.name: Anil Somshekar Karnad
people.since: Re-appointed for two years from 1 Apr 2025 to Mar 2027
people.bio: Anil Karnad holds a B.E. in mechanical engineering from Mumbai University. He has worked across oil and gas, fertilisers, power and chemicals, and at Kilburn runs day-to-day operations: production, quality, engineering, procurement, subcontracting, and site erection and commissioning.

people.name: Sachin Vijayakar
people.since: CFO since 2019; with the company since 1985
people.bio: Sachin Vijayakar is a commerce graduate who has worked at Kilburn since 1985, according to a company investor presentation. He is the company's Chief Financial Officer and signs its accounts.

people.name: Maqsood R. Kazi
people.bio: M. R. Kazi holds a diploma in mechanical engineering and has worked at Kilburn since 1986, according to a company investor presentation. He was Vice President – Marketing and is now President – Marketing, and is part of the senior management team.

companies.changes: Nitin Varadkar (Purchase Head) and Dinesh Nikam (Project Head) were added to senior management on 14 Aug 2026. Company Secretary Arvind Bajoria resigned in Sep 2025 and Abhijit Mehta replaced him in Nov 2025. Amritanshu Khaitan became Chairman in April 2026 after Aditya Khaitan resigned in March 2026.

companies.styleNote: Founder Madan Mohan Mohanka became non-executive Chairman in February 2025; his son Mehul Mohanka runs the company as Managing Director & Group CEO. The rest of the top team is hired. The Mohanka family owns about 67.5%, mostly through Nihal Fiscal Services (49.9%) and family trusts; Madan Mohan Mohanka holds 7.3% directly.

people.name: Mehul Mohanka
people.since: With the company for about two decades; MD & Group CEO
people.relation: Promoter; son of Chairman Madan Mohan Mohanka
people.stake: 0.28% held directly (June 2026 shareholding pattern); promoter group together about 67.5%
people.bio: Mehul Mohanka holds a B.Com from the University of Calcutta and an MBA from the University of Pittsburgh, and completed the Advanced Management Program at Harvard Business School. He has worked at Tega for about two decades, across sales and operations, and now leads the group, including the June 2026 purchase of Molycop, which roughly doubled its size. He is President of the Indian Chamber of Commerce, chairs the CII's mining and construction equipment division, co-chairs its national mining committee, and earlier chaired the CII West Bengal state council.

people.name: Ravi Narayan Joshi
people.bio: Ravi Narayan Joshi is a chartered accountant and law graduate with more than 21 years in finance. He spent about 15 years in the Vedanta group, including Hindustan Zinc and the group's management assurance team, and was then Deputy CFO at Balkrishna Industries. His work has covered treasury, fund-raising, structured finance, M&A, tax, cost control and ESG. He joined Tega as CFO in August 2026, as it takes on the debt from the Molycop deal.

people.name: Manoj Kumar Sinha
people.bio: Manoj Kumar Sinha holds a bachelor's degree in engineering from Sambalpur University. Before joining Tega in September 2015 he worked at Tata Engineering and Locomotive Company (now Tata Motors), New Holland Tractors (India) and Sterling Generators. He runs Tega's global manufacturing operations.

people.name: Pratik Basu Roy
people.role: President – Product Management, Global Sales, Marketing and R&D
people.bio: Pratik Basu Roy holds a bachelor's degree in engineering from Mangalore University and a post-graduate management degree from NMIMS, Mumbai. He has worked at Siemens Wind Energy, Maruti Suzuki, Wockhardt, Suzlon Energy, Birla Tyres and the Varroc Group, in roles covering business P&L, strategy, M&A and post-merger integration, sales and investor relations. He joined Tega in November 2023.

people.name: Vinay Grover
people.bio: Vinay Grover is a B.Tech graduate with more than 30 years in mining, mineral processing, crushing and screening. He worked at Metso Minerals (India) before joining Tega in 2003, and has since held sales, business-development, channel and product roles, with work in Canada, Latin America, Europe and India. He was President – Global Sales before being named Global Head of Sales, a senior management post, from September 2026.

people.name: Shiraj Chakraborty
people.since: Listed as senior management in FY26
people.bio: Shiraj Chakraborty has a bachelor's and a master's in statistics from Delhi University and an MBA in HR from Symbiosis Institute of Business Management, Pune. He started in 2000 as an HR management trainee at GlaxoSmithKline Consumer Healthcare and later worked at RoundGlass Wellbeing, Greaves Cotton, Viacom18 and Kohler, before an HR advisory and consulting role and then joining Tega.

companies.changes: CFO Sharad Kumar Khaitan resigned effective 5 May 2026 to pursue opportunities outside the group; Shyama Prasad Ganguly was interim CFO until Ravi Narayan Joshi joined on 6 Aug 2026. Vinay Grover was named Global Head of Sales from 1 Sep 2026.

companies.styleNote: Founder Ravalnath Shende is Chairman & Managing Director; his wife Rajashri and their daughters Devashree Nampurkar and Rucha Shende are whole-time directors. A retired naval commodore, Sunil Kaushik, is the one non-family whole-time director. The founding couple own about 44.6%.

people.name: Ravalnath Gopinath Shende
people.relation: Founder; husband of Rajashri Shende; father of Devashree Nampurkar and Rucha Shende
people.bio: Ravalnath Shende holds a bachelor's degree in production engineering from VJTI, University of Bombay (1983). He founded the company and has been a director since it was incorporated in 2006. His experience covers sales, manufacturing, operations, planning, finance and compressor manufacturing. He has received the GS Parkhe award for innovation in entrepreneurship and the Brig SB Ghorpade award for MSMEs in defence manufacturing.

people.name: Rajashri Ravalnath Shende
people.since: Director since 2006; whole-time director since 2021, re-appointed Feb 2026
people.relation: Co-founder; wife of the Chairman & MD; mother of Devashree Nampurkar and Rucha Shende
people.bio: Rajashri Shende holds a diploma in electronics and telecommunication engineering (1986). She is a founding member of the company, has been a director for about 20 years and became a whole-time director in 2021. The board re-appointed her as a whole-time director in February 2026, subject to shareholder approval.

people.name: Devashree Vishwesh Nampurkar
people.relation: Promoter; daughter of the Chairman & MD and Rajashri Shende; sister of Rucha Shende
people.bio: Devashree Nampurkar holds a B.E. in mechanical engineering from Shivaji University, Kolhapur (2010) and an MSc in business and management from the University of Strathclyde (2012). She joined the company in 2016 as Manager – Sales & Marketing and has about 13 years in sales, marketing and business strategy. She joined the board in May 2024.

people.name: Rucha Ravalnath Shende
people.relation: Daughter of the Chairman & MD and Rajashri Shende; sister of Devashree Nampurkar
people.bio: Rucha Shende is a mechanical engineer with a background in HVAC, plumbing and fire-protection design, working in the field since 2019 on institutional, healthcare, laboratory and public-sector projects using Revit and AutoCAD. She was appointed to the board as a whole-time director in February 2026, and her appointment was put to shareholders at the August 2026 AGM.

people.name: Commodore Sunil Kaushik, NM, VSM (Retd.)
people.bio: Sunil Kaushik holds a B.Tech in mechanical engineering from Jawaharlal Nehru University, an M.Phil, an M.Sc in defence and strategic studies, and a post-graduate diploma in industrial engineering. He served more than 35 years in the Indian Navy, where he led warship-building projects and worked on project planning and contract management. He joined the board as a whole-time director in November 2024.

people.name: Abhijeet Govind Saoji
people.bio: Abhijeet Saoji holds a B.Tech in agricultural engineering and had about 15 years in manufacturing when he was made CEO in November 2023. The 2025 IPO prospectus lists no previous employer for him. The company gives no further background.

people.name: Manoj Mahavir Kothale
people.bio: Manoj Kothale is a chartered accountant. He was appointed CFO in November 2023, and at the time of the 2025 IPO had a little over four years of experience in finance, banking and tax; his previous employer is listed as LV Dairys, Patas.

companies.changes: Rajashri Shende and Rucha Shende were appointed whole-time directors on 23 Feb 2026. Company Secretary Ashwini Godbole was replaced by Tanmay Pethkar during FY26. No executive changes found since the annual report.

companies.styleNote: Run by its three Indian co-promoters, all ex-engineering-company men: Arvind Kamath is Chairman, Dipak Bharuka is CEO and Goutam Rampelli is a whole-time director. They are business partners, not a family. Promoters own about 68%: the promoter company Mascot Capital & Marketing (Kamath is a director) about 32.5%, the Korean founder JNK Global (formerly JNK Heaters) about 18%, Bharuka 8.9% and Rampelli 8.3%. JNK Global's CEO Kim Bang-hee sits on the board as a non-executive director.

people.name: Arvind Kamath
people.relation: Promoter; director of promoter company Mascot Capital & Marketing
people.stake: Individual stake not found; promoter company Mascot Capital & Marketing, where he is a director, holds about 32.5% (latest shareholding pattern); promoters together about 68%
people.bio: Arvind Kamath holds a bachelor's degree in chemical engineering from NIT Surathkal. Before JNK he worked with Sulzer Pumps India and was associated with Chetra Seals, Mascot Flowtech and Mascot Global. He has been with JNK India since 16 August 2010 and the company credits him with driving its diversification beyond fired heaters. He is also a director of Mascot Capital & Marketing and other Mascot group companies.

people.name: Dipak Bharuka
people.relation: Co-promoter (not related to the other promoters)
people.bio: Dipak Bharuka has an M.E. in machine design from IIT Roorkee and an executive MBA in project management from SP Jain Institute of Management & Research. He spent 12 years at Larsen & Toubro, leaving as Assistant General Manager. At JNK he is the CEO and a whole-time director.

people.name: Goutam Rampelli
people.relation: Co-promoter (not related to the other promoters)
people.bio: Goutam Rampelli spent over 36 years with L&T Hydrocarbon Engineering & Construction, working in marketing, business development, project execution and strategic planning. He joined JNK in 2015 and is a co-promoter and board member. The company credits him with strong negotiation skills and a wide industry network.

people.name: Anand Agarwal
people.bio: Anand Agarwal is a chartered accountant with about 20 years of experience across EPC, infrastructure, industrial parks and oil and gas. He was named interim CFO and key managerial personnel from 12 March 2026, after the previous CFO Pravin Sathe resigned in December 2025.

companies.changes: CFO Pravin Sathe resigned effective 16 Dec 2025; Anand Agarwal is interim CFO from 12 Mar 2026 (no permanent CFO named yet).

companies.styleNote: Promoter Prakash Agarwal has been Managing Director since 2002 and is the only promoter on the board; three hired executive directors run finance, operations and projects. Promoter group holds 70.8%. His daughter Aanya Agarwal works in the company. The group also controls Hindusthan Udyog and Bengal Steel Industries.

people.name: Prakash Agarwal
people.relation: Promoter; father of Aanya Agarwal (employee)
people.bio: Prakash Agarwal, 55, is a mechanical engineer (BE) with about 31 years of experience. He came from the promoter group's Hindusthan Udyog, joined WPIL's board as a non-executive director in 2000 and became Managing Director on 1 July 2002; shareholders re-appointed him from 1 November 2025. The company lists his strengths as marketing, new products, turnarounds, international marketing and setting up new operations; WPIL's overseas pump subsidiaries in South Africa, Australia, the UK and Italy (Gruppo Aturia) were all added during his tenure. He is also a non-executive promoter director of Hindusthan Udyog. He drew ₹2.94cr in FY26.

people.name: K. K. Ganeriwala
people.bio: K. K. Ganeriwala, 63, holds a B.Com (Hons) and LLB and is a qualified cost accountant (FCMA) and company secretary (FCS), with about 41 years in finance: planning, fund raising, investor relations, tax, M&A and restructuring. He was a non-executive director for five years before becoming Executive Director in 2007, covering finance, accounts, tax and legal. He sits on the boards of the overseas subsidiaries (Aturia, Mather & Platt SA, APE Pumps, Sterling Pumps) and of promoter-group companies including Hindusthan Parsons. Re-appointed from 1 November 2025.

people.name: Brahma Prakash Khare
people.bio: Brahma Prakash Khare holds an M.E. in mechanical engineering and has about 46 years in the pump industry across design, quality assurance and manufacturing. He headed WPIL's Ghaziabad business unit for more than 15 years before joining the board as Executive Director (Operations).

people.name: Debraj Roy
people.bio: Debraj Roy holds a B.E. in mechanical engineering, an M.E. in production and a PGCBM, with 30-plus years managing large engineering projects, including quality and contract management. He became Executive Director (Projects) in April 2024.

people.name: U. Chakravarty
people.bio: U. Chakravarty is a fellow company secretary (FCS-5127) and is the company's General Manager (Finance) and Company Secretary, listed among key managerial personnel. WPIL does not name a separate CFO.

companies.changes: No KMP changes after the FY26 annual report found. Prakash Agarwal and K. K. Ganeriwala re-appointed from 1 Nov 2025; B. P. Khare from 1 Mar 2026.

companies.styleNote: Founder Pramod Chaudhari stays on as executive Founder Chairman & Mentor, but day-to-day the company is run by a hired Managing Director, Ashish Gaikwad (ex-Honeywell), with Sachin Raole as Joint MD & CFO. Their son Parth Chaudhari is a non-executive director; Pramod's wife Parimal Chaudhari left the board in August 2025. Promoters own 32.8%.

people.name: Pramod Chaudhari
people.role: Founder Chairman & Mentor – Praj Group (Whole-time Director)
people.since: 1983 (founder); current executive term from 1 July 2025 to 30 June 2030
people.relation: Founder; husband of Parimal Chaudhari and father of Parth Chaudhari (non-executive director)
people.stake: 24.97% (FY26 annual report); with wife Parimal (7.83%) the promoters hold 32.81%
people.bio: Pramod Chaudhari is an IIT Bombay graduate (1971, later named a Distinguished Alumnus) and attended Harvard Business School's Advanced Management Program in 1995. A first-generation entrepreneur, he founded Praj in 1983 and built it into India's largest biofuel technology company, with more than 1,000 installations in over 100 countries. He moved from non-executive chairman back to an executive role from July 2025; shareholders approved this by special resolution because he is over 75. He chairs the governing board of COEP Technological University, Pune, and founded the Indian Federation of Green Energy. His awards include the George Washington Carver Award (2020) and the William C. Holmberg lifetime award (2022).

people.name: Ashish Gaikwad
people.since: 3 February 2025 as MD-designate; MD from 1 July 2025 (term to 31 January 2030)
people.bio: Ashish Gaikwad holds a B.E. (Hons) in electrical and electronics engineering from BITS Pilani. He spent about three decades at Honeywell, starting as an automation and process control engineer and working in India, South-East Asia, Asia Pacific and the USA; for over seven years he was Managing Director of the listed Honeywell Automation India. Under him Honeywell Automation was named Business Standard's Star MNC of the Year 2019, and Fortune India listed him among top wealth creators in 2021. He replaced long-time CEO & MD Shishir Joshipura at Praj in July 2025.

people.name: Sachin Raole
people.role: Joint Managing Director & Chief Financial Officer
people.since: JMD & CFO from 30 April 2026 (earlier CFO & Director – Resources)
people.bio: Sachin Raole is a chartered accountant and cost accountant with about 31 years in finance and accounts: M&A, divestments, restructuring, treasury and tax. Before Praj he worked with RPG group companies, including KEC International, RPG Cables and RPG Life Sciences. At Praj he was CFO & Director – Resources, also overseeing HR, materials, IT, legal and secretarial, and was elevated to Joint Managing Director & CFO for five years from 30 April 2026. He is on the boards of the main subsidiaries, including Praj GenX, Praj HiPurity and Praj Americas.

people.name: Anant Bavare
people.bio: Anant Bavare is the Company Secretary and Compliance Officer and one of the four key managerial personnel named in the FY26 annual report.

companies.changes: CEO & MD Shishir Joshipura retired on 30 June 2025; Ashish Gaikwad took over as MD on 1 July 2025. Sachin Raole became Joint MD & CFO from 30 April 2026. Senior executive Ajay Pratap Singh (VP & Business Head) left in September 2025.

companies.styleNote: A Seth family business: Chairman Lalit Seth is a whole-time director and his two sons hold the other top jobs, Rishi Seth as Managing Director and Gautam Seth as Joint MD and CFO. There are no hired executives on the board. Promoters own 72.7% (22.75% directly by family members and 49.91% through family companies such as HPL India, HPL Electronics and HPL Holdings).

people.name: Lalit Seth
people.relation: Promoter; father of Rishi Seth and Gautam Seth
people.bio: Lalit Seth has more than 56 years in the electrical industry and heads the HPL group as its Chairman. The company credits him with its transformation into a maker of meters, switchgear, lighting, wires and cables, and with building its reputation for quality and technology. He is one of three family executives on the board and did not take a pay rise in FY26.

people.name: Rishi Seth
people.since: Managing Director; retired by rotation and stood for re-appointment at the 24 September 2026 AGM
people.relation: Son of Lalit Seth; brother of Gautam Seth
people.bio: Rishi Seth holds an MBA in finance and has over 31 years in the electrical industry. As Managing Director he sets strategy and leads diversification, including EPC and green-energy projects, and he oversees the institutional and government business, which includes the smart-meter orders from power utilities. The company credits him with making HPL one of the leading smart-meter makers.

people.name: Gautam Seth
people.role: Joint Managing Director & Chief Financial Officer
people.since: Joint MD; also CFO since March 2022
people.relation: Son of Lalit Seth; brother of Rishi Seth
people.bio: Gautam Seth is a commerce graduate and a qualified chartered accountant with over 29 years in the electrical industry. As Joint Managing Director he oversees the group's overall running and administration and leads sales and marketing. He also became CFO and key managerial personnel in March 2022, so the finance function reports to a family member.

people.name: Vivek Kumar
people.bio: Vivek Kumar is the Company Secretary and the only key managerial personnel from outside the Seth family named in the FY26 annual report.

companies.changes: No board or KMP changes in FY26 or since the annual report. Independent director Rashmi Vij was re-appointed from 11 May 2026.

companies.styleNote: A Khurana family company: brothers Pushkar Khurana (Executive Chairman, runs the overseas business from Dubai) and Puneet Khurana (Managing Director) are the sons of the late founder Prem Kumar Khurana. A hired CEO, N. P. Gupta (ex-Jamna Auto), joined in July 2026. Promoters own about 67.4%, including Suman Khurana 24.4% and the family firm Khurana Gases 15.9%.

people.name: Pushkar Khurana
people.since: Board since September 1994; Executive Chairman since 14 November 2019
people.relation: Promoter; son of the late founder Prem Kumar Khurana; brother of MD Puneet Khurana
people.stake: 9.13% (FY26 annual report); promoter group together about 67.4%
people.bio: Pushkar Khurana, 54, is a commerce graduate from Mumbai University with an MBA from the USA, and recently completed Harvard Business School's Owner/President Management programme. He has been with the EKC group for about three decades and oversees its international business as Managing Director of the Dubai subsidiary EKC International FZE. He also sits on the boards of the subsidiaries in Egypt, Europe and the US (CP Industries) and of family companies such as Khurana Gases. He retired by rotation and stood for re-appointment at the 2026 AGM.

people.name: Puneet Khurana
people.relation: Promoter; son of the late founder Prem Kumar Khurana; brother of Chairman Pushkar Khurana
people.bio: Puneet Khurana, 53, is a commerce graduate and completed a business management course at Mumbai University; he has about 30 years in the business. He opened export markets for the company's CNG cylinders in Iran, Malaysia, Thailand and Bangladesh and built relationships with vehicle makers such as Bajaj Auto, Tata Motors, Mahindra and Eicher, and with city gas companies such as MGL, IGL, Adani and Torrent. The company cites his expertise in innovation and R&D in cylinders, and he is a director of Calcutta Compressions & Liquefaction Engineering, Next Gen Cylinder and CP Industries Holdings.

people.name: Narender Prasad Gupta
people.bio: N. P. Gupta is a mechanical engineer (Institution of Engineers, India) with an MBA from IMT Ghaziabad and a Lean Six Sigma Black Belt. He has more than 25 years of leadership experience in automotive and manufacturing, including senior roles at Jamna Auto Industries and Hero Motors. His areas are strategy, operations, lean manufacturing, supply chain and business transformation. CEO Insights named him among the top 10 Indian manufacturing CEOs in 2024.

people.name: Sanjiv Kapur
people.since: CFO; whole-time director since 26 May 2025 (term ends 31 October 2026)
people.bio: Sanjiv Kapur, 65, is a chartered accountant with over 42 years in finance roles across manufacturing industries including textiles, steel, auto ancillaries and industrial products. As CFO he also handles legal and other corporate matters. He was made a whole-time director in May 2025 and retires on 31 October 2026, after which the board wants him to stay on as a non-executive director from 1 November 2026.

people.name: Vishal Totla
people.bio: Vishal Totla is the Company Secretary and Compliance Officer and one of the company's key managerial personnel.

companies.changes: N. P. Gupta joined as CEO on 1 July 2026. CFO Sanjiv Kapur retires on 31 October 2026 and is proposed as a non-executive director from 1 November 2026; no successor CFO had been announced as of late September 2026.

companies.styleNote: A Patel family company run by two brothers' branches: Himanshu Patel is Managing Director and his son Harsh Patel is whole-time director; his brother Nilesh Patel sits on the board as a non-executive director and Nilesh's son Aalap Patel is an executive director. Promoters own 65.6%, almost all held by these four. The chairman, Yatish Parekh, is an independent director.

people.name: Himanshu Patel
people.relation: Promoter; father of Harsh Patel; brother of Nilesh Patel; uncle of Aalap Patel
people.bio: Himanshu Patel is an electrical engineer (B.E., University of Bombay, 1976) with about 49 years in the chemicals and engineering business. The company credits him with shaping its strategy and operating framework and guiding its long-term growth. He joined the board with the other family directors on 31 December 2016 and, as MD, certifies the accounts together with the CFO.

people.name: Harsh Patel
people.since: Director since 31 December 2016; whole-time director since 1 October 2022
people.relation: Son of MD Himanshu Patel; nephew of Nilesh Patel; first cousin of Aalap Patel
people.bio: Harsh Patel, born 1977, is a chemical engineer from the University of Mumbai with an MBA from Seattle University. He has more than 25 years in the chemicals and engineering business and drives product innovation, operations and expansion. He is also a director of family companies including Kinam Engineering Industries, Kinam Process Equipments, HLE Engineers and Yashashvi Rasayan, some of which do business with HLE Glascoat.

people.name: Aalap Patel
people.relation: Son of Nilesh Patel; nephew of Himanshu Patel; first cousin of Harsh Patel
people.bio: Aalap Patel holds a B.E. in mechanical engineering from the University of Pune and an MBA in global management from Thunderbird School of Global Management. He has over 14 years of industry experience and works on strategic planning and operations. He chairs the board's risk management committee.

people.name: Amit Kalra
people.bio: Amit Kalra has about 22 years of experience in P&L management and corporate transformation. He was already part of HLE Glascoat's senior management, working on its strategic transformation, before being named CFO from 25 September 2026. His first task is to steer the ongoing restructuring and deal with the sharp margin fall seen in Q1 FY27.

people.name: Achal Thakkar
people.bio: Achal Thakkar is the Company Secretary and Compliance Officer and one of the company's key managerial personnel.

companies.changes: CFO Naveen Kandpal resigned effective 3 July 2026; Amit Kalra (from within senior management) became CFO on 25 September 2026.

companies.styleNote: Run by the Kandula family: Nageswara Rao Kandula is Managing Director, his wife Krishna Veni Kandula and his brother Ramakrishna Kandula are executive directors. A second promoter family, the Katragadda brothers, has one executive and one non-executive director. Japan's AGI group, a strategic investor, has its CEO Yasuyuki Ikeda on the board as an executive nominee director. Promoters own 60.5%; the chairman is independent.

people.name: Nageswara Rao Kandula
people.relation: Promoter; husband of Krishna Veni Kandula; brother of Ramakrishna Kandula
people.bio: Nageswara Rao Kandula holds a diploma in business management and an MBA, both in finance, from the Indian School of Business Management and Administration. He has been with the company since it was set up and has more than a decade of experience in glass lining, engineering and allied industries. The annual report lists his strengths as strategy, finance and capital allocation, and precision manufacturing. He led the company through its January 2025 stock market listing and its later rename from Standard Glass Lining Technology to Standard Engineering Technology. He is also a director of the family's Standard Group of Companies and Standard C2C Engineering.

people.name: Ramakrishna Kandula
people.relation: Promoter; brother of MD Nageswara Rao Kandula
people.stake: 22.09% directly (March 2026 shareholding pattern); also a partner in promoter firms S2 Engineering Services (9.44%) and Standard Holdings (2.31%)
people.bio: Ramakrishna Kandula, 48, passed Parts I and II of the Technicians Engineering Examination of the Institution of Mechanical Engineers. He has more than 14 years in making stainless steel and nickel-alloy equipment; his listed strengths are manufacturing and shop-floor operations. He is Managing Director of the main subsidiary, S2 Engineering Industry, and a partner in S2 Engineering Services. He stood for re-appointment by rotation at the 18 September 2026 AGM.

people.name: Krishna Veni Kandula
people.relation: Promoter; wife of MD Nageswara Rao Kandula
people.stake: 18.64% (March 2026 shareholding pattern); also a partner in promoter firms S2 Engineering Services and Standard Holdings
people.bio: Krishna Veni Kandula, 45, holds an MBA and a graduate diploma in management, both in finance, from the Indian School of Business Management and Administration. She has been with the company since incorporation and has about 14 years in glass lining and engineering, covering general management and administration. She is a director of many family companies, including S2 Engineering Industry, Standard Flora, CPK Engineers Equipment and Standard Scigenics. She stood for re-appointment by rotation at the 18 September 2026 AGM.

people.name: Venkata Mohana Rao Katragadda
people.relation: Promoter group; brother of non-executive director Venkata Siva Prasad Katragadda (not related to the Kandulas)
people.bio: Venkata Mohana Rao Katragadda holds a diploma in mechanical engineering from Tamil Nadu's State Board of Technical Education and passed the chartered engineer examination of the Institution of Mechanical Engineers (India). Before joining he was Deputy Chief Engineer at The Jeypore Sugar Company, and he has over three decades in construction and engineering. His listed strengths are mechanical engineering, project execution and industrial operations, and he chairs the board's risk management committee.

people.name: Yasuyuki Ikeda
people.bio: Yasuyuki Ikeda is Chief Executive Officer of Japan's AGI Group (Asahi Glassplant), a glass-lined equipment and chemical-processing company that invested in Standard, and he sits on the board as the AGI investors' nominee. He holds a diploma from The American School in England (TASIS) and has over 25 years in engineering and chemical processing. He is also a director of AGI's Indian ventures, including AGI Glassplant India, ATR-Asahi Process Systems and GL Hakko Technology.

people.name: Anjaneyulu Pathuri
people.since: 18 July 2022 (joined 4 March 2022 as Associate VP, Finance)
people.bio: Anjaneyulu Pathuri is a chartered accountant (associate member of ICAI). He worked in audit and assurance at S.R. Batliboi & Associates, G.M. Kapadia & Co. and M. Anandam & Co., and was an Assistant General Manager in finance at Aurobindo Pharma. He joined Standard in March 2022 and has been CFO of both the company and its main subsidiary since July 2022.

people.name: Kallam Hima Priya
people.since: Associated with the company since 1 October 2021
people.bio: Kallam Hima Priya is an associate member of the Institute of Company Secretaries of India and holds an LL.B. from Osmania University. She has been with the company since October 2021 and is also company secretary of the main subsidiary.

companies.changes: No KMP changes found after the FY26 annual report. Independent director Uma Maheswara Rao Kancherla joined on 14 May 2026; Venkata Siva Prasad Katragadda became a non-executive director on 4 August 2025.

companies.styleNote: A subsidiary of Belgium's John Cockerill SA, which owns about 70.4% (it sold roughly 6% in December 2025 and is set to rise to about 72% if pending convertible preference shares convert). There is no family: the parent sends its own executives, and the Managing Director, Frederic Martin, is also a group vice-president. The chairman, Francois-David Martino, is a non-executive group nominee. The MD is the only executive director.

people.name: Frederic Martin
people.bio: Frederic Martin holds a master's degree in mechanical engineering from ENSAM (Arts et Metiers, France) and has over 35 years in the ferrous and non-ferrous metals industry. Before John Cockerill he worked with Fives Stein, Shanghai Stein Heurtey and Durmech Engineering. He joined the group in 2005 as General Manager of CMI Thermline, became VP Operations, ran the Beijing operation for seven years from 2009 and then spent four years in Salem, USA; from 2021 he was Vice President of the Metals business line in Belgium. He moved to India to replace Michael Kotas and continues as Vice President Metals of John Cockerill Industry.

people.name: Deepak Prabhakar Chindarkar
people.bio: Deepak Chindarkar was appointed CFO and key managerial personnel from 24 August 2026. The company says he brings over 36 years of international finance leadership experience. He replaced Marc Dumont, who moved to the same role at another John Cockerill group company.

people.name: Nidhi Salampuria
people.bio: Nidhi Salampuria became Company Secretary and Compliance Officer on 19 December 2025, after Haresh Vala resigned in September 2025.

companies.changes: MD Michael Kotas resigned on 31 July 2025; Frederic Martin took over on 1 August 2025. CFO Marc Dumont left on 31 July 2026 for another group company; Deepak Chindarkar became CFO on 24 August 2026. Company Secretary Haresh Vala left in September 2025; Nidhi Salampuria replaced him in December 2025.

companies.styleNote: Three co-founder relatives run it and own almost equal stakes: brothers Chandrakant Patel (Chairman & MD) and Rajendra Patel (Joint MD), and their cousin Vipul Patel (Joint MD). Promoters held 69.7% before the ₹190cr preferential issue approved in August 2026 (₹180cr from Japan's Galilei Holdings), which would take them to roughly 61% once the shares are issued. A hired CEO, M. Srinivas Reddy (ex-Blue Star), joined in November 2025.

people.name: Chandrakant P. Patel
people.relation: Co-founder and promoter; brother of Rajendra Patel; cousin of Vipul Patel
people.stake: 23.08% (FY25 annual report, March 2025); three promoters together 69.71%
people.bio: Chandrakant Patel is a co-founder of the business, which began in 1989, and has more than 34 years in refrigeration. He heads sales and service, marketing, finance, legal and R&D. He gives the closing remarks on investor calls. The August 2026 Galilei Holdings deal he presides over as Chairman also creates a joint venture, Ice Make Horeca, in which Galilei holds 60% and Ice Make 40%.

people.name: Rajendra P. Patel
people.since: Director since 31 March 2009; Joint MD since 5 September 2017
people.relation: Co-founder and promoter; brother of Chandrakant Patel; cousin of Vipul Patel
people.bio: Rajendra Patel, born 1970, trained as a diesel mechanic (ITI) at M.P. Shah College, Ahmedabad. He has over 27 years in refrigeration and heads production of cold-room panels and refrigerated containers, along with quality control, design and dispatch.

people.name: Vipul I. Patel
people.relation: Co-founder and promoter; cousin of Chandrakant and Rajendra Patel
people.bio: Vipul Patel, 50 in 2025, has over 27 years in the refrigeration industry. He heads purchasing, accounts, production of refrigeration equipment, quality control, HR and IT.

people.name: M. Srinivas Reddy
people.bio: M. Srinivas Reddy is an engineering graduate with an MBA and completed the Senior Executive Programme at London Business School. He has over three decades of experience and was Executive Vice President – Corporate Strategy & Business Development at Blue Star before joining. He was an elected member of the CII Maharashtra State Council for 2024-25. His brief is to drive growth, widen the product range and lead the company's next phase of expansion.

people.name: Ankit P. Patel
people.bio: Ankit Patel is the CFO and presents the financial results on the company's earnings calls. The company does not publish a detailed profile of him, and he is not listed as a relative of the promoters in the related-party disclosures.

people.name: Mandar B. Desai
people.bio: Mandar Desai has been the Company Secretary and Compliance Officer since March 2019.

companies.changes: M. Srinivas Reddy joined as CEO on 14 November 2025. In August 2026 the board approved a preferential issue of 23,67,573 shares at ₹802.51 (₹180cr from Galilei Holdings, ₹10cr from others). The FY26 annual report was not available online, so stakes are from March 2025.

companies.styleNote: A Patil family company founded by brothers Yogesh Patil (Chairman & MD) and Vivek Patil (Whole-time Director). Yogesh's daughter Durva and Vivek's son Shatanik sit on the board as non-executive directors. Long-time CFO Vinayak Parab moved up to executive director in August 2026. Promoters and their family own about 67.7%, split almost equally between the two brothers.

people.name: Yogesh Vishwanath Patil
people.since: Founding promoter; Chairman & MD since 31 May 2024
people.relation: Co-founder; brother of Vivek Patil; father of Durva Patil (non-executive director)
people.stake: About 5.5 million shares, roughly 29% (promoters' annual disclosure, 31 March 2026); promoter group together about 67.7%
people.bio: Yogesh Patil, one of the two founding brothers, completed higher secondary education and has more than 29 years of experience in production, commercial and finance roles in the heat-exchanger industry. He runs the company's commercial and finance functions and became Chairman and Managing Director in May 2024, ahead of the company's listing on NSE Emerge.

people.name: Vivek Vishwanath Patil
people.since: Founding promoter; Whole-time Director since 31 May 2024
people.relation: Co-founder; brother of Yogesh Patil; father of Shatanik Patil (non-executive director)
people.stake: About 5.5 million shares, roughly 29% (promoters' annual disclosure, 31 March 2026)
people.bio: Vivek Patil holds a postgraduate diploma in boiler and process equipment design and engineering. He has more than 29 years of experience in design, marketing and administration, and runs the company's design and marketing functions.

people.name: Vinayak Uttam Parab
people.since: Executive director from 26 August 2026 (CFO from March 2024 to 25 August 2026)
people.bio: Vinayak Parab holds a B.Com from Mumbai University and has more than 20 years in finance and corporate management, including financial planning and control, budgeting, fund raising and risk management. He was CFO from March 2024, through the listing, and stepped down as CFO in August 2026 to take a board seat as an executive director with wider responsibilities; his appointment needs shareholder approval at the AGM.

people.name: Hitesh Dnyaneshwar Haldankar
people.bio: Hitesh Haldankar is a finance professional with over 17 years in finance and accounts. He was Senior Manager – Finance & Accounts at the company before being promoted to CFO, and earlier held senior finance roles elsewhere, including as a finance head.

people.name: Madhura Kamalakar Gaidhani
people.bio: Madhura Gaidhani is an associate member of the Institute of Company Secretaries of India (membership A78000) and is the Company Secretary and Compliance Officer.

companies.changes: CFO Vinayak Parab stepped down as CFO on 25 August 2026 and joined the board as an additional executive director from 26 August 2026; Hitesh Haldankar became CFO the same day. An additional independent director, Sandeep Bodake, was also appointed.

companies.styleNote: Run by the Ador Group's promoter family. Ninotchka Malkani Nagpal is Executive Chairman and Aditya Malkani is Managing Director; both are named promoters. The family holding company J.B. Advani & Co. owns 45.2%, and the promoter group together owns 53.8% (March 2026). The annual report says no two directors are 'relatives' under the Companies Act. Another promoter, Dr Deep Lalvani, chairs the holding company and sits on the board as a non-executive director.

people.name: Ninotchka Malkani Nagpal
people.relation: Promoter-group member of the Ador Group family
people.bio: Holds an MBA in finance from Imperial College London and a B.Sc. in business and economics from Lehigh University, USA. She began her career at Alliance Capital Asset Management in New York. She has worked across Ador Welding and other Ador Group companies for over 27 years, mainly in finance, strategy and governance. She was chairman of Ador Fontech and of J.B. Advani & Co., the group's parent, and now guides the combined business after Ador Fontech merged into Ador Welding. She became Executive Chairman on 19 November 2019.

people.name: Aditya T. Malkani
people.relation: Promoter-group member of the Ador Group family
people.bio: Holds an MBA in finance from the Indian School of Business, Hyderabad, and a BA in economics from Oberlin College, Ohio. He joined the Ador Group in 2002 and worked in international business, corporate marketing, strategy and new business projects before becoming Managing Director in September 2020. The board re-appointed him for another three years from 14 September 2026, subject to shareholder approval at the July 2026 AGM. He also sits on the board of Batliboi Ltd.

people.name: Krishnamurthy Suryanarayan
people.bio: A commerce graduate and chartered accountant with over 25 years in finance. He started in 1996 as an audit manager at RPG Life Sciences, then worked at Godrej Consumer Products, where he was CFO of its Africa operations. He joined CEAT in July 2020 to head business partnering, and was later CFO of Astec LifeSciences. At Ador he was Head – Corporate Strategy (a key managerial person from May 2025) and became CFO on 15 August 2026.

people.name: Lajpat Yadav
people.role: Chief Operating Officer – India Welding Business
people.bio: A mechanical engineer with an MBA from the Birla Institute of Management & Technology, Delhi, and 33 years in the welding industry. He was appointed COO after the Ador Fontech merger and runs the India welding business, the maintenance and repair division, and the welding, cutting and automation division.

people.name: Mustafa Faizullabhoy
people.bio: Named by the company as a key managerial person from 7 May 2025, heading international operations; exports were about 13% of FY26 sales. The annual report gives no further background.

companies.changes: CFO Surya Kant Sethia resigned on 30 July 2026 after 11 years and left on 14 August 2026; Krishnamurthy Suryanarayan became CFO & Head – Strategy from 15 August 2026. Smaller senior changes: Vinit Mangrulkar joined as VP – Sales (July 2026); Pradnya Iyer became Head – HR and V.M. Bhide was redesignated Chief Compliance Officer & Company Secretary (August 2026).

companies.styleNote: A Garg family business, set up in 1982 by former Larsen & Toubro professionals including N.K. Garg. His son Prashant Garg is Chairman & Managing Director and the only executive director. Prashant's mother Chitra Garg and brother Dr Nitin Garg (a practising neurosurgeon) are non-executive directors. Prashant's wife Neelu Garg works in the company as General Manager – Procurement. Promoters own about 70%. There has been no CEO since Ramesh Kumar N left in February 2026.

people.name: Prashant Garg
people.relation: Promoter; son of director Chitra Garg, brother of director Dr Nitin Garg, husband of GM – Procurement Neelu Garg
