companies.changes: CFO Divyesh Maru resigned on 13 Nov 2025; Ashish Desai replaced him. Non-executive director Ravin Gandhi resigned on 12 May 2026, and his alternate Nina Gandhi (Rajiv's wife) left the board with him. An Aug 2026 postal ballot moves Ravin and Bela Gandhi from promoter to public.

companies.styleNote: A Zota family business. Founder Ketankumar Zota is non-executive chairman, yet is paid a commission of 0.30% of turnover. His son Moxesh Zota is MD, and three other Zota promoter-group members (Himanshu, Kamlesh and Viren) are whole-time directors; the filings do not state how they are related to the founder. The Zota family and associates own 49.4% (June 2026). A hired Group CEO, Dr. Sujit Paul, runs the Davaindia pharmacy chain.

people.name: Moxesh Ketanbhai Zota
people.since: With the company since 2014; MD since Oct 2016; re-appointment from Oct 2026 to Oct 2031 proposed
people.relation: Son of founder and Chairman Ketankumar Zota
people.stake: 1.43% (June 2026); his father holds about 11.6% across two holdings; promoter group together 49.38%
people.bio: He holds a B.Pharm from Gujarat Technological University and a master's in international marketing and business management from BPP University, UK. He joined in 2014 and runs overall management, exports, new projects and foreign product registrations. He has taken the company into more than 30 countries, with 325 products registered abroad and 261 more in process. His pay is ₹60 lakh a year plus a commission of 0.20% of consolidated turnover, which proxy adviser IiAS objected to ahead of the September 2026 AGM.

people.name: Himanshu Muktilal Zota
people.relation: Promoter group (Zota family; exact relation to the founder not stated)
people.bio: He holds a diploma in pharmacy from the Maharashtra Board of Technical Examinations and a BCA from Aptech, Surat. He has over 30 years with the company, covering strategy, tax, finance and IT. The company credits him as one of the main people behind creating and building the Davaindia pharmacy chain, and he leads project planning and execution.

people.name: Kamlesh Rajnikant Zota
people.relation: Promoter group (Zota family; exact relation to the founder not stated)
people.bio: He holds a B.Pharm from Gujarat University and has over 28 years in pharmaceutical operations. He began as a senior technical assistant at Torrent Pharma and was a production officer at Unique Pharmaceutical Laboratories before joining Zota at its start. He runs factory operations, regulatory approvals and WHO certifications, export clearances and documentation, and patents and trademarks.

people.name: Viren Manukant Zota
people.relation: Promoter group (Zota family; exact relation to the founder not stated)
people.bio: He is a business administration graduate from B.R.C.M. College. He started in franchise marketing across India and now handles buying products from outside manufacturers, managing thousands of SKUs and streamlining procurement. The company says his focus on quality, pricing and inventory has supported growth over the past five years.

people.name: Laxmi Kant Sharma
people.bio: He holds a B.Sc. in biology from Rajasthan University, Jaipur, and a diploma in pharmacy from the Maharashtra Board of Technical Examinations. Over 21 years he has worked as a medical representative, area sales manager and retail pharmacist. He joined Zota in 2018 and oversees operations at Davaindia stores.

people.name: Dr. Sujit Paul
people.since: Group CEO through FY26 (start date not disclosed)
people.bio: He holds a B.Sc. (Hons) from Calcutta University, an MBA from IMT Ghaziabad, a quality management certificate from the Philip Crosby institute and a doctorate in management from ISBM. He has over 24 years in retail pharmacy, hospitals and wellness. At Reliance Retail he built a nationwide pharmacy chain with over 5,000 staff, and at Apollo he helped launch 1,000 pharmacies. At Zota he leads the Davaindia retail pharmacy expansion.

people.name: Viral Mandviwala
people.since: CFO through FY26 (start date not disclosed)
people.bio: He is the company's CFO and a key managerial person, and signs the financial statements. The annual report gives no details of his education or earlier career.

companies.changes: At the 28 Sep 2026 AGM, shareholders voted on Moxesh Zota's re-appointment and on pay and related-party resolutions for promoter directors, which IiAS opposed; results were not yet filed. Ashvin Variya was made Group Company Secretary in May 2026. Independent director Varshaben Mehta's term ended on 9 Sep 2026, and Mahaveer Dhariwal joined as an independent director on 3 Sep 2026.

companies.styleNote: Founder Rabindra Prasad Sinha is Chairman and a whole-time director, and his son Amit Raj Sinha is MD and CEO. Co-promoter S. Chidambaranathan is Executive Vice Chairman. Promoters own only 36.7% (June 2026), including 15.0% through RPS Industries, and about 28% of promoter shares are pledged. Swati Sinha, a promoter-group shareholder, is VP for ESG.

people.name: Amit Raj Sinha
people.relation: Son of Chairman Rabindra Prasad Sinha
people.stake: 3.66% directly plus 0.78% through his family trust (June 2026); promoter group together 36.69%
people.bio: He holds a B.Tech and an MBA from the Indian School of Business, and is a Fellow of the Institution of Engineers. Before joining industry he served in the Indian Navy, managing critical defence installations. He has over 20 years in pharmaceuticals and fine chemicals and has pushed Sigachi's R&D and its move into drug ingredients and services. He was arrested after the fatal 30 June 2025 explosion at the Pashamylaram plant and was granted bail by the Telangana High Court in February 2026; the case is still under investigation.

people.name: Rabindra Prasad Sinha
people.relation: Founder; father of MD Amit Raj Sinha
people.stake: 3.99% directly (June 2026); RPS Industries holds another 15.02% and the RPS Family Trust 1.21%
people.bio: He holds a postgraduate degree in chemical engineering from Banaras Hindu University and has more than 40 years in cellulose and fine chemicals. He built Sigachi into a global maker of cellulose-based excipients and set up its wholly owned US subsidiary. He has personally guaranteed the company's bank loans along with other promoters.

people.name: S. Chidambaranathan
people.since: Co-promoter; retires by rotation and seeks re-appointment at the Sep 2026 AGM
people.relation: Co-promoter; not related to the Sinhas (per annual report)
people.stake: 5.08% (June 2026); his family members hold about 1.8% more
people.bio: He holds a postgraduate diploma in business administration from Annamalai University. The company says he has worked for over five decades in chemicals and cellulose derivatives. He led the domestic operations and set up the Gujarat manufacturing plants. He has also personally guaranteed the company's loans.

people.name: O. Subbarami Reddy
people.since: CFO through FY26 (start date not disclosed)
people.bio: He is CFO and a key managerial person and wrote the CFO's letter in the FY26 annual report, which promises tight capital allocation and a recovery in margins. The annual report gives no details of his education or earlier career.

companies.changes: No KMP changes were filed after the annual report. On 15 Sep 2026 shareholders rejected a ₹290cr warrant issue, reportedly with 99.4% of votes against. The internal auditor was changed in Aug 2026.

companies.styleNote: The promoter is Sagility B.V., owned by the private equity firm EQT, which bought the business from HGS in 2021–22. It held 50.95% at 31 March 2026, down from 82.39% a year earlier after an offer for sale and block deals, so further sales are possible. A hired team led by MD & Group CEO Ramesh Gopalan runs the company. The chairman, Marty (Martin) Cole, is a non-executive, non-independent director. The annual report says no directors are related to each other.

people.name: Ramesh Gopalan
people.since: Group CEO since January 2022; MD since 24 June 2024
people.relation: Professional; not related to any director
people.stake: nil (FY26 annual report, shares held as on 31 March 2026)
people.bio: Holds a B.Tech from the Indian Institute of Technology (ISM) Dhanbad and an MBA from IIM Ahmedabad. He has more than 30 years in healthcare operations, outsourcing and financial research, with earlier roles at Accenture and Deloitte. He then spent about 11 years at Hinduja Global Solutions (HGS), where he ran the healthcare and India business. That healthcare business was carved out as Sagility when EQT (then Baring Private Equity Asia) bought it, and he has led it as Group CEO since. He took the company public in November 2024. His FY26 pay was ₹33.3cr, up 43%.

people.name: Srinivas Rathnam Mattapalli
people.role: Executive Vice President & Group Chief Financial Officer
people.relation: Professional
people.bio: Has a B.Com from Osmania University, is a qualified cost accountant (ICWA) and holds a PGDM in finance and international business from IIM Bangalore. He has over 30 years in finance. Before Sagility he was a Senior Vice President at Genpact, where he held several roles including business CFO for its hi-tech and manufacturing vertical, and led a global Workday rollout and a cost programme. Earlier he worked at eFunds (now FIS), Hindustan Coca-Cola and Colgate-Palmolive. He joined after the previous CFO, S.D. Srinivasan, resigned in November 2025; besides finance he also oversees procurement, audit and sustainability.

people.name: Chris Shiffert
people.role: Executive Vice President & Chief Growth Officer
people.since: 1 December 2025 (joined through the BroadPath acquisition, January 2025)
people.relation: Professional
people.bio: Holds a BA in history and an MBA from Xavier University. He began as a management consultant at Deloitte, then spent eight years at Xerox Services building healthcare payer solutions. He joined BroadPath Healthcare Solutions in 2016 and ran its sales, marketing and client solutions until Sagility bought it in January 2025. He was made Chief Growth Officer in December 2025, replacing Sohail Djariri, who resigned. He is responsible for winning new clients and growing large accounts.

people.name: Mohit Saxena
people.role: Executive Vice President & Chief Delivery Officer
people.relation: Professional
people.bio: Holds a B.Com from the University of Allahabad and has passed the examinations for a master's in management studies from NMIMS, Mumbai. He was earlier with Hinduja Global Solutions (the business Sagility came out of) and NetAmbit Infosource. He runs service delivery across Sagility's operations.

people.name: Madan Moudgal
people.role: Executive Vice President & Chief Digital Officer
people.since: With Sagility Technologies LLC since December 2017
people.relation: Professional
people.bio: Holds bachelor's and master's degrees in science from Bangalore University and an MBA from NYU Stern School of Business. He was earlier with CareGain and EDS Information Services. He runs technology, product strategy and development, and has been with the healthcare software arm, Sagility Technologies, since December 2017, leading its growth.

people.name: Sreepathy Viswanathan
people.role: Executive Vice President & Chief Corporate Development Officer
people.since: With HGS from 2005; moved to Sagility after EQT's 2022 investment
people.relation: Professional
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's in chemical engineering from Bangalore University, a PGDBA from IBS, a CFA charter from ICFAI and an MBA with high honours from the University of Chicago Booth School of Business. He worked at Tata, Epson and Siemens in planning, joint-venture and turnaround roles before joining HGS in 2005. Based in Austin, Texas, he runs acquisitions, including target search, due diligence, funding and integration; he has worked on more than 12 deals.

companies.changes: Group CFO S.D. Srinivasan resigned with effect from 15 Nov 2025; Abhishek Kayan was made Deputy CFO the same day and Srinivas Mattapalli became Group CFO on 14 Feb 2026. Chief Growth Officer Sohail Djariri resigned with effect from 28 Nov 2025; Chris Shiffert replaced him from 1 Dec 2025. No executive changes found since the annual report (July 2026).

companies.styleNote: Founder and promoter Sachin Gupta runs the group as Global CEO (from the US subsidiary); he stepped down as a whole-time director of the listed company on 31 July 2025 and now sits on its board as a non-executive director. Most of the promoter stake belongs to the late Rakesh Jhunjhunwala's family through three trusts (16.37% each) and Rekha Jhunjhunwala (0.23%); they are not in management and are represented by two nominee directors from Rare Enterprises. Promoters own 63.72% in all. Co-founder Joe Benardello is Group Chief Growth Officer. Hired executives run finance, operations and TruBridge. The board has no family relationships. Chairman Berjis Desai (non-executive) retired at the 21 Sep 2026 AGM; independent director Clarence King II is now chairman.

people.name: Sachin K. Gupta
people.role: Founder & Global CEO (non-executive director of the listed company since 1 August 2025)
people.relation: Founder and promoter; not related to the Jhunjhunwala family or other directors
people.stake: 10.23% (1,75,59,879 shares, 31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); promoter group together 63.72%
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in computer engineering from the University of Pune. Before founding IKS he worked at technology firms Majoris Systems (now Valtech), Selectica Configurators India and Lionbridge Technologies. He founded IKS in 2007 and built it into a provider of billing, coding and clinical support to more than 600 US healthcare organisations with over 12,000 staff. He took it public in December 2024 and led the debt-funded purchase of TruBridge in July 2026. He is a member of the Young Presidents' Organization and splits his time between Dallas and Mumbai.

people.name: Joe Benardello
people.role: Co-founder & Group Chief Growth Officer (non-executive director)
people.relation: Co-founder; not classed as a promoter
people.bio: Attended UCLA and California State University. He built and led the go-to-market strategy at eTesting Labs, which Lionbridge Technologies bought in 2002, and then served as a vice president at Lionbridge across several businesses including healthcare. He co-founded IKS and runs its growth and marketing strategy, winning US hospital and doctor-group clients. He has more than 26 years of executive experience and lives in Los Angeles.

people.name: Nithya Balasubramanian
people.role: Whole-time Director & Group Chief Financial Officer
people.since: CFO since 15 May 2024; whole-time director since 1 August 2025
people.relation: Professional
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's in electrical and electronics engineering from BITS Pilani and a PGDM from IIM Bangalore. She has more than 16 years in corporate finance and equity research. She was an engagement manager at McKinsey, a vice president at Cipla, and a vice president and senior research analyst at AllianceBernstein. At IKS she runs global finance, investor relations, administration, ERP and overall business strategy. She joined the board as the only executive director when Sachin Gupta became non-executive in August 2025.

people.name: Chris Fowler
people.role: CEO, TruBridge & Group Chief Strategy Officer
people.relation: Professional
people.bio: Joined TruBridge's former parent CPSI in 2000 and became vice president of business services in 2008. When that unit became TruBridge LLC in 2013 he was named its president, and later served as chief operating officer. He became president and CEO of the listed parent in 2022 and joined its board. He led TruBridge through its sale to IKS in July 2026 and now runs it as part of IKS, while also serving as group strategy chief.

people.name: Peter Limeri
people.relation: Professional
people.bio: Has served as president, COO and CFO at listed and private-equity-backed companies. Before IKS he was CFO and COO of PRGX Global, a US recovery-audit firm. He first worked with IKS as a client, when he was president and CFO of Physiotherapy Associates. At IKS he runs the shared operating services, integration of acquisitions such as TruBridge, and company-wide efficiency programmes.

companies.changes: Sachin Gupta stepped down as whole-time director on 31 Jul 2025 (he stays Global CEO); Nithya Balasubramanian joined the board as whole-time director on 1 Aug 2025. CHRO Manisha Kadagathur resigned with effect from 4 Sep 2026; Amaris McComas (ex-TruBridge) took over on 5 Sep 2026. Saransh Mundra stopped being classed as senior management on 14 May 2026. Chairman Berjis Desai retired at the 21 Sep 2026 AGM; Clarence King II (independent) is the new chairman.

companies.styleNote: A Kanodia family company. Founder Dr. Lalit Kanodia (85) is executive Chairman and his son Rahul Kanodia is Vice Chairman & CEO and runs the business. His other son Sameer Kanodia is a non-executive director (the company's website says he oversees the Nashik and Puducherry centres) and is the largest single shareholder at 21.56%. The family also sits on the boards of the publishing subsidiaries (Lumina Datamatics, TNQTech). Hired executives run finance, sales, legal and the technology practice. Promoters own 66.33%; institutions own less than 1%.

people.name: Dr. Lalit S. Kanodia
people.since: Founded the group in 1975; on the company's board since 3 November 1987
people.relation: Founder; father of Vice Chairman & CEO Rahul Kanodia and director Sameer Kanodia
people.stake: 20.87% (1,23,38,276 shares, FY26 annual report); he is also a trustee of the Vikrant Trust (18.11%); promoter group together 66.33%
people.bio: Holds an engineering degree from IIT Bombay and a master's and doctorate in management from MIT (USA). Before starting Datamatics in 1975 he helped set up and run Tata Consultancy Services from 1967, according to the company. He now acts as 'Chief Mentor', driving innovation, new products and quality. He has been president of the IMC Chamber of Commerce, the Indo American Chamber of Commerce and the Management Consultants Association of India, an executive member of NASSCOM, and Honorary Consul General of Chile in Mumbai (2002–2014). He is 85 and retires by rotation and seeks re-appointment at the 2026 AGM; his FY26 pay ratio was 219 times the median employee.

people.name: Rahul L. Kanodia
people.role: Vice Chairman & Chief Executive Officer (Whole-time Director)
people.since: Board since 28 September 2007; proposed re-appointment for five years from 22 February 2027
people.relation: Son of Chairman Dr. Lalit Kanodia; brother of director Sameer Kanodia
people.stake: 209 shares, about 0.00% (FY26 annual report); promoter group together 66.33%
people.bio: Holds an MBA from Columbia University (major in strategy and marketing, minor in M&A and turnaround management) and bachelor's degrees from H.R. College, Mumbai (finance and accounting) and Babson College, USA (information systems). He has more than 30 years of experience and leads strategy and corporate initiatives, having steered the shift from a services company to automation and AI-led solutions. He has chaired NASSCOM's regional council and the western region of the Electronics and Computer Software Export Promotion Council. He resigned from the board of Safari Industries in May 2026. His FY26 pay was ₹8.13cr including incentive. He is 59.

people.name: Ankush Akar
people.role: Executive Vice President & Chief Financial Officer
people.relation: Professional
people.bio: A chartered accountant and commerce graduate with more than 19 years in finance. He was Senior Vice President, Finance at Relevance Lab and earlier Global Finance Controller and Vice President, Business Finance at Zensar Technologies. He also worked at Wipro, Genpact and Infosys BPO in planning and deal structuring. He replaced Sandeep Mantri, who resigned in August 2024, and reports to the CEO, running finance, travel and administration.

people.name: Divya Kumat
people.role: President, Chief Legal Officer & Company Secretary
people.since: More than 20 years in the role
people.relation: Professional
people.bio: Has more than 25 years of experience and was earlier Legal Head at Computer Sciences Corporation (India). She runs legal and secretarial work for more than 30 group companies worldwide and works on joint ventures, mergers and acquisitions. She also leads the company's ESG and AI-usage policies.

people.name: Bala Gopalakrishnan
people.relation: Professional
people.bio: Holds a computer science degree from NIT Kurukshetra and has more than 25 years in IT. He held senior roles at Cognizant, Thoughtworks, Motorola and Nous Infosystems in the US, Europe and Asia-Pacific. He runs strategy, offerings, delivery and operations for the technology (IT services) business.

people.name: Dinesh Kumar V K
people.relation: Professional
people.bio: Holds a degree in applied sciences and computer technology from PSG College of Technology, Coimbatore. He has more than 20 years in technology sales, with senior roles at Mphasis (most recently Senior Vice President, Sales), Amdocs and Hewlett-Packard. Based in Dallas, he runs global sales across about 300 enterprise clients.

people.name: Praveer Chadha
people.role: Executive Vice President & Head – Digital Experiences and Operations
people.relation: Professional
people.bio: Runs the Digital Experiences (customer-contact) and Digital Operations (BPM) business, which includes building AI-based customer-engagement and automation offerings. The company does not publish his education or earlier employers.

companies.changes: Sandeep Arora (President & Global Head, Digital Experiences) resigned with effect from 31 May 2025. Independent director Himanshu Verma resigned on 23 Mar 2026. No executive changes found since the annual report (May 2026).

companies.styleNote: Demerged from Quess Corp and listed in June 2025. The promoters are Fairfax, through Fairbridge Capital (Mauritius) with 34.13%, and Quess founder Ajit Isaac with 12.01% personally plus 10.73% through Isaac Enterprises LLP; together about 57%. Ajit Isaac is non-executive Chairman, and two Fairfax executives sit on the board as non-executive directors. A hired team runs the company, and it has almost entirely changed since May 2026: new CEO Sameer Ahluwalia from 1 June, a new COO in July, a CFO-designate in August and the growth chief's exit in September. No directors are related to each other.

people.name: Sameer Ahluwalia
people.relation: Professional
people.bio: Has more than 20 years building and turning around businesses in North America, the UK, EMEA and India. He was most recently a Managing Director at Alvarez & Marsal, building a value-creation and turnaround practice for private equity owners. Before that, as a Group President at the RPSG Group/Firstsource, he led the turnaround of a BPM and B2B services business with over 8,000 staff in six countries. He was a founding leader of HCL Technologies' global BFSI BPO and platform business, which grew to about $200m of revenue, and also worked at Capgemini and GE. He is a Six Sigma Black Belt. He is 41, is on a three-year term with ₹2cr fixed pay plus up to ₹2cr variable, and also sits on the board of subsidiary Alldigi Tech. He withdrew revenue guidance on his first results call.

people.name: Ruchi Ahluwalia
people.since: Joined April 2025 as Group Chief People Officer; COO since July 2026
people.relation: Professional (no family link to the CEO is disclosed)
people.bio: Holds a B.S. in life sciences and an MBA from the Institute of Management Studies, and is SPHR-certified (HRCI, USA). She has about 25 years of experience, mostly in HR. She was Chief People Officer at Quess Corp and then at Digitide, and earlier held senior HR roles at Eaton, Scania Commercial Vehicles India and Carl Zeiss India. She was promoted to COO in July 2026, widening her remit to operations and transformation.

people.name: Suraj Prasad
people.role: Chief Financial Officer (until 30 Sep 2026); then Chief Strategy & Corporate Development Officer
people.relation: Professional
people.bio: A chartered accountant, cost and management accountant and company secretary, with a PGDBA in operations. He has more than 25 years in finance across telecom, IT services and oil and gas. He was Group Deputy CFO of Quess Corp for about two years, running controllership, reporting, restructuring and treasury across 40-plus group entities, and earlier CFO of AXA Business Services; he also worked at the Aditya Birla Group. From 1 October 2026 he moves to lead strategy, M&A, investments and investor relations.

people.name: Harigovind Krishnasamy
people.role: Chief Financial Officer (Designate); CFO and KMP from 1 October 2026
people.relation: Professional
people.bio: A chartered accountant who has cleared all three levels of the CFA programme. He has more than 21 years in finance, including over five years abroad. He was CFO of Matrimony.com and of Indiavidual Learning (Embibe, the Reliance Jio group's edtech business), and earlier held senior finance roles at Vedanta, DEN Networks and Jio Platforms.

people.name: Natarajan (Nat) Laxsmanan
people.relation: Professional
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's in instrumentation engineering from the University of Mumbai and payroll certifications. He has more than 25 years of experience, with roles at Accenture, NGA Human Resources, Wipro and Sitel. He runs Alldigi Tech, the payroll and international BPM business that earns much of the group's profit. He was named among Forbes India's top 100 people managers in 2021.

people.name: Sandeep Malhotra
people.relation: Professional
people.bio: Has 29 years of experience at HCL, Birlasoft and Coforge, covering business strategy, digital and cloud transformation and large global deals in banking, insurance, manufacturing, retail and telecom. He leads Digitide's service lines.

people.name: Mohan C K
people.role: Chief Business Officer, Global Head – Tech, Digital & AI
people.relation: Professional
people.bio: Has more than 30 years in IT services and was earlier a global practice head at Wipro. He runs the technology, digital and AI business.

companies.changes: CEO Gurmeet Singh Chahal resigned with effect from 31 May 2026, twelve days after presenting the FY27 plan; Sameer Ahluwalia took over on 1 Jun 2026. Chief Growth & Revenue Officer Saket Bhatnagar resigned (disclosed 22 Sep 2026). CFO Suraj Prasad becomes Chief Strategy & Corporate Development Officer on 1 Oct 2026; Harigovind Krishnasamy takes over as CFO. Company secretary Neeraj Manchanda has been replaced by Shailesha Barve.

companies.styleNote: Founder-led. Co-founder Kishor Patil is CEO & MD and Sachin Tikekar, part of the founding team, is President & Joint MD. The other co-founder and chairman, S.B. (Ravi) Pandit, died in May 2026. His widow, Dr. Nirmala Pandit, joined the board as a non-executive director on 29 July 2026, and their son Chinmay Pandit is a whole-time director who heads the Americas. Independent director Anant Talaulicar is now chairman. Most of the promoter stake sits in Proficient Finstock LLP (32.41%). Promoters owned 39.42% at 31 March 2026; this fell to about 38.6% in the June quarter after the Bhagwat family was reclassified as public.

people.name: Kishor Patil
people.since: Co-founded KPIT in 1990; on the current company's board since 16 January 2019; CEO & MD term 16 Jan 2024 – 15 Jan 2028
people.relation: Co-founder and promoter; not related to any other director or KMP
people.stake: 4.88% (1,33,85,605 shares, FY26 annual report); wife Anupama Patil 0.04%; promoter group 39.42% at 31 Mar 2026, mostly through Proficient Finstock LLP (32.41%)
people.bio: A chartered accountant and cost accountant with more than 42 years of experience. He co-founded KPIT in 1990 and led the 2018 merger-demerger that created today's focused automotive-software company, and he leads strategy, acquisitions and all client-facing and delivery functions. He is Vice Chair of NASSCOM and chairs its engineering R&D council. He won ICAI's CA Business Leader award in 2014 and was among EY's top 16 entrepreneurs in 2013. His FY26 pay was about ₹6.3cr. He is 64.

people.name: Sachin Tikekar
people.since: With KPIT about 33 years (part of the founding team)
people.relation: Core member of the founding team; classed as a promoter; not related to other directors
people.bio: Holds a master's in strategic management and international finance from Temple University, USA, and worked at the Strategic Positioning Group before KPIT. At KPIT he has been Chief Operating Officer in the US, where he built its American presence, and Chief People & Operations Officer. He now owns long-term relationships with clients and alliance partners, leads the push into trucks and off-highway vehicles, and oversees operations in 17 countries. His FY26 pay was about ₹5.8cr. He is 58.

people.name: Anup Sable
people.role: Whole-time Director & Chief Operating Officer; MD, Technica Engineering
people.since: With KPIT since 1994; whole-time director since 22 December 2021 (re-appointment proposed from 22 Dec 2026)
people.relation: Professional
people.bio: A mechanical engineer from the College of Engineering, Pune (COEP). He began as a powertrain research assistant at the Automotive Research Association of India (ARAI). Since joining KPIT in 1994 he started its automotive business unit, built the Cummins relationship and led the electrification, digital cockpit, autonomous driving, AUTOSAR and diagnostics practices. He is co-inventor on four patents, oversees delivery quality on key accounts, and sits on the board of German subsidiary Technica Engineering. He is 57.

people.name: Chinmay Pandit
people.role: Whole-time Director, President – Americas & Chief Risk Officer
people.since: Joined KPIT about 2008; whole-time director since 26 July 2022 (re-appointment proposed from 26 Jul 2027)
people.relation: Son of the late co-founder and chairman Ravi Pandit and of non-executive director Dr. Nirmala Pandit
people.stake: 0.01% (38,620 shares, FY26 annual report); his mother Dr. Nirmala Pandit holds 12,69,306 shares (about 0.46%)
people.bio: A chartered accountant with an MBA from the Kellogg School of Management, Northwestern University. He worked at KPMG and Infosys before joining KPIT, where he has spent about 18 of his 24 working years. He ran the Vehicle Engineering & Design practice, which the company says was its most profitable business line, and until last year the commercial-vehicle vertical. He now runs the Americas business and is Chief Risk Officer, and sits on the boards of subsidiaries Caresoft and Technica's US arm. His FY26 pay was about ₹5.7cr. He is 47.

people.name: Priyamvada (Priya) Hardikar
people.role: Chief Financial Officer & Member of the Executive Board
people.since: Long-serving; more than 12 years in KPIT finance leadership before becoming CFO
people.relation: Professional
people.bio: A commerce graduate (rank holder) from Pune University and a cost accountant with an all-India rank. She spent more than 12 years in leadership roles in KPIT's corporate accounting and finance function before becoming CFO. She runs finance, legal and secretarial work, including audits and bringing acquired companies into KPIT's books. She was named 'Best Woman in Finance' at the 2018 CFO Executive Leadership Summit and attended a leadership programme at Stanford GSB. Her FY26 pay was about ₹5.3cr. She is 54.

companies.changes: Co-founder and chairman S.B. (Ravi) Pandit died in May 2026; independent director Anant Talaulicar became chairman and Dr. Nirmala Pandit joined as a non-executive director on 29 Jul 2026. Independent director B.V.R. Subbu completed his term on 15 Jan 2026. Promoters Ajay and Ashwini Bhagwat were reclassified as public from 29 Apr 2026. No executive changes found since the annual report.

companies.styleNote: A Mehta family company. Founder Harish Mehta is Executive Chairman and his son Jigar Mehta has been Managing Director since May 2016 and runs the business; the annual report confirms the father–son link and no other family ties on the board. Most of the promoter stake sits in JHM Enterprises (34.98%). Promoters held 39.61% at 31 March 2026 and about 40% after the May 2026 buyback, down from about 45% in 2023; promoter entities bought small lots in August and September 2026. Harsha Raghavan (Convergent Finance, formerly Fairbridge Capital) is a non-executive director. Apart from the CFO, no senior managers are named.

people.name: Harish Mehta
people.relation: Founder; father of MD Jigar Mehta
people.stake: 0.98% (2,20,000 shares, 31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); promoter group together 39.61%, mostly via JHM Enterprises (34.98%)
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's in electrical engineering from the College of Engineering, Pune, and a master's in computer science from Brooklyn Polytechnic Institute, New York. He founded Onward and led it as Chairman & MD for many years. He was a co-founder of NASSCOM and is credited with bringing The Indus Entrepreneurs (TiE) to India. He wrote the 2022 national bestseller 'The Maverick Effect' and has received several lifetime achievement awards. He is being re-appointed as whole-time director and Executive Chairman at the 2026 AGM; his FY26 pay was ₹3.83cr.

people.name: Jigar Mehta
people.relation: Son of Executive Chairman Harish Mehta
people.stake: 1.78% (4,00,000 shares, 31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); promoter group together 39.61%
people.bio: Studied at St. Xavier's College, Mumbai, and Boston University, and completed the Owner/President Management programme at Harvard Business School. A second-generation entrepreneur, he became MD in May 2016 and has grown the company from about 300 staff to more than 2,500, with operations in India, the US, the UK, Germany and Canada. He has refocused Onward on engineering and digital engineering for industrial and auto clients. He is a member of YPO's Bombay chapter. He is being re-appointed as MD at the 2026 AGM; his FY26 pay was ₹4.60cr.

people.name: Pawankumar Nathani
people.relation: Professional
people.bio: The company's CFO and one of only two named senior managers besides the executive directors. He co-signs the CEO/CFO certification of the accounts with the MD, and his pay rose 16% in FY26. The company does not publish his education or earlier employers.

companies.changes: Company secretary Vinav Agarwal resigned on 9 Jul 2025; Aakash Joshi took over on 16 Jul 2025. No executive changes found since the annual report.

companies.styleNote: A Tata group company. The promoter is Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles (formerly Tata Motors) with 53.35%; with other Tata entities the promoter group holds about 55%. Hired professionals run it, led by CEO & MD Warren Harris, who has been with the company since 2005. The chairman, Ajoyendra Mukherjee, is independent. Tata Motors PV's MD & CEO Shailesh Chandra and Dhiman Gupta sit on the board as non-executive directors. There is no family involvement. JLR and Tata Motors are also its largest clients.

people.name: Warren Harris
people.relation: Professional
people.stake: 0.72% (29,26,067 shares at 31 Mar 2026, of which 28,00,000 held through Zedra Corporate Services (Guernsey); FY26 annual report)
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in engineering from the University of Wales Institute of Science and Technology and completed the Advanced Management Programme at Harvard Business School; Amity University gave him an honorary doctorate. He is a chartered mechanical engineer and member of the Institution of Mechanical Engineers. He served on the Board of Overseers of the US Malcolm Baldrige National Quality Award (2013–2016). He joined Tata Technologies in 2005 and led it through its November 2023 IPO. He sits on the boards of its main overseas subsidiaries and the BMW TechWorks India joint venture, and received ₹7.1cr in FY26 as a director of the US subsidiary.

people.name: Uttam Gujrati
people.relation: Professional
people.bio: A finance leader with more than 20 years in strategic finance, M&A, pricing and transformation in engineering and technology services. He was already at Tata Technologies leading global business finance and strategy, where he worked on IPO readiness, pricing governance and margin programmes. He previously held CXO-level roles including CFO elsewhere. He replaced Savitha Balachandran, who left at the end of December 2025 and later became CFO of PepsiCo India. The company does not publish his degrees.

people.name: S Sukanya (Sukanya Sadasivan)
people.relation: Professional
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's in computer science and informatics from Bharathiar University. She spent more than 33 years at Tata Consultancy Services, most recently as Senior Vice President and Chief Information Officer. At Tata Technologies she runs business excellence, IT and cyber security, and the build-out of AI across sales, delivery and internal systems.

people.name: Nachiket Paranjpe
people.relation: Professional
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's in mechanical engineering from the University of Pune and an MBA from Purdue University, and completed Harvard Business School's Advanced Management Program. He has more than 30 years of experience in Europe, Asia and the US, including 14 years building and scaling a business across Europe and Asia-Pacific. He runs the non-Tata client business (automotive, aerospace, industrial heavy machinery and products), embedded-systems delivery and consulting, and company-wide pre-sales.

people.name: Anish Raghunandan
people.role: President, Operations & Client Partner – Tata Motors Group
people.relation: Professional
people.bio: A graduate of NIT Calicut and of the Tata Administrative Services programme (2007 batch). He has more than 25 years across Tata Industries, Tata Sons and TCS, with roles in Singapore, the UK and the US. Before joining he was CEO and a non-executive director of Tata ClassEdge, an edtech business he turned self-sustaining. He manages the relationship with Tata Motors and JLR, the company's largest clients, and also oversees operations.

people.name: Geena Binoy
people.relation: Professional
people.bio: Holds a master's in economics from the Gokhale Institute of Politics and Economics and a master's diploma in business administration from Symbiosis Institute of Management Studies. She was at Tata Motors before joining. She earlier led global delivery for the Digital Enterprise Solutions business, and now runs HR, facilities and administration and the iGETit online-learning business.

companies.changes: CFO Savitha Balachandran resigned with effect from 30 Dec 2025; Uttam Gujrati became CFO on 31 Dec 2025. Company secretary Vikrant Gandhe resigned on 16 Jan 2026; Raghav Mulay was appointed on 14 Apr 2026. Three senior executives were given expanded roles in April 2026. Former CEO Patrick McGoldrick sold shares worth about ₹165cr in September 2026 (he is not in management).
sources: https://cfo.economictimes.indiatimes.com/ (Tata Technologies appoints Uttam Gujrati as new CFO; Savitha Balachandran resigns, 29 Nov 2025)
https://www.business-standard.com/ (PepsiCo India brings in Tata Tech's Savitha Balachandran as new CFO, 23 Jan 2026)

companies.styleNote: Founded in 1991 by B.V.R. Mohan Reddy, who is now a non-executive director ('Founder Chairman'). His son Krishna Bodanapu is Executive Vice Chairman & MD and sets strategy, while a hired CEO, Sukamal Banerjee (since February 2025), runs day-to-day operations with a largely new team. The board chairman, M.M. Murugappan, is non-executive and not a promoter. The annual report says the father–son link is the only family tie on the board. Promoters held 23.28% at 31 March 2026 and about 24.7% after the 2026 buyback, in which they did not tender; this is a minority stake rather than control.

people.name: Krishna Bodanapu
people.since: On the board about 12 years; Executive Vice Chairman & MD since April 2023
people.relation: Son of founder B.V.R. Mohan Reddy (non-executive director)
people.stake: about 1.7% (19,13,260 shares, FY26 annual report); his father holds 4,02,620 shares (about 0.4%); promoter group together 23.28% at 31 Mar 2026
people.bio: An alumnus of the Kellogg School of Management, Northwestern University. He led Cyient as MD & CEO before the April 2023 reorganisation, when he became Executive Vice Chairman & MD and handed day-to-day operations to a hired CEO. He is responsible for strategic direction and long-term value creation, and is a member of industry bodies including CII and the India-US CEO Forum. The company publishes no fuller career history for him.

people.name: Sukamal Banerjee
people.relation: Professional
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering and an MBA in finance. He has more than 30 years in engineering R&D and technology services. At one of the world's leading technology companies he rose to run a multi-billion-dollar digital and engineering services business across more than 35 countries and 25,000 staff, and built a global IoT unit from scratch. Immediately before Cyient he was CEO and a board member of a digital engineering company. Since joining he has reshaped the senior team, with a new CFO, COO and growth heads in 2026.

people.name: Andrew Smith
people.since: With Cyient about nine years; COO since July 2026
people.relation: Professional
people.bio: Holds a PhD from the University of Cambridge and a first-class engineering degree from UMIST (Manchester). He spent more than a decade in senior engineering roles at Airbus, Rolls-Royce and Bombardier Transportation before joining Cyient. At Cyient he led the Transportation and Semiconductor business units, and was made COO in July 2026 when Prabhakar Atla stepped down. He runs global delivery and the Transportation (aerospace and rail) business.

people.name: Shrinivas Kulkarni
people.since: 1 April 2026 (more than 11 years in the Cyient group)
people.relation: Professional
people.bio: A Fellow of the Institute of Cost Accountants of India with a diploma in business finance; he attended leadership programmes at Wharton and ISB. He has close to 30 years in finance, earlier at EMC², Sasken and Intel. In the Cyient group he was most recently CFO of Cyient DLM, where he led its carve-out and heavily subscribed IPO. He now runs group finance, investor relations and business finance.

people.name: Rajkumar Ravindranathan
people.relation: Professional
people.bio: Holds a B.Tech in applied electronics and instrumentation from the University of Kerala and an MBA from Columbia Business School. He has about 25 years building AI, digital, engineering and IT services businesses in EMEA, Asia-Pacific and Latin America, with senior roles at L&T Technology Services (including the board of L&T Thales Technology Services) and Cognizant. Based in Reading, UK, he leads growth in energy, automotive, healthcare and mining, plus India, Japan and the Middle East.

people.name: Dr. PNSV Narasimham
people.relation: Professional
people.bio: Holds an MBA in human resources and a PhD from the University of Bristol. He has more than 30 years in manufacturing, services and technology companies. At Cyient he oversees senior leadership engagement, governance across global entities, government relations, ESG and CSR, and new infrastructure for the group.

companies.changes: CFO Prabhakar Atla was moved to COO and Shrinivas Kulkarni became CFO on 1 Apr 2026; Atla then stepped down in July 2026 and Andrew Smith became COO. Rajkumar Ravindranathan (Chief Growth Officer) and Harjott Atrii (Chief Business Officer) joined in February 2026. Independent directors Vivek Gour (Oct 2025) and Matangi Gowrishankar (Jan 2026) resigned; Murali Yadama was appointed independent director in July 2026.

companies.styleNote: Controlled by the Meghe family of Nagpur and their companies (Raghav Infradevelopers 15.35%, SMG Hospitals 6.51%), who together hold 50.88%. Promoter Sagar Meghe, a director since 1998, moved from non-executive chairman to whole-time director and chairman in December 2025 after the hired CEO, Prashant Kamat, stepped down. Two hired managing directors run operations: Kaushik Khona (India operations) and Dr. Abhay Kimmatkar. The annual report says no board members are related. Rare CP Fund (Rare Enterprises) owns 9.92%. Senior turnover has been high: CFO, CEO, CEO-designate, chief marketing officer and an independent director all left between September 2025 and April 2026.

people.name: Sagar Meghe
people.since: Director since 9 September 1998; whole-time director and chairman since 16 December 2025 (three-year term)
people.relation: Promoter (Meghe family); no relationship with other directors is disclosed
people.stake: 16.03% (33,56,924 shares, 31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); Devika Sagar Meghe holds another 8.44%; promoter group together 50.88%
people.bio: Comes from a Nagpur family with a long record in education, healthcare and institution-building, and is known for philanthropy in education and public service. He has been on the board since 1998 and was non-executive chairman until December 2025, when he became an executive whole-time director to steer strategy after the CEO's exit. The company does not publish his degrees or earlier employers. His FY26 pay ratio was 114 times the median employee.

people.name: Kaushik Khona
people.role: Managing Director, India Operations; chairs the Management Committee
people.relation: Professional; not related to any director or KMP
people.bio: A chartered accountant, company secretary and cost accountant who also holds an LLB, an M.Com and diplomas in business finance and taxation. He has more than 37 years of experience in aviation, travel, forex, facility management, machinery, shipping, tyres, agro-processing and wind energy, often in turnaround roles. He was CEO of the airline GoAir and held senior roles in several Wadia Group companies. At Ceinsys he runs India operations with a focus on efficiency and governance; he is paid ₹3.47cr a year and seeks re-appointment by rotation at the 2026 AGM. He is 58.

people.name: Dr. Abhay Kimmatkar
people.since: Director since 17 December 2007; re-appointed MD from 1 April 2026 to 31 March 2029
people.relation: Professional
people.bio: Holds a PhD in business and management and has more than 20 years in geospatial and infrastructure technology. He has been central to Ceinsys's growth in government geospatial, water and infrastructure projects, building partnerships and pushing technologies such as GeoBIM, IoT and 3D city mapping. The company does not publish his earlier employers.

people.name: Rahul Joharapurkar
people.relation: Professional
people.bio: Previously a Joint Managing Director of the company, he is now Chief Operating Officer and a member of the Management Committee that runs day-to-day operations. His pay rose 10% in FY26. The company does not publish his education or earlier employers.

people.name: CA Amita Saxena
people.relation: Professional
people.bio: A chartered accountant who replaced Samir Sabharwal, who resigned in September 2025. She co-signs the CEO/CFO certification with the MD for India operations. A deputy CFO, Richa Jain, was added in July 2026. The company does not publish her earlier employers.

companies.changes: CFO Samir Sabharwal resigned with effect from 15 Sep 2025; Amita Saxena became CFO on 1 Oct 2025. CEO-designate Surej Kunhithaviyil Poyil resigned in Nov–Dec 2025. Vice Chairman & CEO Prashant Kamat stepped down on 31 Dec 2025 and stayed as a non-executive director (he holds 6,81,344 shares). Chief Marketing Officer Vishal Pawar left on 19 Dec 2025. Independent director Phaneesh Murthy resigned on 28 Apr 2026. Richa Jain was appointed Deputy CFO in July 2026.

companies.styleNote: Founder Uday Reddy is Chairman and CEO and runs the company. His wife Tanuja Reddy is a promoter shareholder but holds no board or executive role. The other executive director (Deepak Goyal), the CFO and the unit heads are hired professionals, several of whom came in with the Karix and ValueFirst acquisitions. The FY26 report says no directors are related to each other. Promoters own 46.17% (June 2026).

people.name: Uday Reddy (D. Uday Kumar Reddy)
people.relation: Founder and promoter; husband of promoter shareholder Tanuja Reddy
people.stake: 23.45% (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report; he bought 18.6 lakh shares during FY26); wife Tanuja Reddy 15.90%; promoter group together 46.17% (June 2026)
people.bio: A commerce graduate with an MBA from Manchester Business School (1996). He did part of a chartered accountancy articleship and then traded property in Hyderabad in the mid-1990s before founding Tanla in June 1999; the name joins his wife Tanuja's name with a relative's. He built Tanla into India's largest business-messaging (CPaaS) platform, buying Karix Mobile in 2017, Gamooga in 2019 and ValueFirst in 2023, and launched the Trubloq and Wisely anti-spam and anti-phishing platforms. Forbes listed him as a billionaire in 2022. He is vice-chair of the Campaign Leadership Board at London Business School and chairs Tanla's risk committee. He took no salary from Tanla in FY26 (annual report).

people.name: Deepak Goyal
people.role: Executive (Whole-time) Director; MD & CEO of subsidiary Karix Mobile
people.since: Karix since 2006; Tanla board since July 2020
people.bio: A computer science engineer from Amravati University with an MBA in marketing from FORE School of Management (1997). He held general management roles at Tulip Telecom, FreeMarkets and Wyse Technology. He joined Karix Mobile (then Air2Web) in 2006 as VP Sales and became its COO in 2013; Tanla bought Karix in 2017. He joined Tanla's board as an executive director in July 2020, and from 1 May 2026 became Managing Director and CEO of Karix, the wholly owned enterprise-messaging arm. He is 54.

people.name: Anubhav Batra
people.bio: A chartered accountant who began his career at KPMG India and then EY. He joined ValueFirst in 2011 as AVP, Corporate Finance, became its CFO in 2019 and later also its Chief Business Officer. After Tanla bought ValueFirst in 2023 he became head of international expansion. He was made Tanla's CFO from 28 July 2025, succeeding Abhishek Kumar Jain. He brings experience in M&A structuring and deal execution.

people.name: Vishwadeep Bajaj
people.since: 2003 (founded ValueFirst); with Tanla since the 2023 acquisition
people.bio: He founded ValueFirst, a business-messaging company, in 2003 and still runs it as a Tanla subsidiary after Tanla bought it in 2023. Before that he worked at Siemens, Telcon Europe, 0800Freedom and Bionics. He has a general management qualification from MIT Sloan School of Management. He has more than three decades of work experience.

people.name: Anshuman Kar
people.bio: He joined Tanla as Chief Customer Officer on 7 July 2025 and leads customer success. He was earlier Senior Vice President at Udemy, running operations for Udemy Business, and held a strategy and planning leadership role at Twilio, a global CPaaS company. He has also worked at McKinsey, EY and Capgemini, and started his career at Satyam Computers in 1998.

people.name: Seshanuradha Chava
people.role: General Counsel, Company Secretary & Compliance Officer
people.bio: She holds an M.Com and an LLB from Osmania University and is a qualified company secretary. She worked at Bellary Steels & Alloys as assistant company secretary and at Karvy Consultants before joining Tanla, where she has spent nearly two decades. She handled the legal work on Tanla's public issue and the Karix and Gamooga acquisitions. She is a key managerial person under company law.

companies.changes: CFO Abhishek Kumar Jain left on 27 July 2025 and Anubhav Batra took over. Chief Growth Officer (Asia & Middle East) MP Sunil Kumar resigned on 6 April 2026 and Chief AI, Data & Analytics Officer Sandeep Kapoor on 30 April 2026. Deepak Goyal became MD & CEO of Karix from 1 May 2026.

companies.styleNote: Founder Anuj Khanna Sohum is Chairperson, MD and CEO and the only executive director. He controls the company through the Singapore promoter companies Affle Holdings (40.65%) and AGPL (14.27%), about 54.9% together (March 2026); Affle Holdings is also buying warrants worth about ₹1,100cr. No family members are in management; the rest of the team are long-serving hired executives. Co-founder Anuj Kumar left the board in April 2026.

people.name: Anuj Khanna Sohum
people.role: Chairperson, Managing Director & Chief Executive Officer
people.relation: Founder and promoter
people.stake: 160 shares directly (about 0.00%); controls promoters Affle Holdings 40.65% and AGPL 14.27% (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report)
people.bio: He studied computer engineering at the National University of Singapore and attended executive programmes at Harvard Business School (OPM) and Stanford GSB (SEP). He founded Affle in Singapore in 2005 and has run it for over two decades, listing the Indian company in 2019. He built it into a global mobile-advertising platform paid per converted user, adding platforms such as RevX, mediasmart and YouAppi. He describes himself as a serial entrepreneur with more than 25 years in technology and data platforms.

people.name: Kapil Mohan Bhutani
people.bio: A Delhi University graduate and chartered accountant with more than 25 years in audit and industry. He was an audit partner at S. Mohan & Co, a chartered accountancy firm, and then VP Finance at KMG Infotech, a New York-based software company. At Affle he leads group finance and also runs legal, IT, admin and HR. He is a key managerial person and co-signs the accounts with the CEO.

people.name: Vipul Kedia
people.role: Chief Operating Officer – India & Emerging Markets
people.since: Founding team; about two decades at Affle
people.bio: He holds a B.Tech in computer science from IIIT Hyderabad and a PGDM from IIM Ahmedabad, and has over 21 years in consulting and adtech. He was part of Affle's founding team and has run several units, most recently as Chief Data & Platforms Officer. After co-founder Anuj Kumar left in April 2026 he took charge of growth in India and other emerging markets. He is named senior management in the FY26 annual report.

people.name: Sameer Sondhi
people.role: CEO, North America & Chief Strategic Investments Officer
people.bio: He joined Affle in January 2026 to lead North American expansion and new strategic investments. He has more than 25 years in the mobile industry across content, media and messaging. He was earlier CEO and Chief Revenue Officer at Verve, a global adtech company, and before that held leadership roles at InMobi covering North America, Europe and Asia.

people.name: Charles Yong Jien Foong
people.role: Chief Architect & Technology Officer; Non-Executive Director
people.bio: He joined Affle in 2006 and leads research and technology for its platforms as chief architect, with the engineering team that builds its big-data and AI systems. He is a telecom industry veteran with over 20 years of consulting and programming design experience. He studied at Monash University in Australia. He also sits on the board as a non-executive director.

people.name: Parmita Choudhury
people.bio: She is the company secretary and compliance officer and one of the three key managerial persons named in the FY26 annual report. The company gives no further profile.

companies.changes: Co-founder Anuj Kumar, who ran developed markets from Europe, left all roles from 16 April 2026; he remains the largest individual shareholder. Gulrez Alam was appointed Chief Revenue Officer for India and emerging markets. Viraj Sinh moved to a Dubai subsidiary (July 2025) and Vishal Soni left in February 2026.

companies.styleNote: Belgian telecom group Proximus controls the company through Proximus Global, which owns 74.85% and is the only promoter. The chairman is Proximus Global CEO Seckin Arikan (non-executive). Founder Rajdipkumar Gupta stays on as Managing Director, but a hired CEO, Tushar Agnihotri, has run the business since February 2026, and a Proximus finance executive is Group CFO. The founding Gupta brothers sold control to Proximus in 2024 and kept a minority stake in the parent; Rajdip's brother Sandipkumar Gupta sits on the Proximus Global board. The annual report says no directors are related to each other.

people.name: Rajdipkumar Gupta
people.since: 2004 (founder); MD & CEO until Feb 2026, MD since
people.relation: Founder; brother of co-founder Sandipkumar Gupta (a director of parent Proximus Global)
people.bio: Holds a B.Sc. in physics from the University of Mumbai and a master's diploma in software engineering from Aptech Computer Education. He founded Route Mobile in 2004 and has been on its board since May 2004, with over 27 years in software and technology. He built it into a global business-messaging (CPaaS) company with offices across the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, Africa and Asia, and sold control to Proximus in 2024. He was re-designated MD and CEO in July 2025 when the CEO left, and handed the CEO role to Tushar Agnihotri in February 2026. He also advises Proximus Global's CEO and holds directorships in several private family and hotel companies. He is 50.

people.name: Tushar Agnihotri
people.since: CEO since 9 Feb 2026; earlier EVP India & APAC
people.bio: He has over 25 years of experience, more than 16 of them in telecom. Before Route Mobile he held senior roles at Tata Teleservices (Maharashtra), Reliance Jio Infocomm, Reliance Infocomm, Kodak India, Arvind Mills and Blowplast. He holds a master's in business management from Bundelkhand University. At Route Mobile he was Executive Vice President for India and Asia-Pacific before being promoted to CEO in February 2026, leading global strategy, operations and growth.

people.name: Rajeshwar Singh (Raj) Gill
people.bio: A finance executive with international telecom and technology experience. Before Route Mobile he held senior finance roles at Proximus Opal (the parent) and Virgin Media O2 in the UK, including post-merger integration work. He holds an honours degree in economics from Brunel University London and is a CIMA-qualified management accountant. He is a key managerial person and leads financial strategy and capital allocation.

people.name: Suresh Jankar
people.bio: A chartered accountant and commerce graduate from the University of Pune with over 25 years in financial management and corporate finance. Before Route Mobile he was with Capricorn Lifestyle Private Limited. He runs the company's finance function, including planning, reporting and compliance, and is a key managerial person alongside the Group CFO.

people.name: Sammy Mamdani
people.role: Chief Operating Officer (Executive VP, Group Head – Global Operations)
people.bio: He has over 18 years in operations, strategy and cross-border management. He worked in Protiviti's business risk division in the United States and at a Mumbai private investment firm running businesses in India and the UAE. He was COO of Cellent Technologies (India) until Route Mobile bought it in 2016. He holds an MBA from the University of Central Florida.

people.name: Vinay Binyala
people.role: Chief Strategy Officer & Investor Relations Officer
people.bio: He has over two decades in technology, investment banking and corporate strategy. He holds a bachelor's in computer science engineering, an MBA from the Indian School of Business, and is a CFA charterholder. He leads strategy, M&A and business transformation work and handles investor relations.

people.name: Tejas Shah
people.bio: An associate member of the Institute of Company Secretaries of India with an LLB from the University of Mumbai. He has over 14 years in corporate governance and secretarial work at listed and unlisted companies. He became company secretary and a key managerial person on 17 July 2025, replacing Rathindra Das.

companies.changes: CEO Gautam Badalia left in July 2025; Rajdip Gupta was MD & CEO until Tushar Agnihotri became CEO on 9 Feb 2026. Chairman Mark Reid (Proximus CFO) left in January 2026 and Seckin Arikan became chairman. Co-founder Sandipkumar Gupta left his finance role at Route Mobile (UK) on 31 Mar 2026. Chief Marketing Officer Milind Pathak left in April 2026 and Masivian CEO Erwin Viertel on 30 June 2026.

companies.styleNote: The Ruia family's Essar group controls the company: Essar Telecom owns 69.99% (March 2026), with Essar Global Funds the ultimate parent. Anshuman Ruia, son of Essar co-founder Shashi Ruia, sits on the board as an executive director but draws no pay and holds no shares personally. Day-to-day, the business is run by hired professionals: Whole-time Director Sanjeev Verma, who is President & CEO of the US operating company, and Executive Director & Global CFO Deepak Kumar Bansal. The chairman, Dilip Thakkar, is independent. The annual report says no directors are related to each other.

people.name: Sanjeev Verma
people.role: Whole-time Director; President & CEO of Black Box Corporation (US)
people.since: More than 12 years with the group (as of 2022); CEO since the 2019 Black Box Corporation acquisition
people.bio: He has about three decades in the information and communications technology business, covering operations, sales and marketing, consulting, M&A and start-ups. Before joining the group he held management roles at Wipro, 3D Networks (bought by Wipro in 2006) and Global Tele Systems in the US and abroad. Inside the company he was EVP of global sales and operations, then President & Executive Director, and CEO of the Americas and President of International Operations. After Black Box Ltd (then AGC Networks) bought the US company Black Box Corporation in 2019 he became its President & CEO. He is based in Dallas, Texas.

people.name: Deepak Kumar Bansal
people.role: Executive Director & Global Chief Financial Officer
people.bio: A B.Com (honours) graduate who is both a chartered accountant and a cost and management accountant, with more than 25 years in finance. The company has named Reliance Industries, Coca-Cola India, Vedanta, Sujana Group, Aegis and Essar among his earlier employers. He joined Black Box in 2019 when AGC Networks bought it and leads global finance, fund-raising, business control and governance. He is also a director and CFO of the US subsidiary Black Box Corporation. In FY26 his pay was ₹4.27cr, all from exercising 1,03,950 stock options.

people.name: Anshuman Ruia
people.relation: Promoter family; son of Essar co-founder Shashi Ruia and nephew of Ravi Ruia
people.stake: nil (FY26 AGM notice); promoter Essar Telecom holds 69.99%
people.bio: A commerce graduate and second-generation member of the Ruia family that founded Essar in 1969. He leads the Essar group's technology investments, including Black Box, and its green-mobility businesses (Blue Energy Motors, GreenLine, Ultra Gas & Energy). The company credits him with scaling Essar's former BPO business Aegis, which the group sold for a cumulative $1.1bn on a $25m investment, and with a key role in building the Vadinar refinery later sold to Rosneft and partners. He draws no remuneration from Black Box. He is an independent director of Finolex Industries and a member of the Young Presidents' Organization. He is 55.

people.name: Rick Gannon
people.role: Chief Operating Officer (leads the Global Solutions Integration business)
people.bio: He joined Black Box in 1998 and has spent more than two decades there in national and regional roles across sales, operations, services and marketing. He was earlier Senior Vice President of Commercial Services and before that Vice President of Operations for Commercial Services. He runs the Global Solutions Integration business, the company's largest segment, with about 2,200 sales, deployment, service and supply-chain staff. He was named senior management in February 2026.

people.name: Aditya Goswami
people.bio: He is the company secretary and compliance officer and one of the four key managerial persons named in the FY26 annual report. The company gives no further profile.

companies.changes: Paul Williams was named head of the TPS business and senior management on 26 May 2026. Jai Venkat, Head of Sales for GSI Americas, left on 30 June 2026; a replacement is being sought.

companies.styleNote: A Lodha family company. Founder Sanjay Lodha is Chairman & MD, and three other Lodhas are whole-time directors, each running sales in one region. The annual report names two pairs of brothers: Sanjay and Vivek, and Navin and Niraj. A relative, Raghav Lodha, joined as Technology Evangelist in February 2026. Operations, R&D and finance are run by long-serving hired executives. Promoters own about 67.0% (March 2026), down from about 71.0% a year earlier after the four directors each sold part of their stakes.

people.name: Sanjay Lodha
people.relation: Founder and promoter; brother of Whole-time Director Vivek Lodha
people.stake: 26.58% (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); promoter group together about 67.0%
people.bio: Holds a BA (Honours) in economics from the University of Delhi and a postgraduate diploma in business management from the Apeejay School of Marketing, New Delhi. He founded Netweb Technologies as a proprietorship in 1996 and ran it until the listed company took it over in August 2016; he has been a director of the company since September 1999. Since 2016 he has led strategy and business development, building it into India's main maker of supercomputers, AI servers and private-cloud systems. He is Vice President of the IT hardware makers' body MAIT, served on its governing council from 2016 to 2022, and sat on Intel's Board of Advisors in 2020 and 2022.

people.name: Navin Lodha
people.role: Whole-time Director (heads sales and marketing, West Zone)
people.relation: Promoter; brother of Whole-time Director Niraj Lodha
people.bio: A commerce graduate from Shaheed Bhagat Singh College, University of Delhi, with over 25 years in sales and marketing. He worked in Sanjay Lodha's Netweb proprietorship from 2008 until the company took it over in 2016, and has been a director since September 1999. He leads sales and marketing for the West Zone. He was re-appointed as a whole-time director for five years from 14 August 2026. He is 52.

people.name: Vivek Lodha
people.role: Whole-time Director (heads sales and marketing, East Zone)
people.relation: Promoter; brother of Chairman & MD Sanjay Lodha
people.bio: A commerce graduate from Shaheed Bhagat Singh College, University of Delhi, with over 25 years of experience. He worked in the Netweb proprietorship from 2008 until the company took it over in 2016, and has been a director since April 2015. He leads sales and marketing for the East Zone.

people.name: Niraj Lodha
people.role: Whole-time Director (heads sales and marketing, South Zone)
people.relation: Promoter; brother of Whole-time Director Navin Lodha
people.bio: A commerce graduate from Deshbandhu College with over 25 years in sales and marketing. He worked in the Netweb proprietorship from 2008 until the company took it over in 2016, and has been a director since April 2015. He leads sales and marketing for the South Zone.

people.name: Hemant Agrawal
people.bio: A commerce graduate from the University of Calcutta with 32 years in the technology industry. He has been with the company for over 22 years, since 2003, and runs operations as COO. He is named senior management in the FY26 annual report.

people.name: Ankit Kumar Singhal
people.bio: A chartered accountant with more than 15 years in financial planning and analysis, business finance, controllership, tax and project planning. Before Netweb he worked in manufacturing, industrial and technology companies, including a fast-growing SaaS start-up; the company does not name them. He became CFO on 15 November 2024, succeeding Prawal Jain.

people.name: Mukesh Golla
people.bio: Holds a B.Tech in computer science and engineering from Jawaharlal Nehru Technological University, Hyderabad, and has over 21 years of experience. He joined the company in 2004 and runs product engineering and R&D, which designs the company's own motherboards, systems and firmware. He is named senior management in the FY26 annual report.

companies.changes: Mukul Kedia joined as Chief Strategy Officer and Swastik Chakraborty was made Vice President – Technology from 2 May 2026. No senior management left during FY26. Company Secretary Lohit Chhabra (since January 2023) is not listed above because of the seven-person limit.

companies.styleNote: Run by its three founders, all executive directors and part of the promoter group: Ishank Joshi (MD & CEO), Kunal Kothari (Chairman & COO) and Tejas Rathod (CTO). The business was founded in 2017 by Kothari and Rathod and moved into the listed shell (formerly Lucent Industries) when the listed company bought it from its promoters. The three named promoter shareholders are Kothari, Rathod and Prachi Arora, with 21.87% each; the promoter group owns 65.60% (March 2026). The annual report gives no family relationship between the directors. A hired Group CFO joined in April 2026.

people.name: Ishank Joshi
people.since: Joined Mobavenue 2020; MD & CEO of the listed company since April 2025
people.relation: Co-founder; part of the promoter group
people.stake: nil held directly (FY26 annual report director shareholding table)
people.bio: Holds a B.Tech in electronics and communication and has over 16 years in B2B and technology-platform sales. He started his first venture soon after college in 2010, and co-founded Goals101, a fintech company later bought by M2P Fintech. He joined Mobavenue as co-founder, MD and CEO in 2020 and has led its expansion into Southeast Asia, Latin America, the UK and the US. He joined the board of MMA India in 2026, was named in Businessworld's 30 Under 30, and is an angel investor in more than 40 start-ups.

people.name: Kunal Kothari
people.role: Chairman, Whole-time Director & Chief Operating Officer
people.relation: Co-founder and promoter
people.stake: 21.87% (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); promoter group together 65.60%
people.bio: Holds a degree in information technology and has over 15 years of experience; he started his first commerce and software businesses at 17. He co-founded Mobavenue with Tejas Rathod in 2017 and built it as a profitable, bootstrapped company. He runs media operations and product-led growth and led the company's AI centre of excellence. He was named in Forbes 30 Under 30 Asia (2023) and Businessworld 30 Under 30. The listed company still owed him about ₹15.2cr in March 2026 for the business it bought from the promoters.

people.name: Tejas Rathod
people.relation: Co-founder and promoter
people.bio: Holds a degree in computer engineering and has over 15 years in technology, digital advertising and finance. He co-founded Mobavenue with Kunal Kothari in 2017. He was whole-time director and CFO of the listed company from April 2025 until 31 March 2026, and became CTO from 1 April 2026 when a professional CFO was hired. He is a member of the AI Council at MMA India. The listed company owed him about ₹15.2cr in March 2026 for the business it bought from the promoters.

people.name: Vijay Basantani
people.bio: A chartered accountant with over 23 years of post-qualification experience since 2002. He has worked at Infosys, Mahindra & Mahindra, Omnicom Media Group and Dentsu, in business planning, operational finance, legal and compliance, and controllership. He became Group CFO and a key managerial person on 1 April 2026, taking over the CFO role from co-founder Tejas Rathod.

people.name: Raghav Maheshwari
people.bio: A graduate of the College of Business Studies (Delhi University) and the Indian School of Business, Hyderabad, with over 15 years in adtech, mobile and SaaS. He previously drove growth at InMobi and Affle across India, Asia, Europe and the US. At Mobavenue he leads business and revenue growth in global markets.

people.name: Sumit Bhansali
people.role: Chief Strategy Officer & Chief Human Resources Officer
people.bio: He has over 18 years across strategy, digital transformation, technology products, e-commerce, HR and marketing. He began as a software developer in 2008 and later led digital and e-commerce work for retail brands. He runs strategy, brand marketing, financial planning, investments and HR, and was named among Businessworld's 40 Under 40 marketers.

people.name: Manali Gohil
people.bio: She has been company secretary and compliance officer, a key managerial person, since 7 February 2025. The company gives no further profile.

companies.changes: Tejas Rathod stepped down as CFO on 31 March 2026 and became CTO; Vijay Basantani joined as Group CFO on 1 April 2026. No later management changes found in the company's announcements.

companies.styleNote: Founder Tarun Dua is Managing Director. His wife, co-founder Srishti Baweja, is Whole-time Director and COO, and her sister Megha Raheja is also a Whole-time Director (she was CFO until April 2025). The CFO, CTO and business heads are hired professionals, and the chairman is independent. Promoters own 39.45% (March 2026), almost all of it Tarun Dua's; L&T, which invested in 2024, holds 18.45% and has two non-executive directors on the board.

people.name: Tarun Dua
people.relation: Founder and promoter; husband of Whole-time Director Srishti Baweja
people.stake: 36.31% (74,64,779 shares, 31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); promoter group together 39.45%
people.bio: A computer science graduate from the National Institute of Technology, Kurukshetra. He began as a lecturer at JMIT Radaur and then held positions at Yahoo, Nanocast R&D, GlobalLogic and ValueFirst, working on system architecture, software engineering and data-centre operations. He founded E2E Networks in 2009 as a low-cost Indian cloud provider and has turned it into a GPU cloud and 'AI factory' for Indian enterprises, start-ups and research bodies. He has over two decades in IT, cloud computing and data-centre management. His FY26 salary was ₹1.25cr.

people.name: Srishti Baweja
people.relation: Co-founder; wife of MD Tarun Dua; sister of Whole-time Director Megha Raheja
people.bio: A chartered accountant (ICAI, 2004) and a graduate of Shri Ram College of Commerce, Delhi University, with over 20 years across finance, legal, compliance and operations. Before co-founding E2E she worked at PwC in audit and advisory and then as a finance officer at the Petroleum Planning and Analysis Cell of the petroleum ministry, on deputation from HPCL. At E2E she runs operations, finance, HR and governance, and led its 2018 listing on NSE Emerge and later move to the main board. Her FY26 salary was ₹1.25cr.

people.name: Megha Raheja
people.since: CFO from July 2021; Whole-time Director since December 2024
people.relation: Sister of Whole-time Director Srishti Baweja; sister-in-law of MD Tarun Dua
people.bio: A chartered accountant with over 25 years in finance, covering accounting and reporting, tax, treasury, budgeting and M&A, much of it in IT, IT services and telecom. She joined E2E as CFO in July 2021 and worked on its capital raises, investor relations and deals. She joined the board as a whole-time director in December 2024 and handed the CFO role to Nitin Jain in April 2025. She retires by rotation and is up for re-appointment at the 2026 AGM.

people.name: Nitin Jain
people.bio: A chartered accountant with over two decades in corporate finance, strategy, controllership and commercial operations. He was most recently CFO of Bata Malaysia and before that Finance Controller at Bata India. Earlier he was in EY's audit and consulting practice, auditing clients such as Hindustan Coca-Cola Beverages and Jubilant FoodWorks, and worked on finance projects at HT Media and Macquarie. He became CFO on 18 April 2025.

people.name: Kotapalli Ravoof Mohamed Imran
people.bio: Holds a Master of Science (by research) in information and communication engineering from Anna University, with a thesis on wireless network protocols. He joined E2E in March 2010, in its first year, and runs its cloud computing operations and technology team. He is a long-time user and supporter of open-source software, which E2E's platform is built on.

people.name: Bakshish Dutta
people.bio: An engineering graduate (B.E., AMIE) described by the company as a business leader experienced in driving growth, scaling operations and building sales teams. He was named senior management with effect from 1 July 2025. The company does not name his earlier employers.

people.name: Ronit
people.bio: A qualified company secretary with a law degree (LLB) and qualifications from Delhi University, with over eight years in governance and compliance, earlier in the sugar and automobile industries. He joined E2E on 1 December 2023 and has handled its preferential allotments, listing work, ESOPs and investor relations paperwork.

companies.changes: Megha Raheja stepped down as CFO on 17 April 2025 and Nitin Jain took over the next day. Chief Revenue Officer Kesava Reddy M., who headed sales since 2018, resigned effective 30 June 2026 for personal reasons. Independent directors Naman Sarawagi and Ashish Fafadia left the board in FY26.

companies.styleNote: Founded in 1992 by Diwakar Nigam and T.S. Varadarajan, who are still Chairman & MD and Whole-time Director. Nigam's wife Priyadarshini is also a whole-time director, and their daughter Shubhi Nigam joined the board as a non-executive director in Nov 2025. Day-to-day operations are run by long-serving hired managers: Tarun Nandwani (at Newgen since 1993) became CEO on 1 Aug 2026. Promoters own about 53.5%.

people.name: Diwakar Nigam
people.relation: Co-founder; husband of Whole-time Director Priyadarshini Nigam; father of non-executive director Shubhi Nigam
people.stake: 22.03% (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); with his wife 31.26%; promoters together about 53.5%
people.bio: Holds a B.Sc. from the University of Allahabad, an M.Sc. in mathematics from IIT Delhi and an M.Tech. in computer science from IIT Madras. Before Newgen he founded Softek and was with it for 12 years. He co-founded Newgen in 1992 and has been on its board since 1993, with over 40 years in the IT industry. He is a founding member of NASSCOM, the IT industry body, and sat on its anti-piracy task group. He is 71.

people.name: T.S. Varadarajan
people.relation: Co-founder and promoter; not related to the Nigam family
people.bio: Holds a B.Sc. from Bangalore University, an engineering degree (electrical technology) from the Indian Institute of Science, Bengaluru, and an M.Tech. in computer science from IIT Madras. Before Newgen he promoted Softek Private Limited and was with it for about 12 years. He co-founded Newgen in 1992 and has been a director since incorporation, with over 40 years in software design and development. He is 73.

people.name: Priyadarshini Nigam
people.relation: Wife of Chairman & MD Diwakar Nigam; mother of non-executive director Shubhi Nigam
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's and a master's degree in economics. Before joining the board she was a journalist for over 10 years, writing for South-North News Service and Depthnews Press Foundation Asia. She has been a whole-time director since 1997 and chairs the board's CSR committee. She is 69.

people.name: Tarun Nandwani
people.since: Joined July 1993; COO from Sep 2021; CEO from 1 Aug 2026 (18-month term to 31 Jan 2028)
people.bio: An engineering graduate of Delhi University (Netaji Subhas Institute of Technology), he joined Newgen straight after college in 1993 and has spent his whole 33-year career there.
