He rose through vice-president and senior vice-president (business management) roles to Chief Operating Officer in 2021, running customer relationships, contracts, new business solutions and application development. He was the company's highest-paid employee in FY26 (₹12.2cr). He was promoted to CEO after Virender Jeet resigned, on a fixed 18-month term. He is 54.

people.name: Arun Kumar Gupta
people.bio: A B.Sc. from the University of Calcutta who is also a qualified chartered accountant, company secretary and cost accountant. He has over 30 years in finance, with earlier stints at Maersk, Thermax and Satyam, and joined Newgen from Interra Infotech in 2010. He oversees financial planning, treasury, global tax, investor relations and financial reporting. He is 56.

people.name: Pramod Kumar
people.since: New role from Aug 2026; at Newgen about 27 years
people.bio: A Newgen veteran of about 27 years who has held leadership roles across product management, R&D, strategy, marketing, business development and regional operations. In Aug 2026 he was named to the newly created post of Chief Growth Officer, leading worldwide growth strategy, partnerships, go-to-market and customer acquisition.

people.name: Dr. S.J. Raj (Surender Jeet Raj)
people.role: EVP – Global Business Strategy and HR
people.bio: Holds an M.A. in social work from Jamia Millia Islamia and a Ph.D. from Chandigarh University. Before Newgen he worked with Eicher Goodearth, SRF Nippondenso, PCS Data Products and Semiconductor Complex Limited. He joined in 1993 and runs HR strategy and global operations; he is listed among the company's key management personnel. He is 68.

companies.changes: CEO Virender Jeet (at Newgen since 1992, CEO since 2021) resigned on 9 Jun 2026, effective 31 Aug 2026; COO Tarun Nandwani became CEO from 1 Aug 2026 and Pramod Kumar was named Chief Growth Officer. Shubhi Nigam joined the board as a non-executive director in Nov 2025.

companies.styleNote: Founder Arun Jain (who earlier founded Nucleus Software and Polaris) is Chairman & MD; his brother-in-law Anil Kumar Verma is an executive director. Each product line is run by a hired business CEO, most of them long-time Polaris/Intellect executives. Promoters own 29.6% (Jun 2026), mostly through Polaris Banyan Holding.

people.name: Arun Jain
people.since: Founder; MD re-appointed for five years from Aug 2025
people.relation: Founder and promoter; brother-in-law of Executive Director Anil Kumar Verma
people.stake: 5.41% directly plus 1.51% through Arun Jain HUF (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); promoter company Polaris Banyan Holding holds another 22.81%; promoter group together 29.63% (Jun 2026)
people.bio: An engineering graduate of Delhi College of Engineering (now Delhi Technological University). He co-founded International Information Systems in 1983, which became Nucleus Software Workshop in 1986, and founded Polaris Software Lab in 1993, which grew over 100% a year through the 1990s. Intellect, carved out of Polaris in 2014, is his fourth venture and sells banking and insurance software to over 500 institutions in 62 countries. He mentors government and industry bodies such as the National Software Product Mission and STPI Chennai, and earlier chaired the board of IIIT Ranchi. He founded the Ullas Trust, a student-scholarship charity, in 1997. He is 66.

people.name: Anil Kumar Verma
people.since: Re-appointed for five years from 1 Feb 2026
people.relation: Brother-in-law of Chairman & MD Arun Jain
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's in electrical engineering from IIT Delhi and a postgraduate qualification in instructional design from the University of Wollongong, Australia, with over 40 years in the industry. He built the Polaris (now Intellect) brand in Australia and was founder president of FINDIT, the forum of Indian IT firms that became NASSCOM Australia. He chairs the board's CSR committee. Shareholders approved his continuing as a whole-time director beyond age 70 in Mar 2026.

people.name: Manish Maakan
people.role: Executive President & Group Chief Revenue Officer; CEO, Wholesale Banking
people.bio: Joined Polaris FT in 2007 to lead its product business, whose product was called Intellect, and helped build it in its founding years to $75m of revenue. Before that he was CIO at GE Money, set up the technology centre for Whirlpool's India business, and was a management consultant at E&Y, after starting as a technologist at IBM and other IT companies in the US. He now runs the wholesale (transaction) banking business, which the company says serves 88 corporate banks in 55 countries, and is also group chief revenue officer.

people.name: Rajesh Saxena
people.bio: A mechanical engineering graduate (gold medallist) of BITS Pilani with an MBA in marketing and finance from XLRI. He spent 19 years at Citibank across several countries, the last 10 running product and country P&Ls, and was then CEO of American Express in India, running its credit card business (2008–2011). He joined the Intellect business around 2011 and runs the consumer (retail and core) banking platform.

people.name: Banesh Prabhu
people.bio: Has about 38 years in banking operations and technology, including 23 years at Citibank running operations and technology services across 55+ markets, where he sat on its global consumer planning, IT and operations councils. He then headed the Technology and Operations Group and sat on the executive committee of Siam Commercial Bank in Thailand, and was a senior adviser at Boston Consulting Group. He now leads IntellectAI, the AI-based wealth, insurance and capital-markets platform business.

people.name: Deepak Dastrala
people.since: Joined 2011; Purple Fabric CEO from Jun 2026
people.bio: Holds a B.E. in mechanical engineering from Vellore Institute of Technology and has about 25 years of experience, starting at Premier Technology and Ebix. He joined Intellect in 2011 as an AVP and rose to Partner and EVP–Chief Technology Officer of IntellectAI, leading delivery and innovation at its Intellect SEEC insurance business. In Jun 2026 the company carved Purple Fabric, its enterprise-AI platform, into a separate line of business and made him its CEO, reporting to Arun Jain.

people.name: Vasudha Subramaniam
people.since: CFO since Sep 2023; at Intellect since 2014
people.bio: A chartered accountant and cost accountant with over 20 years in finance. She was at Polaris from 2008 to 2012 leading MIS, then led finance for Standard Chartered Bank's technology unit, and joined Intellect in 2014. She was Senior Vice President and Financial Controller, running business finance, planning, revenue assurance, consolidation and tax, before being made CFO from 1 Sep 2023.

companies.changes: Deepak Dastrala was made CEO of the newly separated Purple Fabric business on 7 Jun 2026. From 1 Jun 2026 Prashant Lalchandani became CTO, Krishna Rajaraman moved to Head – Customer Delivery Experience and Vivek Gupta became Chief Customer Officer. Chief Assurance & Governance Officer Sudha Gopalakrishnan retired on 31 May 2026. John Owen (President, Western Hemisphere) and Kannan Ramasamy (Chief Partner Officer) left on 31 Mar 2026 to cut management layers. Non-executive director Andrew England retired at the Jul 2026 AGM.

companies.styleNote: Founder Bhanu Chopra is Chairman & MD (re-appointed to Aug 2031) and his wife Megha Chopra is an executive director. Sojern, the US ad-tech business bought in FY26, is still run by its own CEO Mark Rabe. Finance has churned: Chetan Garg (ex-Optum India), who joined on 28 Sep 2026, is the third CFO since May 2025. Promoters own 48.8%.

people.name: Bhanu Chopra
people.since: Founder; board since Nov 2012; CMD since Aug 2021, re-appointed to Aug 2031
people.relation: Founder; husband of Executive Director Megha Chopra
people.stake: About 38.3% (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); with his wife about 47.7%; promoter group together 48.77%
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in finance and computer science from Indiana University Bloomington and worked at Deloitte before starting RateGain. He has over 27 years in technology and travel and has run the company since inception, taking it through its 2021 IPO and several acquisitions, including Sojern in FY26. He won 'Founder of the Year' at the Entrepreneur India Startup Awards 2023. In Jul 2026 the board re-appointed him for five more years and sought approval for higher pay benchmarked against promoter MDs of similar companies (FY26 pay ₹3.7cr). He is 50.

people.name: Megha Chopra
people.relation: Wife of Chairman & MD Bhanu Chopra
people.bio: Holds a postgraduate diploma in family business management from NMIMS. Before joining the board she worked with HCL Infosystems. She has over 13 years with the company, is involved in its day-to-day running and chairs the board's CSR committee. She is 46.

people.name: Chetan Garg
people.bio: Holds a B.Tech. from IIT Madras and an MBA in finance from Cornell University. He has about 20 years in finance: consulting at Deloitte India and PwC, vice-president finance roles at Whirlpool in the US and Asia, and most recently CFO of Optum India, part of UnitedHealth Group. He joined RateGain in Noida on 28 Sep 2026 to run global finance, filling the post left vacant when Rohan Mittal resigned in May 2026.

people.name: Mark Rabe
people.since: Sojern CEO since 2011; part of RateGain since the FY26 acquisition
people.bio: Holds an MBA from Duke University and a BA in psychology and economics from Denison University. Before Sojern he held leadership roles at Yahoo! (Managing Director for the UK & Ireland and VP of global sales, 2005–2011), Overture and About Inc. He has run Sojern, a travel-marketing platform, since 2011 and continued as its CEO after RateGain bought it; RateGain has since folded its other marketing-tech units into Sojern.

companies.changes: CFO Rohan Mittal (appointed May 2025) resigned with effect from 8 May 2026; Deputy CFO Ankit Aggarwal covered the role from 9 May 2026 until Chetan Garg joined as CFO on 28 Sep 2026. His predecessor Tanmaya Das left in May 2025. The board re-appointed Bhanu Chopra as CMD for 2026–2031, put to shareholders at the 24 Sep 2026 AGM.

companies.styleNote: Founder-led: co-founder Aneesh Reddy Boddu is MD & CEO, and another founding-team member, Sridhar Bollam, runs North America. The controlling promoter is not a family but a Singapore holding company, Capillary Technologies International (CTIPL), backed by private-equity investors such as Warburg Pincus and Peak XV; it holds 49.7% and the promoter group 52.2% (31 Mar 2026). Aneesh himself owns only about 2%. The board is chaired by an independent director, Neelam Dhawan (ex-HP and Microsoft India). The directors and KMPs are not related to each other.

people.name: Aneesh Reddy Boddu
people.relation: Founder and named promoter; not related to other directors
people.stake: 2.18% (17.33 lakh shares, 31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); promoter CTIPL 49.70%; promoter group together 52.23%
people.bio: Holds a B.Tech. in manufacturing science and engineering from IIT Kharagpur, where he co-founded the Entrepreneurship Cell; the institute gave him its Distinguished Alumnus Award in 2017. He worked at ITC Limited before co-founding Capillary in 2008 with Ajay Modani and Krishna Mehra. He has run the customer-loyalty software company since, through its stock-market listing in FY26. Fortune India named him in its '40 under 40' in 2014, as did The Economic Times in 2017. FY26 pay was ₹1.7cr. He is 42.

people.name: Anant Choubey
people.role: Whole-time Director, Chief Financial Officer & Chief Operating Officer
people.stake: 1.25% before the IPO (DRHP); all non-promoter KMPs together held 1.17% at 31 Mar 2026
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in industrial engineering from IIT Kharagpur. He previously worked at Procter & Gamble Home Products, where in 2008 he won a Special Appreciation Award and was one of the youngest employees to be given shares. At Capillary he is both CFO and COO and sits on the board's audit, CSR and risk committees. FY26 salary was ₹1.4cr, and he holds 8.3 lakh stock options.

people.name: Sridhar Bollam
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in electrical engineering from IIT Kharagpur. He is a founding team member of Capillary and now leads customer relationships in North America. He is named as senior management in the FY26 annual report.

people.name: Rohan Mahadar
people.bio: Holds an engineering degree from Pune Institute of Computer Technology and a postgraduate management degree from the Indian School of Business, Hyderabad. He joined Capillary in Aug 2015 and heads product for its loyalty and customer-engagement platform. He is named as senior management in the FY26 annual report.

people.name: Piyush Kumar
people.bio: Joined Capillary on 1 Aug 2016 and now heads technology and engineering. He is named as senior management in the FY26 annual report.

companies.changes: Head of Finance Ravi Jaswani resigned effective 5 Jun 2026 and Head of Corporate Development Sunil M Jain effective 31 Jul 2026. DP Nambiar joined as CHRO on 29 May 2026. On 1 Sep 2026 the board named seven new senior managers, including Rishi Pratim Ray (finance and corporate development, investor relations) and Sumit Kumar (President, Middle East, Africa & India); Narayanan Alagappan left. Company Secretary Gireddy Bhargavi Reddy now also handles investor relations.

companies.styleNote: The promoter is AceVector (formerly Snapdeal), whose founders Kunal Bahl and Rohit Kumar Bansal sit on the board as non-executive nominee directors; AceVector's CFO Bharat Venishetti is a third nominee. The promoter group holds 36.0% (31 Mar 2026). The business is run by a hired MD & CEO, Kapil Makhija, and the board has been chaired by an independent director, K. Ullas Kamath, since Jul 2026. No directors are related to each other.

people.name: Kapil Makhija
people.stake: 1.15% (12.93 lakh shares) at 31 Mar 2026, cut to 0.19% (2.17 lakh shares) by 13 Aug 2026 (FY26 annual report)
people.bio: Studied computer science and engineering at IIT Delhi and holds a postgraduate diploma in management from IIM Bangalore. He worked at A.T. Kearney, Oracle India and Qwest Software Services before Unicommerce. He has over 20 years in technology, consulting and business leadership, and as MD & CEO runs growth strategy and execution across the three platforms (Uniware, Shipway and Convertway), as well as the technology and corporate functions. The FY26 annual report shows he sold most of his shares between Mar and Aug 2026.

people.name: Anurag Mittal
people.bio: A commerce graduate of Sri Guru Gobind Singh College of Commerce, Delhi University, and a chartered accountant with an IFRS certificate from ICAI and an executive general-management programme from IIM Jammu. He previously worked at Lovelock & Lewis (a PwC member firm), Nokia Siemens, One97 Communications (Paytm), Body Cupid and the promoter AceVector (Snapdeal). He is a KMP and co-signs the company's annual letter to shareholders with the CEO.

people.name: Gaurav Juneja
people.bio: Joined Unicommerce as Chief Revenue Officer during FY26 to drive growth and was designated senior management from 18 Dec 2025. The company has not published further detail on his background in its annual report.

companies.changes: Chairman and independent director Manoj Kumar Kohli resigned effective 4 Jul 2026; independent director K. Ullas Kamath became chairman. Compliance Officer Monish Pal resigned on 13 Aug 2026 (replaced by Sourabh Yadav), and Company Secretary Anil Kumar resigned on 5 Sep 2026. At subsidiary Shipway, whole-time directors Gaurav Gupta and Vikas Garg resigned in Dec 2025.

companies.styleNote: There is no promoter; the company (formerly NSDL e-Governance) is widely held, with institutions as the main owners. Hired managers run it: Ajay Rajan, a banker from YES Bank, became MD & CEO on 1 Jun 2026 after Suresh Sethi left on 1 Apr 2026. Shailesh Haribhakti is non-executive chairman (since Feb 2026). The top team has turned over heavily in the past year.

people.name: Ajay Rajan
people.bio: A banker with over 30 years in corporate, digital and transaction banking. In 8.5 years on YES Bank's senior management team he ran the transaction-banking and digital-banking product units, led the government, multinational and new-economy client businesses, and managed the bank's GIFT City IFSC unit and its mobile and web channels. He also led the bank's work on digital public infrastructure and fintech partnerships. He joined Protean as MD & CEO on 1 Jun 2026 and is already looking at BFSI technology acquisitions. He is 51.

people.name: V Easwaran
people.since: Joined Jan 2025; COO from May 2025; Whole-time Director from Dec 2025; interim CEO Apr–May 2026
people.bio: Holds a B.Sc. in physics, a diploma in computer science and an M.A. in public administration. He has over 30 years in banking and was on the start-up teams of two leading private banks and India Post Payments Bank, where he was Chief Operations Officer for six years. Earlier he worked at Kotak Mahindra Bank, HDFC Bank and Standard Chartered. At Protean he runs business operations; he stood in as interim CEO between Suresh Sethi's exit and Ajay Rajan's arrival. He is 58.

people.name: Sandeep Mantri
people.bio: A chartered accountant and US certified public accountant who is an alumnus of Berkeley Haas and IIM Calcutta. He has about 25 years in finance and was previously EVP & CFO of Datamatics Global Services. He joined Protean in Aug 2024 as CFO. He is 51.

people.name: Rakesh Dosi
people.bio: Holds a B.E. and a PGDM. He is listed in the FY26 annual report's management team as Chief Business & Product Officer, overseeing the company's business lines and products. He is 50.

people.name: Dr. Harpreet Singh Anand
people.role: Chief Human Resources Officer and Chief Growth & Marketing Officer
people.bio: Has over 20 years of experience in HR, business transformation and marketing at ICICI Prudential, Aditya Birla Group, Kotak Life Insurance and India Post Payments Bank. At India Post Payments Bank he led the digital retraining of over 300,000 postal employees and was head of marketing from Dec 2019 to Oct 2021. At Protean he runs HR and administration, and since Jun 2026 also marketing and growth.

companies.changes: MD & CEO Suresh Sethi left the board on 1 Apr 2026; V Easwaran was interim CEO until Ajay Rajan joined on 1 Jun 2026. CTO Dattaram Mhadgut resigned effective 18 Jun 2026. Mitesh Shah became Chief Information Officer on 5 Mar 2026. During FY26 the Whole-time Director & COO Jayesh Sule (Jul 2025), Chief Digital & AI Officer Metesh Bhati (Dec 2025), Chief Product & Innovation Officer Bertram D'Souza (Dec 2025) and Chief Growth & Marketing Officer Gaurav Ramdev (Oct 2025) also left.

companies.styleNote: Co-founder Paresh Zaveri is Chairman & MD. Fellow founding member Amit Sheth is Co-Chairman but non-executive. The business is run day to day by a hired Vice Chairman & Group CEO, Ashish Rai (ex-FIS), who is also the second-largest individual shareholder, with three business presidents under him. Promoters hold 26.85% (31 Mar 2026). None of the directors are related to each other. Both Zaveri and Rai are based in Singapore and are paid by the Singapore subsidiary.

people.name: Paresh Zaveri
people.relation: Co-founder and promoter; not related to other directors
people.stake: 15.46% (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); promoter group together 26.85%
people.bio: Holds an engineering degree and an MBA in finance. He co-founded Aurionpro in 1997 and has shaped its strategy since, mixing organic growth with a string of acquisitions, and chose the markets to enter and the companies to buy. He now focuses on day-to-day executive, financial and business operations and guides the senior team. He has over 28 years in corporate finance, supply chain, general management and strategic planning. He is based in Singapore and chairs the board's risk committee.

people.name: Ashish Rai
people.stake: 6.99% (38.68 lakh shares, 31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); not classed as a promoter
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in computer engineering from Bhopal University and an MBA from an Indian Institute of Management. He has over 25 years building fintech and enterprise software businesses, with leadership roles at FIS, Sungard, Finastra and Coforge. He joined Aurionpro from FIS, where he was Group MD for Asia-Pacific and the Middle East & Africa. As Group CEO he runs the banking, fintech and technology-innovation businesses. He is based in Singapore.

people.name: Vipul Parmar
people.bio: The company's CFO and a key managerial person; he co-signs the CEO/CFO certification with Ashish Rai. The annual report does not give further background on him; his pay rose 18% in FY26.

people.name: Shekhar Mullatti
people.bio: Heads the Banking Solutions Group, the banking-software business. He is named as senior management in the FY26 annual report; the company does not publish further detail on his background there.

people.name: Sanjay Bali
people.bio: Heads the Tech Innovation Group. He is named as senior management in the FY26 annual report; the company does not publish further detail on his background there.

people.name: Sanjay Varma
people.role: President & Global Head – Fintech Solutions Group
people.bio: Heads the Fintech Solutions Group. He is named as senior management in the FY26 annual report; the company does not publish further detail on his background there.

companies.changes: No executive, KMP or senior-management changes were filed with NSE between Mar and Sep 2026. On the board, independent director Frank Osusky left on 17 Sep 2025 and Hong Guan Bernard Chew joined.

companies.styleNote: Both named promoters run the company: Raj P Narayanam is Executive Chairman and Avinash Ramesh Godkhindi is MD & CEO (re-appointed for two years to May 2028). They are not related to each other or to any other director. Promoters own 44.3% (Jun 2026). A permanent Group CFO, Venkatesh Ramachandran (ex-Biological E), joined on 18 May 2026 after six weeks with an interim CFO.

people.name: Raj P Narayanam
people.relation: Promoter; not related to other directors
people.stake: 34.39% (4.62 crore shares, 31 Mar 2025, FY25 annual report; FY26 report not yet filed); promoters together 44.30% (Jun 2026)
people.bio: Holds a postgraduate diploma in business management (finance) from FORE School of Management, New Delhi, and a postgraduate diploma in computer systems; he has also done short online programmes from Wharton and MICA, and received an honorary D.Litt. from Chitkara University in 2024. He has been on the board since Apr 2012 and is the largest shareholder. He has a background in technology and fintech and invests in companies at various stages. He was 55 in 2025.

people.name: Avinash Ramesh Godkhindi
people.since: Board since May 2012; MD & CEO re-appointed 7 May 2026 – 6 May 2028
people.relation: Promoter; not related to other directors
people.stake: 5.72% (76.75 lakh shares, 31 Mar 2025, FY25 annual report)
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's in engineering from Bangalore University and an MBA from the University of Chicago Booth School of Business; he has also done Cornell's Chief AI Officer certificate programme. Before Zaggle he was an Assistant Vice President at Citibank N.A., India. He has been on the board since 2012 and runs the business as MD & CEO. He won The Economic Times 'Inspiring CEO' award in 2022, and in 2025–26 its 'Impactful CEO' (soonicorn category) and ET Now's 'CEO of the Year'. Shareholders re-appointed him in May 2026 for only two years.

people.name: Venkatesh Ramachandran
people.bio: A finance professional with over 27 years across pharmaceuticals, life sciences, vaccines, logistics, IT services, retail, telecom and infrastructure. Most recently he was CFO of vaccine maker Biological E. Before that he was Director and Group CFO of NTC Logistics, and CFO of Aragen Life Sciences and of Prolifics Corporation; earlier he held finance roles at Spencer's Retail, Hutchison Essar and IL&FS. His experience covers M&A, IPOs, private equity, capital raising and restructuring.

companies.changes: CFO Venkata Aditya Kumar Grandhi resigned on 3 Apr 2026; Rajesh Tummalaganti was interim CFO until 17 May 2026 and stays as Deputy CFO. Venkatesh Ramachandran joined as Group CFO on 18 May 2026. CTO Srikanth Gaddam resigned, last day 27 May 2026. On 14 Aug 2026 director Arun Vijaykumar Gupta was re-designated from independent to non-independent non-executive director. The FY26 annual report had not been filed on NSE by 29 Sep 2026, so stakes are from the FY25 report.

companies.styleNote: Co-founder Vishnu R Dusad is Managing Director and his daughter Dr Ritika Dusad is an executive director (on sabbatical). A long-serving insider, Parag Bhise, is CEO, and a hired CFO joined in October 2025. The chair, Yasmin Javeri Krishan, is independent (since March 2026). Promoters, including the family holding company Karmayogi Holdings (33.59%) and Madhu Dusad (11.44%), own 73.59%.

people.name: Vishnu R Dusad
people.since: Board since January 1989 (co-founder); MD since January 1997
people.relation: Co-founder and promoter; father of Executive Director Dr Ritika Dusad
people.stake: 5.98% (15,75,325 shares, FY26 annual report); promoter group together 73.59%, including Karmayogi Holdings (33.59%, where he is a director) and Madhu Dusad (11.44%)
people.bio: Holds a B.Tech from IIT Delhi. He started out as an entrepreneur in 1983 and co-founded Nucleus Software in 1986, working with Indian banks and lenders in the late 1980s. He led the building of the LeaseWare and FinnOne lending products, which took the company into more than 50 countries. He has been MD since January 1997 and briefly also acted as interim CFO from August to October 2025. He is 69; shareholders are being asked to let him continue as MD beyond age 70. He is a director of the promoter company Karmayogi Holdings and of the Indian Software Product Industry Round Table (iSPIRT) Foundation.

people.name: Parag Bhise
people.role: Chief Executive Officer and Whole-time Director
people.since: Joined about 1990; board since March 2020; CEO since April 2021
people.relation: Not related to any director
people.bio: Holds a master's in computer applications from BIT Mesra and an MBA from MDI Gurgaon, plus a professional certificate in innovation and technology from MIT. He has spent more than three decades at Nucleus in product development, delivery, IT infrastructure and quality. He delivered the company's first lending-product order in Indonesia in 1992, led lending-platform projects for Citibank and SAMBA, and built the Shinsei Bank partnership in Japan. He was Head of Delivery before succeeding R P Singh as CEO in April 2021. Shareholders re-appointed him as whole-time director and CEO for 1 April 2026 to 31 March 2028. He is 60.

people.name: Dr Ritika Dusad
people.since: Board since July 2016; whole-time director since 2020
people.relation: Daughter of MD Vishnu R Dusad
people.bio: Studied at UCLA and earned a PhD in physics at Cornell University, where her thesis won the Springer Thesis Award. She then did postdoctoral research on quantum magnetism at Lawrence Berkeley National Lab. She joined the board as a non-executive director in July 2016, became a whole-time director in 2020, and led global marketing, strategy and data-driven innovation. She was re-appointed for 2025–2030. She has been on sabbatical since 2024; in March 2026 the board extended it by up to one more year.

people.name: Ashok Kumar Bhura
people.relation: Not related
people.bio: A Chartered Accountant and B.Com from St. Xavier's College, Kolkata, with an executive programme from IIM Ahmedabad. He has more than 25 years in finance. He spent over 18 years at Bharti Airtel, latest as Vice President and Head of Financial Reporting and as Chief Risk Officer. Earlier he worked at the Binaykia Group and The Oodlabari Co. He joined Nucleus as CFO on 1 October 2025, filling a gap after the previous CFO left in May 2025.

people.name: Anurag Mantri
people.role: Chief Operating Officer and Country Head, Singapore
people.relation: Not related
people.bio: Holds a postgraduate degree in statistics and a postgraduate diploma in computer science applications, both from Banaras Hindu University. He joined Nucleus in 1994 and has worked across professional services, sales and customer service. He led the digital services business and ran large transformation programmes for clients, and drove FinnOne Neo and FinnAxia sales in South-East Asia. He left the board on 18 December 2025 when his term as whole-time director ended, but remains COO.

companies.changes: CFO Surya Prakash Kanodia resigned in May 2025; the MD was interim CFO until Ashok Kumar Bhura joined on 1 Oct 2025. Anurag Mantri left the board in Dec 2025 (still COO). Independent director S M Acharya retired as chairman in March 2026; Yasmin Javeri Krishan became chair. Dr Ritika Dusad's sabbatical was extended in March 2026. Senior management since the annual report: CMO Aabhinna Khare resigned in Jun 2026; Bhavit Godiwala joined as Chief Customer Success Officer (22 Jun 2026) and Sudhanshu Tripathi as CMO (21 Sep 2026).

companies.styleNote: Founder V Srinivasan is Executive Chairman and takes ₹1 a year in pay. His sons run the business lines: Kaushik (products and India, whole-time director from April 2026) and Arvind (international markets, on the board from April 2026). There is no separate CEO or MD. Promoters own 54.4%, including Taarav Pte Ltd (16.72%) and Mythili Srinivasan (15.40%).

people.name: Venkatraman Srinivasan
people.since: Chairman since June 2008; Executive Chairman since November 2021
people.relation: Founder and promoter; father of Kaushik and Arvind Srinivasan
people.stake: 17.36% (1,43,72,543 shares, FY26 annual report); promoter group together 54.4%
people.bio: A mathematics graduate of the University of Madras (first rank). He is also a rank-holding chartered accountant, a cost accountant and a company secretary, and attended the Kellogg executive programme. Before eMudhra he was a senior general manager at ICICI and then MD and global CEO of 3i Infotech, the company eMudhra was spun out of. He has chaired eMudhra since 2008. Shareholders re-appointed him for five years from May 2026, when he turned 70, at ₹1 a year. He chairs the Asia PKI Consortium and the India PKI Forum. Investors should note the continuing legal dispute with 3i Infotech; he has confirmed a personal stake in Capital MXT, which bought 3i Infotech shares.

people.name: Kaushik Srinivasan
people.role: Whole-time Director and EVP – Products and India (co-founder)
people.relation: Son of Executive Chairman V Srinivasan; brother of Arvind Srinivasan
people.bio: Holds bachelor's and master's degrees in computer engineering from Stevens Institute of Technology, New Jersey, and is a CFA charterholder. He worked in US finance, first at UBS Wealth Management and then as a quantitative analyst at the hedge fund Trafelet Delta Funds. He joined eMudhra in 2015 as head of the Technology Solutions Group. He now leads product development, engineering and professional services for identity, authentication and e-signature products, and India sales. He became a whole-time director and KMP on 1 April 2026 for five years. He was a Businessworld 40 under 40 winner in 2024.

people.name: Arvind Srinivasan
people.since: At eMudhra DMCC, Dubai since 2017; board since 1 April 2026
people.relation: Son of Executive Chairman V Srinivasan; brother of Kaushik Srinivasan
people.bio: Holds a master's in finance from the University of Michigan and an MBA from Saïd Business School, Oxford. He began at Barclays Capital in treasury and then on the commodities desk in New York. Since 2017 he has run eMudhra's international business from Dubai, taking it into more than 40 countries. He is paid by the Dubai subsidiary (AED 40,000 a month), not by the listed company.

people.name: Venu Madhava
people.role: Whole-time Director and EVP – Legal, GRC and HR
people.relation: Not related to any director
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's in commerce and a bachelor's in law, both from Kuvempu University. He spent over 13 years as legal manager at Adecco India. At eMudhra he runs legal, governance, risk and compliance, and HR, and sits on the board as a whole-time director and KMP. He retires by rotation at the 2026 AGM and was up for re-election.

people.name: Ritesh Raj Pariyani
people.relation: Not related
people.bio: A chartered accountant and company secretary with about 13 years in business finance, including plant controlling, financial reporting, governance and audit. Before eMudhra he was senior manager, finance at AXA Business Services. He has led finance ERP and digital projects. He was appointed CFO and KMP on 5 February 2024.

companies.changes: Kaushik Srinivasan (whole-time director) and Arvind Srinivasan (director) joined the board on 1 Apr 2026; the chairman was re-appointed from 26 May 2026. No KMP resignations since the annual report.

companies.styleNote: The three co-founders still run the company: Baskar Subramanian is MD & CEO, his wife Srividhya Srinivasan is CTO, and Arunachalam Srinivasan Karapattu leads global business from the US. But the founders own only 14.92% together (including Vinculum Advisors LLP); funds and institutions own most of it, and two venture investors (Accel, Norwest) have nominee directors. The chair, Giridhar Sanjeevi, is independent.

people.name: Baskar Subramanian
people.since: Board since February 2008 (co-founder); MD & CEO since July 2025
people.relation: Co-founder and promoter; husband of CTO Srividhya Srinivasan
people.stake: 4.42% (95,65,092 shares, FY26 annual report); founders together 14.92%
people.bio: Holds a B.E. from Government College of Technology, Coimbatore. Before co-founding Amagi in 2008 he was Chief Technology Officer of ImpulseSoft and earlier worked at Texas Instruments (India). He has over 24 years in technology and media and has led Amagi's product, engineering and sales as it grew into a global cloud TV-software company that listed in 2026. He was re-designated MD & CEO in July 2025. In August 2026 the board re-appointed him for five years from 1 December 2026, subject to shareholder approval; his FY26 pay was ₹3.59cr. He is 52.

people.name: Srividhya Srinivasan
people.relation: Co-founder and promoter; wife of MD & CEO Baskar Subramanian
people.bio: Holds a B.E. from Government College of Technology, Coimbatore. Before Amagi she was technical marketing officer at ImpulseSoft and earlier worked at Texas Instruments (India). She has over 23 years in technology and broadcasting and co-founded Amagi in 2008. She was a whole-time director but left the board on 22 May 2025 when it was reshaped for listing. She remains CTO and is named as senior management.

people.name: Arunachalam Srinivasan Karapattu
people.relation: Co-founder and promoter; the company says he is not related to the other directors
people.bio: Holds a B.E. from Government College of Technology, Coimbatore. Before Amagi he was a programme manager at ImpulseSoft, senior manager (business development) at SiRF Technologies, senior engineer at Integrated Decisions and Systems, and a software design engineer at Texas Instruments (India). He has over 23 years in technology and broadcasting. He sits on the board as a non-executive director but works full-time as President, Global Business, employed and paid by the US subsidiary Amagi Corporation.

people.name: Vijay N P
people.relation: Not related
people.bio: Holds an MBA from the National Institute of Technology, Tiruchirappalli, and a B.Com from the University of Mumbai. He has more than 15 years in finance. Before Amagi he was a senior finance manager at Amazon Web Services India and earlier worked at General Electric. He joined as CFO in January 2023 and took Amagi through its 2026 IPO.

people.name: Rajagopal Govindakrishnan
people.relation: Not related
people.bio: Holds a master's in computer applications from Gujarat University and a B.Sc. from Sri Sathya Sai Institute of Higher Learning. He has over 25 years in engineering and software. He joined Amagi on 1 October 2021 and is part of the named senior management.

people.name: N Prasad
people.relation: Not related
people.bio: Holds a B.E. in mechanical engineering from Madurai Kamaraj University. He has over 25 years in human resources. He joined Amagi on 18 July 2022 and is part of the named senior management.

companies.changes: Srividhya Srinivasan left the board in May 2025 (remains CTO). Baskar Subramanian's re-appointment as MD & CEO from 1 Dec 2026 needs shareholder approval. No senior-management changes in FY26.

companies.styleNote: MapmyIndia is run by the founding Verma family. Co-founder Rakesh Verma is Chairman & MD; his wife and co-founder Rashmi Verma is executive director and CTO; their son Rohan Verma returned as Joint MD from 1 July 2026; their daughter Rakhi Prasad is a non-executive director. Rakesh and Rashmi own 50.89%. Hired managers run finance and the business units.

people.name: Rakesh Kumar Verma
people.relation: Co-founder; husband of Rashmi Verma; father of Rohan Verma and Rakhi Prasad
people.stake: 41.39% (2,26,63,080 shares, FY26 annual report); with his wife 50.89%
people.bio: Holds a B.E. (Hons.) in mechanical engineering from BITS Pilani (1972) and an MBA from Eastern Washington University, USA (1979). He worked at General Motors in the US before returning to India in 1990 to start the company with his wife. He built MapmyIndia with little outside capital and took it public in 2021. He has chaired FICCI's geospatial committee and been president of the Survey and Mapping Association of India, and pushed for the opening up of India's mapping sector. He is 75 and is also a director of subsidiaries Gtropy Systems and Mappls DT.

people.name: Rashmi Verma
people.since: Co-founder; current whole-time director term from May 2024
people.relation: Co-founder; wife of Rakesh Kumar Verma; mother of Rohan Verma and Rakhi Prasad
people.bio: Holds a B.E. with distinction from IIT Roorkee (1977) and an MS from Eastern Washington University, USA (1979). She worked for 12 years in the US, starting as a software engineer at IBM and becoming a consultant to IBM Global Business Services. She returned to India in the early 1990s and co-founded the company with her husband. She built the digital-mapping foundation and the mapping and GIS teams, and leads technology and HR. Her current five-year service contract runs from May 2024. She is 70.

people.name: Rohan Verma
people.since: Board since July 2007; CEO until March 2025; Joint MD since 1 July 2026
people.relation: Son of Rakesh Kumar Verma and Rashmi Verma; brother of director Rakhi Prasad
people.bio: Holds a B.S. in electrical engineering from Stanford University (2007) and an MBA from London Business School (2015). He built the first mapmyindia.com portal at 19 and later served as CEO and whole-time director. He stepped down as CEO on 31 March 2025 to start a separate consumer venture, in which the company agreed to take a 10% stake, and stayed on as a non-executive director. In May 2025 he became MD of the subsidiaries Mappls DT and Gtropy. The board made him Joint MD and KMP from 1 July 2026 for five years, to lead products, partnerships and growth. He is 40.

people.name: Anuj Kumar Jain
people.relation: Not related
people.bio: The company's CFO and KMP, now also CFO for the group companies. He is a graduate of the University of Rajasthan and is a director of KOGO Tech Labs and VidTeq (India). The annual report does not give more of his background.

people.name: Sapna Ahuja
people.role: Chief Operating Officer & President, Automotive Business
people.relation: Not related
people.bio: Named in the FY26 annual report as senior management, running operations and the automotive business (maps and navigation for carmakers). The annual report does not give her background, so none is shown here.

people.name: Ankeet Bhat
people.relation: Not related
people.bio: Named in the FY26 annual report as senior management, running the enterprise business. The annual report does not give his background, so none is shown here.

companies.changes: Rohan Verma stepped down as CEO on 31 Mar 2025 and was appointed Joint MD from 1 Jul 2026 (shareholder approval sought). After year-end, Shishir Kumar Verma was made COO and CHRO of subsidiaries Gtropy and Mappls DT, and Rishin Kalra CTO of Gtropy.

companies.styleNote: NPST is run by its co-founders, who are business partners, not a family: Deepak Chand Thakur is Chairman, MD & CEO and Ashish Aggarwal is Joint MD. The third co-founder, Savita Vashist, the largest single shareholder (24.11%), resigned as executive director in August 2026 for health reasons. The company says none of the directors are related. Promoters own 60.52%.

people.name: Deepak Chand Thakur
people.since: Board since July 2014; CMD since October 2020
people.relation: Co-founder and promoter; not related to other directors
people.stake: 18.17% (37,89,487 shares, FY26 annual report); promoters together 60.52%
people.bio: Holds a master's in marketing management and a B.Com, both from the University of Mumbai. Before NPST he was General Manager – Business Strategy at Spanco Ltd and a senior research analyst at Frost & Sullivan. He has over 21 years of experience, mainly in strategy and fintech. He co-founded NPST and runs the business, growth and strategy. He was re-appointed CMD for five years from 20 October 2025. He is 44.

people.name: Ashish Aggarwal
people.since: Board since November 2014; Joint MD since October 2020
people.relation: Co-founder and promoter; not related to other directors
people.bio: A chartered accountant and cost accountant, with a B.Com from the University of Delhi and an M.Com from Dr. Bhimrao Ambedkar University, Agra. He was General Manager – Accounts and Finance at Spanco Ltd, and earlier worked at Richa Knits. He has over 21 years in finance and heads NPST's finance and business operations, including working capital and funding. He was re-appointed Joint MD for five years from 20 October 2025. He is 48.

people.name: Inder Kumar Naugai
people.relation: Not related
people.bio: CFO and KMP since 26 August 2020; he handles the company's finance and accounts and signs the CFO certification with the CMD. The annual reports do not give his education or earlier employers.

people.name: Rajiv Beri
people.relation: Not related
people.stake: About 1.29% (2,70,000 shares; top-ten shareholder list, FY26 annual report)
people.bio: Named as senior management and CTO in the FY25 and FY26 annual reports, and one of the company's ten largest shareholders. The annual reports do not give his background.

people.name: Prashant Vaddadi Rao
people.relation: Not related
people.bio: Named as senior management, heading business operations, in the FY25 and FY26 annual reports. The annual reports do not give his background.

people.name: Pavan Kumar
people.relation: Not related
people.bio: Named as senior management and Chief Product Officer in the FY25 and FY26 annual reports. The annual reports do not give his background.

companies.changes: Co-founder Savita Vashist (executive director, 24.11% holder) resigned from the board on 24 Aug 2026 for personal health reasons. Independent director Abhishek Mishra left in Apr 2026; Vijay Kumar Singh joined as independent director.

companies.styleNote: A founder-run company: Trishneet Arora, who started it in 2013, is Chairman and CEO (proposed as Chairman & MD from September 2026), and his father Charanjit Singh is whole-time director. Promoters own about 56.65%, almost all held by Trishneet. The FY26 secretarial audit found the company had lent money to both of them in breach of company law; the loans were repaid by year-end.

people.name: Trishneet Arora
people.role: Chairman, Executive Director & CEO (founder); proposed Chairman & Managing Director
people.relation: Founder and promoter; son of Whole-time Director Charanjit Singh
people.stake: 53.79% (1,13,10,460 shares, FY26 annual report); promoter group together about 56.65%
people.bio: The company describes him as a school dropout who taught himself cybersecurity and founded TAC Security in 2013. He has about 14 years in the field and built the company around low-cost vulnerability-management software (ESOF) sold to thousands of small clients abroad. He appeared on Forbes Asia's 30 Under 30 (2018) and Fortune's 40 Under 40 list (2019). He took no pay in FY26; the board has proposed him as Chairman & MD and CEO for five years from 2 September 2026 at nil pay. Investors should note that the FY26 secretarial audit found a company loan to him, given against pay he had waived, broke the Companies Act; the company says it has been repaid. He is 33.

people.name: Charanjit Singh
people.relation: Father of Chairman & CEO Trishneet Arora
people.bio: Described in the AGM notice only as a businessman and whole-time director; the company gives no education or earlier career. He has been on the board since 1 August 2016 and was paid ₹25 lakh in FY26. The FY26 secretarial audit found that the company had also lent money to him in breach of company law; the company says the loan was repaid by year-end. He retires by rotation at the 2026 AGM and is seeking re-appointment. He is 60.

people.name: Malkit Singh Bharaj
people.relation: Not related
people.bio: CFO and KMP since 7 December 2024; he signs the financial statements with the Chairman and the whole-time director. The annual report and website do not give his education or earlier employers.

companies.changes: Company Secretary Chinmay Chokshi resigned in Mar 2026; Preeti Rathi was appointed in Jun 2026. Trishneet Arora's appointment as Chairman & MD from 2 Sep 2026 is up for shareholder approval at the 2026 AGM. Hector Balderas, a former New Mexico Attorney General, joined as an independent director in May 2026.

companies.styleNote: A family-run company: Chairperson Shashi Soni, her son Sanjay Soni (Managing Director) and his wife Kiran Soni (CFO and whole-time director) hold all three executive board seats, and the family owns 34.79%. The overseas business is led by Tej Soni as CEO, izmo Global, and the chip unit izmo Microsystems by COO Dinanath Soni; the annual report names them as core management but does not state any family link, so none is claimed here.

people.name: Sanjay Soni
people.since: Board since April 1999; has headed the company since it was set up (1995)
people.relation: Promoter; son of Chairperson Shashi Soni; husband of CFO Kiran Soni
people.stake: 3.68% (5,50,661 shares, FY26 annual report); family together 34.79%
people.bio: A commerce graduate who has completed a postgraduate programme at IIM Bangalore and studied IT for over a decade. He has led the company since its incorporation in 1995, building the automotive web, CRM and car-image business in the US and Europe and, more recently, the izmo Microsystems chip-packaging unit. He has international finance and banking experience and has written books in these areas. His current term as MD runs from April 2025 to September 2027; he drew ₹9.19 lakh a month in FY26. He is 58.

people.name: Kiran Soni
people.relation: Wife of MD Sanjay Soni; daughter-in-law of Chairperson Shashi Soni
people.bio: A graduate of Sydenham College, Mumbai, and a chartered accountant. She joined the company in 1995 as a corporate analyst, later became CFO and KMP, and was made a whole-time director in August 2020. She has about 33 years of experience in the company. The 2026 AGM is asked to re-appoint her as whole-time director from 27 September 2026 to 26 September 2029; her FY26 pay was ₹3 lakh a month. She is 58.

people.name: Shashi Soni
people.since: One of the first directors; current term October 2025 to September 2028
people.relation: Promoter; mother of MD Sanjay Soni; mother-in-law of CFO Kiran Soni
people.bio: A graduate with about 48 years of business experience across entertainment, industrial gases and transport before and alongside izmo. She is one of the company's first directors and has chaired it from the start, with a focus on HR and administration. She is a Padma Shri recipient. She was re-appointed whole-time director for October 2025 to September 2028 at the age of 84.

companies.changes: No KMP resignations since the annual report. The board approved Kiran Soni's re-appointment as whole-time director (announced 14 Aug 2026) for shareholder approval at the 2026 AGM; Sanjay Soni retires by rotation and seeks re-appointment.

companies.styleNote: Part of Harsh Goenka's RPG group. Chairman H. V. Goenka and his son, Vice Chairman Anant Goenka, are non-executive directors; the business is run by a hired CEO and MD, Manish Tandon, with a hired COO and CFO. Five of the eight directors are independent. Promoters own 48.99%.

people.name: Manish Tandon
people.role: Chief Executive Officer and Managing Director
people.since: CEO and MD since January 2023 (five-year term)
people.stake: 3,43,086 shares, about 0.15% (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report)
people.bio: An alumnus of an IIT and an IIM, with over 27 years in IT services. He spent about 20 years at Infosys, where he led a global business of more than $2 billion across healthcare, financial services, insurance, life sciences and technology, and sat on the boards of Infosys Lodestone and Infosys Public Services. He was then CEO of US-based CSS Corp, where the company credits him with a turnaround, and advised US private-equity firms. He is the only executive on Zensar's board. He is paid through the US subsidiary, Zensar Technologies Inc.

people.name: Vijayasimha (Vijay) Alilughatta
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in computer science and engineering from Bangalore University and has over 27 years in IT services. He spent 18 years at Infosys in delivery, practice, pre-sales and sales roles. At Wipro he was Global Delivery Head of the $2.5 billion banking and financial-services unit, and then COO of its largest global business line (over 100,000 people), where he set up the operating model. At Zensar he runs delivery and operations from Bengaluru.

people.name: Pulkit Bhandari
people.role: Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer
people.bio: A chartered accountant with over 20 years across start-ups, corporates, investment banking and advisory. He was Head of Group Corporate Finance at the RPG group from 2014 to 2023, so he knows the promoter group well. He then was CFO of Zetwerk Manufacturing, a contract-manufacturing company, before joining Zensar. His areas include M&A, strategy, capital raising, ESG and investor relations, relevant as the company weighs a large acquisition.

companies.changes: Independent director Harsh Mariwala left the board on 17 Apr 2026. Senior VP Rajat Sharma (head of growth and platforms) resigned in 2026; Brahma Pandey joined as Senior VP on 15 Jun 2026. No change in CEO, COO or CFO.

companies.styleNote: Run by its three co-founders, school and college friends from Indore who started it in 1999–2000: Siddharth Sethi (MD and CEO), Avinash Sethi (Director and CFO) and Mitesh Bohra (Executive Director and President). The two Sethis are not related, and the annual report discloses no family ties among directors. The other three directors are independent. Promoters own 72.82% and may sell or pledge up to 3% until October 2026.

people.name: Siddharth Sethi
people.role: Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer; co-founder
people.since: Co-founder (2000); director since March 2011; MD since February 2015; reappointed for 2026–2031
people.relation: Co-founder and promoter; not related to Avinash Sethi despite the shared surname
people.stake: 2,37,20,504 shares, 24.46% (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); promoter group together 72.82%
people.bio: Holds a degree in electrical engineering from SGSITS, Indore, and an MBA from IIM Indore. After college he joined Tata Motors in Jamshedpur, moved to its IT division in Mumbai, and worked at a start-up in the US before returning to India in 2002 to build InfoBeans. He runs global software delivery and business development in Europe and the Middle East. Shareholders reappointed him as MD for five years from February 2026, with 90.7% of votes in favour.

people.name: Avinash Sethi
people.role: Director and Chief Financial Officer; co-founder
people.since: Co-founder; on the board since March 2011
people.relation: Co-founder and promoter; not related to Siddharth Sethi
people.bio: Holds a degree in electrical engineering from SGSITS, Indore, and an MBA from IIM Indore. He began his career at TCS and later worked for Intel in Portland, US, before co-founding InfoBeans, which started in his home garage in Indore. He is the CFO and handles people, finance and acquisitions. He is 54 and retires by rotation at the 2026 AGM, seeking reappointment.

people.name: Mitesh Bohra
people.relation: Co-founder and promoter
people.bio: An engineering graduate of SGSITS, Indore, and a school friend of Avinash Sethi. He started at Tata Infotech and worked in New Jersey before co-founding InfoBeans. He leads R&D, AI stewardship and global leadership development, and has looked after US business development. His pay comes from the US subsidiary.

people.name: Harmeet Bhatia
people.bio: Has 31 years in sales, marketing and business development, according to the annual report. He was hired in January 2025 to lead sales in the Americas, the company's largest market, as part of its push to add US clients.

companies.changes: Siddharth Sethi was reappointed MD for five years from Feb 2026 (approved by postal ballot in May 2026). Independent director Shilpa Saboo left in Jul 2025 at the end of her term. No KMP resignations found since the annual report.

companies.styleNote: Founded by Ashank Desai (Chairman) and Ketan Mehta, who are both non-executive directors. The business is run by Group CEO Umang Nahata, the founder of Evosys, which Mastek bought in 2020; he is not classed as a promoter but is its largest individual non-promoter shareholder. Promoters own 35.77%.

people.name: Umang Nahata
people.role: Whole-time Director and Group Chief Executive Officer
people.since: Joined 2020 (Evosys acquisition); board since 2023; CEO since January 2025
people.bio: A chartered accountant with over two decades in IT services. He founded Evosys (Evolutionary Systems), which grew into one of the largest Oracle Cloud partners and was bought by Mastek in 2020. At Mastek he first ran the Oracle practice, then served as CEO of the Oracle business and President of North America, APAC and the Middle East. He joined the board as a non-executive director in 2023 and became CEO in January 2025. His large shareholding came from the Evosys sale.

people.name: Deepak Kedia
people.bio: A chartered accountant and CPA (Australia), and an alumnus of the University of Cambridge's sustainable finance programme. He has over 20 years in finance leadership at Motorola Solutions, Hewlett-Packard, NTT Ltd and Wipro, and at private-equity-backed technology companies. He was CFO of Markets and Markets before joining. He followed a short stint by Raghvendra Jha, who joined as CFO in May 2025 and left in July 2025.

people.name: Amit Gajwani
people.bio: Has over 28 years in business growth, strategy and large operations. At LTM Limited he built the Europe, UK and Nordics unit into a high-growth vertical and earlier led its media and entertainment and travel verticals. Before that he was Executive Vice President at Cybage, handling global sales, delivery portfolios and key accounts. He replaced Prameela Kalive, who retired.

people.name: Abhishek Singh
people.since: President since May 2022; earlier Mastek's CFO
people.bio: Holds an MBA in finance from IMDR and a B.Com from Patna University, with over two decades in IT, healthcare, financial services and BPM. He spent over nine years at Firstsource Solutions, rising to Senior VP and Group Finance Controller, and worked at Tech Mahindra. He was Mastek's CFO before taking over the UK, Ireland and Europe P&L in 2022, including Oracle services. This region is about two-thirds of revenue, including the UK government and NHS work.

companies.changes: CFO Raghvendra Jha joined 19 May 2025 and resigned 11 Jul 2025; Deepak Kedia became CFO on 11 Nov 2025. CHRO Arvind Jonnalagadda resigned 16 Oct 2025. COO Prameela Kalive handed over to Amit Gajwani on 18 May 2026 and retired at the end of June 2026. Company Secretary Dinesh Kalani retired Aug 2025.

companies.styleNote: Part of the CK Birla group. Chairman Amita Birla and her husband CK Birla are non-executive directors; the business is run by a hired CEO and MD, Angan Guha, the only executive on the board. Top management has turned over heavily: a new CFO (Aug 2025), CEO-Americas (Oct 2025), COO and CHRO (Apr 2026). Promoters (National Engineering Industries and Central India Industries) own 40.4%.

people.name: Angan Guha
people.role: Chief Executive Officer and Managing Director
people.since: CEO and MD since 1 December 2022; reappointed for two years from 1 December 2025
people.bio: An electronics engineer from the University of Pune who also completed an executive management programme at the University of Chicago's Booth School of Business. Before Birlasoft he was at Wipro, where he was CEO of the Americas 2 strategic market unit and sat on its Executive Board and Group Executive Council. He is based in the US and is also paid by the US subsidiary. Shareholders renewed his term in November 2025 for only two years, and he was granted 950,000 performance share units in December 2025.

people.name: Chandrasekar Thyagarajan
people.since: CFO since 8 August 2025 (second stint; earlier CFO 2020–2023)
people.bio: A chartered accountant with over 36 years in finance, more than 20 of them in CXO roles. He spent about two decades at IBM across India, South Asia and global growth markets. He was Birlasoft's CFO from 2020 until he resigned in early 2023, then CFO of Greaves Electric Mobility, before returning in August 2025 to replace Kamini Shah. His experience covers restructuring, M&A integration and private-equity and IPO funding.

people.name: Vikram Puranik
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in electronics and telecommunications engineering and a postgraduate degree in computer software engineering, with over 25 years in engineering services. He came from GlobalLogic, where he was Chief of Engineering Delivery and Operations and a P&L owner, running digital engineering for Fortune 500 and technology clients in payments, retail and edtech, and building India delivery centres. At Birlasoft he is charged with delivery, margins and productivity.

people.name: Komal Jain
people.bio: Holds an electronics engineering degree from NIT Kurukshetra and an MBA from IIM Calcutta, with more than two decades in technology, strategy, sales and marketing. Before Birlasoft he was Senior Vice President and head of the high-tech, media and entertainment vertical at Infosys. Based in Dallas, he runs the US, Canada and Latin America business, about 83% of revenue.

companies.changes: CFO Kamini Shah left 7 Aug 2025. COO Selvakumaran Mannappan, CHRO Priti Kataria and CEO-Rest of World Manjunath Kygonahally all left on 31 Mar 2026; Arun Rao returned as CHRO from 1 Apr 2026. Chief Strategy Officer Ankur Vaish resigned effective 19 Sep 2026.

companies.styleNote: Controlled by Blackstone, which took control from the founding promoters and owns 51.85%. Blackstone's nominees sit on the board as non-executive directors; the company is run by a hired MD and CEO, Nitesh Bansal, with a long-serving CFO and COO. The annual report says key managerial staff together held 0.17% at 31 Dec 2025.

people.name: Nitesh Bansal
people.role: Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer
people.bio: A chartered accountant who has taken executive courses at INSEAD and Stanford Graduate School of Business. He spent 23 of his 25 years before R Systems at Infosys, working in India, Europe and the US, and was last Senior Vice President and Global Head of Engineering Services. Blackstone brought him in as CEO soon after taking control. He was granted 2,841,546 performance-linked restricted stock units in January 2024.

people.name: Nand Sardana
people.bio: A chartered accountant, cost and management accountant and company secretary. He joined R Systems in 2000 and has worked across finance, accounting, tax, investor relations, M&A, fund raising and private-equity financing. He has stayed on under Blackstone, giving continuity through the ownership change.

people.name: Avirag Jain
people.since: With the company since 1997; COO since 17 May 2025
people.bio: Holds a science degree and an MBA in finance and international business from IMT Ghaziabad, plus a postgraduate diploma in cyber laws. He has over 32 years of experience and has been with R Systems since 1997, running large onsite and offshore projects in banking, telecom and healthcare. He was Chief Technology Officer and Executive Vice President before being made COO after Mandeep Sodhi left in April 2025.

companies.changes: COO Mandeep Sodhi left 1 Apr 2025; Avirag Jain became COO. Farooq Ahmad joined as Chief Revenue Officer on 30 Mar 2026. Company Secretary Bhasker Dubey left May 2026 and his successor Piyush Jain resigned effective 24 Aug 2026. The board was reshaped on 29 Jun 2026 with Shailesh Kekre as chairperson; Blackstone nominee Mukesh Mehta resigned.

companies.styleNote: A state-owned company under the Ministry of Railways: the President of India owns 72.84%. There is no family promoter. The Ministry appoints the Chairman & MD and the functional directors (finance; projects, operations and maintenance; network planning and marketing), who are career railway officers or long-serving RailTel managers. Part-time government nominee directors from the Railway Board and independent directors complete the board.

people.name: Sanjai Kumar
people.since: CMD since 23 September 2022; with RailTel since 2002
people.stake: 6,000 shares, a negligible fraction of equity (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report)
people.bio: An electronics and telecommunication engineering graduate from the University of Allahabad, he joined the Indian Railway Service of Signal Engineers in 1992. On the North Eastern Railway he worked on train operations and signalling, including panel interlocking at more than 50 stations. He then took a full-time PGDM from MDI Gurugram and joined RailTel on deputation in 2002, being absorbed in 2008, so he has been with it from its early years. He helped build the National Knowledge Network with NIC. Before becoming CMD he was Director (Network Planning & Marketing), with extra charge of projects and operations.

people.name: V. Rama Manohara Rao
people.bio: A 1998-batch officer of the Indian Railway Accounts Service. He holds an M.Sc. in physics from Sri Venkateswara University and did a postgraduate public policy and management programme at IIM Bangalore and the Maxwell School, Syracuse (US). He served as Senior Divisional Finance Manager in three railway divisions and as Director Finance in the Railway Board, working on the Union rail budget. On deputation to Andhra Pradesh he was Special Commissioner and Group Director Finance at the AP Capital Region Development Authority and Secretary, Municipal Administration and Urban Development.

people.name: Manoj Tandon
people.stake: 225 shares, negligible (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report)
people.bio: Holds a B.E. in electronics from Maulana Azad College of Technology (now MANIT), Bhopal. Before RailTel he worked at several telecom companies on greenfield network rollouts and network automation. At RailTel he was Group General Manager (Operations) and headed the RailWire retail broadband business, which crossed half a million customers on his watch. He now oversees project execution, the network operations centres and maintenance, the part of the business where low-margin projects are growing fastest.

people.name: Yashpal Singh Tomar
people.bio: Holds an M.Tech from IIT Kanpur and joined the Indian Railway Service of Signal Engineers in 1992. He worked on the Central, North Central and South Central Railways, at the research body RDSO in Lucknow and at the signal and telecom training institute IRISET in Secunderabad, in operations, projects, R&D and training. He had an earlier stint at RailTel as Group General Manager, and was Divisional Railway Manager of the Palghat division before taking this post. He is responsible for network planning, sales and marketing.

companies.changes: Government nominee director Rameshwar Meena was replaced by Rajesh Gupta (Railway Board) on 10 Aug 2026. Independent director Dr Subhash Sharma left on 15 Apr 2026 at the end of his term. No change among the CMD and functional directors found.

companies.styleNote: Founder-led but not family-controlled. Co-founders Srikanth Velamakanni (Group Chief Executive and Executive Vice-Chairman) and Pranay Agrawal (CEO of the US subsidiary, which earns most of the revenue) run it. Srikanth's wife Chetana Kumar is Chief Sustainability Officer, and Pranay's father and wife are also named promoters. Promoters together own only 16.68%; investors such as TPG and public holders own the rest. Most directors are independent or investor nominees.

people.name: Srikanth Velamakanni
people.role: Whole-time Director, Group Chief Executive and Executive Vice-Chairman; co-founder
people.relation: Co-founder and promoter; husband of Chief Sustainability Officer Chetana Kumar
people.stake: 73,95,590 shares, 4.30% (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); promoters together 16.68%
people.bio: Holds a B.Tech in electrical engineering from IIT Delhi and a PGDM from IIM Ahmedabad. Before co-founding Fractal in 2000 he worked at ICICI Bank and ANZ Investment Bank. He leads the Fractal group and is responsible for client partnerships and revenue growth. He chairs NASSCOM, co-founded Plaksha University, and is an independent director of ideaForge, NIIT and Dr. Reddy's Laboratories. Before the IPO, 1.87% of the company's shares held by him were pledged for a personal loan; they were released for the IPO lock-in and the prospectus said he may re-pledge them.

people.name: Pranay Agrawal
people.role: Non-Executive Director; Chief Executive Officer, Fractal Analytics Inc. (US); co-founder
people.relation: Co-founder and promoter; son of promoter Narendra Kumar Agrawal and husband of promoter Rupa Krishnan Agrawal
people.stake: 81,21,360 shares, 4.72% (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report), of which 33,32,940 are beneficially owned by the Agrawal Family Trust; his father holds 3.47% and his wife 0.48%
people.bio: Holds a B.Com from Bangalore University and a PGDM from IIM Ahmedabad, and is a certified Financial Risk Manager (GARP). Before Fractal he worked at ICICI Bank and ANZ Grindlays Bank. He runs the US subsidiary, the company's main operating arm, and is paid by it rather than by the listed company. IIM Ahmedabad gave him its Young Alumni Achiever award in 2018–19.

people.name: Ajoy Singh
people.bio: Holds a B.Tech in mechanical engineering from IIT Delhi and a postgraduate diploma in computer-aided management from IIM Calcutta. Before Fractal he worked at GE Countrywide Consumer Financial Services as AVP-risk and at Standard Chartered Investments & Loans. He builds the company's AI, cloud and data capabilities and heads functional practices such as supply chain, marketing effectiveness and personalisation.

people.name: Natwar Mall
people.since: With the company since February 2006; in this role since 3 June 2026
people.bio: Holds a B.Tech in mechanical engineering from IIT Bombay and a postgraduate diploma in computer-aided management from IIM Calcutta. He worked at Hindustan Lever, Infosys and Kotak Securities before joining Fractal in 2006. He led the financial services and insurance practice for years and was redesignated Chief Transformation Officer in June 2026.

people.name: Matthew Gennone
people.role: Chief Commercial Officer and CEO, Cogentiq
people.since: With Fractal USA since December 2018; in this role since 30 April 2026
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in psychology from West Virginia University. Before Fractal he was a digital strategy senior manager at Accenture and worked at Antuit. He built and led the healthcare and life-sciences practice at Fractal USA before being made Chief Commercial Officer and head of Cogentiq, the company's agentic-AI platform, in April 2026.

people.name: Chetana Kumar
people.since: Employee since October 2020 (pro bono CSR consultant from 2017)
people.relation: Promoter; wife of co-founder Srikanth Velamakanni
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in social and legal sciences and a law degree from the University of Pune, and a diploma in international business from Symbiosis Institute of International Business. She previously worked at e-Serve International. She advised Fractal pro bono on CSR from 2017 and joined as an employee in 2020; she heads its CSR and sustainability work.

companies.changes: CFO and Group CFO Ashwath Bhat, appointed 1 Aug 2025, resigned on 6 Jul 2026 and left on 24 Jul 2026; no successor had been named when the note was written. Chief Growth Officer Shailendra Pratap Singh (May 2026) and Chief Design Officer Raja Rajeswari Aradhyula (Apr 2026) left senior management; CPGR practice head Mrunali Majmudar left in Mar 2026.

companies.styleNote: Founded in 2011 by Ashok Soota (a Mindtree co-founder), who is still Executive Chairman and Chief Mentor and the controlling shareholder. Day-to-day it is run by co-founder Joseph Anantharaju (Co-Chairman and CEO) and Venkatraman Narayanan (MD); neither is related to Soota or to each other. Promoters own 44.21%. Under the merger agreed on 31 Aug 2026 it will fold into ITC Infotech, and Soota is selling about half his holding to ITC Infotech for cash, so control and the top roles are likely to change once the deal closes.

people.name: Ashok Soota
people.since: Founder (2011); whole-time director reappointed to March 2029
people.relation: Founder and promoter
people.stake: 4,92,45,787 shares, 32.77% in his own name; with Ashok Soota Medical Research LLP (11.94%), 44.13% (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report)
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in electrical engineering from the University of Roorkee (now IIT Roorkee) and an MBA from the Asian Institute of Management, Philippines. He co-founded Mindtree, which listed in 2007, and then founded Happiest Minds, which listed in 2020. He has been President of the Confederation of Indian Industry and a member of the Prime Minister's Task Force for IT. He also set up SKAN, a non-profit for medical research on ageing and neurological disorders, in 2021. Shareholders approved his continuing as a whole-time director beyond the age of 70.

people.name: Joseph Anantharaju
people.since: Joined 2011; board since November 2020; CEO since March 2025; reappointed to November 2030
people.relation: Co-founder; not related to any director or KMP
people.bio: Holds a BE from BITS Pilani and a PGDM from IIM Ahmedabad, and has over 30 years in technology. He began in banking and manufacturing, then led Microsoft business at Aztecsoft and, after Mindtree bought it, ran Mindtree's Microsoft business unit (about 8% of its revenue). He joined Happiest Minds at its start in 2011, built the product engineering unit, became Executive Vice Chairman in 2020 and Co-Chairman and CEO in March 2025. He is 55.

people.name: Venkatraman Narayanan
people.since: Joined April 2015; MD since November 2020 (was also CFO until June 2025); reappointed to November 2030
people.bio: A fellow chartered accountant with degrees in commerce and law, and over 25 years in general management, operations, finance and legal work. He was CFO of Mindtree, Transworks Information Services, Perot Systems TSI (India), TeamLease Services and Sonata Software, and earlier Director of Operations at Oracle and a consultant at Arthur Andersen. He joined Happiest Minds in 2015 and was MD and CFO from 2020 until a separate CFO was hired in June 2025.

people.name: Anand Balakrishnan
people.bio: A chartered accountant, cost accountant and US CPA with a commerce degree from Bangalore University, and over 20 years in finance. He spent six years in senior finance roles at listed IT firm Mindteck, where the company credits him with helping return it to profit, and earlier worked at Marsh McLennan (formerly JLT) and GE Healthcare.

companies.changes: Executive Director Rajiv Shah (head of the GBS unit) left the board on 31 Dec 2025 and senior management on 31 Mar 2026. Anand Balakrishnan became CFO in Jun 2025, taking the role from MD Venkatraman Narayanan. The company agreed on 31 Aug 2026 to merge into ITC Infotech (25 ITC Infotech shares for every 81), subject to approvals.

companies.styleNote: Founded by the husband-and-wife team A. V. Venkatraman (known as Venkat Viswanathan; Executive Chairperson) and Pramadwathi (Pramad) Jandhyala (Whole-time Director), who together own 65.1%. Both are executive directors, but day-to-day management is with a hired CEO: Sonal Ramrakhiani replaced Rajan Sethuraman on 15 Jul 2026. The other five directors are independent.

people.name: A. V. Venkatraman (Venkat Viswanathan)
people.since: Founder; on the board since January 2007; reappointed as whole-time director for 2026–2031
people.relation: Founder and promoter; husband of Whole-time Director Pramadwathi Jandhyala
people.stake: 11,79,06,923 shares, 56.98% (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); with his wife, 65.1%
people.bio: An engineer from IIT Madras with an MBA from IIM Calcutta. Before founding LatentView he worked at Cognizant Technology Solutions, Moody's ICRA and the Essar Group. He is the controlling shareholder and chairs the board; he announced the change of CEO in July 2026. He is 55.

people.name: Pramadwathi (Pramad) Jandhyala
people.since: Co-founder; on the board since January 2006; reappointed for 2026–2031
people.relation: Co-founder and promoter; wife of Executive Chairperson A. V. Venkatraman
people.bio: An engineer from BITS Pilani with an MBA from IIM Calcutta. Before co-founding LatentView she worked at IBM, Ford, Moody's ICRA and Kotak Mahindra Bank. She chairs the board's CSR committee and retires by rotation at the 2026 AGM, seeking reappointment. She is 53.

people.name: Sonal Ramrakhiani
people.bio: Studied at St. Xavier's College and the Nirma Institute of Management, Ahmedabad, and is an alumna of the Tata Administrative Service, with over 20 years of leadership experience. She worked at TCS and Tata Teleservices, then at Tata Technologies as COO and President of Sales (Automotive). Most recently she led Wipro's Engineering Edge business in the Americas. She sits on the board of Titan North America and is based in the US.

people.name: Rajan Bala Venkatesan
people.bio: A commerce graduate from Hindu College and a chartered accountant, with earlier experience in banking, financial services and consulting, according to the company. He is one of the three key managerial personnel and sits on the board's banking and authorisation committee.

people.name: Venky Ramesh
people.role: Chief Client Officer – Consumer, Retail & Marketplaces
people.bio: A mechanical engineer from the College of Engineering, Guindy, with an MBA from IIM Ahmedabad. He previously worked at Infosys, Capgemini and EPAM. He was hired after Chief Client Officer Krishnan Venkata resigned in September 2025, to lead the consumer, retail and marketplace clients.

companies.changes: CEO Rajan Sethuraman (CEO since 2019, through the IPO and the Decision Point purchase) handed over to Sonal Ramrakhiani on 15 Jul 2026 and stays as Strategic Advisor to the CEO for up to six months. Chief Client Officer Krishnan Venkata resigned Sep 2025. Independent directors Dipali Sheth and Mukesh Butani completed their terms in Jun–Jul 2026.

companies.styleNote: The Rajan Raheja family are the promoters with 28.17%; Viren Raheja sits on the board as a non-executive promoter director and no family member holds an executive role. The chairman, Sanjay Asher, is non-executive. The company is run by professionals: Executive Vice Chairman P. Srikar Reddy (with Sonata since 1986 and CEO 2012–2022) and a new CEO, Rajsekhar Datta Roy, who took over on 9 May 2026 after MD and CEO Samir Dhir left at the end of his term.

people.name: Rajsekhar Datta Roy
people.since: CEO since 9 May 2026 (three-year term); earlier Chief Technology Officer and Chief Delivery Officer
people.bio: Has more than 30 years of experience scaling technology practices and running global delivery for large enterprise clients. At Sonata he built the Microsoft Dynamics and Microsoft practices into industry offerings, led delivery across product engineering and enterprise systems, and drove the AI-first push including the Harmoni.AI platform. He was Senior Vice President and CTO as of March 2026, became Chief Delivery Officer from 1 April 2026, and was named CEO weeks later. He is not on the board.

people.name: P. Srikar Reddy
people.role: Executive Vice Chairman and Whole-time Director
people.since: With Sonata since 1986; CEO 2012–2022; reappointed whole-time director from 4 April 2026
people.stake: 30,10,431 shares, about 1.07% (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report)
people.bio: An engineering graduate of the Regional Engineering College (now NIT) Trichy with a postgraduate degree in management from IIM Calcutta. He has spent his whole career at Sonata since 1986 and was its CEO from 2012 to 2022, a period in which the company says revenue and profit multiplied and market value rose more than twentyfold. As Executive Vice Chairman he is now the only executive on the board, and signs the company's financial certifications with the CFO. He is also a non-executive director of Palred Technologies.

people.name: Jagannathan C N
people.role: Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer
people.bio: A commerce graduate from the University of Madras and a fellow chartered accountant and cost accountant, with more than two decades in finance. He was CFO of Carborundum Universal and of Mindtree, and earlier held finance roles at Bharti Airtel, HCL Technologies, Hindustan Powerplus and Ashok Leyland. His remit covers risk, tax, treasury, investor relations, internal audit and company secretarial work.

people.name: Sujit Mohanty
people.role: Managing Director & CEO, Sonata Information Technology Ltd (India business)
people.bio: Holds an MBA from XIM Bhubaneswar and has over 30 years in IT, almost all at Sonata, where he headed product marketing and product support before taking charge of the India business. He runs the Indian resale of Microsoft and cloud licences, about three-quarters of group revenue at thin margins. Before Sonata he worked at ACE in Hyderabad.

people.name: Suresh H P
people.since: COO since 1 April 2026 (earlier Executive Vice President and Chief Delivery Officer)
people.bio: Was Executive Vice President and Chief Delivery Officer during FY26 and took the new COO role from 1 April 2026, as part of the reshuffle that preceded the CEO change.

companies.changes: MD and CEO Samir Dhir did not seek renewal and left the board on 8 May 2026; Rajsekhar Datta Roy became CEO on 9 May 2026. From 1 Apr 2026 Suresh H P became COO and Manu Swami CTO. CHRO Balaji Kumar resigned in May 2025 and rejoined in Mar 2026.

companies.styleNote: Founder Aditya Krishna is Chairman and MD and, directly and through Sak Industries, controls the company.
